Código completo — V54

<!doctype html>
<html lang="pt-BR">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Teacher Platform · V47 Separated Content</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Plus+Jakarta+Sans:wght@600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2">
/* TIC TASK ENGINE V2 — additive upgrade: preserves existing task system */
(function(){
  const CEFR=['A0','A1','A2','B1','B2','C1','C2'];
  const SKILLS=['Grammar','Vocabulary','Reading','Listening','Speaking','Writing','Pronunciation','Integrated Skills'];
  const TASK_LEVELS=[['quick','⚡ Quick Task','3–5 min'],['lesson','📘 Lesson Task','10–20 min'],['assessment','🎯 Assessment','20–60 min']];
  const TYPES=[['multiple_choice','🔘 Multiple Choice'],['true_false','✅ True / False'],['fill_blank','✍️ Fill in the blank'],['short_answer','📝 Short Answer'],['word_order','🔤 Word Order']];
  window.__ticTaskQuestions=window.__ticTaskQuestions||[];
  const uid=()=> 'q_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,9)+Date.now().toString(36).slice(-4);
  const val=id=>document.getElementById(id)?.value||'';
  const checked=id=>!!document.getElementById(id)?.checked;

  function questionTypeLabel(t){return (TYPES.find(x=>x[0]===t)||['','Question'])[1]}
  function normalizeQuestions(q){
    if(!Array.isArray(q))return [];
    return q.map(x=>({id:x.id||uid(),type:x.type||'multiple_choice',prompt:x.prompt||'',options:Array.isArray(x.options)?x.options:[],answer:x.answer??'',points:Number(x.points||1),placeholder:x.placeholder||''}));
  }
  function renderBuilder(){
    const box=document.getElementById('taskQuestionBuilder');if(!box)return;
    box.innerHTML=window.__ticTaskQuestions.length?window.__ticTaskQuestions.map((q,i)=>`
      <article class="task-q-card" data-qid="${q.id}">
        <div class="task-q-head"><div><span class="task-q-number">${i+1}</span><b>${questionTypeLabel(q.type)}</b></div><div class="task-q-actions"><button type="button" class="icon-btn" onclick="ticMoveQuestion('${q.id}',-1)" title="Subir">↑</button><button type="button" class="icon-btn" onclick="ticMoveQuestion('${q.id}',1)" title="Descer">↓</button><button type="button" class="icon-btn danger" onclick="ticRemoveQuestion('${q.id}')" title="Excluir">×</button></div></div>
        <div class="field"><label>Enunciado</label><textarea class="tq-prompt" rows="2" placeholder="Ex.: Choose the correct answer.">${esc(q.prompt)}</textarea></div>
        <div class="form-grid">
          <div class="field"><label>Tipo</label><select class="tq-type">${TYPES.map(t=>`<option value="${t[0]}" ${q.type===t[0]?'selected':''}>${t[1]}</option>`).join('')}</select></div>
          <div class="field"><label>Pontos</label><input class="tq-points" type="number" min="1" value="${q.points||1}"></div>
        </div>
        <div class="tq-specific">${renderSpecific(q)}</div>
      </article>`).join(''):`<div class="task-builder-empty"><div>🧩</div><b>Nenhuma questão criada</b><span>Adicione questões ou use o editor HTML abaixo.</span></div>`;
    box.querySelectorAll('.task-q-card').forEach(card=>{
      card.querySelector('.tq-type').addEventListener('change',e=>{const q=window.__ticTaskQuestions.find(x=>x.id===card.dataset.qid);if(q){q.type=e.target.value;q.options=q.options||[];renderBuilder()}});
      card.querySelector('.tq-prompt').addEventListener('input',e=>{const q=window.__ticTaskQuestions.find(x=>x.id===card.dataset.qid);if(q)q.prompt=e.target.value});
      card.querySelector('.tq-points').addEventListener('input',e=>{const q=window.__ticTaskQuestions.find(x=>x.id===card.dataset.qid);if(q)q.points=Number(e.target.value||1)});
      card.querySelectorAll('[data-opt-index]').forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('input',e=>{const q=window.__ticTaskQuestions.find(x=>x.id===card.dataset.qid);if(q)q.options[Number(e.target.dataset.optIndex)]=e.target.value}));
      const ans=card.querySelector('.tq-answer');if(ans)ans.addEventListener('input',e=>{const q=window.__ticTaskQuestions.find(x=>x.id===card.dataset.qid);if(q)q.answer=e.target.value});
      card.querySelectorAll('.tq-answer-select').forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('change',e=>{const q=window.__ticTaskQuestions.find(x=>x.id===card.dataset.qid);if(q)q.answer=e.target.value}));
    });
  }
  function renderSpecific(q){
    if(q.type==='multiple_choice'){
      const opts=[0,1,2,3].map(i=>`<div class="inline-option"><input data-opt-index="${i}" value="${esc(q.options?.[i]||'')}" placeholder="Opção ${i+1}"><span><input class="tq-answer-select" type="radio" name="ans_${q.id}" value="${i}" ${String(q.answer)===String(i)?'checked':''}> correta</span></div>`).join('');
      return `<div class="field"><label>Alternativas <small>Marque a correta</small></label>${opts}</div>`;
    }
    if(q.type==='true_false')return `<div class="field"><label>Resposta correta</label><select class="tq-answer-select"><option value="true" ${String(q.answer)==='true'?'selected':''}>Verdadeiro</option><option value="false" ${String(q.answer)==='false'?'selected':''}>Falso</option></select></div>`;
    if(q.type==='fill_blank')return `<div class="field"><label>Resposta esperada</label><input class="tq-answer" value="${esc(q.answer||'')}" placeholder="Ex.: goes"></div>`;
    if(q.type==='short_answer')return `<div class="field"><label>Resposta / palavras-chave</label><input class="tq-answer" value="${esc(q.answer||'')}" placeholder="Opcional: resposta esperada ou palavras-chave"></div>`;
    if(q.type==='word_order')return `<div class="field"><label>Frase correta</label><input class="tq-answer" value="${esc(q.answer||'')}" placeholder="Ex.: I study English every day."></div>`;
    return '';
  }
  window.ticAddQuestion=function(type='multiple_choice'){window.__ticTaskQuestions.push({id:uid(),type,prompt:'',options:['','','',''],answer:'',points:1});renderBuilder()};
  window.ticRemoveQuestion=function(id){window.__ticTaskQuestions=window.__ticTaskQuestions.filter(q=>q.id!==id);renderBuilder()};
  window.ticMoveQuestion=function(id,dir){const i=window.__ticTaskQuestions.findIndex(q=>q.id===id),j=i+dir;if(i<0||j<0||j>=window.__ticTaskQuestions.length)return;[window.__ticTaskQuestions[i],window.__ticTaskQuestions[j]]=[window.__ticTaskQuestions[j],window.__ticTaskQuestions[i]];renderBuilder()};
  window.ticAddQuestionMenu=function(){openModal('➕ Adicionar questão',`<div class="task-type-grid">${TYPES.map(t=>`<button class="task-type-choice" onclick="closeModal();ticAddQuestion('${t[0]}')"><b>${t[1]}</b><small>Adicionar ao Task Builder</small></button>`).join('')}</div>`) };
  window.ticQuestionsJson=function(){return {version:2,questions:window.__ticTaskQuestions.map(q=>({...q,options:q.options||[]}))}};
  window.ticLoadQuestions=function(data){window.__ticTaskQuestions=normalizeQuestions(data?.questions||[]);renderBuilder()};

  window.openAssignmentForm=async function(x=null){
    const [{data:students,error},{data:classes}]=await Promise.all([
      sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name,current_level').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active').order('display_name'),
      sb.from('tic_classes').select('id,name,level').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active').order('name')
    ]);
    if(error)return toast('Não foi possível carregar os alunos: '+error.message,'error');
    let existing={};
    if(x?.id){const {data:a}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').select('cefr_level,skill,task_level,content_json').eq('id',x.id).maybeSingle();existing=a||{}}
    ticLoadQuestions(existing.content_json||x?.content_json||{});
    openModal(x?'✏️ Editar Task':'✨ Criar nova Task',`<form class="task-builder-form" onsubmit="saveAssignmentV2(event,'${x?.id||''}')">
      <div class="task-wizard-head"><div><span class="eyebrow">TASK BUILDER</span><h2>${x?'Editar tarefa':'Criar uma tarefa'}</h2><p>Monte a atividade, teste como aluno e depois distribua.</p></div><div class="task-wizard-progress"><span class="active">1</span><i></i><span class="active">2</span><i></i><span>3</span></div></div>
      <section class="task-builder-section"><div class="task-section-title"><span>01</span><div><b>Identidade pedagógica</b><small>Organize a Task por CEFR, habilidade e finalidade.</small></div></div>
        <div class="task-hero-grid"><div class="field"><label>Título da tarefa</label><input id="a1" value="${esc(x?.title||'')}" placeholder="Ex.: Present Simple · Daily Routine" required></div><div class="field"><label>Imagem de capa</label><input id="aCover" value="${esc(x?.cover_image_url||'')}" placeholder="URL da imagem (opcional)"></div></div>
        <div class="form-grid four"><div class="field"><label>CEFR</label><select id="aCefr">${CEFR.map(v=>`<option ${v===(existing.cefr_level||'A1')?'selected':''}>${v}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Skill</label><select id="aSkill">${SKILLS.map(v=>`<option ${v===(existing.skill||'Grammar')?'selected':''}>${v}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Nível da Task</label><select id="aTaskLevel">${TASK_LEVELS.map(v=>`<option value="${v[0]}" ${v[0]===(existing.task_level||'lesson')?'selected':''}>${v[1]} · ${v[2]}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Tipo principal</label><select id="a3">${['assignment','quiz','speaking','writing','listening','reading','project','audio','file'].map(v=>`<option value="${v}" ${v===(x?.assignment_type||'assignment')?'selected':''}>${v}</option>`).join('')}</select></div></div>
      </section>
      <section class="task-builder-section"><div class="task-section-title"><span>02</span><div><b>Instruções</b><small>Explique claramente o que o aluno precisa fazer.</small></div></div><div class="field"><textarea id="a2" rows="3" placeholder="Ex.: Read the sentences and choose the correct answer.">${esc(x?.instructions||'')}</textarea></div></section>
      <section class="task-builder-section"><div class="task-section-title"><span>03</span><div><b>Questões interativas</b><small>Crie exercícios sem precisar escrever HTML.</small></div><button type="button" class="btn primary" onclick="ticAddQuestionMenu()">＋ Adicionar questão</button></div><div id="taskQuestionBuilder"></div></section>
      <section class="task-builder-section"><div class="task-section-title"><span>04</span><div><b>HTML avançado</b><small>Preserva seu editor HTML atual para atividades especiais.</small><label class="switchline"><input id="aHtmlEnabled" type="checkbox" ${x?.html_enabled?'checked':''} onchange="$('assignmentHtmlBox')?.classList.toggle('hidden',!this.checked)"> Ativar HTML interativo</label></div></div><div id="assignmentHtmlBox" class="advanced-html ${x?.html_enabled?'':'hidden'}"><textarea id="aHtmlContent" rows="12" placeholder="Cole aqui seu HTML interativo...">${esc(x?.html_content||'')}</textarea><div class="builder-actions"><button type="button" class="btn secondary" onclick="previewAssignmentHtml()">👁 Preview</button><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="ticPreviewTaskBuilder()">🎓 Ver como aluno</button><label class="switchline"><input id="aMulti" type="checkbox" ${x?.allow_multiple_attempts!==false?'checked':''}> Permitir múltiplas tentativas</label></div></div></section>
      <section class="task-builder-section"><div class="task-section-title"><span>05</span><div><b>Configuração</b><small>Prazo, pontos e prioridade.</small></div></div><div class="form-grid three"><div class="field"><label>Prazo</label><input id="a5" type="datetime-local" value="${x?.due_at?new Date(x.due_at).toISOString().slice(0,16):''}"></div><div class="field"><label>Pontos</label><input id="a6" type="number" min="0" value="${x?.points??10}"></div><div class="field"><label>Prioridade</label><select id="a4"><option value="low" ${x?.priority==='low'?'selected':''}>Baixa</option><option value="normal" ${!x||x?.priority==='normal'?'selected':''}>Normal</option><option value="high" ${x?.priority==='high'?'selected':''}>Alta</option></select></div></div></section>
      <section class="task-builder-section"><div class="task-section-title"><span>06</span><div><b>Materiais e recursos</b><small>Continue usando os recursos existentes.</small></div></div><div class="resource-box"><div class="resource-head"><b>📚 Recursos</b><button type="button" class="btn secondary" onclick="addResourceRow('aResources')">＋ Adicionar recurso</button></div><div id="aResources"></div></div></section>
      <section class="task-builder-section"><div class="task-section-title"><span>07</span><div><b>Distribuição</b><small>${x?'As atribuições existentes serão preservadas.':'Escolha aluno(s) ou uma turma.'}</small></div></div>${x?'<div class="notice">📌 Editar a Task não remove as atribuições já existentes. Use <b>Atribuir</b> na lista para adicionar novos alunos.</div>':`<div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Destino</label><select id="a7type" onchange="renderAssignmentTarget()"><option value="students">👤 Aluno(s)</option><option value="class">🏫 Turma inteira</option></select></div><div class="field"><label>Notificação</label><select id="a7notify"><option value="none">Somente plataforma</option><option value="whatsapp">📱 Preparar WhatsApp</option></select></div></div><div id="a7target"></div>`}</section>
      <div class="task-sticky-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button type="button" class="btn secondary" onclick="ticPreviewTaskBuilder()">👁 Ver como aluno</button><button class="btn primary" id="assignmentSaveBtn">💾 Salvar Task</button></div>
    </form>`);
    renderResourceRows('aResources',x?.resource_items||[]);if(!x)renderAssignmentTarget();renderBuilder();
  };

  window.saveAssignmentV2=async function(e,id){
    e.preventDefault();const btn=$('assignmentSaveBtn');if(btn){btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='Salvando...'}
    const questions=ticQuestionsJson();
    const o={teacher_id:session.user.id,title:val('a1').trim(),instructions:val('a2').trim(),assignment_type:val('a3'),priority:val('a4'),due_at:val('a5')?new Date(val('a5')).toISOString():null,points:Number(val('a6')||0),resource_items:collectResources('aResources'),cover_image_url:val('aCover').trim()||null,html_enabled:checked('aHtmlEnabled'),html_content:checked('aHtmlEnabled')?(val('aHtmlContent')||''):null,allow_multiple_attempts:document.getElementById('aMulti')?.checked!==false,active:true,cefr_level:val('aCefr')||'A1',skill:val('aSkill')||'Grammar',task_level:val('aTaskLevel')||'lesson',content_json:questions};
    let r=id?await sb.from('tic_assignments').update(o).eq('id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).select().single():await sb.from('tic_assignments').insert(o).select().single();
    if(r.error){if(btn){btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='💾 Salvar Task'}return toast('Não foi possível salvar: '+r.error.message,'error')}
    if(!id){let studentIds=[],classId=null;if(val('a7type')==='class'){classId=val('a7class')||null;if(!classId)return toast('Selecione a turma.','error');const {data:members,error:me}=await sb.from('tic_class_students').select('student_id').eq('class_id',classId).eq('status','active');if(me){await sb.from('tic_assignments').delete().eq('id',r.data.id);return toast(me.message,'error')}studentIds=(members||[]).map(m=>m.student_id)}else studentIds=[...($('a7students')?.selectedOptions||[])].map(o=>o.value);studentIds=[...new Set(studentIds)].filter(Boolean);if(!studentIds.length){await sb.from('tic_assignments').delete().eq('id',r.data.id);return toast('Selecione pelo menos um aluno ou uma turma.','error')}if(classId){const ur=await sb.from('tic_assignments').update({class_id:classId}).eq('id',r.data.id);if(ur.error){await sb.from('tic_assignments').delete().eq('id',r.data.id);return toast(ur.error.message,'error')}}const rows=studentIds.map(student_id=>({assignment_id:r.data.id,student_id,status:'pending',active:true}));const rr=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').insert(rows);if(rr.error){await sb.from('tic_assignments').delete().eq('id',r.data.id);return toast('A tarefa foi criada, mas não foi vinculada aos alunos: '+rr.error.message,'error')}}
    closeModal();toast(id?'Task atualizada.':'Task criada e distribuída.','success');loadView('assignments');
  };

  window.ticPreviewTaskBuilder=function(){
    const data={id:'preview',title:val('a1')||'Task Preview',instructions:val('a2'),cefr_level:val('aCefr'),skill:val('aSkill'),task_level:val('aTaskLevel'),points:Number(val('a6')||0),html_enabled:checked('aHtmlEnabled'),html_content:val('aHtmlContent'),resource_items:collectResources('aResources'),content_json:ticQuestionsJson()};
    openModal('🎓 Preview · como aluno',ticRenderStudentTaskPreview(data));
  };
  function autoGrade(qs,answers){let earned=0,total=0;qs.forEach(q=>{const pts=Number(q.points||1);total+=pts;const a=answers[q.id];let ok=false;if(q.type==='multiple_choice')ok=String(a)===String(q.answer);else if(q.type==='true_false')ok=String(a)===String(q.answer);else if(q.type==='fill_blank'||q.type==='word_order')ok=String(a||'').trim().toLowerCase()===String(q.answer||'').trim().toLowerCase();else if(q.type==='short_answer'){const keys=String(q.answer||'').toLowerCase().split(',').map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean);ok=!keys.length?false:keys.some(k=>String(a||'').toLowerCase().includes(k))}if(ok)earned+=pts});return {earned,total,percent:total?Math.round(earned/total*100):null}}
  function renderStudentQuestions(data,interactive=true){const qs=normalizeQuestions(data?.content_json?.questions||[]);if(!qs.length)return '';return `<div class="student-question-stack">${qs.map((q,i)=>{let body='';if(q.type==='multiple_choice')body=(q.options||[]).map((o,j)=>`<label class="student-option"><input type="radio" name="sq_${q.id}" value="${j}"><span>${esc(o||'Opção '+(j+1))}</span></label>`).join('');else if(q.type==='true_false')body=`<label class="student-option"><input type="radio" name="sq_${q.id}" value="true"><span>Verdadeiro</span></label><label class="student-option"><input type="radio" name="sq_${q.id}" value="false"><span>Falso</span></label>`;else if(q.type==='word_order')body=`<input class="student-answer-input" data-answer="${q.id}" placeholder="Digite a frase na ordem correta...">`;else body=`<input class="student-answer-input" data-answer="${q.id}" placeholder="${esc(q.placeholder||'Digite sua resposta...')}">`;return `<article class="student-question"><div class="student-question-head"><span>${i+1}</span><b>${esc(q.prompt||'Question')}</b><em>${q.points||1} pt</em></div><div class="student-question-body">${body}</div></article>`}).join('')}</div>`}
  window.ticRenderStudentTaskPreview=function(data){return `<div class="student-task-preview"><div class="student-task-cover"><div><span class="badge blue">${esc(data.cefr_level||'A1')}</span><span class="badge green">${esc(data.skill||'Grammar')}</span><h1>${esc(data.title||'Task')}</h1><p>${esc(data.instructions||'Realize a atividade com atenção.')}</p></div><span class="preview-pill">${data.points||0} pts</span></div>${data.html_enabled&&data.html_content?`<div class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>🧩 HTML interativo</b></div><iframe class="preview-html-frame" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox" srcdoc="${esc(ticResponsiveSrcdoc(data.html_content))}"></iframe></div>`:''}${renderStudentQuestions(data)}<div class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>📚 Recursos</b></div>${ticRenderLessonResources(data)}</div><div class="task-preview-footer"><button class="btn primary" onclick="toast('Preview concluído. No modo aluno, o envio ficará registrado no histórico.','success')">📤 Enviar resposta</button></div></div>`};

  window.openStudentTask=async function(taskId){
    const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;
    const {data:ta,error}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,status,active,completed_at,assigned_at,assignment_id').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('active',true).or(`id.eq.${taskId},assignment_id.eq.${taskId}`).maybeSingle();
    if(error||!ta)return toast(error?.message||'Task não encontrada ou não está disponível para sua conta.','error');
    return openStudentTaskViewer(ta.id);
  };

  window.studentTasks=async function(){
    const s=await studentRecord();if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Conta não vinculada.</div>';return}
    const {data:tas,error}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,status,active,removed_at,completed_at,assigned_at,assignment_id').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('active',true).order('assigned_at',{ascending:false});
    if(error){$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention"><b>Não foi possível carregar suas Tasks.</b><p>${esc(error.message)}</p></div>`;return}
    const ids=[...new Set((tas||[]).map(x=>x.assignment_id).filter(Boolean))];let amap=new Map();if(ids.length){const {data:as}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').select('id,title,instructions,due_at,points,assignment_type,cefr_level,skill,task_level,html_enabled,cover_image_url').in('id',ids).eq('active',true);(as||[]).forEach(a=>amap.set(a.id,a))}
    const cards=(tas||[]).map(ta=>{const a=amap.get(ta.assignment_id);if(!a)return '';const overdue=a.due_at&&new Date(a.due_at)<new Date()&&ta.status!=='reviewed';return `<article class="student-task-card ${overdue?'is-overdue':''}" id="task_${ta.id}" onclick="openStudentTaskViewer('${ta.id}')"><div class="student-task-card-top"><div class="task-icon">🧩</div><div class="student-task-title"><div><span class="badge blue">${esc(a.cefr_level||'A1')}</span><span class="badge gray">${esc(a.skill||a.assignment_type||'Task')}</span></div><h3>${esc(a.title)}</h3><p>${esc((a.instructions||'').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,'').slice(0,110))}</p></div><div class="task-status-badge">${badge(ta.status)}</div></div><div class="student-task-card-meta"><span>⭐ ${a.points||0} pontos</span><span>⏱ ${a.task_level==='quick'?'Quick Task':a.task_level==='assessment'?'Assessment':'Lesson Task'}</span><span>${a.due_at?(overdue?'⚠️ Vencida · ':'⏰ ')+fmtDate(a.due_at):'Sem prazo'}</span><button class="btn primary sm" onclick="event.stopPropagation();openStudentTaskViewer('${ta.id}')">Abrir Task →</button></div></article>`}).join('');
    setPage('My Tasks','Atividades atribuídas pelo Teacher.');$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="task-student-dashboard"><div class="task-stats-row"><div><b>${tas?.length||0}</b><small>Tasks</small></div><div><b>${(tas||[]).filter(x=>x.status==='pending').length}</b><small>Pendentes</small></div><div><b>${(tas||[]).filter(x=>['submitted','reviewed'].includes(x.status)).length}</b><small>Entregues</small></div></div><div class="task-filter-bar"><span>Filtrar</span><button class="filter-chip active" onclick="ticFilterStudentTasks(this,'all')">Todas</button><button class="filter-chip" onclick="ticFilterStudentTasks(this,'pending')">Pendentes</button><button class="filter-chip" onclick="ticFilterStudentTasks(this,'submitted')">Entregues</button></div><div id="studentTaskGrid" class="student-task-grid">${cards||'<div class="card empty">Nenhuma Task atribuída.</div>'}</div></div>`;
  };
  window.ticFilterStudentTasks=function(btn,status){document.querySelectorAll('.filter-chip').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('active'));btn.classList.add('active');document.querySelectorAll('.student-task-card').forEach(c=>{const text=c.querySelector('.task-status-badge')?.textContent?.toLowerCase()||'';c.style.display=status==='all'||text.includes(status)?'':'none'})};

  window.openStudentTaskViewer=async function(taskAssignmentId){
    const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;
    const {data:ta,error}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,active,assignment_id,status,completed_at,assigned_at').eq('id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();
    if(error||!ta||ta.active===false)return toast(error?.message||'Task não encontrada ou removida.','error');
    const {data:a,error:ae}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').select('id,title,instructions,due_at,points,html_enabled,html_content,allow_multiple_attempts,cover_image_url,resource_items,lesson_id,cefr_level,skill,task_level,content_json,assignment_type').eq('id',ta.assignment_id).eq('active',true).maybeSingle();
    if(ae||!a)return toast(ae?.message||'O conteúdo desta Task não está disponível.','error');
    const {data:subs}=await sb.from('tic_submissions').select('id,attempt,grade,submitted_at,answer_text,response_data').eq('task_assignment_id',ta.id).eq('student_id',s.id).order('attempt',{ascending:false});
    const ids=(subs||[]).map(x=>x.id);const {data:fbs}=ids.length?await sb.from('tic_feedback').select('submission_id,comment,grade,private_note,improvement_skill,improvement_link,created_at').in('submission_id',ids).order('created_at',{ascending:false}):{data:[]};
    const latest=subs?.[0];const fb=latest?(fbs||[]).find(q=>q.submission_id===latest.id):null;
    const questionHtml=renderStudentQuestions(a);
    const html=a.html_enabled&&a.html_content?`<div class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>🧩 Atividade interativa</b><span class="badge green">Responsiva</span></div><div class="html-devicebar"><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('desktop')">🖥 Desktop</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('tablet')">▣ Tablet</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('mobile')">📱 Mobile</button></div><div id="htmlViewerWrap" class="html-viewer-wrap desktop"><iframe id="htmlViewerFrame" class="viewer-html-frame" title="Task HTML" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox"></iframe></div><div id="htmlViewerStatus" class="viewer-status">Faça a atividade e use Enviar/Submit dentro dela.</div></div>`:'';
    const autoForm=questionHtml?`<div class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>📝 Questões</b><span>${(a.content_json?.questions||[]).length} questão(ões)</span></div><form id="generatedTaskForm" onsubmit="ticSubmitGeneratedTask(event,'${ta.id}')">${questionHtml}<div class="viewer-actions"><button class="btn primary">📤 Enviar respostas</button></div></form><div id="generatedTaskResult"></div></div>`:'';
    const plain=!html&&!questionHtml?`<div class="viewer-response"><label><b>✍️ Sua resposta</b></label><textarea id="taskViewerText" placeholder="Digite sua resposta..."></textarea><div class="viewer-actions"><button class="btn primary" onclick="submitTaskViewerText('${ta.id}')">📤 Enviar para o Teacher</button></div></div>`:'';
    const feedback=fb&&!fb.private_note?`<div class="notice success"><b>👨‍🏫 Feedback do Teacher</b>${fb.grade!=null?`<div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:800;margin-top:5px">Nota: ${fb.grade}</div>`:''}<div style="margin-top:7px;white-space:pre-wrap">${esc(fb.comment||'Sem comentário.')}</div>${fb.improvement_skill||fb.improvement_link?`<div class="improvement-box"><b>🎯 Como melhorar</b>${fb.improvement_skill?`<div>Habilidade: <b>${esc(fb.improvement_skill)}</b></div>`:''}${fb.improvement_link?`<a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(ticSafeUrl(fb.improvement_link))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">🔗 Abrir material</a>`:''}</div>`:''}</div>`:'';
    openModal(`🧩 ${esc(a.title)}`,`<div class="student-task-viewer-v2"><div class="student-task-viewer-hero"><div><div><span class="badge blue">${esc(a.cefr_level||'A1')}</span><span class="badge green">${esc(a.skill||'Task')}</span><span class="badge gray">${esc(a.task_level||'lesson')}</span></div><h2>${esc(a.title)}</h2><p>${esc(a.instructions||'Realize a atividade e envie sua resposta.')}</p></div><div class="task-score-pill"><b>${a.points||0}</b><small>pontos</small></div></div>${html}${autoForm}${plain}<div class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>📚 Recursos</b></div>${ticRenderLessonResources(a)}</div>${feedback}<div class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>🕘 Histórico de tentativas</b></div><div class="attempt-history">${(subs||[]).map(z=>{const zf=(fbs||[]).find(q=>q.submission_id===z.id);return `<div class="attempt-row"><div><b>Tentativa ${z.attempt||1}</b><small>${fmtDate(z.submitted_at)}${z.grade!=null?' · Nota '+z.grade:''}</small></div><span class="badge ${zf?'green':'yellow'}">${zf?'Corrigida':'Aguardando correção'}</span></div>`}).join('')||'<div class="empty">Nenhuma entrega ainda.</div>'}</div></div><div class="notice">💡 A correção não encerra a atribuição. O Teacher pode permitir novas tentativas.</div><div class="viewer-actions"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Fechar</button></div></div>`);
    if(html){ticHtmlViewerContext={mode:'studentTask',refId:ta.id,html:a.html_content};const f=$('htmlViewerFrame');if(f)f.srcdoc=ticResponsiveSrcdoc(a.html_content)+ticHtmlBridge()}
  };

  window.ticSubmitGeneratedTask=async function(e,taskAssignmentId){
    e.preventDefault();const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;const {data:ta}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,active,assignment_id').eq('id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();if(!ta||ta.active===false)return toast('Esta atribuição não está disponível.','error');const {data:a}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').select('content_json,points').eq('id',ta.assignment_id).maybeSingle();const qs=normalizeQuestions(a?.content_json?.questions||[]);const answers={};qs.forEach(q=>{if(q.type==='multiple_choice'||q.type==='true_false'){const el=document.querySelector(`[name="sq_${q.id}"]:checked`);answers[q.id]=el?.value||''}else answers[q.id]=document.querySelector(`[data-answer="${q.id}"]`)?.value||''});const g=autoGrade(qs,answers);const {data:last}=await sb.from('tic_submissions').select('attempt').eq('task_assignment_id',ta.id).eq('student_id',s.id).order('attempt',{ascending:false}).limit(1).maybeSingle();const attempt=Number(last?.attempt||0)+1;const r=await sb.from('tic_submissions').insert({task_assignment_id:ta.id,student_id:s.id,attempt,answer_text:null,response_data:{source:'task_builder_v2',answers,auto_grade:g},submitted_at:new Date().toISOString(),grade:g.percent});if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível enviar: '+r.error.message,'error');await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').update({status:'submitted',completed_at:null}).eq('id',ta.id).eq('student_id',s.id);const box=$('generatedTaskResult');if(box)box.innerHTML=`<div class="auto-result ${g.percent>=70?'good':'review'}"><b>✅ Resposta registrada</b><span>Resultado automático: ${g.earned}/${g.total} pontos · ${g.percent??0}%</span><small>O Teacher ainda poderá revisar e enviar feedback.</small></div>`;toast(`Tentativa ${attempt} enviada. ${g.percent??0}% automático.`,'success');
  };

  function addFloating(){if(document.getElementById('ticTaskFab'))return;const fab=document.createElement('div');fab.id='ticTaskFab';fab.innerHTML=`<button class="tic-fab-main" title="Ações rápidas">＋</button><div class="tic-fab-menu"><button onclick="openAssignmentForm();ticCloseFab()">✨ Nova Task</button><button onclick="loadView('assignments');ticCloseFab()">📋 Tasks</button><button onclick="loadView('studentTasks');ticCloseFab()">🎓 My Tasks</button></div>`;document.body.appendChild(fab);fab.querySelector('.tic-fab-main').onclick=()=>fab.classList.toggle('open');window.ticCloseFab=()=>fab.classList.remove('open')}
  addFloating();
})();

</script>
<style>
:root{--p:#6844d8;--p2:#8d61ef;--dark:#171522;--bg:#f6f6fa;--card:#fff;--text:#242330;--muted:#878696;--line:#e9e8f0;--green:#18ae78;--yellow:#e7a52d;--red:#e35d67;--blue:#3c82e8;--shadow:0 12px 35px #34245c10;--r:18px}
*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--text);font-family:"DM Sans",sans-serif;font-size:15px;line-height:1.55}button,input,select,textarea{font:inherit}button{cursor:pointer}a{text-decoration:none;color:inherit}
.hidden{display:none!important}.app{min-height:100vh}.sidebar{position:fixed;inset:0 auto 0 0;width:255px;background:#fff;border-right:1px solid var(--line);padding:20px 14px;z-index:30;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:auto;transition:.25s}.brand{font:800 20px "Plus Jakarta Sans";padding:8px 12px 20px}.brand span{color:var(--p)}.brand small{display:block;font:700 9px "DM Sans";letter-spacing:1.5px;color:#aaa8b6;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:4px}
.user{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:10px;background:#faf9ff;border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:12px}.avatar{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:13px;object-fit:cover;background:#eee}.user b{font-size:14px}.user small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;margin-top:2px}.nav-label{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#aaa8b6;font-weight:800;padding:13px 11px 5px}.nav{display:grid;gap:3px}.nav button{background:transparent;border:0;color:#858492;text-align:left;border-radius:11px;padding:12px 11px;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:center}.nav button:hover{background:#f6f2ff;color:var(--p)}.nav button.active{background:#eee8ff;color:var(--p);font-weight:800}.ico{width:19px;text-align:center;font-size:16px}.sidebar-footer{margin-top:auto;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:12px}.sidebar-footer button{width:100%;border:0;background:transparent;color:#9997a5;text-align:left;padding:10px 11px}
.main{margin-left:255px;min-height:100vh}.topbar{height:72px;background:#ffffffdd;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);backdrop-filter:blur(15px);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:0 28px;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20}.crumb{font-size:12px;color:#9997a5}.top-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.icon{width:38px;height:38px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:11px;color:#777585}.container{max-width:1240px;margin:auto;padding:25px 28px 60px}.page-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:15px;margin-bottom:20px}.page-head h1{font:800 25px "Plus Jakarta Sans";margin:0;letter-spacing:-.7px}.page-head p{margin:5px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}.actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.btn{border:0;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 14px;font-weight:800;font-size:12px}.primary{background:var(--p);color:#fff}.secondary{background:#eee8ff;color:var(--p)}.ghost{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);color:#777585}.danger{background:#ffe8ea;color:#a82d38}
.grid{display:grid;gap:15px}.stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}.cols2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.cols3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.card{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--r);padding:18px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}.stat-label{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}.stat-value{font:800 25px "Plus Jakarta Sans";margin-top:7px}.stat-note{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px}.section{margin-top:18px}.section-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:12px}.section-head h2{font:800 16px "Plus Jakarta Sans";margin:0}.section-head span{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}.row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:11px;margin-bottom:8px}.row:last-child{margin-bottom:0}.row b{font-size:13px}.row small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;margin-top:3px}.badge{display:inline-flex;padding:5px 9px;border-radius:99px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800}.green{background:#e3f8ef;color:#13835d}.yellow{background:#fff3d8;color:#9b6a12}.red{background:#ffe5e8;color:#a93442}.blue{background:#e4efff;color:#2462b7}.gray{background:#f0f0f3;color:#858492}.progress{height:8px;background:#ededf2;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden}.progress i{display:block;height:100%;border-radius:99px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--p),var(--p2))}.mini{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);display:flex;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:5px}.table-wrap{overflow:auto}.table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse}.table th,.table td{text-align:left;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:12px;white-space:nowrap;font-size:12px}.table 9px;border-radius:8px;border:0;background:#f0ebff;color:var(--p);font-size:10px;font-weight:800}.empty{text-align:center;padding:35px;color:var(--muted);font-size:13px}.attention{border-left:4px solid var(--red)}.hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4f2cad,#8156df);color:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:24px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}.hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:230px;height:230px;border:45px solid #ffffff12;border-radius:50%;right:-80px;top:-100px}.hero h2{font:800 26px "Plus Jakarta Sans";margin:4px 0}.hero p{font-size:13px;opacity:.75;margin:0 0 20px}.hero .progress{background:#ffffff28;max-width:650px}.hero .progress i{background:#fff}.hero-foot{max-width:650px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:11px;margin-top:7px;opacity:.8}
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#11101b99;backdrop-filter:blur(5px);z-index:100;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:18px}.modal-card{background:#fff;border-radius:20px;width:min(680px,100%);max-height:90vh;overflow:auto;padding:20px}.modal-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}.modal-head h3{font:800 17px "Plus Jakarta Sans";margin:0}.form{display:grid;gap:12px;margin-top:18px}.field{display:grid;gap:5px}.field label{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#555362}.field input,.field select,.field textarea{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:12px 13px;font-size:15px;outline:0;background:#fff}.field input:focus,.field select:focus,.field textarea:focus{border-color:var(--p);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #6844d814}.form-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}.modal-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:8px;margin-top:15px}
.login{min-height:100vh;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#171522,#40278d);display:grid;place-items:center;padding:20px}.login-card{width:min(440px,100%);background:#fff;border-radius:23px;padding:30px;box-shadow:0 30px 90px #0005}.login-card h1{font:800 25px "Plus Jakarta Sans";margin:0}.login-card h1 span{color:var(--p)}.login-card p{color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}.remember{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}.auth-msg{font-size:12px;padding:10px;border-radius:9px;margin-top:10px;background:#eef3ff;color:#345b9d}.mobile{display:none}
.float.hidden{display:none!important}.float{position:fixed;right:23px;bottom:22px;z-index:50}.float-menu{position:absolute;right:0;bottom:62px;display:grid;gap:8px;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateY(8px);transition:.2s}.float.open .float-menu{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:none}.float-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}.float-item span{background:#25222e;color:#fff;border-radius:8px;padding:7px 9px;font-size:9px;font-weight:800}.float-item button{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow);color:var(--p)}.float-main{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--p),var(--p2));color:#fff;font-size:23px;box-shadow:0 15px 35px #6844d84a}
.student-banner{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#171522,#31234c);color:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:20px}.student-banner h2{font:800 22px "Plus Jakarta Sans";margin:0 0 5px}.student-banner p{font-size:13px;color:#bbb6c8;margin:0}.skills{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:12px}
@media(max-width:1050px){.stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.cols3{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.hero{margin-top:0}}
@media(max-width:760px){.sidebar{transform:translateX(-100%)}.sidebar.open{transform:none}.main{margin-left:0}.mobile{display:block}.topbar{padding:0 15px}.container{padding:18px 15px 45px}.cols2,.cols3,.form-grid,.skills{grid-template-columns:1fr}.stats{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.profile-name{display:none}.page-head{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}}

/* resource builder */
.resource-box{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:12px;background:#fbfaff}.resource-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px}.resource-head b{font-size:13px}.resource-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:145px 1fr auto;gap:8px;align-items:start;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px}.resource-row:last-child{margin-bottom:0}.resource-row input,.resource-row select,.resource-row textarea{width:100%;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;padding:9px;font-size:13px}.resource-row textarea{min-height:70px;resize:vertical}.resource-row .resource-file{font-size:11px}.resource-row .resource-actions{display:flex;gap:5px}.resource-row .resource-actions button{border:0;background:#ffe8ea;color:#a82d38;border-radius:8px;padding:8px}.resource-help{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:7px}.cover-upload{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:8px}.resource-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:12px}.resource-card{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:12px;background:#fff;transition:.2s}.resource-card:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}.resource-thumb{width:76px;height:62px;border-radius:10px;object-fit:cover;background:#eee8ff;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;font-size:25px}.resource-card h4{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:14px}.resource-card p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}.resource-card .btn{margin-top:8px}.task-cover{width:100%;max-height:180px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:12px}.task-complete{width:100%;margin-top:12px}.manual-resource{white-space:pre-wrap;color:var(--text);font-size:13px;line-height:1.65}
@media(max-width:760px){.resource-row,.resource-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.cover-upload{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* accessibility / readability */
button,input,select,textarea{font-size:inherit}
.nav button span{line-height:1.35}.quick b{font-size:13px}.quick small{font-size:11px}.notice{font-size:13px}.loading{font-size:13px}
@media(max-width:760px){body{font-size:14px}.nav button{font-size:14px}.page-head h1{font-size:23px}.table th,.table td{font-size:12px}.modal-card{padding:18px}.field input,.field select,.field textarea{font-size:16px}}

/* v2 polish */
:root{--sidebar:255px;--top:72px}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}body{overflow-x:hidden}button:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:not-allowed}.sidebar::-webkit-scrollbar,.modal-card::-webkit-scrollbar{width:7px}.sidebar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb,.modal-card::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#ddd8ea;border-radius:20px}.nav-label{margin-top:2px}.nav button{position:relative;transition:background .18s,color .18s,transform .18s}.nav button:hover{transform:translateX(2px)}.nav button.active:after{content:'';position:absolute;right:7px;width:4px;height:18px;border-radius:10px;background:var(--p)}
.topbar{box-shadow:0 4px 18px #34245c06}.top-status{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-right:4px}.dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px #18ae7815}.icon{transition:.18s}.icon:hover{border-color:#d8cff4;color:var(--p);transform:translateY(-1px)}

<style id="tic-class-center-v36-css">
/* V36 — Class Center is a true page/workspace, never a popup. */
.class-center-page{width:100%;min-height:calc(100vh - 145px);background:transparent;}
.class-center-page .class-center-top{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:15;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(30,20,60,.03)}
.class-center-page .class-center-body{overflow:visible;min-height:0}
.class-center-page .class-center-board{overflow-x:auto;overflow-y:visible;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}
.class-center-page .class-center-float{position:fixed;right:24px;bottom:24px;z-index:45}
.class-center-page .class-center-tabs{max-width:100%;overflow-x:auto;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch}

 .class-center-page{min-height:calc(100vh - 110px)}
 .class-center-page .class-center-top{position:relative;padding:14px 15px 10px}
 .class-center-page .class-center-body{padding:15px 12px 95px}
 .class-center-page .class-center-float{right:12px;left:12px;bottom:12px}
}
</style>

<style>
/* TIC v6 — Lesson/Task viewer and feedback polish */
.lesson-viewer-shell,.task-viewer-shell{display:grid;gap:14px}
.lesson-viewer-head,.task-viewer-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap}
.lesson-viewer-meta,.task-viewer-meta{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:8px}
.viewer-panel{border:1px solid #e8e5f2;border-radius:16px;background:#fff;overflow:hidden}
.viewer-panel-head{padding:13px 15px;background:#faf9fd;border-bottom:1px solid #ece9f4;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.viewer-content-frame{width:100%;height:460px;border:0;display:block;background:#fff}
.viewer-html-frame{width:100%;height:560px;border:0;display:block;background:#fff}
.viewer-resource-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:10px;padding:14px}
.viewer-resource{border:1px solid #e8e5f2;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;background:#fff;display:grid;gap:7px}
.viewer-resource b{font-size:13px}.viewer-resource small{color:var(--muted);line-height:1.45}
.viewer-response{padding:15px;border-top:1px solid #ece9f4;background:#faf9fd}
.viewer-response textarea{width:100%;min-height:110px;resize:vertical}
.viewer-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap;padding:14px}
.viewer-status{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);padding:0 14px 14px}
.feedback-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}
.feedback-stat{border:1px solid #e8e5f2;background:#fff;border-radius:14px;padding:13px}.feedback-stat b{display:block;font-size:22px}.feedback-stat small{color:var(--muted)}
.correction-card{border:1px solid #e7e3f0;border-radius:16px;background:#fff;padding:16px;margin-bottom:12px}
.correction-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}.correction-answer{margin-top:12px;padding:13px;border-radius:12px;background:#faf9fd;border:1px solid #ece9f4;white-space:pre-wrap;line-height:1.65}
.correction-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px}
@media(max-width:800px){.feedback-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.viewer-content-frame{height:360px}.viewer-html-frame{height:500px}}
@media(max-width:520px){.feedback-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.viewer-content-frame{height:300px}.viewer-html-frame{height:430px}.viewer-actions .btn{width:100%}}
</style>

<style id="tic-global-workspace-fix-v37">
/* V37 — Todas as abas/páginas ocupam o workspace e possuem rolagem própria. */
html,body{min-height:100%;}
body{overflow:hidden;}
.app{height:100vh;min-height:100vh;}
.main{height:100vh;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;}
.main>.topbar{flex:0 0 74px;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:60;}
.main>.container{width:100%;max-width:none;box-sizing:border-box;flex:1 1 auto;height:calc(100vh - 74px);min-height:0;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;margin:0;padding:28px 32px 80px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;scroll-behavior:smooth;}
.main>.container>.page-head{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:18;background:rgba(248,247,252,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);padding:4px 0 16px;margin-bottom:18px;}
/* Abas internas permanecem visíveis enquanto o conteúdo cresce. */
.agenda-tabs,.class-center-tabs{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;background:rgba(255,255,255,.96);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);padding-bottom:10px;}
.class-center-page{min-height:100%;}
.class-center-page .class-center-top{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;}
.class-center-page .class-center-tabs{top:0;z-index:31;}
/* Qualquer área de conteúdo grande pode crescer e rolar sem cortar botões. */
.content-scroll,.table-wrap,.board-scroll,.agenda-scroll,.class-center-body{max-width:100%;}
@media(max-width:760px){
 body{overflow:hidden;}
 .main{height:100vh;}
 .main>.topbar{flex-basis:74px;}
 .main>.container{height:calc(100vh - 74px);padding:18px 15px 90px;}
 .main>.container>.page-head{padding-bottom:13px;}
 .agenda-tabs,.class-center-tabs{top:0;}
}
</style>
<style id="tic-student-class-v1">
.student-class-page{width:100%;min-height:100%;}
.student-class-switcher{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:18px;margin-bottom:16px;padding:20px 22px;}
.student-class-switcher h2{margin:5px 0 3px;font:800 23px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';}
.student-class-switcher p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;}
.student-class-select{min-width:240px;padding:11px 13px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;}
.student-class-kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px;}
.student-class-kpis .card{padding:15px 17px;}.student-class-kpis span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px}.student-class-kpis b{display:block;font:800 23px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin-top:7px;}
.student-class-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;}
.student-class-grid>.card{min-width:0;}.student-class-next{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;padding:15px;background:#fbfaff}.student-class-next b{display:block}.student-class-next span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;margin-top:4px}.student-class-summary{margin:12px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.55}
.student-class-resource,.student-class-session,.student-class-board-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);text-decoration:none;color:inherit}.student-class-resource:last-child,.student-class-session:last-child,.student-class-board-item:last-child{border-bottom:0}.student-class-resource>span:nth-child(2),.student-class-session>div,.student-class-board-item>div{flex:1;min-width:0}.student-class-resource b,.student-class-session b,.student-class-board-item b{display:block;font-size:12px}.student-class-resource small,.student-class-session small,.student-class-board-item small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;margin-top:3px}.resource-icon{width:32px;height:32px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-radius:9px;background:#f0ebff;flex:0 0 32px}.student-class-resource>span:last-child{color:var(--p);font-weight:900}.student-class-board-card{grid-column:1/-1}.student-class-board-item{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:8px}.student-class-board-item:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
@media(max-width:800px){.student-class-switcher{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.student-class-select{width:100%;min-width:0}.student-class-kpis{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.student-class-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.student-class-board-card{grid-column:auto}}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div id="login" class="login">
 <div class="login-card">
  <h1>Teacher <span>Platform</span></h1>
  <p>Seu centro de comando para aulas, alunos, progresso e mensalidades.</p>
  <div id="authMsg"></div>
  <form id="loginForm" class="form">
   <div class="field"><label>E-mail</label><input id="email" type="email" autocomplete="username" required></div>
   <div class="field"><label>Senha</label><input id="password" type="password" autocomplete="current-password" required></div>
   <label class="remember"><input id="remember" type="checkbox" checked> Lembrar e-mail</label>
   <button id="loginBtn" class="btn primary">Entrar</button>
   <button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="showForgot()">Esqueci minha senha</button>
   <button type="button" class="btn secondary" onclick="showRegister()">Criar conta de aluno</button>
  </form>
  <form id="forgotForm" class="form hidden">
   <div class="field"><label>E-mail da conta</label><input id="forgotEmail" type="email" autocomplete="email" required></div>
   <button id="forgotBtn" class="btn primary">Enviar link para redefinir senha</button>
   <button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="showLogin()">Voltar para o login</button>
  </form>
  <form id="recoveryForm" class="form hidden">
   <div class="field"><label>Nova senha</label><input id="newPassword" type="password" minlength="6" required></div>
   <div class="field"><label>Confirmar nova senha</label><input id="newPassword2" type="password" minlength="6" required></div>
   <button id="recoveryBtn" class="btn primary">Salvar nova senha</button>
  </form>
  <form id="registerForm" class="form hidden">
   <div class="field"><label>Nome completo</label><input id="rName" required></div>
   <div class="field"><label>WhatsApp</label><input id="rWhatsapp" type="tel" inputmode="tel" placeholder="(41) 99999-9999" required></div>
   <div class="field"><label>E-mail</label><input id="rEmail" type="email" required></div>
   <div class="field"><label>Senha</label><input id="rPassword" type="password" minlength="6" required></div>
   <div class="notice">Novos cadastros são criados como <b>Student</b>. O acesso Teacher é provisionado pelo administrador.</div>
   <button class="btn primary">Cadastrar aluno</button>
   <button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="showLogin()">Voltar</button>
  </form>
  <button type="button" class="btn ghost" style="width:100%;margin-top:12px" onclick="showDiagnostics()">🔎 Diagnosticar problema de login</button>
 </div>
</div>

<div id="toastWrap" class="toast-wrap"></div>
<div id="mobileOverlay" class="mobile-overlay" onclick="toggleMobile(false)"></div>
<div id="app" class="app hidden">
<aside class="sidebar" id="sidebar">
 <div class="brand">Teacher <span>Platform</span><small>English classroom OS</small></div>

 <nav class="nav" id="teacherNav">

 </nav>

<main class="main">
<header class="topbar"><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px"><button class="icon mobile" onclick="toggleMobile()">☰</button><span class="crumb" id="crumb">Teacher Platform / Overview</span></div><div class="top-right"><span class="top-status"><i class="dot"></i> Online</span><button class="icon" title="Buscar" onclick="openGlobalSearch()">⌕</button><button class="icon" title="Notificações" onclick="loadView('notifications')">♢</button><div class="profile-name" style="font-size:12px;font-weight:800" id="topName">Teacher</div></div></header>
<div class="container"><div class="page-head"><div><h1 id="pageTitle">Overview</h1><p id="pageSub">O que precisa da sua atenção hoje?</p></div><div class="actions" id="pageActions"></div></div><div id="content"></div></div>
</main>
