<div class="float" id="float"><div class="float-menu">
 <div class="float-item"><span>Novo aluno</span><button onclick="closeFloat();openStudentForm()">👤</button></div>
 <div class="float-item"><span>Mensalidade</span><button onclick="closeFloat();openPaymentForm()">💰</button></div>
 <div class="float-item"><span>Nova aula</span><button onclick="closeFloat();openLessonForm()">📝</button></div>
 <div class="float-item"><span>Buscar</span><button onclick="closeFloat();openGlobalSearch()">⌕</button></div>
</div><button class="float-main" onclick="document.getElementById('float').classList.toggle('open')">+</button></div>

<div id="diagModal" class="modal hidden"><div class="modal-card" style="max-width:620px"><div class="modal-head"><h3>🔎 Diagnóstico de Login</h3><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeDiagnostics()">✕</button></div><p style="font-size:11px;color:#878696">Use este diagnóstico para descobrir exatamente em qual etapa o login está falhando.</p><div id="diagBox" style="border:1px solid #e9e8f0;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden"></div><div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeDiagnostics()">Fechar</button></div></div></div>
<div id="searchModal" class="modal hidden"><div class="modal-card"><div class="modal-head"><h3>Busca global</h3><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeSearch()">✕</button></div><div class="form"><div class="field"><label>Buscar</label><input id="globalSearch" oninput="doSearch()" placeholder="aluno, aula, curso, material..."></div><div id="searchResults"></div></div></div></div>

<script>
const SUPABASE_URL='https://rvgcniaowzmsudzliozf.supabase.co';
const SUPABASE_KEY='sb_publishable_N_xCS0lbbTvG7qWTpAw0ag_vlg1lbHb';
const sb=supabase.createClient(SUPABASE_URL,SUPABASE_KEY);
let session=null,profile=null,teacher=null,currentView='overview',previewStudent=null;
function isTeacherRole(){ return profile?.role==='teacher' || profile?.role==='admin'; }
function requireTeacherAction(){ if(!isTeacherRole()){ toast('Esta função é exclusiva do Teacher.','error'); return false; } return true; }
function setTeacherOnlyUI(show){ const f=$('float'); if(f) f.classList.toggle('hidden',!show); }
const levels=['A0','A1','A2','B1','B2','C1','C2'];
const skills=['grammar','vocabulary','listening','reading','writing','speaking','pronunciation','overall'];
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id);
const esc=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,m=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#039;'}[m]));
const money=n=>Number(n||0).toLocaleString('pt-BR',{style:'currency',currency:'BRL'});
const fmtDate=d=>d?new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR'):'—';
const monthLabel=d=>d?new Date(d+'T12:00:00').toLocaleDateString('pt-BR',{month:'long',year:'numeric'}):'—';
const badge=(s)=>{let c=['paid','completed','active'].includes(s)?'green':['pending','reviewed','open'].includes(s)?'yellow':['overdue','cancelled'].includes(s)?'red':['submitted'].includes(s)?'blue':'gray';return `<span class="badge ${c}">${esc(s)}</span>`};

function showLogin(){ $('loginForm').classList.remove('hidden');$('registerForm').classList.add('hidden');$('forgotForm').classList.add('hidden');$('recoveryForm').classList.add('hidden'); }
function showRegister(){ $('loginForm').classList.add('hidden');$('registerForm').classList.remove('hidden');$('forgotForm').classList.add('hidden');$('recoveryForm').classList.add('hidden'); }
function showForgot(){ $('loginForm').classList.add('hidden');$('registerForm').classList.add('hidden');$('forgotForm').classList.remove('hidden');$('recoveryForm').classList.add('hidden'); $('forgotEmail').value=$('email').value.trim(); }
function showRecovery(){ $('loginForm').classList.add('hidden');$('registerForm').classList.add('hidden');$('forgotForm').classList.add('hidden');$('recoveryForm').classList.remove('hidden'); }
function msg(t,bad=false){ $('authMsg').innerHTML=`<div class="auth-msg" style="${bad?'background:#ffe8ea;color:#a93442':''}">${esc(t)}</div>`;}
function diag(label,ok,detail=''){ const box=$('diagBox'); if(!box)return; const row=document.createElement('div');row.style.cssText='padding:8px 10px;border-bottom:1px solid #e9e8f0;font-size:11px';row.innerHTML=`<b>${ok?'✅':'❌'} ${esc(label)}</b>${detail?`<div style="color:#878696;margin-top:3px">${esc(detail)}</div>`:''}`;box.appendChild(row); }
async function startDiag(clear=true){
 const box=$('diagBox'); if(box&&clear)box.innerHTML='';
 diag('Biblioteca Supabase',!!window.supabase,window.supabase?'carregada':'não carregada');
 diag('URL do projeto',SUPABASE_URL.includes('.supabase.co'),SUPABASE_URL);
 diag('Cliente Supabase',!!sb,!!sb?'inicializado':'não inicializado');
 if(!sb)return;
 const {data,error}=await sb.auth.getSession();
 diag('Auth respondendo',!error,error?.message||'Supabase Auth respondeu corretamente');
 diag('Sessão atual',true,data?.session?'há uma sessão ativa':'nenhuma sessão ativa — normal antes do login');
 if(data?.session){
   const {data:p,error:pe}=await sb.from('tic_profiles').select('id,full_name,role,active').eq('id',data.session.user.id).maybeSingle();
   diag('tic_profiles',!pe,pe?.message||(p?`${p.full_name||'Sem nome'} · role=${p.role} · active=${p.active}`:'perfil não encontrado'));
   if(p?.role==='student'){
     const {data:st,error:se}=await sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name,teacher_id,auth_user_id').eq('auth_user_id',data.session.user.id).maybeSingle();
     diag('Vínculo tic_students',!se,se?.message||(st?`Aluno ${st.display_name} vinculado ao Teacher ${st.teacher_id}`:'nenhum vínculo'));
   }
   if(p?.role==='teacher'||p?.role==='admin'){
     try{
       const hr=await sb.functions.invoke('tic-student-admin',{body:{action:'health_check'}});
       diag('Edge Function tic-student-admin',!hr.error&&!hr.data?.error,hr.error?.message||hr.data?.error||hr.data?.message||'Função segura respondeu corretamente');
     }catch(e){diag('Edge Function tic-student-admin',false,e?.message||'Falha ao chamar a função');}
   }
 }
}
async function showDiagnostics(){ $('diagModal').classList.remove('hidden'); await startDiag(true); }
function closeDiagnostics(){ $('diagModal').classList.add('hidden'); }
function toggleMobile(force){const open=typeof force==='boolean'?force:!$('sidebar').classList.contains('open');$('sidebar').classList.toggle('open',open);$('mobileOverlay').classList.toggle('open',open)}
function closeFloat(){$('float').classList.remove('open')}
function closeModal(){const m=$('modal');m.classList.add('hidden');m.classList.remove('class-center-host');m.querySelector('.modal-card')?.classList.remove('class-center-modal');window.__ticClassCenter=null}
function openModal(title,body){$('modalTitle').textContent=title;$('modalBody').innerHTML=body;$('modal').classList.remove('hidden')}
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape'){const m=$('modal');if(m&&!m.classList.contains('hidden')){closeModal();return;}}});
function setPage(t,s,actions=''){ $('pageTitle').textContent=t;$('pageSub').textContent=s;$('pageActions').innerHTML=actions;$('crumb').innerHTML=`Teacher Platform / <b>${esc(t)}</b>`; }

$('loginForm').onsubmit=async e=>{
 e.preventDefault();
 const btn=$('loginBtn'); btn.disabled=true; btn.textContent='Verificando...';
 startDiag(); diag('Tentativa de autenticação',true,'enviando e-mail e senha ao Supabase Auth');
 msg('Verificando suas credenciais...');
 const {data,error}=await sb.auth.signInWithPassword({email:$('email').value.trim(),password:$('password').value});
 if(error){ diag('Autenticação',false,error.message+' | código: '+(error.code||'sem código')); msg(error.message,true); btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='Entrar'; $('diagModal').classList.remove('hidden'); return; }
 diag('Autenticação',true,'Sessão criada. ID: '+data.user.id);
 
 btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='Entrar';
};
$('forgotForm').onsubmit=async e=>{
 e.preventDefault(); const btn=$('forgotBtn');btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='Enviando...';
 const email=$('forgotEmail').value.trim();
 const redirectTo=location.origin+location.pathname;
 const {error}=await sb.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email,{redirectTo});
 btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='Enviar link para redefinir senha';
 if(error){msg(error.message,true);return;}
 msg('Se este e-mail estiver cadastrado, o Supabase enviará um link para redefinir a senha. Verifique também Spam/Lixo eletrônico.');
};
$('recoveryForm').onsubmit=async e=>{
 e.preventDefault(); const p=$('newPassword').value,p2=$('newPassword2').value;
 if(p!==p2){msg('As senhas não são iguais.',true);return;}
 const btn=$('recoveryBtn');btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='Salvando...';
 const {error}=await sb.auth.updateUser({password:p});
 btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='Salvar nova senha';
 if(error){msg(error.message,true);return;}
 msg('Senha alterada com sucesso. Agora você pode entrar.');
 await sb.auth.signOut(); showLogin();
};
$('registerForm').onsubmit=async e=>{
 e.preventDefault(); const name=$('rName').value.trim(),whatsapp=$('rWhatsapp').value.trim(),email=$('rEmail').value.trim(),password=$('rPassword').value;
 const {data,error}=await sb.auth.signUp({email,password,data:{full_name:name,role:'student',whatsapp}});
 if(error){msg(error.message,true);return}
 if(data.user){
   // tic_profiles is created server-side by the Supabase auth trigger.
   // This also works when email confirmation is enabled, because there is no authenticated session yet.
 }
 showLogin();msg(data.session?'Cadastro criado e você já pode entrar.':'Cadastro criado. Confirme o e-mail se a confirmação estiver ativa e depois entre.');
};
(async()=>{
 $('email').value='';
 startDiag();
 const {data,error}=await sb.auth.getSession();
 if(error)diag('Leitura da sessão',false,error.message);else diag('Leitura da sessão',true,data.session?'sessão existente':'nenhuma sessão ativa');
 if(data.session){session=data.session;await boot();}
 sb.auth.onAuthStateChange(async(event,s)=>{
  session=s;
  if(event==='PASSWORD_RECOVERY'){ showRecovery(); msg('Link de recuperação validado. Crie sua nova senha.'); return; }
  if(s){await boot(); if(profile?.role==='student'){const taskId=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('task');if(taskId)setTimeout(()=>openStudentTask(taskId),250);}}
 });
})();
async function boot(){
 $('login').classList.add('hidden');$('app').classList.remove('hidden');
 const {data:p,error:pe}=await sb.from('tic_profiles').select('*').eq('id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();profile=p||{full_name:session.user.user_metadata?.full_name||session.user.email,role:'student'};if(pe)toast('Perfil não pôde ser carregado: '+pe.message,'error');
 $('userName').textContent=profile.full_name||'User';$('topName').textContent=profile.full_name||'User';$('userRole').textContent=profile.role==='admin'?'Admin':profile.role==='teacher'?'Teacher':'Student';
 if(profile.role==='teacher'||profile.role==='admin'){
  $('teacherNav').classList.remove('hidden');setTeacherOnlyUI(true);const {data:t}=await sb.from('tic_teachers').select('*').eq('id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();teacher=t;
  currentView='overview';await loadView('overview');
 }else{
  setTeacherOnlyUI(false);
  $('teacherNav').innerHTML=`<div class="nav-label">My Learning</div>
  <button class="active" data-view="student">🏠 <span>My Dashboard</span></button>
  <button data-view="studentCourses">📚 <span>My Courses</span></button>
  <button data-view="studentClass">🏫 <span>My Class</span></button>
  <button data-view="studentTasks">✅ <span>My Tasks</span></button>
  <button data-view="studentProgress">📊 <span>My Progress</span></button>
  <button data-view="studentLessons">📚 <span>My Lessons</span></button>
  <button data-view="studentCalendar">📅 <span>Calendar</span></button>
  <button data-view="studentMessages">💬 <span>Messages</span></button>
  <div class="nav-label">Account</div><button onclick="logout()">↪ <span>Sair</span></button>`;
  currentView='student';await loadView('student');
 }
 document.querySelectorAll('#teacherNav [data-view]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>loadView(b.dataset.view));
}
async function loadView(v){
 currentView=v;toggleMobile();
 // Cada aba abre no topo do próprio workspace, sem ficar presa na posição da aba anterior.
 requestAnimationFrame(()=>{const c=document.querySelector('.main>.container');if(c)c.scrollTo({top:0,left:0,behavior:'instant'});});
 // Mantém a navegação sincronizada com a tela atual, inclusive para alunos.
 document.querySelectorAll('#teacherNav [data-view]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.view===v));
 const map={
 overview:['Overview','O que precisa da sua atenção hoje?',''],
 students:['Students','Cadastre, organize e acompanhe seus alunos.','<button class="btn primary" onclick="openStudentForm()">+ Novo aluno</button>'],
 classes:['Classes','Turmas, horários e links de encontro.','<button class="btn primary" onclick="openClassForm()">+ Nova turma</button>'],
 courses:['Courses','Cursos por nível CEFR.','<button class="btn primary" onclick="openCourseForm()">+ Novo curso</button>'],
 lessons:['Lessons','Aulas, conteúdo e recursos.','<button class="btn primary" onclick="openLessonForm()">+ Nova lesson</button>'],
 plans:['Lesson Plans','Organize suas aulas e planos de aula.','<button class="btn primary" onclick="openLessonForm(true)">+ Novo plano</button>'],
 assignments:['Assignments','Atividades, prazos e correções.','<button class="btn primary" onclick="openAssignmentForm()">+ Nova tarefa</button>'],
 feedback:['Feedback & Corrections','Veja as entregas dos alunos, dê nota e envie feedback.',''],
 materials:['Materials','PDF, links, vídeo, áudio e arquivos.','<button class="btn primary" onclick="openMaterialForm()">+ Novo material</button>'],
 teacherMaterials:['Teacher Materials','Sua biblioteca privada de links, websites, PDFs, vídeos, ferramentas e materiais diversos.','<button class="btn primary" onclick="openTeacherMaterialFormV53()">+ Novo Teacher Material</button>'],
 calendar:['Calendar','Agenda de aulas e compromissos.','<button class="btn primary" onclick="openEventForm()">+ Novo evento</button>'],
 progress:['Progress','Acompanhe o desenvolvimento por habilidade.',''],
 messages:['Messages','Comunicação individual com alunos.',''],
 notifications:['Notifications','Avisos e atualizações.',''],
 payments:['Mensalidades','Controle nominal de mensalidades por mês.','<button class="btn primary" onclick="openPaymentForm()">+ Registrar mensalidade</button>'],
 cash:['Caixa','Entradas, saídas e saldo.','<button class="btn primary" onclick="openCashForm()">+ Lançamento</button>'],
 closing:['Fechamento mensal','Feche e consulte os meses anteriores.','<button class="btn primary" onclick="closeMonthForm()">+ Fechar mês</button>'],
 reports:['Reports','Visão consolidada da operação.',''],
 settings:['Settings','Perfil e configurações da plataforma.',''],
 student:['Student Dashboard','Seu espaço de aprendizagem.',''],
 studentCourses:['My Courses','Seus cursos, módulos e currículo.',''],
 studentClass:['My Class','Sua turma, aulas, materiais e atividades.',''],
 studentTasks:['My Tasks','Atividades atribuídas pelo Teacher.',''],
 studentProgress:['My Progress','Seu desenvolvimento.',''],
 studentLessons:['My Lessons','Aulas disponíveis para você.',''],
 studentCalendar:['Calendar','Suas próximas aulas.',''],
 studentMessages:['Messages','Converse com seu Teacher.','']
 };
 const x=map[v]||map.overview;setPage(x[0],x[1],x[2]);
 if(v==='overview')return overview();
 if(v==='students')return studentsPage();
 if(v==='classes')return classesPage();
 if(v==='courses')return genericTable('courses');
 if(v==='lessons'||v==='plans')return lessonsPage(v==='plans');
 if(v==='assignments')return assignmentsPage();
 if(v==='feedback')return feedbackPage();
 if(v==='materials')return genericTable('materials');
 if(v==='teacherMaterials')return teacherMaterialsPageV53();
 if(v==='calendar'||v==='studentCalendar')return calendarPage(v.startsWith('student'));
 if(v==='progress'||v==='studentProgress')return progressPage(v.startsWith('student'));
 if(v==='messages'||v==='studentMessages')return messagesPage(v.startsWith('student'));
 if(v==='notifications')return notificationsPage();
 if(v==='payments')return paymentsPage();
 if(v==='cash')return cashPage();
 if(v==='closing')return closingPage();
 if(v==='reports')return reportsPage();
 if(v==='settings')return settingsPage();
 if(v==='student')return studentDashboard();
 if(v==='studentCourses')return studentCoursesPage();
 if(v==='studentClass')return studentClassPage();
 if(v==='studentTasks')return studentTasks();
 if(v==='studentLessons')return studentLessons();
}

async function overview(){
 const [{data:st},{data:cl},{data:as},{data:pay},{data:ev},{data:sub}]=await Promise.all([
  sb.from('tic_students').select('id').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active'),
  sb.from('tic_classes').select('id').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active'),
  sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,status').in('status',['pending','submitted','overdue']),
  sb.from('tic_monthly_payments').select('amount,status').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id),
  sb.from('tic_events').select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).gte('starts_at',new Date().toISOString()).order('starts_at').limit(5),
  sb.from('tic_submissions').select('id,student_id,grade').limit(100)
 ]);
 const paid=(pay||[]).filter(x=>x.status==='paid').reduce((a,x)=>a+Number(x.amount),0),pending=(pay||[]).filter(x=>x.status==='pending').reduce((a,x)=>a+Number(x.amount),0),overdue=(pay||[]).filter(x=>x.status==='overdue').reduce((a,x)=>a+Number(x.amount),0);
 $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="hero"><div style="font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.5px;opacity:.65;font-weight:800">TEACHER COMMAND CENTER</div><h2>Good morning, ${esc(profile?.full_name?.split(' ')[0]||'Teacher')} 👋</h2><p>Veja rapidamente o que precisa da sua atenção.</p><div class="progress"><i style="width:${Math.min(100,(paid/(paid+pending+overdue||1))*100)}%"></i></div><div class="hero-foot"><span>Recebimento do período</span><b>${money(paid)}</b></div></div>
 <div class="quick-grid section"><button class="quick" onclick="openStudentForm()">👤<b>Novo aluno</b><small>Cadastrar e enviar convite</small></button><button class="quick" onclick="openPaymentForm()">💰<b>Mensalidade</b><small>Registrar recebimento</small></button><button class="quick" onclick="openLessonForm()">📝<b>Nova lesson</b><small>Adicionar conteúdo</small></button><button class="quick" onclick="openGlobalSearch()">⌕<b>Busca global</b><small>Encontrar qualquer item</small></button></div><div class="grid stats section"><div class="card"><div class="stat-label">👨‍🎓 Alunos ativos</div><div class="stat-value">${st?.length||0}</div><div class="stat-note">Base atual</div></div><div class="card"><div class="stat-label">🏫 Turmas</div><div class="stat-value">${cl?.length||0}</div><div class="stat-note">Turmas ativas</div></div><div class="card"><div class="stat-label">📝 Para acompanhar</div><div class="stat-value">${as?.length||0}</div><div class="stat-note">Tarefas em aberto</div></div><div class="card"><div class="stat-label">💰 Recebido</div><div class="stat-value">${money(paid)}</div><div class="stat-note">${money(pending)} pendente</div></div></div>
 <div class="grid cols2 section"><div class="card attention"><div class="section-head"><h2>⚠️ Attention</h2><span>Ações prioritárias</span></div><div class="row"><div><b>Mensalidades atrasadas</b><small>Verifique os pagamentos</small></div>${badge('overdue')} <strong>${money(overdue)}</strong></div><div class="row"><div><b>Tarefas para acompanhar</b><small>Pending / submitted / overdue</small></div><span class="badge blue">${as?.length||0}</span></div><div class="row"><div><b>Submissions</b><small>Entregas registradas</small></div><span class="badge gray">${sub?.length||0}</span></div></div>
 <div class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>📅 Próximas aulas</h2><span>Agenda</span></div>${(ev||[]).map(e=>`<div class="row"><div><b>${esc(e.title)}</b><small>${new Date(e.starts_at).toLocaleString('pt-BR')}</small></div><span class="badge blue">${esc(e.event_type)}</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="empty">Nenhum evento próximo.</div>'}</div></div>`;
}

let studentsCache=[];
async function studentsPage(){
 const {data,error}=await sb.from('tic_students').select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('display_name');
 if(error){$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card notice error">Não foi possível carregar os alunos: ${esc(error.message)}</div>`;return}
 studentsCache=data||[];
 renderStudentsTable();
}
function renderStudentsTable(){
 const q=($('studentSearch')?.value||'').trim().toLowerCase(), level=$('studentLevel')?.value||'', status=$('studentStatus')?.value||'';
 const data=studentsCache.filter(s=>(!q||`${s.display_name||''} ${s.email||''}`.toLowerCase().includes(q))&&(!level||s.current_level===level)&&(!status||s.status===status));
 $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card"><div class="section-head"><div><h2>Seus alunos</h2><span>${data.length} de ${studentsCache.length} exibidos</span></div><button class="btn primary" onclick="openStudentForm()">+ Novo aluno</button></div><div class="filterbar"><input id="studentSearch" class="field-input" style="flex:2;min-width:220px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 11px" placeholder="Buscar por nome ou e-mail..." value="${esc(q)}" oninput="renderStudentsTable()"><select id="studentLevel" onchange="renderStudentsTable()"><option value="">Todos os níveis</option>${levels.map(l=>`<option ${l===level?'selected':''}>${l}</option>`).join('')}</select><select id="studentStatus" onchange="renderStudentsTable()"><option value="">Todos os status</option><option value="active" ${status==='active'?'selected':''}>Ativos</option><option value="inactive" ${status==='inactive'?'selected':''}>Inativos</option></select></div><div class="table-wrap"><table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Aluno</th><th>Nível</th><th>Mensalidade</th><th>Status</th><th>Ações</th></tr></thead><tbody>${data.map(s=>`<tr><td><b>${esc(s.display_name)}</b><br><small>${esc(s.email||'')}</small></td><td>${esc(s.current_level)} → ${esc(s.target_level||'—')}</td><td>${money(s.monthly_fee)}</td><td>${badge(s.status)}</td><td><div class="action-group"><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="openStudentView('${s.id}')">🎓 View</button><button class="btn sm ghost" onclick='editStudent(${JSON.stringify(s)})'>Editar</button><button class="btn sm ghost" onclick="shareStudentAccess('${s.id}')">📲 WhatsApp</button><button class="btn sm ghost" onclick="resetStudentPassword('${s.id}')">🔑 Senha</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="shareStudentWhatsApp('${s.id}')">📱 WhatsApp</button><button class="btn sm danger" onclick="deleteRow('tic_students','${s.id}','students')">Excluir</button></div></td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="5" class="empty">Nenhum aluno encontrado.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div></div>`;
}
function editStudent(s){openStudentForm(s)}
async function saveStudent(e,id){
 e.preventDefault();
 const obj={display_name:$('sName').value.trim(),email:$('sEmail').value.trim().toLowerCase()||null,current_level:$('sLevel').value,target_level:$('sTarget').value||null,monthly_fee:Number($('sFee').value||0),phone:$('sPhone').value.trim()||null,notes:$('sNotes').value.trim()||null,status:'active'};
 if(!obj.display_name)return toast('Informe o nome do aluno.','error');
 if(id){
   const r=await sb.from('tic_students').update(obj).eq('id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);
   if(r.error)return toast(r.error.message,'error');
   closeModal();toast('Aluno atualizado.','success');return loadView('students');
 }
 if(!obj.email)return toast('Para criar o acesso do aluno, informe o e-mail.','error');
 const tempPassword=$('sTempPassword')?.value||'';
 if(!tempPassword || tempPassword.length<6)return toast('Defina uma senha temporária com pelo menos 6 caracteres.','error');
 const r=await sb.functions.invoke('tic-student-admin',{body:{action:'create_student',...obj,temp_password:tempPassword,redirect_to:location.origin+location.pathname}});
 if(r.error)return toast(r.error.message||'Não foi possível criar o aluno.','error');
 if(r.data?.error)return toast(r.data.error,'error');
 closeModal();toast(r.data?.message||'Aluno criado e convite enviado.','success');loadView('students');
}

async function classesPage(){
 const {data,error}=await sb.from('tic_classes').select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('created_at',{ascending:false});
 if(error){$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention"><b>Não foi possível carregar as turmas.</b><p>${esc(error.message)}</p></div>`;return}
 const ids=(data||[]).map(x=>x.id);
 let members=[];
 if(ids.length){const r=await sb.from('tic_class_students').select('class_id,student_id,status').in('class_id',ids);members=r.data||[];}
 const countBy={};members.forEach(m=>{if(m.status==='active')countBy[m.class_id]=(countBy[m.class_id]||0)+1});
 $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="grid cols2">${(data||[]).map(c=>`<article class="card">
   <div class="section-head"><div><span class="badge blue">${esc(c.level||'A1')}</span><h2 style="font:800 18px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin:8px 0 0">${esc(c.name)}</h2></div>${badge(c.status||'active')}</div>
   <div class="mini"><span>👥 Alunos</span><b>${countBy[c.id]||0}</b></div>
   <div class="mini"><span>🕐 Horário</span><b>${esc(c.schedule_text||'Não definido')}</b></div>
   <div class="mini"><span>🔗 Aula online</span><b>${c.meeting_url?'Configurado':'Não definido'}</b></div>
   <div class="actions" style="margin-top:14px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px">
    <button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="openClassMembers('${c.id}')">👥 Alunos</button>
    <button class="btn sm primary" onclick="openClassAssign('${c.id}')">📤 Atribuir</button>
    <button class="btn sm ghost" onclick="openClassSubmissions('${c.id}')">📝 Feedback</button>
    <button class="btn sm ghost" onclick="openClassProgress('${c.id}')">📊 Progresso</button>
    <button class="btn sm primary" onclick="openClassCenter('${c.id}')">🏫 Abrir turma</button>
    <button class="btn sm ghost" onclick='editGeneric("classes",${JSON.stringify(c)})'>Editar</button>
    <button class="btn sm danger" onclick="deleteRow('tic_classes','${c.id}','classes')">Excluir</button>
   </div>
 </article>`).join('')||'<div class="card empty">Nenhuma turma criada.</div>'}</div>`;
}

async function openClassCenter(classId,initialTab='overview'){
 const {data:cls,error}=await sb.from('tic_classes').select('*').eq('id',classId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();
 if(error||!cls)return toast(error?.message||'Turma não encontrada.','error');
 const {data:members}=await sb.from('tic_class_students').select('student_id,status').eq('class_id',classId).eq('status','active');
 const memberIds=(members||[]).map(x=>x.student_id);
 const [{data:assignments},{data:events},{data:students},{data:boardData}]=await Promise.all([
  sb.from('tic_assignments').select('id,title,due_at,points,assignment_type,active,created_at,task_level,cefr_level,skill,resource_items').eq('class_id',classId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('created_at',{ascending:false}),
  sb.from('tic_events').select('id,title,event_type,starts_at,ends_at,notes,meeting_url,status,created_at').eq('class_id',classId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('starts_at',{ascending:false}),
  memberIds.length?sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name,current_level,email,status').in('id',memberIds):Promise.resolve({data:[]}),
  sb.from('tic_class_board_items').select('id,title,description,item_type,status,position,source_type,source_id,created_at,updated_at').eq('class_id',classId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('position').order('created_at')
 ]);
 const tasks=assignments||[],evs=events||[],boardItems=boardData||[];
 let counts={planned:tasks.filter(t=>t.active!==false).length,inProgress:0,done:0};
 if(tasks.length&&memberIds.length){const {data:tas}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('assignment_id,student_id,status,completed_at').in('assignment_id',tasks.map(t=>t.id));const by={};(tas||[]).forEach(x=>(by[x.assignment_id]??=[]).push(x));tasks.forEach(t=>{const a=by[t.id]||[];if(a.length&&a.every(x=>['completed','submitted','graded'].includes(String(x.status||'').toLowerCase())))counts.done++;else if(a.some(x=>['started','in_progress','submitted','graded'].includes(String(x.status||'').toLowerCase())))counts.inProgress++});counts.planned=Math.max(0,tasks.filter(t=>t.active!==false).length-counts.inProgress-counts.done)}
 const tabs=[['overview','📊 Visão geral'],['board','📌 Board'],['lessons','📚 Aulas'],['topics','📚 Assuntos & Tópicos'],['students','👥 Alunos'],['tasks','📝 Tasks'],['materials','🔗 Materiais'],['resources','🧰 Resources'],['notes','💬 Observações'],['progress','📈 Progresso']];
 /* V36: Class Center is a real full-page workspace, not a modal. Everything that already exists inside the Class Center is preserved. */
 const shell=`<div class="class-center-shell class-center-page" data-class-center="${classId}"><div class="class-center-top"><div class="class-center-title"><div><span class="badge blue">${esc(cls.level||'A1')}</span><h2>🏫 ${esc(cls.name)}</h2><small>${esc(cls.schedule_text||'Horário não definido')} · ${cls.meeting_url?'Aula online configurada':'Aula online não definida'}</small></div><div class="class-center-actions"><button class="btn secondary" onclick="openClassMembers('${classId}')">👥 Alunos</button><button class="btn primary" onclick="openClassAssign('${classId}')">📤 Atribuir</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="openClassFormById('${classId}')">✏️ Editar</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="loadView('classes')">← Voltar para Classes</button></div></div><div class="class-center-tabs">${tabs.map(([id,label])=>`<button data-tab="${id}" class="${initialTab===id?'active':''}" onclick="classCenterTab('${classId}','${id}')">${label}</button>`).join('')}</div></div><div id="classCenterBody" class="class-center-body"></div><div class="class-center-float"><button class="btn primary" onclick="openClassAssign('${classId}')">📤 Atribuir</button><button class="btn secondary" onclick="openClassMembers('${classId}')">👥 Alunos</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="openClassFormById('${classId}')">⚙️ Editar</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="loadView('classes')">← Classes</button></div></div>`;
 /* Leave the global modal untouched: Class Center now occupies the normal app workspace and can scroll naturally. */
 $('content').innerHTML=shell;
 $('pageTitle').textContent=cls.name||'Class';
 $('pageSub').textContent='Class Center · turma completa';
 $('crumb').innerHTML=`Teacher Platform / <b>Classes</b> / <b>${esc(cls.name||'Turma')}</b>`;
 $('pageActions').innerHTML=`<button class="btn secondary" onclick="openClassMembers('${classId}')">👥 Alunos</button><button class="btn primary" onclick="openClassAssign('${classId}')">📤 Atribuir</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="loadView('classes')">← Classes</button>`;
 window.__ticClassCenter={classId,cls,tasks,evs,students:students||[],counts,boardItems};
 await classCenterTab(classId,initialTab);
 window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
}
async function classCenterTab(classId,tab){
 const root=document.querySelector('.class-center-shell[data-class-center="'+classId+'"]');const body=root?.querySelector('#classCenterBody');if(!root||!body)return;root.querySelectorAll('.class-center-tabs button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.tab===tab));const s=window.__ticClassCenter||{},cls=s.cls||{},tasks=s.tasks||[],evs=s.evs||[],students=s.students||[],counts=s.counts||{};const fmt=d=>d?new Date(d).toLocaleString('pt-BR',{dateStyle:'short',timeStyle:'short'}):'—';const k=`<div class="class-center-kpis"><div class="class-center-kpi"><span>👥 Alunos</span><b>${students.length}</b><span>ativos</span></div><div class="class-center-kpi"><span>📌 Planejados</span><b>${counts.planned||0}</b><span>cards</span></div><div class="class-center-kpi"><span>🟡 Em andamento</span><b>${counts.inProgress||0}</b><span>cards</span></div><div class="class-center-kpi"><span>🟢 Concluídos</span><b>${counts.done||0}</b><span>cards</span></div><div class="class-center-kpi"><span>🔗 Materiais</span><b>${tasks.reduce((n,t)=>n+(Array.isArray(t.resource_items)?t.resource_items.length:0),0)}</b><span>recursos</span></div></div>`;
 if(tab==='overview'||tab==='board'){body.innerHTML=k+(tab==='overview'?`<div class="class-center-grid"><div><div class="class-center-panel"><h3>📌 Board da turma</h3><p>Planejado → Em andamento → Concluído</p>${classCenterBoardHTML(tasks,counts)}</div></div><div><div class="class-center-panel"><h3>🕐 Últimas atividades</h3><p>Registros recentes com data.</p><div class="class-center-list">${[...evs,...tasks.map(t=>({title:t.title,created_at:t.created_at,event_type:'task'}))].sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.created_at||0)-new Date(a.created_at||0)).slice(0,5).map(x=>`<div class="class-center-list-item"><div><b>${esc(x.title||'Registro')}</b><small>${esc(x.event_type||'atividade')}</small></div><small>${fmt(x.created_at)}</small></div>`).join('')||'<div class="class-center-empty">Nenhum registro.</div>'}</div></div><div class="class-center-panel"><h3>📚 Última aula</h3><p>${evs[0]?esc(evs[0].title):'Ainda não registrada'}</p><b>${evs[0]?fmt(evs[0].starts_at||evs[0].created_at):'—'}</b></div></div></div>`:`<div class="class-center-panel"><h3>📌 Trello da turma</h3><p>Visão completa do trabalho da turma, preservando as atribuições existentes.</p>${classCenterBoardHTML(tasks,counts)}</div>`)}
 else if(tab==='lessons'){body.innerHTML=`<div class="class-center-panel"><h3>📚 Aulas</h3><p>Últimas e próximas aulas registradas.</p><button class="btn primary" onclick="openClassLessonForm('${classId}')">+ Registrar aula</button><div class="class-center-list" style="margin-top:14px">${evs.map(e=>`<div class="class-center-list-item"><div><b>${esc(e.title)}</b><small>${esc(e.event_type||'aula')} · ${esc(e.notes||'')}</small></div><small>${fmt(e.starts_at||e.created_at)}</small></div>`).join('')||'<div class="class-center-empty">Nenhuma aula registrada.</div>'}</div></div>`}
 else if(tab==='students'){body.innerHTML=`<div class="class-center-panel"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap"><div><h3>👥 Alunos da turma</h3><p>${students.length} aluno(s) ativo(s). Agora você pode adicionar conteúdo para a turma inteira ou somente para um aluno.</p></div><button class="btn primary" onclick="openClassMembers('${classId}')">👥 Gerenciar alunos</button></div><div class="class-center-student-grid" style="margin-top:14px">${students.map(st=>`<article class="class-center-student-card"><div class="class-center-student-main"><span class="class-center-avatar">👤</span><div><b>${esc(st.display_name)}</b><small>${esc(st.current_level||'')} · ${esc(st.email||'')}</small><span class="badge green">${esc(st.status||'active')}</span></div></div><div class="class-center-student-actions"><button class="btn sm primary" onclick="openClassStudentContent('${classId}','${st.id}')">➕ Adicionar conteúdo</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="openStudentView('${st.id}')">👤 Abrir aluno</button></div></article>`).join('')||'<div class="class-center-empty">Nenhum aluno vinculado.</div>'}</div></div>`}
 else if(tab==='tasks'||tab==='topics'){body.innerHTML=`<div class="class-center-panel"><h3>${tab==='tasks'?'📝 Tasks':'📚 Assuntos & Tópicos'}</h3><p>${tab==='tasks'?'Tarefas e atribuições desta turma.':'Conteúdos organizados por CEFR e skill.'}</p><button class="btn primary" onclick="openClassAssign('${classId}')">📤 Atribuir conteúdo</button><div class="class-center-list" style="margin-top:14px">${tasks.map(t=>`<div class="class-center-list-item"><div><b>${esc(t.title)}</b><small>${esc(t.assignment_type||'task')} · ${esc(t.skill||'')} · ${esc(t.cefr_level||cls.level||'')}</small></div><small>${fmt(t.due_at)}</small></div>`).join('')||'<div class="class-center-empty">Nenhum registro.</div>'}</div></div>`}
 else if(tab==='materials'){
  /* V47: Materials is a dedicated content area. It must not reuse the old
     assignment-resource renderer. The V45 material module is defined later
     in this same HTML and is available by the time the user clicks the tab. */
  if(typeof window.renderMaterialsTab45==='function'){
    await window.renderMaterialsTab45(classId);
    return;
  }
  const rs=tasks.flatMap(t=>Array.isArray(t.resource_items)?t.resource_items.map(r=>({...r,task:t.title})):[]);
  body.innerHTML=`<div class="class-center-panel"><h3>🔗 Materiais e links</h3><p>Recursos preservados nas atribuições da turma.</p><div class="class-center-list">${rs.map(r=>`<div class="class-center-list-item"><div><b>${esc(r.title||'Recurso')}</b><small>${esc(r.type||'link')} · ${esc(r.task)}</small></div>${r.url?`<a class="btn sm secondary" href="${esc(r.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Abrir ↗</a>`:''}</div>`).join('')||'<div class="class-center-empty">Nenhum recurso encontrado.</div>'}</div></div>`
}
 else if(tab==='resources'){
  body.innerHTML=`<div class="class-center-panel"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap"><div><h3>🧰 Resources da turma</h3><p>Centralize links, PDFs, vídeos, áudios, Drive, Docs, worksheets e outros recursos. Você pode adicionar à turma inteira ou somente a um aluno.</p></div><div style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap"><button class="btn primary" onclick="openResourceFormV39('${classId}')">+ Novo resource</button><button class="btn secondary" onclick="openResourcePickerV39('${classId}')">📚 Inserir existente</button></div></div><div id="classResourceListV39" class="class-resource-grid-v39"><div class="loading">Carregando resources...</div></div></div>`;
  loadClassResourcesV39(classId);
 }
 else if(tab==='notes'){body.innerHTML=`<div class="class-center-panel"><h3>💬 Observações</h3><p>Feedback, correções e observações do Teacher.</p><button class="btn primary" onclick="openClassSubmissions('${classId}')">📝 Feedback & correções</button><div class="notice" style="margin-top:14px">As observações registradas nas aulas ficam na aba <b>Aulas</b>.</div></div>`}
 else if(tab==='progress'){closeModal();setTimeout(()=>openClassProgress(classId),0)}
}
function classCenterBoardHTML(tasks,counts){
 const st=window.__ticClassCenter||{}; const bi=Array.isArray(st.boardItems)?st.boardItems:[];
 const cols=[['planned','📋 Planejado','blue'],['doing','🔵 Em andamento','purple'],['review','🟡 Revisão','yellow'],['done','🟢 Concluído','green']];
 const statusMap=new Map(bi.map(x=>[x.source_id,x.status]));
 const fallback=t=>{const a=String(t.assignment_type||'').toLowerCase(); if(a==='lesson'||a==='material')return 'planned'; return t.active===false?'done':'planned'};
 const cards=tasks.filter(t=>t.active!==false).map(t=>({...t,board_status:statusMap.get(t.id)||fallback(t)}));
 return `<div class="class-board-toolbar"><div><b>Board da turma</b><small>Arraste qualquer conteúdo entre as colunas. O status fica salvo.</small></div><span class="badge blue">${cards.length} itens</span></div><div class="class-center-board tic-draggable-board">${cols.map(([key,label,color])=>{const list=cards.filter(t=>t.board_status===key);return `<section class="class-center-column board-drop-${key}" data-board-status="${key}" ondragover="ticBoardDragOver(event)" ondrop="ticBoardDrop(event,'${key}')"><div class="class-center-column-head"><span>${label}</span><span class="board-count">${list.length}</span></div><div class="board-column-body">${list.map(t=>`<article class="class-center-card board-task-card" draggable="true" data-task-id="${t.id}" ondragstart="ticBoardDragStart(event,'${t.id}')" title="Arraste para mudar o status"><div class="board-card-type"><span class="badge ${color}">${esc(t.assignment_type||'task')}</span>${t.due_at?`<small>Prazo ${fmtDate(t.due_at)}</small>`:''}</div><b>${esc(t.title)}</b><small>${esc(t.skill||'')} ${t.cefr_level?'· '+esc(t.cefr_level):''}</small><div class="board-card-actions"><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="event.stopPropagation();openClassAssign('${st.classId}')">Atribuir</button></div></article>`).join('')||`<div class="class-center-empty board-drop-empty">Solte itens aqui</div>`}</div></section>`}).join('')}</div>`;
}
window.ticBoardDragStart=function(e,id){window.__ticDraggedBoardId=id;try{e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed='move';e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain',id);}catch(_){}e.currentTarget.classList.add('dragging');};
window.ticBoardDragOver=function(e){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();try{e.dataTransfer.dropEffect='move';}catch(_){}e.currentTarget.classList.add('drag-over');};
window.ticBoardDrop=async function(e,status){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();e.currentTarget.classList.remove('drag-over');const raw=e.dataTransfer?.getData('text/plain')||window.__ticDraggedBoardId;if(!raw)return;const dbStatus=({planned:'planned',doing:'doing',in_progress:'doing',review:'review',done:'done'})[String(status||'').toLowerCase()];if(!dbStatus)return toast('Status de Board inválido.','error');const s=window.__ticClassCenter||{};const t=(s.tasks||[]).find(x=>x.id===raw);if(!t)return;let existing=(s.boardItems||[]).find(x=>x.source_id===raw);let r;if(existing)r=await sb.from('tic_class_board_items').update({status:dbStatus,updated_at:new Date().toISOString()}).eq('id',existing.id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);else r=await sb.from('tic_class_board_items').insert({teacher_id:session.user.id,class_id:s.classId,title:t.title,description:t.instructions||null,item_type:t.assignment_type||'task',status:dbStatus,position:Date.now(),source_type:'assignment',source_id:raw});if(r?.error)return toast('Não foi possível salvar o novo status: '+r.error.message,'error');const item=existing||{source_id:raw,status:dbStatus};item.status=dbStatus;if(!existing)s.boardItems=[...(s.boardItems||[]),item];else existing.status=dbStatus;window.__ticDraggedBoardId=null;toast('Status atualizado.','success');await classCenterTab(s.classId,'board');};
document.addEventListener('dragend',()=>document.querySelectorAll('.dragging,.drag-over').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('dragging','drag-over')));
async function openClassFormById(classId){const {data,error}=await sb.from('tic_classes').select('*').eq('id',classId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();if(error||!data)return toast(error?.message||'Turma não encontrada.','error');closeModal();setTimeout(()=>openClassForm(data),0)}
async function openClassLessonForm(classId){const {data:cls}=await sb.from('tic_classes').select('id,name,level').eq('id',classId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();if(!cls)return toast('Turma não encontrada.','error');openModal(`📚 Registrar aula · ${cls.name}`,`<form class="form" onsubmit="saveClassLessonV35(event,'${classId}')"><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Data e hora</label><input id="clDate" type="datetime-local" value="${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,16)}" required></div><div class="field"><label>Duração (min)</label><input id="clDuration" type="number" min="1" value="60"></div></div><div class="field"><label>Tipo</label><select id="clType"><option value="lesson">Aula ministrada</option><option value="next">Próxima aula</option><option value="review">Revisão</option></select></div><div class="field"><label>Título / assunto</label><input id="clTitle" required placeholder="Ex.: Present Simple — Daily routines"></div><div class="field"><label>Resumo / observação</label><textarea id="clNotes" rows="5" placeholder="O que foi trabalhado? O que precisa ser retomado?"></textarea></div><div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">💾 Salvar aula</button></div></form>`)}
async function saveClassLessonV35(e,classId){e.preventDefault();const start=new Date($('clDate').value),mins=Number($('clDuration').value||60),type=$('clType').value;const r=await sb.from('tic_events').insert({teacher_id:session.user.id,class_id:classId,title:$('clTitle').value.trim(),event_type:type==='next'?'next_class':'lesson',starts_at:start.toISOString(),ends_at:new Date(start.getTime()+mins*60000).toISOString(),notes:$('clNotes').value.trim()||null,status:type==='next'?'scheduled':'completed'});if(r.error)return toast(r.error.message,'error');closeModal();toast(type==='next'?'Próxima aula salva.':'Aula registrada com sucesso.','success');setTimeout(()=>openClassCenter(classId,'lessons'),250)}

async function openClassProgress(classId){
 const {data:cls}=await sb.from('tic_classes').select('id,name,level').eq('id',classId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();
 if(!cls)return toast('Turma não encontrada.','error');
 const {data:members}=await sb.from('tic_class_students').select('student_id,status').eq('class_id',classId).eq('status','active');
 const ids=(members||[]).map(x=>x.student_id);
 if(!ids.length)return openModal(`📊 Progresso · ${cls.name}`,'<div class="empty">Nenhum aluno ativo nesta turma.</div>');
 const [{data:students},{data:progress}]=await Promise.all([
  sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name,current_level').in('id',ids),
  sb.from('tic_progress').select('student_id,level,skill,progress').in('student_id',ids)
 ]);
 const cards=(students||[]).map(st=>{const p=(progress||[]).find(x=>x.student_id===st.id&&x.skill==='overall'&&x.level===st.current_level);return `<div class="row"><div><b>${esc(st.display_name)}</b><small>${esc(st.current_level)}</small></div><div style="min-width:170px"><div class="mini"><span>Overall</span><b>${p?.progress||0}%</b></div><div class="progress"><i style="width:${p?.progress||0}%"></i></div></div></div>`}).join('');
 openModal(`📊 Progresso · ${cls.name}`,`<div class="notice">Acompanhamento dos alunos atualmente vinculados à turma.</div><div class="form">${cards}</div>`);
}

async function genericTable(type){
 const viewToken=window.__ticViewToken||0;
 const cfg={classes:['tic_classes','name','level','schedule_text'],courses:['tic_courses','title','level','description'],materials:['tic_materials','title','material_type','level']}[type];
 const {data}=await sb.from(cfg[0]).select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('created_at',{ascending:false});
 // Evita que uma consulta iniciada em uma aba anterior sobrescreva a aba que o Teacher acabou de abrir.
 if((window.__ticViewToken||0)!==viewToken || currentView!==type)return;
 $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card"><div class="table-wrap"><table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Nome</th><th>${cfg[2]}</th><th>${cfg[3]}</th><th>Ações</th></tr></thead><tbody>${(data||[]).map(x=>`<tr><td><b>${esc(x[cfg[1]])}</b></td><td>${esc(x[cfg[2]]||'—')}</td><td>${esc(x[cfg[3]]||'—')}</td><td><button onclick='editGeneric("${type}",${JSON.stringify(x)})'>Editar</button> ${type==='classes'?`<button onclick='openClassMembers("${x.id}")'>👥 Alunos</button><button onclick='openClassAssign("${x.id}")'>📤 Atribuir</button>`:''} ${type==='materials'?`<button onclick='openMaterialAssignV52(${JSON.stringify(x)})'>📤 Atribuir</button>`:''} <button onclick="deleteRow('${cfg[0]}','${x.id}','${type}')">Excluir</button></td></tr>`).join('')||`<tr><td colspan="4" class="empty">Nenhum registro.</td></tr>`}</tbody></table></div></div>`;
}
async function openClassMembers(classId){const [{data:cls},{data:students},{data:members}]=await Promise.all([sb.from('tic_classes').select('id,name,level').eq('id',classId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle(),sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name,current_level').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active').order('display_name'),sb.from('tic_class_students').select('student_id,status').eq('class_id',classId)]);if(!cls)return toast('Turma não encontrada.','error');const current=new Set((members||[]).filter(m=>m.status==='active').map(m=>m.student_id));openModal(`👥 Alunos · ${cls.name}`,`<form class="form" onsubmit="saveClassMembers(event,'${classId}')"><div class="notice">Selecione os alunos que pertencem à turma. Ao salvar, os vínculos são atualizados.</div><div class="field"><label>Alunos</label><select id="cmStudents" multiple size="10" style="min-height:220px">${(students||[]).map(st=>`<option value="${st.id}" ${current.has(st.id)?'selected':''}>${esc(st.display_name)} · ${esc(st.current_level)}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">Salvar alunos</button></div></form>`)}
async function saveClassMembers(e,classId){e.preventDefault();const ids=[...($('cmStudents')?.selectedOptions||[])].map(o=>o.value);const {data:old}=await sb.from('tic_class_students').select('id,student_id').eq('class_id',classId);const selected=new Set(ids);const oldMap=new Map((old||[]).map(x=>[x.student_id,x.id]));const remove=(old||[]).filter(x=>!selected.has(x.student_id)).map(x=>x.id);if(remove.length){const r=await sb.from('tic_class_students').delete().in('id',remove);if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível remover vínculos: '+r.error.message,'error')}const add=ids.filter(id=>!oldMap.has(id)).map(student_id=>({class_id:classId,student_id,status:'active'}));if(add.length){const r=await sb.from('tic_class_students').insert(add);if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível adicionar alunos: '+r.error.message,'error')}closeModal();toast('Alunos da turma atualizados.','success');loadView('classes')}
async function openClassAssign(classId){
 const {data:cls}=await sb.from('tic_classes').select('id,name,level').eq('id',classId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();
 if(!cls)return toast('Turma não encontrada.','error');
 openModal(`📤 Atribuir à turma · ${cls.name}`,`<div class="form">
  <div class="notice">Aqui ficam <b>todas as formas de atribuição</b> disponíveis para a turma: Lessons, Lesson Plans, Materials e Tasks. Os alunos precisam estar vinculados à turma.</div>
  <div class="field"><label>O que você quer atribuir?</label><select id="caType" onchange="loadClassContentOptions('${classId}')">
   <option value="lesson">📚 Lesson</option><option value="plan">📋 Lesson Plan</option><option value="material">📂 Material</option><option value="assignment">✅ Task / Assignment existente</option>
  </select></div><div id="caContent"><div class="loading">Carregando...</div></div>
  <div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Fechar</button><button type="button" class="btn secondary" onclick="openClassMembers('${classId}')">👥 Gerenciar alunos</button></div>
 </div>`);loadClassContentOptions(classId);
}
async function loadClassContentOptions(classId){
 const type=$('caType')?.value||'lesson',box=$('caContent');if(!box)return;
 let html='';
 if(type==='lesson'||type==='plan'){
  const {data}=await sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('lesson_type',type==='plan'?'plan':'lesson').order('created_at',{ascending:false});
  html=`<div class="field"><label>${type==='plan'?'Lesson Plan':'Lesson'}</label><select id="caSource">${(data||[]).map(x=>`<option value="${x.id}">${esc(x.title)} · ${esc(x.level||'')}</option>`).join('')||'<option value="">Nenhum conteúdo encontrado</option>'}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Mensagem para os alunos</label><textarea id="caMessage" rows="2" placeholder="Ex.: Estude este conteúdo antes da próxima aula."></textarea></div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Prazo</label><input id="caDue" type="datetime-local"></div><div class="field"><label>Pontos</label><input id="caPoints" type="number" min="0" value="0"></div></div><button type="button" class="btn primary" onclick="assignClassContent('${classId}','${type}')">📤 Atribuir para a turma</button>`;
 }else if(type==='material'){
  const {data}=await sb.from('tic_materials').select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('created_at',{ascending:false});
  html=`<div class="field"><label>Materiais <span style="font-weight:500;color:var(--muted)">— selecione um ou vários</span></label><select id="caSource" multiple size="8" style="min-height:190px">${(data||[]).map(x=>`<option value="${x.id}">${esc(x.title)} · ${esc(x.level||'')} · ${esc(x.material_type||'material')}</option>`).join('')||'<option value="">Nenhum material encontrado</option>'}</select><small style="color:var(--muted)">Use Ctrl/Cmd para selecionar vários materiais. Cada material selecionado será criado como um recurso separado na turma e ficará disponível para os alunos.</small></div><div class="field"><label>Mensagem para os alunos</label><textarea id="caMessage" rows="2" placeholder="Ex.: Abra o PDF e complete as atividades."></textarea></div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Prazo</label><input id="caDue" type="datetime-local"></div><div class="field"><label>Pontos</label><input id="caPoints" type="number" min="0" value="0"></div></div><button type="button" class="btn primary" onclick="assignClassContent('${classId}','material')">📤 Adicionar materiais à turma</button>`;
 }else{
  const {data}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').select('id,title,assignment_type,due_at').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('created_at',{ascending:false});
  html=`<div class="field"><label>Task / Assignment</label><select id="caSource">${(data||[]).map(x=>`<option value="${x.id}">${esc(x.title)} · ${esc(x.assignment_type||'assignment')}</option>`).join('')||'<option value="">Nenhuma tarefa encontrada</option>'}</select></div><div class="notice">Isso distribui a tarefa existente para todos os alunos ativos da turma, preservando a tarefa original.</div><button type="button" class="btn primary" onclick="assignExistingTaskToClass('${classId}')">📤 Atribuir tarefa à turma</button>`;
 }
 box.innerHTML=html;
}
async function assignClassContent(classId,type){
 const selected=[...($('caSource')?.selectedOptions||[])].map(o=>o.value).filter(Boolean);
 const sourceIds=selected.length?selected:($('caSource')?.value?[ $('caSource').value ]:[]);
 if(!sourceIds.length)return toast(type==='material'?'Selecione pelo menos um material.':'Selecione um conteúdo.','error');
 const {data:members,error:me}=await sb.from('tic_class_students').select('student_id').eq('class_id',classId).eq('status','active');if(me)return toast(me.message,'error');
 const studentIds=[...new Set((members||[]).map(x=>x.student_id))];if(!studentIds.length)return toast('Adicione alunos à turma antes de atribuir conteúdo.','error');
 const sourceType=type==='plan'?'lesson':type;
 const table=sourceType==='lesson'?'tic_lessons':'tic_materials';
 const results=[];
 for(const sourceId of sourceIds){
  const {data:source,error}=await sb.from(table).select('*').eq('id',sourceId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();
  if(error||!source){toast(`Conteúdo não encontrado: ${sourceId}`,'error');continue;}
  const payload={teacher_id:session.user.id,lesson_id:sourceType==='lesson'?source.id:null,class_id:classId,title:source.title,instructions:$('caMessage')?.value.trim()||source.description||source.content||'',assignment_type:type==='plan'?'lesson_plan':sourceType==='lesson'?'lesson':'material',due_at:$('caDue')?.value?new Date($('caDue').value).toISOString():null,points:Number($('caPoints')?.value||0),priority:'normal',resource_items:Array.isArray(source.resource_items)?source.resource_items:[],cover_image_url:source.cover_image_url||null,source_type:type==='plan'?'lesson_plan':sourceType,source_id:source.id};
  const {data:a,error:ae}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').insert(payload).select().single();
  if(ae){toast(`Não foi possível adicionar ${source.title}: ${ae.message}`,'error');continue;}
  const {error:te}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').insert(studentIds.map(student_id=>({assignment_id:a.id,student_id,status:'pending'})));
  if(te){await sb.from('tic_assignments').delete().eq('id',a.id);toast(`Não foi possível distribuir ${source.title}: ${te.message}`,'error');continue;}
  results.push(source.title);
 }
 if(!results.length)return;
 closeModal();
 toast(type==='material'?`${results.length} material(is) adicionado(s) à turma e disponibilizado(s) para ${studentIds.length} aluno(s).`:`${results.length} conteúdo(s) atribuído(s) para ${studentIds.length} aluno(s).`,'success');
 setTimeout(()=>openClassCenter(classId,type==='material'?'materials':'overview'),250);
}
async function assignExistingTaskToClass(classId){
 const assignmentId=$('caSource')?.value;if(!assignmentId)return toast('Selecione uma tarefa.','error');
 const {data:members,error:me}=await sb.from('tic_class_students').select('student_id').eq('class_id',classId).eq('status','active');if(me)return toast(me.message,'error');
 const ids=[...new Set((members||[]).map(x=>x.student_id))];if(!ids.length)return toast('Adicione alunos à turma antes de atribuir a tarefa.','error');
 const {data:existing}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('student_id').eq('assignment_id',assignmentId).in('student_id',ids);const have=new Set((existing||[]).map(x=>x.student_id));
 const rows=ids.filter(id=>!have.has(id)).map(student_id=>({assignment_id:assignmentId,student_id,status:'pending'}));if(!rows.length)return toast('Essa tarefa já está atribuída a todos os alunos da turma.','info');
 const {error}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').insert(rows);if(error)return toast(error.message,'error');closeModal();toast(`Tarefa atribuída para ${rows.length} aluno(s).`,'success');
}


async function openClassStudentContent(classId,studentId){
 const [{data:cls},{data:student}]=await Promise.all([
  sb.from('tic_classes').select('id,name,level').eq('id',classId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle(),
  sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name,current_level,email').eq('id',studentId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle()
 ]);
 if(!cls||!student)return toast('Aluno ou turma não encontrado.','error');
 openModal(`➕ Conteúdo para ${student.display_name}`,`<div class="form">
  <div class="notice"><b>${esc(student.display_name)}</b> receberá o conteúdo individualmente dentro da Class <b>${esc(cls.name)}</b>. Outros alunos da turma não receberão este conteúdo.</div>
  <div class="field"><label>O que deseja adicionar?</label><select id="csaType" onchange="loadClassStudentContentOptions('${classId}','${studentId}')">
   <option value="lesson">📚 Lesson</option><option value="plan">📋 Lesson Plan</option><option value="material">📂 Material</option><option value="assignment">✅ Task / Assignment</option>
  </select></div>
  <div id="csaContent"><div class="loading">Carregando...</div></div>
  <div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Fechar</button></div>
 </div>`);
 loadClassStudentContentOptions(classId,studentId);
}
async function loadClassStudentContentOptions(classId,studentId){
 const type=$('csaType')?.value||'lesson',box=$('csaContent');if(!box)return;let html='';
 if(type==='lesson'||type==='plan'){
  const {data}=await sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('lesson_type',type==='plan'?'plan':'lesson').order('created_at',{ascending:false});
  html=`<div class="field"><label>${type==='plan'?'Lesson Plan':'Lesson'}</label><select id="csaSource">${(data||[]).map(x=>`<option value="${x.id}">${esc(x.title)} · ${esc(x.level||'')}</option>`).join('')||'<option value="">Nenhum conteúdo encontrado</option>'}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Mensagem para o aluno</label><textarea id="csaMessage" rows="2" placeholder="Ex.: Faça esta lesson antes da próxima aula."></textarea></div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Prazo</label><input id="csaDue" type="datetime-local"></div><div class="field"><label>Pontos</label><input id="csaPoints" type="number" min="0" value="0"></div></div><button type="button" class="btn primary" onclick="assignClassContentToStudent('${classId}','${studentId}','${type}')">📤 Adicionar ao aluno</button>`;
 }else if(type==='material'){
  const {data}=await sb.from('tic_materials').select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('created_at',{ascending:false});
  html=`<div class="field"><label>Material</label><select id="csaSource">${(data||[]).map(x=>`<option value="${x.id}">${esc(x.title)} · ${esc(x.level||'')} · ${esc(x.material_type||'material')}</option>`).join('')||'<option value="">Nenhum material encontrado</option>'}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Mensagem para o aluno</label><textarea id="csaMessage" rows="2" placeholder="Ex.: Abra este material e conclua as atividades."></textarea></div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Prazo</label><input id="csaDue" type="datetime-local"></div><div class="field"><label>Pontos</label><input id="csaPoints" type="number" min="0" value="0"></div></div><button type="button" class="btn primary" onclick="assignClassContentToStudent('${classId}','${studentId}','material')">📤 Adicionar material ao aluno</button>`;
 }else{
  const {data}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').select('id,title,assignment_type,due_at,class_id').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('created_at',{ascending:false});
  html=`<div class="field"><label>Task / Assignment existente</label><select id="csaSource">${(data||[]).map(x=>`<option value="${x.id}">${esc(x.title)} · ${esc(x.assignment_type||'assignment')}${x.class_id===classId?' · desta turma':''}</option>`).join('')||'<option value="">Nenhuma tarefa encontrada</option>'}</select></div><div class="notice">A tarefa existente será preservada. Será criada apenas a atribuição para este aluno.</div><button type="button" class="btn primary" onclick="assignExistingTaskToStudent('${classId}','${studentId}')">📤 Adicionar tarefa ao aluno</button>`;
 }
 box.innerHTML=html;
}
async function assignClassContentToStudent(classId,studentId,type){
 const sourceId=$('csaSource')?.value;if(!sourceId)return toast('Selecione um conteúdo.','error');
 const sourceType=type==='plan'?'lesson':type,table=sourceType==='lesson'?'tic_lessons':'tic_materials';
 const {data:source,error:se}=await sb.from(table).select('*').eq('id',sourceId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();
 if(se||!source)return toast('Conteúdo não encontrado.','error');
 const payload={teacher_id:session.user.id,lesson_id:sourceType==='lesson'?source.id:null,class_id:classId,title:source.title,instructions:$('csaMessage')?.value.trim()||source.description||source.content||'',assignment_type:type==='plan'?'lesson_plan':sourceType==='lesson'?'lesson':'material',due_at:$('csaDue')?.value?new Date($('csaDue').value).toISOString():null,points:Number($('csaPoints')?.value||0),priority:'normal',resource_items:Array.isArray(source.resource_items)?source.resource_items:[],cover_image_url:source.cover_image_url||null,source_type:type==='plan'?'lesson_plan':sourceType,source_id:source.id};
 const {data:a,error:ae}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').insert(payload).select().single();
 if(ae)return toast('Não foi possível adicionar o conteúdo: '+ae.message,'error');
 const {error:te}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').insert({assignment_id:a.id,student_id:studentId,status:'pending'});
 if(te){await sb.from('tic_assignments').delete().eq('id',a.id);return toast('Não foi possível vincular ao aluno: '+te.message,'error');}
 closeModal();toast(`${source.title} adicionado somente para o aluno.`,'success');setTimeout(()=>openClassCenter(classId,'students'),200);
}
async function assignExistingTaskToStudent(classId,studentId){
 const assignmentId=$('csaSource')?.value;if(!assignmentId)return toast('Selecione uma tarefa.','error');
 const {data:source,error:ae}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').select('*').eq('id',assignmentId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();if(ae||!source)return toast('Tarefa não encontrada.','error');
 const payload={teacher_id:session.user.id,lesson_id:source.lesson_id||null,class_id:classId,title:source.title,instructions:source.instructions||'',assignment_type:source.assignment_type||'assignment',due_at:source.due_at||null,points:Number(source.points||0),priority:source.priority||'normal',resource_items:Array.isArray(source.resource_items)?source.resource_items:[],cover_image_url:source.cover_image_url||null,source_type:source.source_type||'assignment',source_id:source.source_id||source.id,html_enabled:source.html_enabled||false,html_content:source.html_content||null,allow_multiple_attempts:source.allow_multiple_attempts!==false,active:source.active!==false,cefr_level:source.cefr_level||null,skill:source.skill||null,task_level:source.task_level||null,content_json:source.content_json||null};
 const {data:copy,error:ce}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').insert(payload).select().single();if(ce)return toast('Não foi possível criar a cópia da tarefa na Class: '+ce.message,'error');
 const {error:te}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').insert({assignment_id:copy.id,student_id:studentId,status:'pending'});
 if(te){await sb.from('tic_assignments').delete().eq('id',copy.id);return toast('Não foi possível atribuir a tarefa ao aluno: '+te.message,'error');}
 closeModal();toast(`${source.title} adicionado somente para o aluno. A tarefa original foi preservada.`,'success');setTimeout(()=>openClassCenter(classId,'students'),200);
}

function editGeneric(type,x){if(type==='classes')openClassForm(x);else if(type==='courses')openCourseForm(x);else openMaterialForm(x)}
function openClassForm(x=null){openModal(x?'Editar turma':'Nova turma',`<form class="form" onsubmit="saveGeneric(event,'tic_classes','${x?.id||''}','classes')"><div class="field"><label>Nome</label><input id="g1" value="${esc(x?.name||'')}" required></div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Nível</label><select id="g2">${levels.map(l=>`<option ${l===x?.level?'selected':''}>${l}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Horário</label><input id="g3" value="${esc(x?.schedule_text||'')}"></div></div><div class="field"><label>Link da aula</label><input id="g4" value="${esc(x?.meeting_url||'')}"></div><div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">Salvar</button></div></form>`)}
function openCourseForm(x=null){openModal(x?'Editar curso':'Novo curso',`<form class="form" onsubmit="saveGeneric(event,'tic_courses','${x?.id||''}','courses')"><div class="field"><label>Título</label><input id="g1" value="${esc(x?.title||'')}" required></div><div class="field"><label>Nível</label><select id="g2">${levels.map(l=>`<option ${l===x?.level?'selected':''}>${l}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Descrição</label><textarea id="g3">${esc(x?.description||'')}</textarea></div><div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">Salvar</button></div></form>`)}

/* V53 — Teacher Materials: biblioteca privada do professor. Nunca é publicada automaticamente para alunos. */
async function teacherMaterialsPageV53(){
 const {data,error}=await sb.from('tic_teacher_materials').select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('created_at',{ascending:false});
 if(error){$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention"><b>Teacher Materials ainda não está disponível.</b><p>${esc(error.message)}</p><small>Execute o SQL V53 no Supabase para criar a biblioteca privada.</small></div>`;return}
 window.__teacherMaterialsV53=data||[];
 $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="notice">🔒 <b>Biblioteca privada do Teacher.</b> Tudo aqui é para sua organização. Nada é enviado ao aluno ou à Class automaticamente. Quando quiser usar um item com um aluno, você poderá copiar o link para Materials/Resources ou criar uma atribuição específica.</div>
 <div class="card section"><div class="toolbar" style="display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center"><input id="tm53Search" class="input" style="flex:1;min-width:220px" placeholder="🔎 Buscar website, material, ferramenta..." oninput="renderTeacherMaterialsV53()"><select id="tm53Cat" onchange="renderTeacherMaterialsV53()" style="min-width:160px"><option value="">Todas as categorias</option><option value="website">🌐 Website</option><option value="tool">🛠️ Ferramenta</option><option value="ai">🤖 IA</option><option value="pdf">📄 PDF</option><option value="video">🎬 Vídeo</option><option value="audio">🎧 Áudio</option><option value="worksheet">📝 Worksheet</option><option value="book">📚 Livro</option><option value="other">📦 Outros</option></select><button class="btn primary" onclick="openTeacherMaterialFormV53()">＋ Novo</button></div></div>
 <div id="tm53Grid" class="grid cols3 section"></div>`;
 renderTeacherMaterialsV53();
}
function renderTeacherMaterialsV53(){
 const q=($('tm53Search')?.value||'').toLowerCase().trim(),cat=$('tm53Cat')?.value||'';
 const data=(window.__teacherMaterialsV53||[]).filter(x=>!cat||x.category===cat).filter(x=>!q||[x.title,x.description,x.notes,x.tags].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(q));
 $('tm53Grid').innerHTML=data.map(x=>{const rs=Array.isArray(x.resource_items)?x.resource_items.filter(r=>r?.url||r?.value):[];return `<article class="card" style="position:relative"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:flex-start"><span class="badge blue">${esc(x.category||'other')}</span><span class="badge gray">${rs.length} recurso(s)</span></div><h3 style="margin:12px 0 6px">${esc(x.title)}</h3><p style="color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;min-height:34px">${esc(x.description||'')}</p>${x.tags?`<small style="color:var(--muted)">🏷️ ${esc(x.tags)}</small>`:''}<div style="display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px"><button class="btn secondary" onclick="openTeacherMaterialViewV53('${x.id}')">👁️ Abrir</button><button class="btn secondary" onclick='openTeacherMaterialFormV53(${JSON.stringify(x)})'>✏️ Editar</button><button class="btn danger" onclick="deleteTeacherMaterialV53('${x.id}')">Excluir</button></div></article>`}).join('')||'<div class="card empty" style="grid-column:1/-1">Nenhum Teacher Material encontrado. Clique em <b>+ Novo</b> para guardar seu primeiro website, link, PDF ou ferramenta.</div>';
}
function openTeacherMaterialFormV53(x=null){
 openModal(x?'✏️ Editar Teacher Material':'🗂️ Novo Teacher Material',`<form class="form" onsubmit="saveTeacherMaterialV53(event,'${x?.id||''}')">
 <div class="field"><label>Nome / título</label><input id="tm1" value="${esc(x?.title||'')}" placeholder="Ex.: ESL Games Plus, British Council, Canva..." required></div>
 <div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Categoria</label><select id="tm2">${['website','tool','ai','pdf','video','audio','worksheet','book','other'].map(c=>`<option value="${c}" ${c===(x?.category||'website')?'selected':''}>${c}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Nível (opcional)</label><select id="tm3"><option value="">Todos</option>${levels.map(l=>`<option ${l===x?.level?'selected':''}>${l}</option>`).join('')}</select></div></div>
 <div class="field"><label>Descrição</label><textarea id="tm4" rows="3" placeholder="Para que serve? O que você quer lembrar sobre este recurso?">${esc(x?.description||'')}</textarea></div>
 <div class="field"><label>Tags</label><input id="tm5" value="${esc(x?.tags||'')}" placeholder="A1, grammar, listening, AI, free, worksheets..."></div>
 <div class="resource-box"><div class="resource-head"><b>🔗 Links e arquivos guardados</b><button type="button" class="btn secondary" onclick="addResourceRow('tmResources')">＋ Adicionar recurso</button></div><div id="tmResources"></div><div class="resource-help">Você pode guardar vários links no mesmo card: website + YouTube + PDF + Drive + ferramenta + outros.</div></div>
 <div class="field"><label>Notas privadas do Teacher</label><textarea id="tm6" rows="4" placeholder="Anotações, senha não deve ser colocada aqui, ideias de uso, observações...">${esc(x?.notes||'')}</textarea></div>
 <div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">💾 Guardar na biblioteca</button></div></form>`);
 renderResourceRows('tmResources',x?.resource_items||[]);
}
async function saveTeacherMaterialV53(e,id){
 e.preventDefault();
 const resources=collectResources('tmResources').filter(r=>r.url||r.value);
 if(!resources.length)return toast('Adicione pelo menos um link ou recurso.','error');
 const o={teacher_id:session.user.id,title:$('tm1').value.trim(),category:$('tm2').value,level:$('tm3').value||null,description:$('tm4').value.trim()||null,tags:$('tm5').value.trim()||null,notes:$('tm6').value.trim()||null,resource_items:resources};
 const r=id?await sb.from('tic_teacher_materials').update(o).eq('id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id):await sb.from('tic_teacher_materials').insert(o);
 if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível guardar: '+r.error.message,'error');
 closeModal();toast(id?'Teacher Material atualizado.':'Teacher Material guardado na sua biblioteca.','success');await teacherMaterialsPageV53();
}
function openTeacherMaterialViewV53(id){
 const x=(window.__teacherMaterialsV53||[]).find(z=>z.id===id);if(!x)return;
 const rs=Array.isArray(x.resource_items)?x.resource_items:[];
 openModal(`🗂️ ${esc(x.title)}`,`<div class="notice">🔒 Biblioteca privada do Teacher · ${esc(x.category||'other')}</div><p>${esc(x.description||'')}</p><div class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>🔗 Recursos</b></div>${rs.map((r,i)=>r.url?`<div class="row"><div><b>${esc(r.title||'Recurso '+(i+1))}</b><small>${esc(r.description||r.type||'link')}</small></div><a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(r.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Abrir ↗</a></div>`:'').join('')||'<div class="empty">Nenhum link válido.</div>'}</div><div class="viewer-panel" style="margin-top:10px"><b>🏷️ Tags</b><p>${esc(x.tags||'—')}</p><b>📝 Notas privadas</b><p>${esc(x.notes||'—')}</p></div><div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Fechar</button><button class="btn primary" onclick='closeModal();openTeacherMaterialFormV53(${JSON.stringify(x)})'>✏️ Editar</button></div>`);
}
async function deleteTeacherMaterialV53(id){if(!confirm('Excluir este Teacher Material da sua biblioteca?'))return;const r=await sb.from('tic_teacher_materials').delete().eq('id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);if(r.error)return toast(r.error.message,'error');toast('Teacher Material excluído.','success');await teacherMaterialsPageV53();}

async function openAssignmentForm(x=null){
 const [{data:students,error},{data:classes}]=await Promise.all([sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active').order('display_name'),sb.from('tic_classes').select('id,name,level').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active').order('name')]);
 if(error){toast('Não foi possível carregar os alunos: '+error.message,'error');return}
 openModal(x?'Editar tarefa':'Nova tarefa',`<form class="form" onsubmit="saveAssignment(event,'${x?.id||''}')">
 <div class="field"><label>Título da tarefa</label><input id="a1" value="${esc(x?.title||'')}" placeholder="Ex.: Listening practice — Unit 3" required></div>
 <div class="field"><label>Instruções para o aluno</label><textarea id="a2" rows="4" placeholder="Explique o que o aluno deve fazer...">${esc(x?.instructions||'')}</textarea></div>
 <div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Tipo</label><select id="a3">${['assignment','speaking','writing','listening','reading','project','quiz','audio','file'].map(v=>`<option ${v===x?.assignment_type?'selected':''}>${v}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Prioridade</label><select id="a4"><option value="normal" ${x?.priority==='normal'||!x?'selected':''}>normal</option><option value="low" ${x?.priority==='low'?'selected':''}>low</option><option value="high" ${x?.priority==='high'?'selected':''}>high</option></select></div></div>
 <div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Prazo</label><input id="a5" type="datetime-local" value="${x?.due_at?new Date(x.due_at).toISOString().slice(0,16):''}"></div><div class="field"><label>Pontos</label><input id="a6" type="number" min="0" value="${x?.points??10}"></div></div>
 <div class="field"><label>Imagem de capa <span style="font-weight:500;color:var(--muted)">(opcional)</span></label><div class="cover-upload"><input id="aCover" value="${esc(x?.cover_image_url||'')}" placeholder="URL da imagem ou faça upload"><input type="file" accept="image/*" onchange="uploadCover(this,'aCover')"></div><div class="resource-help">A imagem aparece como capa do card para deixar o material mais apresentável.</div></div>
 <div class="resource-box"><div class="resource-head"><b>📚 Materiais e recursos da tarefa</b><button type="button" class="btn secondary" onclick="addResourceRow('aResources')">+ Adicionar recurso</button></div><div id="aResources"></div><div class="resource-help">Você pode misturar Google Drive, Google Docs, links, PDF, vídeo, áudio, arquivos e uma atividade escrita manual.</div></div>
 <div class="resource-box"><div class="resource-head"><b>📤 Distribuição</b><span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)">${x?'Os destinatários desta tarefa já foram definidos.':'Envie para um ou vários alunos ou para uma turma inteira.'}</span></div>${x?'':`<div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Destino</label><select id="a7type" onchange="renderAssignmentTarget()"><option value="students">👤 Aluno(s)</option><option value="class">🏫 Turma inteira</option></select></div><div class="field"><label>Notificação</label><select id="a7notify"><option value="none">Somente plataforma</option><option value="whatsapp">📱 Preparar WhatsApp</option></select></div></div><div id="a7target"></div>`}</div>
 <div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary" id="assignmentSaveBtn">Salvar tarefa</button></div></form>`);
 renderResourceRows('aResources',x?.resource_items||[]);
 if(!x)renderAssignmentTarget();
}
async function renderAssignmentTarget(){
 const type=$('a7type')?.value||'students', box=$('a7target'); if(!box)return;
 if(type==='class'){
  const {data}=await sb.from('tic_classes').select('id,name,level').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active').order('name');
  box.innerHTML=`<div class="field"><label>Turma</label><select id="a7class">${(data||[]).map(c=>`<option value="${c.id}">${esc(c.name)} · ${esc(c.level||'')}</option>`).join('')||'<option value="">Nenhuma turma ativa</option>'}</select></div>`;
 }else{
  const {data}=await sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name,current_level,phone').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active').order('display_name');
  box.innerHTML=`<div class="field"><label>Aluno(s) <span style="font-weight:500;color:var(--muted)">— use Ctrl/Cmd para selecionar vários</span></label><select id="a7students" multiple size="6" style="min-height:150px">${(data||[]).map(st=>`<option value="${st.id}">${esc(st.display_name)} · ${esc(st.current_level)}</option>`).join('')||'<option value="">Nenhum aluno ativo</option>'}</select></div>`;
 }
}
async function openAssignContent(sourceType,source){
 const title=source?.title||'Conteúdo';
 const sourceId=source?.id||'';
 const levelsList=levels;
 const [{data:students},{data:classes}]=await Promise.all([
  sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name,current_level,phone').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active').order('display_name'),
  sb.from('tic_classes').select('id,name,level').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active').order('name')
 ]);
 const optionsStudents=(students||[]).map(st=>`<option value="${st.id}">${esc(st.display_name)} · ${esc(st.current_level)}</option>`).join('');
 const optionsClasses=(classes||[]).map(c=>`<option value="${c.id}">${esc(c.name)} · ${esc(c.level||'')}</option>`).join('');
