 openModal(`📤 Atribuir · ${title}`,`<form class="form" onsubmit="saveUniversalAssignment(event,'${esc(sourceType)}','${esc(sourceId)}')">
  <div class="notice">Você está atribuindo <b>${esc(title)}</b>. A mesma função será usada para Lessons, Lesson Plans, Materials e Tasks.</div>
  <div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Destino</label><select id="uTargetType" onchange="toggleUniversalTarget()"><option value="students">👤 Aluno(s)</option><option value="class">🏫 Turma</option></select></div><div class="field"><label>Prazo</label><input id="uDue" type="datetime-local"></div></div>
  <div id="uStudentsBox"><div class="field"><label>Aluno(s)</label><select id="uStudents" multiple size="7" style="min-height:170px">${optionsStudents}</select><small style="color:var(--muted)">Use Ctrl/Cmd para selecionar vários alunos.</small></div></div>
  <div id="uClassBox" class="hidden"><div class="field"><label>Turma</label><select id="uClass">${optionsClasses||'<option value="">Nenhuma turma ativa</option>'}</select></div><div class="notice">Todos os alunos ativos da turma receberão uma cópia da atribuição e terão seu próprio status de conclusão.</div></div>
  <div class="field"><label>Mensagem para o aluno</label><textarea id="uMessage" rows="3" placeholder="Ex.: Complete antes da próxima aula."></textarea></div>
  <div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Notificação</label><select id="uNotify"><option value="none">Somente plataforma</option><option value="whatsapp">📱 Preparar WhatsApp</option></select></div><div class="field"><label>Pontos</label><input id="uPoints" type="number" min="0" value="0"></div></div>
  <div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary" id="uSave">📤 Atribuir agora</button></div></form>`);
}
function toggleUniversalTarget(){const t=$('uTargetType')?.value||'students';$('uStudentsBox')?.classList.toggle('hidden',t!=='students');$('uClassBox')?.classList.toggle('hidden',t!=='class')}
async function saveUniversalAssignment(e,sourceType,sourceId){e.preventDefault();const btn=$('uSave');btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='Atribuindo...';
 try{
  const targetType=$('uTargetType').value;let studentIds=[];let classId=null;
  if(targetType==='class'){
   classId=$('uClass').value;const {data:members,error}=await sb.from('tic_class_students').select('student_id').eq('class_id',classId).eq('status','active');if(error)throw error;studentIds=(members||[]).map(x=>x.student_id);
  }else studentIds=[...($('uStudents')?.selectedOptions||[])].map(o=>o.value);
  studentIds=[...new Set(studentIds)].filter(Boolean);if(!studentIds.length)throw new Error('Selecione pelo menos um aluno ou uma turma com alunos.');
  const {data:source}=sourceType==='lesson'?await sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').eq('id',sourceId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle():await sb.from('tic_materials').select('*').eq('id',sourceId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();
  if(!source)throw new Error('O conteúdo não foi encontrado ou não pertence a este Teacher.');
  const isLesson=sourceType==='lesson';
  const payload={teacher_id:session.user.id,lesson_id:isLesson?sourceId:null,class_id:classId,title:source.title,instructions:$('uMessage').value.trim()||source.description||source.content||'',assignment_type:isLesson?'lesson':'material',due_at:$('uDue').value?new Date($('uDue').value).toISOString():null,points:Number($('uPoints').value||0),priority:'normal',resource_items:Array.isArray(source.resource_items)?source.resource_items:[],cover_image_url:source.cover_image_url||null,source_type:sourceType,source_id:sourceId};
  const {data:a,error:ae}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').insert(payload).select().single();if(ae)throw ae;
  const rows=studentIds.map(student_id=>({assignment_id:a.id,student_id,status:'pending'}));const {error:te}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').insert(rows);if(te){await sb.from('tic_assignments').delete().eq('id',a.id);throw te;}
  closeModal();toast(`${source.title} atribuída para ${studentIds.length} aluno(s).`,'success');loadView(currentView);
  if($('uNotify')?.value==='whatsapp')openWhatsAppShareModal(a.id,studentIds,source.title);
 }catch(err){toast(err.message||'Não foi possível atribuir o conteúdo.','error');btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='📤 Atribuir agora'}
}
async function openWhatsAppShareModal(assignmentId,studentIds,title){const {data}=await sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name,phone').in('id',studentIds).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);const url=location.origin+location.pathname+'?task='+encodeURIComponent(assignmentId);const rows=(data||[]).map(st=>{const n=String(st.phone||'').replace(/\D/g,'');const text=`Olá, ${st.display_name||'Aluno'}! 👋\n\nUma nova atividade foi atribuída a você na Teacher Platform.\n📚 ${title}\n\nAcesse aqui: ${url}`;const href=n.length>=10?`https://wa.me/${n}?text=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`:'';return `<div class="row"><div><b>${esc(st.display_name)}</b><small>${st.phone?esc(st.phone):'WhatsApp não cadastrado'}</small></div>${href?`<a class="btn secondary" href="${href}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">📱 WhatsApp</a>`:'<span class="badge red">Sem WhatsApp</span>'}</div>`}).join('');openModal('📱 Compartilhar pelo WhatsApp',`<div class="notice success">A atribuição foi salva. Agora você pode abrir a conversa de cada aluno com a mensagem e o link já preenchidos.</div><div class="form">${rows||'<div class="empty">Nenhum aluno encontrado.</div>'}<div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Fechar</button><button class="btn primary" onclick="copyAssignmentLink('${esc(url)}')">🔗 Copiar link</button></div></div>`)}
async function copyAssignmentLink(url){try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);toast('Link da atribuição copiado.','success')}catch{toast(url,'info',8000)}}
function shareStudentWhatsApp(id,contentTitle='Nova atividade'){const s=studentsCache.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!s?.phone)return toast('Cadastre o WhatsApp do aluno primeiro.','error');const n=String(s.phone).replace(/\D/g,'');if(n.length<10)return toast('O WhatsApp cadastrado parece inválido.','error');const text=`Olá, ${s.display_name||'Aluno'}! 👋\n\nUma nova atividade foi atribuída a você na Teacher Platform.\n📚 ${contentTitle}\n\nAcesse sua plataforma para realizar a atividade.`;window.open(`https://wa.me/${n}?text=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`,'_blank','noopener')}

function resourceTypeOptions(selected='link'){return [['link','🔗 Link'],['google','🟢 Google Docs / Sheets / Forms'],['drive','📁 Google Drive'],['pdf','📄 PDF'],['video','🎬 Vídeo'],['audio','🎧 Áudio'],['file','📎 Arquivo'],['manual','✍️ Atividade manual']].map(([v,l])=>`<option value="${v}" ${v===selected?'selected':''}>${l}</option>`).join('')}
function addResourceRow(containerId,item={}){const box=$(containerId);if(!box)return;const id='res_'+Date.now()+'_'+Math.random().toString(36).slice(2,7);const type=item.type||'link';const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='resource-row';row.dataset.id=id;row.innerHTML=`<div><select class="res-type" onchange="resourceTypeChanged(this)">${resourceTypeOptions(type)}</select></div><div class="res-main"></div><div class="resource-actions"><button type="button" title="Remover" onclick="this.closest('.resource-row').remove()">✕</button></div>`;box.appendChild(row);renderResourceMain(row,item)}
function renderResourceRows(containerId,items){const box=$(containerId);if(!box)return;box.innerHTML='';(Array.isArray(items)&&items.length?items:[{}]).forEach(item=>addResourceRow(containerId,item))}
function resourceTypeChanged(sel){const row=sel.closest('.resource-row');renderResourceMain(row,{type:sel.value})}
function renderResourceMain(row,item={}){const type=row.querySelector('.res-type').value;const main=row.querySelector('.res-main');const val=item.url||item.value||'';const title=item.title||'';const desc=item.description||'';if(type==='manual'){main.innerHTML=`<div style="display:grid;gap:7px"><input class="res-title" placeholder="Título da atividade" value="${esc(title)}"><textarea class="res-value" placeholder="Escreva aqui a atividade, perguntas, instruções ou conteúdo...">${esc(val||desc)}</textarea></div>`}else{main.innerHTML=`<div style="display:grid;gap:7px"><input class="res-title" placeholder="Nome do recurso" value="${esc(title)}"><div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:7px"><input class="res-url" placeholder="Cole a URL ou envie um arquivo" value="${esc(val)}"><input class="resource-file" type="file" onchange="uploadResourceFile(this)"></div><input class="res-desc" placeholder="Descrição curta (opcional)" value="${esc(desc)}"></div>`}}
function collectResources(containerId){return [...($(containerId)?.querySelectorAll('.resource-row')||[])].map(row=>{const type=row.querySelector('.res-type')?.value||'link';const title=row.querySelector('.res-title')?.value.trim()||'Recurso';if(type==='manual')return {type,title,value:row.querySelector('.res-value')?.value.trim()||'',description:''};return {type,title,url:row.querySelector('.res-url')?.value.trim()||'',description:row.querySelector('.res-desc')?.value.trim()||''};}).filter(x=>x.value||x.url||x.title!=='Recurso')}
async function uploadResourceFile(input){const file=input.files?.[0];if(!file)return;const row=input.closest('.resource-row');const urlInput=row.querySelector('.res-url');input.disabled=true;input.title='Enviando...';try{const safe=file.name.normalize('NFKD').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g,'_');const path=`${session.user.id}/${Date.now()}_${safe}`;const r=await sb.storage.from('tic-media').upload(path,file,{upsert:false,contentType:file.type||undefined});if(r.error)throw r.error;const {data}=sb.storage.from('tic-media').getPublicUrl(path);urlInput.value=data.publicUrl;const title=row.querySelector('.res-title');if(title&&!title.value)title.value=file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/,'');toast('Arquivo enviado.','success')}catch(e){toast('Falha no upload: '+e.message,'error')}finally{input.disabled=false;input.title=''}}
async function uploadCover(input,targetId){const file=input.files?.[0];if(!file)return;input.disabled=true;try{const safe=file.name.normalize('NFKD').replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/g,'_');const path=`${session.user.id}/covers/${Date.now()}_${safe}`;const r=await sb.storage.from('tic-media').upload(path,file,{upsert:false,contentType:file.type||undefined});if(r.error)throw r.error;const {data}=sb.storage.from('tic-media').getPublicUrl(path);$(targetId).value=data.publicUrl;toast('Capa enviada.','success')}catch(e){toast('Falha no upload da capa: '+e.message,'error')}finally{input.disabled=false}}
async function saveAssignment(e,id){e.preventDefault();const btn=$('assignmentSaveBtn');if(btn){btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='Salvando...'}const o={teacher_id:session.user.id,title:$('a1').value.trim(),instructions:$('a2').value.trim(),assignment_type:$('a3').value,priority:$('a4').value,due_at:$('a5').value?new Date($('a5').value).toISOString():null,points:Number($('a6').value||0),resource_items:collectResources('aResources'),cover_image_url:$('aCover').value.trim()||null};let r=id?await sb.from('tic_assignments').update(o).eq('id',id).select().single():await sb.from('tic_assignments').insert(o).select().single();if(r.error){toast('Não foi possível salvar a tarefa: '+r.error.message,'error');if(btn){btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='Salvar tarefa'}return}if(!id){let studentIds=[];let classId=null;if($('a7type')?.value==='class'){classId=$('a7class')?.value||null;const {data:members,error:me}=await sb.from('tic_class_students').select('student_id').eq('class_id',classId).eq('status','active');if(me){await sb.from('tic_assignments').delete().eq('id',r.data.id);toast('Não foi possível ler os alunos da turma: '+me.message,'error');return}studentIds=(members||[]).map(m=>m.student_id)}else{studentIds=[...($('a7students')?.selectedOptions||[])].map(o=>o.value)}studentIds=[...new Set(studentIds)].filter(Boolean);if(!studentIds.length){await sb.from('tic_assignments').delete().eq('id',r.data.id);toast('Selecione pelo menos um aluno ou uma turma.','error');return}if(classId){const ur=await sb.from('tic_assignments').update({class_id:classId}).eq('id',r.data.id);if(ur.error){await sb.from('tic_assignments').delete().eq('id',r.data.id);toast('Não foi possível vincular a turma: '+ur.error.message,'error');return}}const rows=studentIds.map(student_id=>({assignment_id:r.data.id,student_id,status:'pending'}));const rr=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').insert(rows);if(rr.error){await sb.from('tic_assignments').delete().eq('id',r.data.id);toast('A tarefa não foi vinculada aos alunos: '+rr.error.message,'error');return}}closeModal();toast(id?'Tarefa atualizada.':'Tarefa criada e distribuída.','success');loadView('assignments')}

async function openAssignmentSubmissions(assignmentId){
 const {data:a}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').select('id,title').eq('id',assignmentId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();if(!a)return toast('Tarefa não encontrada.','error');
 const {data:rows,error}=await sb.from('tic_submissions').select('id,task_assignment_id,student_id,answer_text,file_url,audio_url,video_url,submitted_at,attempt,grade,tic_students(display_name,email),tic_feedback(id,comment,grade,private_note,improvement_skill,improvement_link,created_at)').in('task_assignment_id', (await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id').eq('assignment_id',assignmentId)).data?.map(x=>x.id)||[]).order('submitted_at',{ascending:false});
 if(error)return toast('Não foi possível carregar as entregas: '+error.message,'error');window.__taMap=new Map(((await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,assignment_id,student_id,active').eq('assignment_id',assignmentId)).data||[]).map(x=>[x.id,x.assignment_id]));renderSubmissionModal(a.title,rows||[],[{id:assignmentId,title:a.title}]);
}
async function openClassSubmissions(classId){
 const {data:cls}=await sb.from('tic_classes').select('id,name').eq('id',classId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();if(!cls)return toast('Turma não encontrada.','error');
 const {data:assignments}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').select('id,title').eq('class_id',classId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('created_at',{ascending:false});const ids=(assignments||[]).map(x=>x.id);if(!ids.length)return openModal(`📝 Feedback · ${cls.name}`,'<div class="empty">Nenhuma tarefa atribuída a esta turma.</div>');
 const {data:tas}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,assignment_id').in('assignment_id',ids);const taIds=(tas||[]).map(x=>x.id);if(!taIds.length)return openModal(`📝 Feedback · ${cls.name}`,'<div class="empty">Nenhuma entrega ainda.</div>');
 const {data:rows}=await sb.from('tic_submissions').select('id,task_assignment_id,student_id,answer_text,file_url,audio_url,video_url,submitted_at,attempt,grade,tic_students(display_name,email),tic_feedback(id,comment,grade,private_note,improvement_skill,improvement_link,created_at)').in('task_assignment_id',taIds).order('submitted_at',{ascending:false});
 window.__taMap=new Map((tas||[]).map(x=>[x.id,x.assignment_id]));renderSubmissionModal(`Feedback · ${cls.name}`,rows||[],assignments);
}
function renderSubmissionModal(title,rows,assignments=[]){
 const amap=new Map(assignments.map(x=>[x.id,x.title]));window.__submissionCache=new Map();
 const body=(rows||[]).map(x=>{const f=Array.isArray(x.tic_feedback)?x.tic_feedback[0]:x.tic_feedback;window.__submissionCache.set(x.id,{submission:x,feedback:f||null});const taskTitle=amap.get((window.__taMap||new Map()).get?.(x.task_assignment_id))||'';const active=x.__active!==false;return `<article class="card" style="margin-bottom:10px;border:1px solid #e8e5f2"><div class="section-head"><div><b>👤 ${esc(x.tic_students?.display_name||'Aluno')}</b><small style="display:block">${esc(taskTitle||'Entrega')} · tentativa ${x.attempt||1} · ${fmtDate(x.submitted_at)}</small></div>${x.grade!=null?`<span class="badge green">Nota ${x.grade}</span>`:'<span class="badge yellow">Sem correção</span>'}</div>${x.answer_text?`<div style="white-space:pre-wrap;line-height:1.6;margin:10px 0"><b>Resposta:</b><br>${esc(x.answer_text)}</div>`:''}${x.file_url?`<a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(x.file_url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">📎 Abrir arquivo/link</a>`:''}${f?`<div class="notice success" style="margin-top:10px"><b>Feedback enviado</b>${f.grade!=null?`<div style="font-weight:800;margin-top:4px">Nota: ${f.grade}</div>`:''}<div style="white-space:pre-wrap;margin-top:5px">${esc(f.comment||'')}</div>${f.improvement_skill||f.improvement_link?`<div class="notice" style="margin-top:9px"><b>🎯 Plano de melhoria</b>${f.improvement_skill?`<div style="margin-top:4px">Habilidade: <b>${esc(f.improvement_skill)}</b></div>`:''}${f.improvement_link?`<div style="margin-top:7px"><a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(f.improvement_link)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">🔗 Abrir material de melhoria</a></div>`:''}</div>`:''}</div>`:''}<div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn primary" onclick="openFeedbackFromCache('${x.id}')">${f?'✏️ Editar feedback':'📝 Corrigir / Feedback'}</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="removeTaskAssignment('${x.task_assignment_id}','${x.student_id}','${esc(x.tic_students?.display_name||'Aluno')}')">🗑 Remover atribuição</button></div></article>`}).join('');
 openModal(`📝 ${title}`,body||'<div class="empty">Nenhuma entrega encontrada.</div>');
}
function openFeedbackFromCache(id){const item=window.__submissionCache?.get(id);if(item)openFeedbackForm(item.submission,item.feedback);}
async function openFeedbackForm(submission,existing=null){
 const f=Array.isArray(existing)?existing[0]:existing;openModal('📝 Feedback da entrega',`<form class="form" onsubmit="saveFeedback(event,'${submission.id}','${submission.task_assignment_id}','${submission.student_id}')"><div class="notice"><b>${esc(submission.tic_students?.display_name||'Aluno')}</b><br>Entrega enviada em ${fmtDate(submission.submitted_at)} · tentativa ${submission.attempt||1}${submission.answer_text?`<div style="margin-top:8px;white-space:pre-wrap"><b>Resposta:</b><br>${esc(submission.answer_text)}</div>`:''}${submission.file_url?`<div style="margin-top:8px"><a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(submission.file_url)}" target="_blank">Abrir arquivo/link →</a></div>`:''}</div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Nota</label><input id="fbGrade" type="number" min="0" max="100" step="0.1" value="${f?.grade??submission.grade??''}" placeholder="0–100"></div><div class="field"><label>Visibilidade</label><select id="fbPrivate"><option value="false" ${!f?.private_note?'selected':''}>Aluno pode ver</option><option value="true" ${f?.private_note?'selected':''}>Nota privada do Teacher</option></select></div></div><div class="field"><label>Feedback para o aluno</label><textarea id="fbComment" rows="7" placeholder="Escreva pontos fortes, correções e próximos passos...">${esc(f?.comment||'')}</textarea></div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>🎯 Habilidade para melhorar</label><select id="fbSkill"><option value="">Selecione uma habilidade</option>${['grammar','vocabulary','listening','reading','writing','speaking','pronunciation','fluency','communication'].map(v=>`<option value="${v}" ${f?.improvement_skill===v?'selected':''}>${v}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>🔗 Link de melhoria (opcional)</label><input id="fbImprovementLink" type="url" value="${esc(f?.improvement_link||'')}" placeholder="https://..." /></div></div><div class="notice" style="font-size:12px">💡 O aluno poderá ver esta correção e o material de melhoria e poderá enviar <b>novas tentativas</b> enquanto a atribuição permanecer ativa.</div><div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">💾 Salvar feedback</button></div></form>`);
}
async function saveFeedback(e,submissionId,taskAssignmentId,studentId){e.preventDefault();const grade=$('fbGrade')?.value.trim();const comment=$('fbComment')?.value.trim()||null;const private_note=$('fbPrivate')?.value==='true';const improvement_skill=$('fbSkill')?.value||null;const improvement_link=$('fbImprovementLink')?.value.trim()||null;
 const payload={submission_id:submissionId,teacher_id:session.user.id,comment,grade:grade===''?null:Number(grade),private_note,improvement_skill,improvement_link};
 const {data:existing}=await sb.from('tic_feedback').select('id').eq('submission_id',submissionId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();let r=existing?await sb.from('tic_feedback').update(payload).eq('id',existing.id):await sb.from('tic_feedback').insert(payload);
 if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível salvar o feedback: '+r.error.message,'error');
 const tr=await sb.from('tic_submissions').update({grade:grade===''?null:Number(grade)}).eq('id',submissionId);if(tr.error)return toast('Feedback salvo, mas a nota da entrega não foi atualizada: '+tr.error.message,'error');
 await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').update({status:'reviewed'}).eq('id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',studentId);closeModal();toast('Feedback salvo. A atribuição continua ativa para novas tentativas.','success');loadView('feedback');
}
async function removeTaskAssignment(taskAssignmentId,studentId,studentName){
 if(!confirm(`Remover a atribuição desta tarefa para ${studentName||'este aluno'}? O histórico de entregas e correções será preservado, mas o aluno não poderá mais abrir a tarefa.`))return;
 const {error}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').update({active:false,removed_at:new Date().toISOString()}).eq('id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',studentId);
 if(error)return toast('Não foi possível remover a atribuição: '+error.message,'error');toast('Atribuição removida. O histórico foi preservado.','success');closeModal();loadView('feedback');
}

async function feedbackPage(){
 const {data:tas,error}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,assignment_id,student_id,status,active,removed_at,assigned_at,completed_at,tic_assignments(title,due_at,assignment_type),tic_students(display_name,email)').order('assigned_at',{ascending:false});if(error){$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention"><b>Não foi possível carregar as atividades.</b><p>${esc(error.message)}</p></div>`;return}
 const ids=(tas||[]).map(x=>x.id);let subs=[];if(ids.length){const r=await sb.from('tic_submissions').select('id,task_assignment_id,submitted_at,grade').in('task_assignment_id',ids).order('submitted_at',{ascending:false});subs=r.data||[]}
 const rows=(tas||[]).map(t=>{const sub=subs.find(x=>x.task_assignment_id===t.id);return `<tr><td><b>${esc(t.tic_students?.display_name||'')}</b></td><td>${esc(t.tic_assignments?.title||'')}</td><td>${sub?fmtDate(sub.submitted_at):'—'}</td><td>${sub?.grade!=null?`<span class="badge green">${sub.grade}</span>`:'<span class="badge yellow">Pendente</span>'}</td><td>${sub?`<button class="btn sm primary" onclick="openFeedbackFromId('${sub.id}')">📝 Corrigir</button>`:`<span class="badge gray">Aguardando entrega</span>`} ${t.active!==false?`<button class="btn sm ghost" onclick="removeTaskAssignment('${t.id}','${t.student_id}','${esc(t.tic_students?.display_name||'Aluno')}')">🗑 Remover</button>`:`<span class="badge red">Removida</span>`}</td></tr>`}).join('');
 $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card"><div class="notice">📌 <b>Fluxo:</b> aluno envia a entrega → Teacher corrige → nota e comentário aparecem no painel do aluno.</div><div class="table-wrap"><table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Aluno</th><th>Tarefa</th><th>Entrega</th><th>Nota</th><th>Ação</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows||'<tr><td colspan="5" class="empty">Nenhuma atividade encontrada.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div></div>`;
}
async function openFeedbackFromId(submissionId){const {data:x}=await sb.from('tic_submissions').select('id,task_assignment_id,student_id,answer_text,file_url,audio_url,video_url,submitted_at,attempt,grade,tic_students(display_name,email)').eq('id',submissionId).maybeSingle();
 if(!x)return;
 const {data:f}=await sb.from('tic_feedback').select('id,comment,grade,private_note,improvement_skill,improvement_link,created_at').eq('submission_id',submissionId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();openFeedbackForm(x,f);
}

/* ==========================================================
   AGENDA V2 — visual, responsive, recurring + sporadic
   Preserves tic_events schema: recurring events are materialized
   as individual occurrences, so no database migration is required.
   ========================================================== */
let ticAgendaState={student:false,mode:'week',anchor:new Date(),events:[],students:[],classes:[],selectedStudent:null};

function ticAgendaDateKey(d){const x=new Date(d);return `${x.getFullYear()}-${String(x.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')}-${String(x.getDate()).padStart(2,'0')}`}
function ticAgendaStartOfWeek(d){const x=new Date(d);x.setHours(0,0,0,0);const day=x.getDay();x.setDate(x.getDate()-(day===0?6:day-1));return x}
function ticAgendaEndOfWeek(d){const x=ticAgendaStartOfWeek(d);x.setDate(x.getDate()+7);return x}
function ticAgendaMonthStart(d){const x=new Date(d.getFullYear(),d.getMonth(),1);x.setHours(0,0,0,0);return x}
function ticAgendaMonthEnd(d){const x=new Date(d.getFullYear(),d.getMonth()+1,1);x.setHours(0,0,0,0);return x}
function ticAgendaFmtTime(v){return new Date(v).toLocaleTimeString('pt-BR',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'})}
function ticAgendaFmtDay(v){return new Date(v).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR',{day:'2-digit',month:'2-digit'})}
function ticAgendaTypeLabel(t){return ({class:'Aula',meeting:'Reunião',exam:'Avaliação',other:'Evento',lesson:'Aula',next_class:'Próxima aula'})[t]||t||'Evento'}
function ticAgendaTypeIcon(t){return ({class:'📚',meeting:'🤝',exam:'📝',other:'📌',lesson:'📚',next_class:'🎯'})[t]||'📅'}
function ticAgendaTypeClass(t){return `agenda-type-${String(t||'other').replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]/gi,'')}`}
function ticAgendaStatusLabel(s){return ({scheduled:'Agendada',pending:'Pendente',completed:'Concluída',cancelled:'Cancelada',rescheduled:'Reagendada',done:'Concluída'})[s]||s||'Agendada'}
function ticAgendaEsc(v){return esc(v==null?'':String(v))}

async function calendarPage(student=false){
  ticAgendaState.student=student;
  ticAgendaState.anchor=new Date();
  ticAgendaState.mode='week';
  const userId=session.user.id;
  let students=[],classes=[];
  if(student){
    const {data:s}=await sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name,current_level,teacher_id').eq('auth_user_id',userId).maybeSingle();
    if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Sua conta ainda não está vinculada a um cadastro de aluno.</div>';return}
    ticAgendaState.selectedStudent=s.id;
  }else{
    const [sr,cr]=await Promise.all([
      sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name,current_level').eq('teacher_id',userId).eq('status','active').order('display_name'),
      sb.from('tic_classes').select('id,name,level,status').eq('teacher_id',userId).eq('status','active').order('name')
    ]);
    students=sr.data||[];classes=cr.data||[];
  }
  ticAgendaState.students=students;ticAgendaState.classes=classes;
  await ticAgendaReload();
}

async function ticAgendaReload(){
  const student=ticAgendaState.student;
  let q=sb.from('tic_events').select('*').order('starts_at',{ascending:true});
  if(student)q=q.eq('student_id',ticAgendaState.selectedStudent);
  else q=q.eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);
  const {data,error}=await q;
  if(error){$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention"><b>Não foi possível carregar a agenda.</b><p>${ticAgendaEsc(error.message)}</p></div>`;return}
  ticAgendaState.events=data||[];
  ticAgendaRender();
}

function ticAgendaRender(){
  const c=$('content');if(!c)return;
  const st=ticAgendaState, d=st.anchor, ev=st.events;
  const todayKey=ticAgendaDateKey(new Date());
  const upcoming=ev.filter(e=>new Date(e.starts_at)>=new Date()).slice(0,5);
  const weekStart=ticAgendaStartOfWeek(d),weekEnd=ticAgendaEndOfWeek(d);
  const weekEvents=ev.filter(e=>new Date(e.starts_at)>=weekStart&&new Date(e.starts_at)<weekEnd);
  const monthStart=ticAgendaMonthStart(d),monthEnd=ticAgendaMonthEnd(d);
  const monthEvents=ev.filter(e=>new Date(e.starts_at)>=monthStart&&new Date(e.starts_at)<monthEnd);
  const done=ev.filter(e=>['completed','done'].includes(e.status)).length;
  const recurringHint=ev.filter(e=>String(e.notes||'').includes('[RECORRÊNCIA]')).length;
  const toolbar=st.student?'':`<div class="agenda-toolbar-actions"><button class="btn secondary" onclick="ticAgendaToday()">Hoje</button><button class="btn secondary" onclick="ticAgendaMove(-1)">‹</button><button class="btn secondary" onclick="ticAgendaMove(1)">›</button><button class="btn primary" onclick="openEventForm()">＋ Novo evento</button></div>`;
  c.innerHTML=`<div class="agenda-shell">
    <header class="agenda-hero"><div><div class="agenda-kicker">📅 Teacher Platform</div><h1>Agenda</h1><p>${st.student?'Suas aulas, compromissos e próximos encontros.':'Organize aulas, turmas, alunos, avaliações e compromissos em um só lugar.'}</p></div>${toolbar}</header>
    <section class="agenda-summary"><article><span>📅</span><b>${weekEvents.length}</b><small>eventos esta semana</small></article><article><span>🗓️</span><b>${monthEvents.length}</b><small>eventos no mês</small></article><article><span>✅</span><b>${done}</b><small>concluídos</small></article><article><span>🔄</span><b>${recurringHint}</b><small>ocorrências recorrentes</small></article><article><span>⏭️</span><b>${upcoming.length}</b><small>próximos registros</small></article></section>
    <nav class="agenda-tabs"><button class="${st.mode==='overview'?'active':''}" onclick="ticAgendaMode('overview')">📊 Overview</button><button class="${st.mode==='day'?'active':''}" onclick="ticAgendaMode('day')">☀️ Dia</button><button class="${st.mode==='week'?'active':''}" onclick="ticAgendaMode('week')">📆 Semana</button><button class="${st.mode==='month'?'active':''}" onclick="ticAgendaMode('month')">🗓️ Mês</button><button class="${st.mode==='list'?'active':''}" onclick="ticAgendaMode('list')">☷ Lista</button><button class="${st.mode==='recurring'?'active':''}" onclick="ticAgendaMode('recurring')">🔄 Recorrentes</button></nav>
    <div class="agenda-main">${ticAgendaBody()}</div>
  </div>`;
}

function ticAgendaBody(){
  const st=ticAgendaState;
  if(st.mode==='overview')return ticAgendaOverview();
  if(st.mode==='day')return ticAgendaDay();
  if(st.mode==='month')return ticAgendaMonth();
  if(st.mode==='list')return ticAgendaList();
  if(st.mode==='recurring')return ticAgendaRecurring();
  return ticAgendaWeek();
}
function ticAgendaNavTitle(){const d=ticAgendaState.anchor;if(ticAgendaState.mode==='month')return d.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR',{month:'long',year:'numeric'});if(ticAgendaState.mode==='day')return d.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR',{weekday:'long',day:'2-digit',month:'long'});const a=ticAgendaStartOfWeek(d),b=new Date(a);b.setDate(b.getDate()+6);return `${a.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR',{day:'2-digit',month:'short'})} — ${b.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR',{day:'2-digit',month:'short',year:'numeric'})}`}
function ticAgendaNav(){return `<div class="agenda-view-head"><div><h2>${ticAgendaNavTitle()}</h2><small>Arraste visualmente com a rolagem horizontal ou use os controles para navegar.</small></div><div class="agenda-nav-buttons"><button class="btn secondary" onclick="ticAgendaToday()">Hoje</button><button class="btn secondary" onclick="ticAgendaMove(-1)">‹ Anterior</button><button class="btn secondary" onclick="ticAgendaMove(1)">Próximo ›</button></div></div>`}
function ticAgendaCard(e){const cls=ticAgendaTypeClass(e.event_type),studentName=ticAgendaState.students.find(s=>s.id===e.student_id)?.display_name;return `<article class="agenda-event-card ${cls}" onclick="openEventForm('${e.id}')"><div class="agenda-event-time">${ticAgendaFmtTime(e.starts_at)}${e.ends_at?' — '+ticAgendaFmtTime(e.ends_at):''}</div><div class="agenda-event-title">${ticAgendaTypeIcon(e.event_type)} ${ticAgendaEsc(e.title)}</div><div class="agenda-event-meta">${studentName?'👤 '+ticAgendaEsc(studentName)+' · ':''}${ticAgendaTypeLabel(e.event_type)} · ${ticAgendaStatusLabel(e.status)}</div><div class="agenda-event-actions"><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="event.stopPropagation();openEventForm('${e.id}')">Editar</button><button class="btn sm ghost" onclick="event.stopPropagation();ticAgendaDelete('${e.id}')">Excluir</button>${e.meeting_url?`<a class="btn sm primary" onclick="event.stopPropagation()" href="${ticAgendaEsc(e.meeting_url)}" target="_blank">Entrar</a>`:''}</div></article>`}
function ticAgendaWeek(){const a=ticAgendaStartOfWeek(ticAgendaState.anchor),days=['Seg','Ter','Qua','Qui','Sex','Sáb','Dom'];return `${ticAgendaNav()}<div class="agenda-week-grid">${days.map((name,i)=>{const day=new Date(a);day.setDate(a.getDate()+i);const key=ticAgendaDateKey(day),list=ticAgendaState.events.filter(e=>ticAgendaDateKey(e.starts_at)===key).sort((x,y)=>new Date(x.starts_at)-new Date(y.starts_at));return `<section class="agenda-day-column ${key===ticAgendaDateKey(new Date())?'today':''}"><header><b>${name}</b><strong>${day.getDate()}</strong></header><div class="agenda-day-body">${list.map(ticAgendaCard).join('')||'<div class="agenda-empty-day">Sem eventos</div>'}</div></section>`}).join('')}</div>`}
function ticAgendaDay(){const key=ticAgendaDateKey(ticAgendaState.anchor),list=ticAgendaState.events.filter(e=>ticAgendaDateKey(e.starts_at)===key).sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.starts_at)-new Date(b.starts_at));return `${ticAgendaNav()}<div class="agenda-day-list">${list.map(ticAgendaCard).join('')||'<div class="card empty">Nenhum evento para este dia.</div>'}</div>`}
function ticAgendaMonth(){const d=ticAgendaState.anchor,first=new Date(d.getFullYear(),d.getMonth(),1),start=ticAgendaStartOfWeek(first),cells=[];for(let i=0;i<42;i++){const day=new Date(start);day.setDate(start.getDate()+i);const key=ticAgendaDateKey(day),list=ticAgendaState.events.filter(e=>ticAgendaDateKey(e.starts_at)===key);cells.push(`<section class="agenda-month-cell ${day.getMonth()!==d.getMonth()?'muted':''} ${key===ticAgendaDateKey(new Date())?'today':''}"><header><b>${day.getDate()}</b>${list.length?`<span>${list.length}</span>`:''}</header><div>${list.slice(0,4).map(e=>`<button class="agenda-month-event ${ticAgendaTypeClass(e.event_type)}" onclick="openEventForm('${e.id}')">${ticAgendaFmtTime(e.starts_at)} · ${ticAgendaEsc(e.title)}</button>`).join('')}${list.length>4?`<small>+${list.length-4} mais</small>`:''}</div></section>`)}return `${ticAgendaNav()}<div class="agenda-month-grid">${['Seg','Ter','Qua','Qui','Sex','Sáb','Dom'].map(x=>`<div class="agenda-month-weekday">${x}</div>`).join('')}${cells.join('')}</div>`}
function ticAgendaList(){const list=[...ticAgendaState.events].sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.starts_at)-new Date(b.starts_at));return `${ticAgendaNav()}<div class="agenda-list-panel">${list.map(e=>`<div class="agenda-list-row"><div class="agenda-list-date"><b>${ticAgendaFmtDay(e.starts_at)}</b><small>${ticAgendaFmtTime(e.starts_at)}</small></div><div class="agenda-list-info"><strong>${ticAgendaTypeIcon(e.event_type)} ${ticAgendaEsc(e.title)}</strong><small>${ticAgendaTypeLabel(e.event_type)} · ${ticAgendaStatusLabel(e.status)}${e.notes?' · '+ticAgendaEsc(String(e.notes).replace('[RECORRÊNCIA]','')):''}</small></div><div class="agenda-list-actions"><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="openEventForm('${e.id}')">Editar</button><button class="btn sm ghost" onclick="ticAgendaDelete('${e.id}')">Excluir</button></div></div>`).join('')||'<div class="card empty">Nenhum evento cadastrado.</div>'}</div>`}
function ticAgendaOverview(){const ev=[...ticAgendaState.events].sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.created_at||b.starts_at)-new Date(a.created_at||a.starts_at)).slice(0,8);return `<div class="agenda-overview-grid"><section class="agenda-panel"><div class="section-head"><div><h2>📌 Próximos eventos</h2><small>O que vem pela frente.</small></div><button class="btn primary" onclick="ticAgendaMode('week')">Ver semana</button></div>${ticAgendaState.events.filter(e=>new Date(e.starts_at)>=new Date()).slice(0,6).map(ticAgendaCard).join('')||'<div class="agenda-empty">Nenhum próximo evento.</div>'}</section><section class="agenda-panel"><div class="section-head"><div><h2>🕘 Últimos registros</h2><small>Atividades recentes da agenda.</small></div></div>${ev.map(e=>`<div class="agenda-history-row"><span class="${ticAgendaTypeClass(e.event_type)}">${ticAgendaTypeIcon(e.event_type)}</span><div><b>${ticAgendaEsc(e.title)}</b><small>${new Date(e.created_at||e.starts_at).toLocaleString('pt-BR')} · ${ticAgendaStatusLabel(e.status)}</small></div><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="openEventForm('${e.id}')">Abrir</button></div>`).join('')||'<div class="agenda-empty">Nenhum registro.</div>'}</section></div>`}
function ticAgendaRecurring(){const list=ticAgendaState.events.filter(e=>String(e.notes||'').includes('[RECORRÊNCIA]'));return `${ticAgendaNav()}<div class="agenda-recurring-info"><b>🔄 Agenda recorrente</b><span>As ocorrências são gravadas individualmente para manter compatibilidade com os dados atuais.</span></div><div class="agenda-list-panel">${list.map(e=>`<div class="agenda-list-row"><div class="agenda-list-date"><b>${ticAgendaFmtDay(e.starts_at)}</b><small>${ticAgendaFmtTime(e.starts_at)}</small></div><div class="agenda-list-info"><strong>🔄 ${ticAgendaEsc(e.title)}</strong><small>${ticAgendaEsc(String(e.notes||'').replace('[RECORRÊNCIA]','').replace(/\n/g,' '))}</small></div><div class="agenda-list-actions"><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="openEventForm('${e.id}')">Editar</button><button class="btn sm ghost" onclick="ticAgendaDelete('${e.id}')">Excluir</button></div></div>`).join('')||'<div class="card empty">Nenhuma ocorrência recorrente cadastrada.</div>'}</div>`}
function ticAgendaMode(m){ticAgendaState.mode=m;ticAgendaRender()}
function ticAgendaToday(){ticAgendaState.anchor=new Date();ticAgendaRender()}
function ticAgendaMove(n){const d=ticAgendaState.anchor;if(ticAgendaState.mode==='month')d.setMonth(d.getMonth()+n);else if(ticAgendaState.mode==='day')d.setDate(d.getDate()+n);else d.setDate(d.getDate()+7*n);ticAgendaRender()}

async function openEventForm(id=null){
  let x=null;
  if(id){const r=await sb.from('tic_events').select('*').eq('id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();x=r.data;if(!x)return toast('Evento não encontrado.','error')}
  const students=ticAgendaState.students||[],classes=ticAgendaState.classes||[];
  const dt=x?.starts_at?new Date(x.starts_at):new Date(Date.now()+3600000);const local=new Date(dt.getTime()-dt.getTimezoneOffset()*60000).toISOString().slice(0,16);
  const selectedStudents=x?.student_id?[x.student_id]:[];
  openModal(x?'✏️ Editar evento':'📅 Novo evento',`<form class="form agenda-event-form" onsubmit="saveEvent(event,'${x?.id||''}')">
    <div class="agenda-form-hero"><div><span class="badge blue">${x?'EDIÇÃO':'NOVO EVENTO'}</span><h2>${x?ticAgendaEsc(x.title):'Planeje seu próximo compromisso'}</h2></div></div>
    <div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Título</label><input id="e1" required value="${ticAgendaEsc(x?.title||'')}"></div><div class="field"><label>Tipo</label><select id="e2"><option value="class" ${x?.event_type==='class'?'selected':''}>📚 Aula</option><option value="meeting" ${x?.event_type==='meeting'?'selected':''}>🤝 Reunião</option><option value="exam" ${x?.event_type==='exam'?'selected':''}>📝 Avaliação</option><option value="other" ${x?.event_type==='other'?'selected':''}>📌 Evento</option></select></div></div>
    <div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Início</label><input id="e3" type="datetime-local" required value="${local}"></div><div class="field"><label>Duração</label><select id="eDuration"><option value="30">30 min</option><option value="45">45 min</option><option value="60" selected>60 min</option><option value="90">90 min</option><option value="120">120 min</option></select></div></div>
    ${!ticAgendaState.student?`<div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Aluno(s)</label><select id="eStudents" multiple size="5">${students.map(s=>`<option value="${s.id}" ${selectedStudents.includes(s.id)?'selected':''}>${ticAgendaEsc(s.display_name)} · ${ticAgendaEsc(s.current_level||'')}</option>`).join('')}</select><small>Segure Ctrl para selecionar vários alunos.</small></div><div class="field"><label>Turma</label><select id="eClass"><option value="">Sem turma</option>${classes.map(c=>`<option value="${c.id}" ${x?.class_id===c.id?'selected':''}>${ticAgendaEsc(c.name)} · ${ticAgendaEsc(c.level||'')}</option>`).join('')}</select></div></div>`:''}
    ${!x?`<div class="agenda-recurring-box"><label><input id="eRecurring" type="checkbox" onchange="document.getElementById('eRecurringOptions').style.display=this.checked?'grid':'none'"> 🔄 Criar agenda recorrente</label><div id="eRecurringOptions" class="form-grid" style="display:none"><div class="field"><label>Repetir</label><select id="eRepeat"><option value="weekly">Toda semana</option><option value="biweekly">A cada 2 semanas</option><option value="monthly">Todo mês</option></select></div><div class="field"><label>Até</label><input id="eUntil" type="date" value="${new Date(Date.now()+30*86400000).toISOString().slice(0,10)}"></div></div></div>`:''}
    <div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Status</label><select id="eStatus"><option value="scheduled" ${x?.status==='scheduled'||!x?'selected':''}>Agendada</option><option value="completed" ${x?.status==='completed'?'selected':''}>Concluída</option><option value="cancelled" ${x?.status==='cancelled'?'selected':''}>Cancelada</option><option value="rescheduled" ${x?.status==='rescheduled'?'selected':''}>Reagendada</option></select></div><div class="field"><label>Link da aula</label><input id="e4" value="${ticAgendaEsc(x?.meeting_url||'')}" placeholder="Google Meet, Zoom, Teams..."></div></div>
    <div class="field"><label>Observações</label><textarea id="e5" rows="4" placeholder="Assunto, tópico, homework, observações...">${ticAgendaEsc(String(x?.notes||'').replace('[RECORRÊNCIA]',''))}</textarea></div>
    <div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button>${x?`<button type="button" class="btn danger" onclick="ticAgendaDelete('${x.id}',true)">Excluir</button>`:''}<button class="btn primary">${x?'Salvar alterações':'Criar evento'}</button></div>
  </form>`)
}

async function saveEvent(e,id=''){e.preventDefault();const title=$('e1').value.trim(),type=$('e2').value,start=new Date($('e3').value),duration=Number($('eDuration')?.value||60),status=$('eStatus')?.value||'scheduled',url=$('e4').value.trim()||null,notes=$('e5').value.trim()||null,classId=$('eClass')?.value||null;const end=new Date(start.getTime()+duration*60000);if(!title||Number.isNaN(start.getTime()))return toast('Preencha título e data corretamente.','error');
  if(id){const r=await sb.from('tic_events').update({title,event_type:type,starts_at:start.toISOString(),ends_at:end.toISOString(),meeting_url:url,notes,status,class_id:classId}).eq('id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível atualizar: '+r.error.message,'error');closeModal();toast('Evento atualizado.','success');await ticAgendaReload();return}
  let studentIds=[null];if($('eStudents')){studentIds=[...$('eStudents').selectedOptions].map(o=>o.value).filter(Boolean);if(!studentIds.length)studentIds=[null]}
  const recurring=$('eRecurring')?.checked,repeat=$('eRepeat')?.value,until=$('eUntil')?.value;
  let starts=[];if(recurring){if(!until)return toast('Defina a data final da recorrência.','error');let cur=new Date(start),last=new Date(until+'T23:59:59');while(cur<=last&&starts.length<104){starts.push(new Date(cur));if(repeat==='monthly')cur.setMonth(cur.getMonth()+1);else cur.setDate(cur.getDate()+(repeat==='biweekly'?14:7))}}else starts=[start];
  const rows=[];starts.forEach(dt=>studentIds.forEach(sid=>rows.push({teacher_id:session.user.id,student_id:sid,class_id:classId,title,event_type:type,starts_at:dt.toISOString(),ends_at:new Date(dt.getTime()+duration*60000).toISOString(),meeting_url:url,notes:recurring?`[RECORRÊNCIA] ${notes||''}`:notes,status})));
  const r=await sb.from('tic_events').insert(rows);if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível salvar: '+r.error.message,'error');closeModal();toast(`${rows.length} evento(s) criado(s) com sucesso.`,'success');await ticAgendaReload();
}

async function ticAgendaDelete(id,fromForm=false){if(!confirm('Excluir este evento? Os demais registros da agenda serão preservados.'))return;const r=await sb.from('tic_events').delete().eq('id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível excluir: '+r.error.message,'error');if(fromForm)closeModal();toast('Evento removido.','success');await ticAgendaReload()}

async function progressPage(student=false){
 let students=[];if(student){const {data:s}=await sb.from('tic_students').select('*').eq('auth_user_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Conta não vinculada.</div>';return}students=[s]}else{const {data:s}=await sb.from('tic_students').select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active');students=s||[]}
 const ids=students.map(s=>s.id);let q=sb.from('tic_progress').select('*').in('student_id',ids);const {data:p}=ids.length?await q:{data:[]};
 $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="grid cols3">${students.map(s=>{const overall=p?.find(x=>x.student_id===s.id&&x.skill==='overall'&&x.level===s.current_level)?.progress||0;return `<div class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>${esc(s.display_name)}</h2><span>${s.current_level}</span></div><div style="font:800 27px 'Plus Jakarta Sans'">${overall}%</div><div class="progress"><i style="width:${overall}%"></i></div><div style="margin-top:15px">${skills.slice(0,7).map(k=>{const v=p?.find(x=>x.student_id===s.id&&x.skill===k&&x.level===s.current_level)?.progress||0;return `<div class="mini"><span>${k}</span><b>${v}%</b></div><div class="progress" style="height:5px;margin-bottom:8px"><i style="width:${v}%"></i></div>`}).join('')}</div></div>`}).join('')||'<div class="card empty">Nenhum aluno.</div>'}</div>`;
}

async function messagesPage(student=false){
 let sid=null;if(student){const {data:s}=await sb.from('tic_students').select('id').eq('auth_user_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();sid=s?.id}
 let q=sb.from('tic_messages').select('*').order('created_at');if(student)q=q.eq('student_id',sid);else q=q.eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);const {data}=await q;
 $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>${student?'Conversa com seu Teacher':'Mensagens'}</h2>${student?'':'<button class="btn primary" onclick="openMessageForm()">+ Mensagem</button>'}</div>${(data||[]).map(m=>`<div class="row"><div><b>${m.sender_id===session.user.id?'Você':'Mensagem'}</b><small>${esc(m.body)} · ${new Date(m.created_at).toLocaleString('pt-BR')}</small></div>${m.read_at?'<span class="badge green">Lida</span>':'<span class="badge yellow">Nova</span>'}</div>`).join('')||'<div class="empty">Nenhuma mensagem.</div>'}</div>`;
}
async function openMessageForm(){const {data:s}=await sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active');openModal('Nova mensagem',`<form class="form" onsubmit="saveMessage(event)"><div class="field"><label>Aluno</label><select id="m1">${(s||[]).map(x=>`<option value="${x.id}">${esc(x.display_name)}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Mensagem</label><textarea id="m2" required></textarea></div><div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">Enviar</button></div></form>`)}
async function saveMessage(e){e.preventDefault();const r=await sb.from('tic_messages').insert({teacher_id:session.user.id,student_id:$('m1').value,sender_id:session.user.id,body:$('m2').value});if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível enviar: '+r.error.message,'error');closeModal();toast('Mensagem enviada.','success');loadView('messages')}

async function notificationsPage(){const {data}=await sb.from('tic_notifications').select('*').eq('user_id',session.user.id).order('created_at',{ascending:false});$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card">${(data||[]).map(n=>`<div class="row"><div><b>${esc(n.title)}</b><small>${esc(n.body||'')} · ${new Date(n.created_at).toLocaleString('pt-BR')}</small></div>${n.read_at?badge('read'):badge('pending')}</div>`).join('')||'<div class="empty">Nenhuma notificação.</div>'}</div>`}

async function paymentsPage(){
 const {data}=await sb.from('tic_monthly_payments').select('*,tic_students(display_name)').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('reference_month',{ascending:false}).order('due_date');
 const paid=(data||[]).filter(x=>x.status==='paid').reduce((a,x)=>a+Number(x.amount),0),pending=(data||[]).filter(x=>x.status==='pending').reduce((a,x)=>a+Number(x.amount),0),late=(data||[]).filter(x=>x.status==='overdue').reduce((a,x)=>a+Number(x.amount),0);
 $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="grid stats"><div class="card"><div class="stat-label">Previsto</div><div class="stat-value">${money(paid+pending+late)}</div></div><div class="card"><div class="stat-label">Recebido</div><div class="stat-value">${money(paid)}</div></div><div class="card"><div class="stat-label">Pendente</div><div class="stat-value">${money(pending)}</div></div><div class="card"><div class="stat-label">Atrasado</div><div class="stat-value">${money(late)}</div></div></div><div class="card section"><div class="table-wrap"><table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Aluno</th><th>Referência</th><th>Valor</th><th>Vencimento</th><th>Pagamento</th><th>Status</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>${(data||[]).map(p=>`<tr><td><b>${esc(p.tic_students?.display_name||'')}</b></td><td>${monthLabel(p.reference_month)}</td><td>${money(p.amount)}</td><td>${fmtDate(p.due_date)}</td><td>${fmtDate(p.payment_date)}</td><td>${badge(p.status)}</td><td><button onclick='editPayment(${JSON.stringify(p)})'>Editar</button></td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="7" class="empty">Nenhuma mensalidade registrada.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div></div>`;
}
async function openPaymentForm(x=null){const {data:s}=await sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name,monthly_fee').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active').order('display_name');openModal(x?'Editar mensalidade':'Registrar mensalidade',`<form class="form" onsubmit="savePayment(event,'${x?.id||''}')"><div class="field"><label>Aluno</label><select id="p1">${(s||[]).map(a=>`<option value="${a.id}" ${a.id===x?.student_id?'selected':''}>${esc(a.display_name)}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Mês de referência</label><input id="p2" type="month" value="${x?.reference_month?.slice(0,7)||new Date().toISOString().slice(0,7)}" required></div><div class="field"><label>Valor</label><input id="p3" type="number" step=".01" value="${x?.amount??0}" required></div></div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Vencimento</label><input id="p4" type="date" value="${x?.due_date||''}"></div><div class="field"><label>Pagamento</label><input id="p5" type="date" value="${x?.payment_date||''}"></div></div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Status</label><select id="p6"><option ${x?.status==='pending'?'selected':''}>pending</option><option ${x?.status==='paid'?'selected':''}>paid</option><option ${x?.status==='overdue'?'selected':''}>overdue</option><option ${x?.status==='cancelled'?'selected':''}>cancelled</option></select></div><div class="field"><label>Forma de pagamento</label><select id="p7">${['PIX','Dinheiro','Transferência','Cartão','Outro'].map(v=>`<option ${v===x?.payment_method?'selected':''}>${v}</option>`).join('')}</select></div></div><div class="field"><label>Observação</label><textarea id="p8">${esc(x?.notes||'')}</textarea></div><div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">Salvar</button></div></form>`)}
function editPayment(x){openPaymentForm(x)}
async function savePayment(e,id){e.preventDefault();const o={teacher_id:session.user.id,student_id:$('p1').value,reference_month:$('p2').value+'-01',amount:Number($('p3').value),due_date:$('p4').value||null,payment_date:$('p5').value||null,status:$('p6').value,payment_method:$('p7').value,notes:$('p8').value||null};const r=id?await sb.from('tic_monthly_payments').update(o).eq('id',id):await sb.from('tic_monthly_payments').insert(o);if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível salvar a mensalidade: '+r.error.message,'error');closeModal();toast('Mensalidade salva.','success');loadView('payments')}

async function cashPage(){const {data}=await sb.from('tic_cash_transactions').select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('transaction_date',{ascending:false});const income=(data||[]).filter(x=>x.transaction_type==='income').reduce((a,x)=>a+Number(x.amount),0),expense=(data||[]).filter(x=>x.transaction_type==='expense').reduce((a,x)=>a+Number(x.amount),0);$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="grid stats"><div class="card"><div class="stat-label">Entradas</div><div class="stat-value">${money(income)}</div></div><div class="card"><div class="stat-label">Saídas</div><div class="stat-value">${money(expense)}</div></div><div class="card"><div class="stat-label">Saldo</div><div class="stat-value">${money(income-expense)}</div></div><div class="card"><div class="stat-label">Lançamentos</div><div class="stat-value">${data?.length||0}</div></div></div><div class="card section"><div class="table-wrap"><table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Data</th><th>Tipo</th><th>Categoria</th><th>Descrição</th><th>Valor</th></tr></thead><tbody>${(data||[]).map(x=>`<tr><td>${fmtDate(x.transaction_date)}</td><td>${badge(x.transaction_type)}</td><td>${esc(x.category)}</td><td>${esc(x.description)}</td><td>${money(x.amount)}</td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="5" class="empty">Nenhum lançamento.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div></div>`}
function openCashForm(){openModal('Novo lançamento',`<form class="form" onsubmit="saveCash(event)"><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Tipo</label><select id="c1"><option value="income">Entrada</option><option value="expense">Saída</option></select></div><div class="field"><label>Valor</label><input id="c2" type="number" step=".01" required></div></div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Categoria</label><input id="c3" placeholder="mensalidade, material, despesa..."></div><div class="field"><label>Data</label><input id="c4" type="date" value="${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}"></div></div><div class="field"><label>Descrição</label><input id="c5" required></div><div class="field"><label>Forma de pagamento</label><input id="c6"></div><div class="field"><label>Observação</label><textarea id="c7"></textarea></div><div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">Salvar</button></div></form>`)}
async function saveCash(e){e.preventDefault();const r=await sb.from('tic_cash_transactions').insert({teacher_id:session.user.id,transaction_type:$('c1').value,amount:Number($('c2').value),category:$('c3').value||'other',transaction_date:$('c4').value,description:$('c5').value,payment_method:$('c6').value||null,notes:$('c7').value||null});if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível salvar o lançamento: '+r.error.message,'error');closeModal();toast('Lançamento salvo.','success');loadView('cash')}

async function closingPage(){const {data}=await sb.from('tic_cash_closings').select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('reference_month',{ascending:false});$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card"><div class="table-wrap"><table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Mês</th><th>Inicial</th><th>Entradas</th><th>Saídas</th><th>Final</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody>${(data||[]).map(x=>`<tr><td><b>${monthLabel(x.reference_month)}</b></td><td>${money(x.opening_balance)}</td><td>${money(x.total_income)}</td><td>${money(x.total_expense)}</td><td>${money(x.closing_balance)}</td><td>${badge(x.status)}</td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="6" class="empty">Nenhum mês fechado.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div></div>`}
function closeMonthForm(){openModal('Fechar mês',`<form class="form" onsubmit="saveClosing(event)"><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Mês</label><input id="cl1" type="month" value="${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,7)}" required></div><div class="field"><label>Saldo inicial</label><input id="cl2" type="number" step=".01" value="0"></div></div><div class="field"><label>Observação</label><textarea id="cl3"></textarea></div><div class="notice">O fechamento registra um retrato financeiro do mês. Os lançamentos históricos permanecem disponíveis.</div><div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">Fechar mês</button></div></form>`)}
async function saveClosing(e){e.preventDefault();const m=$('cl1').value+'-01';const {data:t}=await sb.from('tic_cash_transactions').select('transaction_type,amount').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).gte('transaction_date',m).lt('transaction_date',new Date(new Date(m).getFullYear(),new Date(m).getMonth()+1,1).toISOString().slice(0,10));const income=(t||[]).filter(x=>x.transaction_type==='income').reduce((a,x)=>a+Number(x.amount),0),expense=(t||[]).filter(x=>x.transaction_type==='expense').reduce((a,x)=>a+Number(x.amount),0),opening=Number($('cl2').value||0);const r=await sb.from('tic_cash_closings').upsert({teacher_id:session.user.id,reference_month:m,opening_balance:opening,total_income:income,total_expense:expense,closing_balance:opening+income-expense,status:'closed',closed_at:new Date().toISOString(),notes:$('cl3').value||null},{onConflict:'teacher_id,reference_month'});if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível fechar o mês: '+r.error.message,'error');closeModal();toast('Fechamento salvo.','success');loadView('closing')}

async function reportsPage(){const [{data:s},{data:p},{data:c},{data:l}]=await Promise.all([sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name,current_level').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id),sb.from('tic_monthly_payments').select('amount,status').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id),sb.from('tic_classes').select('id').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id),sb.from('tic_lessons').select('id').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id)]);$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="grid cols3"><div class="card"><div class="stat-label">Alunos</div><div class="stat-value">${s?.length||0}</div></div><div class="card"><div class="stat-label">Lessons</div><div class="stat-value">${l?.length||0}</div></div><div class="card"><div class="stat-label">Turmas</div><div class="stat-value">${c?.length||0}</div></div></div><div class="grid cols2 section"><div class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>Financeiro</h2></div>${['paid','pending','overdue'].map(k=>{let v=(p||[]).filter(x=>x.status===k).reduce((a,x)=>a+Number(x.amount),0);return `<div class="mini"><span>${k}</span><b>${money(v)}</b></div><div class="progress" style="margin-bottom:10px"><i style="width:${Math.min(100,v/Math.max(1,(p||[]).reduce((a,x)=>a+Number(x.amount),0))*100)}%"></i></div>`}).join('')}</div><div class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>Níveis dos alunos</h2></div>${levels.map(k=>`<div class="row"><b>${k}</b><span class="badge blue">${(s||[]).filter(x=>x.current_level===k).length}</span></div>`).join('')}</div></div>`}
async function settingsPage(){const {data:t}=await sb.from('tic_teachers').select('*').eq('id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="grid cols2"><div class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>Perfil Teacher</h2></div><form class="form" onsubmit="saveSettings(event)"><div class="field"><label>Nome</label><input id="set1" value="${esc(t?.display_name||profile?.full_name||'')}"></div><div class="field"><label>Bio</label><textarea id="set2">${esc(t?.bio||'')}</textarea></div><div class="field"><label>Telefone</label><input id="set3" value="${esc(t?.phone||'')}"></div><button class="btn primary">Salvar perfil</button></form></div><div class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>Plataforma</h2></div><div class="row"><b>Banco</b><span class="badge green">Supabase</span></div><div class="row"><b>Namespace</b><span class="badge blue">tic_</span></div><div class="row"><b>Frontend</b><span class="badge gray">GitHub Pages</span></div><div class="row"><b>Segurança</b><span class="badge green">RLS</span></div></div></div>`}
async function saveSettings(e){e.preventDefault();const r=await sb.from('tic_teachers').upsert({id:session.user.id,display_name:$('set1').value,bio:$('set2').value,phone:$('set3').value});if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível salvar o perfil: '+r.error.message,'error');toast('Perfil salvo.','success');}

async function studentRecord(){const {data}=await sb.from('tic_students').select('*').eq('auth_user_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();return data}
async function studentDashboard(){const s=await studentRecord();if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Sua conta ainda não está vinculada a um cadastro de aluno pelo Teacher.</div>';return}const [{data:p},{data:ta},{data:pay}]=await Promise.all([sb.from('tic_progress').select('*').eq('student_id',s.id),sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('*,tic_assignments(title,due_at)').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('active',true).limit(8),sb.from('tic_monthly_payments').select('*').eq('student_id',s.id).order('reference_month',{ascending:false}).limit(3)]);const overall=p?.find(x=>x.skill==='overall'&&x.level===s.current_level)?.progress||0;setPage(`Hello, ${s.display_name?.split(' ')[0]||'Student'} 👋`,'Seu espaço de aprendizagem.');$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="student-banner"><div style="font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:#aaa1bd">CURRENT LEVEL</div><h2>${esc(s.current_level)} → ${esc(s.target_level||'—')}</h2><p>Progresso geral: <b>${overall}%</b></p><div class="progress" style="margin-top:10px;background:#ffffff22"><i style="width:${overall}%;background:#fff"></i></div></div><div class="grid cols2 section"><div class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>✅ My Tasks</h2></div>${(ta||[]).map(x=>`<div class="row task-row" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="openStudentTask('${x.id}')"><div><b>${esc(x.tic_assignments?.title||'Task')}</b><small>${x.tic_assignments?.due_at?'Prazo '+fmtDate(x.tic_assignments.due_at):'Sem prazo'}</small></div><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px"><span onclick="event.stopPropagation()">${badge(x.status)}</span><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="event.stopPropagation();openStudentTask('${x.id}')">Abrir</button></div></div>`).join('')||'<div class="empty">Nenhuma tarefa.</div>'}</div><div class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>📊 My Progress</h2></div>${['grammar','vocabulary','listening','reading','writing','speaking'].map(k=>{let v=p?.find(x=>x.skill===k&&x.level===s.current_level)?.progress||0;return `<div class="mini"><span>${k}</span><b>${v}%</b></div><div class="progress" style="margin-bottom:10px"><i style="width:${v}%"></i></div>`}).join('')}</div></div><div class="card section"><div class="section-head"><h2>💰 My Payments</h2></div>${(pay||[]).map(x=>`<div class="row"><div><b>${monthLabel(x.reference_month)}</b><small>${x.payment_date?'Pago em '+fmtDate(x.payment_date):'Vencimento '+fmtDate(x.due_date)}</small></div><b>${money(x.amount)} ${badge(x.status)}</b></div>`).join('')||'<div class="empty">Nenhum registro.</div>'}</div>`}
async function openStudentTask(taskId){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;
 // Aceita tanto o ID de tic_task_assignments quanto o ID de tic_assignments.
 let q=sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,status,active,completed_at,assignment_id,tic_assignments(title,instructions,due_at,points,resource_items,cover_image_url,assignment_type)').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('active',true);
 let {data:x,error}=await q.eq('id',taskId).maybeSingle();
 if(!x&&!error){({data:x,error}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,status,completed_at,assignment_id,tic_assignments(title,instructions,due_at,points,resource_items,cover_image_url,assignment_type)').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('assignment_id',taskId).maybeSingle());}
 if(error||!x)return toast(error?.message||'Tarefa não encontrada.','error');
 await loadView('studentTasks');
 setTimeout(()=>{const el=document.getElementById('task_'+x.id);if(el){el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});el.classList.add('task-focus');}},180);
}

async function studentTasks(){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Conta não vinculada.</div>';return}
 const {data,error}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,status,active,removed_at,completed_at,assigned_at,assignment_id,tic_assignments(title,instructions,due_at,points,resource_items,cover_image_url,assignment_type)').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('active',true).order('assigned_at',{ascending:false});
 if(error){$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention"><b>Não foi possível carregar suas tarefas.</b><p>${esc(error.message)}</p></div>`;return}
 const ids=(data||[]).map(x=>x.id);let subs=[];let feedback=[];
 if(ids.length){const r=await sb.from('tic_submissions').select('id,task_assignment_id,answer_text,file_url,audio_url,video_url,submitted_at,attempt,grade').in('task_assignment_id',ids).order('submitted_at',{ascending:false});subs=r.data||[];const subIds=subs.map(x=>x.id);if(subIds.length){const f=await sb.from('tic_feedback').select('id,submission_id,comment,grade,private_note,improvement_skill,improvement_link,created_at').in('submission_id',subIds).order('created_at',{ascending:false});feedback=f.data||[]}}
 const cards=(data||[]).map(x=>{const a=x.tic_assignments||{},resources=Array.isArray(a.resource_items)?a.resource_items:[],taskSubs=subs.filter(z=>z.task_assignment_id===x.id).sort((u,v)=>new Date(v.submitted_at)-new Date(u.submitted_at)),sub=taskSubs[0],fb=sub?feedback.find(z=>z.submission_id===sub.id):null;
 const history=taskSubs.map(z=>{const zf=feedback.find(q=>q.submission_id===z.id);return `<div class="row" style="align-items:flex-start"><div><b>📤 Tentativa ${z.attempt||1}</b><small>${fmtDate(z.submitted_at)}${z.grade!=null?' · Nota '+z.grade:''}</small>${zf&&!zf.private_note?`<div style="margin-top:5px;color:#5b6577">${esc(zf.comment||'Sem comentário.')}</div>${zf.improvement_skill||zf.improvement_link?`<div style="margin-top:5px;font-size:12px">🎯 ${zf.improvement_skill?`Habilidade: <b>${esc(zf.improvement_skill)}</b>`:''}${zf.improvement_link?` · <a href="${esc(zf.improvement_link)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Material de melhoria →</a>`:''}</div>`:''}`:''}</div><span class="badge ${zf?'green':'yellow'}">${zf?'Corrigida':'Aguardando correção'}</span></div>`}).join('');
 return `<article id="task_${x.id}" class="card" style="padding:18px"><div class="section-head"><div><span class="badge blue">${esc(a.assignment_type||'assignment')}</span><h2 style="font:800 18px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin:8px 0 0">${esc(a.title||'Task')}</h2></div><span class="badge green">🟢 Atribuição ativa</span></div>${a.cover_image_url?`<img class="task-cover" src="${esc(a.cover_image_url)}" alt="">`:''}${a.instructions?`<div style="font-size:14px;line-height:1.7;margin:10px 0 15px">${esc(a.instructions).replace(/\n/g,'<br>')}</div>`:''}<div class="mini"><span>Prazo informado pelo Teacher</span><b>${fmtDate(a.due_at)}</b></div><div class="mini"><span>Pontuação</span><b>${a.points||0} pts</b></div>${resources.length?`<div style="margin-top:16px"><div style="font-weight:800;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:9px">📚 Materiais da atividade</div><div class="resource-grid">${resources.map(resourceCard).join('')}</div></div>`:''}${sub&&!fb?' <div class="notice warning" style="margin-top:14px"><b>📤 Última entrega enviada.</b><small style="display:block;margin-top:4px">O Teacher ainda não corrigiu esta tentativa. A atividade continua aberta.</small></div>':''}${fb&&!fb.private_note?`<div class="notice success" style="margin-top:14px"><b>📝 Correção do Teacher</b>${fb.grade!=null?`<div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:800;margin-top:5px">Nota: ${fb.grade}</div>`:''}<div style="margin-top:6px;white-space:pre-wrap">${esc(fb.comment||'Sem comentário.')}</div>${fb.improvement_skill||fb.improvement_link?`<div class="notice" style="margin-top:10px"><b>🎯 Como melhorar</b>${fb.improvement_skill?`<div style="margin-top:5px">Habilidade: <b>${esc(fb.improvement_skill)}</b></div>`:''}${fb.improvement_link?`<div style="margin-top:8px"><a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(fb.improvement_link)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">🔗 Abrir atividade/material de melhoria</a></div>`:''}</div>`:''}</div>`:''}${history?`<div style="margin-top:14px"><div style="font-weight:800;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:7px">📚 Histórico de tentativas</div><div class="card" style="padding:8px;background:#faf9fd">${history}</div></div>`:''}<form class="form" style="margin-top:14px" onsubmit="submitTaskWork(event,'${x.id}')"><div class="notice" style="margin-bottom:10px"><b>🔓 Nova tentativa disponível</b><small style="display:block;margin-top:4px">Você pode abrir esta tarefa e enviar quantas tentativas forem necessárias enquanto o Teacher mantiver a atribuição ativa.</small></div><div class="field"><label>✍️ Sua resposta / nova entrega</label><textarea id="ans_${x.id}" rows="5" placeholder="Digite sua resposta, comentário, produção escrita ou link..." required></textarea></div><div class="field"><label>Arquivo (opcional)</label><input id="file_${x.id}" type="url" placeholder="Cole aqui um link para Google Drive, PDF, vídeo etc."></div><button class="btn primary">📤 ${sub?'Enviar nova tentativa':'Enviar para o Teacher'}</button></form></article>`}).join('');
 $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="notice success" style="margin-bottom:15px">🔓 <b>As tarefas não expiram automaticamente.</b> O prazo é apenas informativo. A atribuição permanece ativa até o Teacher removê-la.</div><div class="grid cols2">${cards||'<div class="card empty">Nenhuma tarefa ativa.</div>'}</div>`;
}
async function submitTaskWork(e,taskAssignmentId){e.preventDefault();const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;const {data:ta}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,active').eq('id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();if(!ta||ta.active===false)return toast('Esta atribuição foi removida pelo Teacher.','error');const answer=$(`ans_${taskAssignmentId}`)?.value.trim()||'',file=$(`file_${taskAssignmentId}`)?.value.trim()||null;if(!answer&&!file)return toast('Digite uma resposta ou informe um link.','error');
 const {data:old}=await sb.from('tic_submissions').select('attempt').eq('task_assignment_id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',s.id).order('attempt',{ascending:false}).limit(1);const attempt=(old?.[0]?.attempt||0)+1;
 const {error}=await sb.from('tic_submissions').insert({task_assignment_id:taskAssignmentId,student_id:s.id,answer_text:answer||null,file_url:file,attempt});if(error)return toast('Não foi possível enviar a entrega: '+error.message,'error');
 const r=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').update({status:'submitted',completed_at:null}).eq('id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',s.id);if(r.error)return toast('Entrega enviada, mas não foi possível atualizar o status: '+r.error.message,'error');toast(`Tentativa ${attempt} enviada para o Teacher. A tarefa continua ativa.`,'success');loadView('studentTasks');
}

async function studentClassPage(){
  const s=await studentRecord();
  if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Sua conta ainda não está vinculada a um cadastro de aluno pelo Teacher.</div>';return}
  setPage('My Class','Sua turma, aulas, materiais e atividades.');
  const {data:members,error:me}=await sb.from('tic_class_students').select('class_id,status').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('status','active');
  if(me){$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention">Não foi possível carregar suas turmas: ${esc(me.message)}</div>`;return}
  const ids=[...(members||[]).map(x=>x.class_id).filter(Boolean)];
  if(!ids.length){$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card empty" style="padding:42px 20px"><div style="font-size:38px">🏫</div><h2 style="margin:10px 0 5px">Você ainda não está em uma turma</h2><p>Quando o Teacher adicionar você a uma Class, ela aparecerá aqui com aulas, materiais, conteúdos e atividades.</p></div>`;return}
  const [{data:classes},{data:sessions},{data:boards},{data:links},{data:tasks},{data:classAssignments}]=await Promise.all([
    sb.from('tic_classes').select('id,name,level,schedule_text,meeting_url,status,course_id').in('id',ids).eq('status','active').order('name'),
    sb.from('tic_class_sessions').select('id,class_id,session_date,duration_minutes,lesson_title,summary,status').in('class_id',ids).order('session_date',{ascending:false}).limit(50),
    sb.from('tic_class_board_items').select('id,class_id,title,description,item_type,status,position,source_type,source_id,created_at,updated_at').in('class_id',ids).order('position').order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(100),
    sb.from('tic_class_material_links').select('id,class_id,title,url,material_type,note,position,created_at,updated_at').in('class_id',ids).order('position').order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(100),
    sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,assignment_id,status,due_at,active').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('active',true).order('due_at',{ascending:true}).limit(50),
    sb.from('tic_assignments').select('id,title,instructions,assignment_type,due_at,points,priority,class_id,resource_items,cover_image_url,source_type,source_id,cefr_level,skill,task_level,created_at').in('class_id',ids).order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(100)
  ]);
  const classMap=new Map((classes||[]).map(c=>[c.id,c]));
  const activeClasses=(classes||[]).filter(c=>ids.includes(c.id));
  const allTasks=(tasks||[]).filter(t=>t.assignment_id);
  let selected=activeClasses[0]?.id||'';
  const render=()=>{
    const c=classMap.get(selected)||activeClasses[0]; if(!c)return;
    selected=c.id;
    const cs=(sessions||[]).filter(x=>x.class_id===c.id).sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.session_date)-new Date(a.session_date));
    const now=new Date();
    const upcoming=cs.filter(x=>new Date(x.session_date)>=now).sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.session_date)-new Date(b.session_date))[0];
    const past=cs.filter(x=>new Date(x.session_date)<now).slice(0,6);
    const ml=(links||[]).filter(x=>x.class_id===c.id);
    const bi=(boards||[]).filter(x=>x.class_id===c.id);
    /* Class-level content belongs to the Class itself and must be visible to every active member,
       even when no tic_task_assignments row exists yet. Individual task rows remain separate. */
    const ca=(classAssignments||[]).filter(x=>x.class_id===c.id);
    const myTasks=allTasks.map(t=>({ta:t,a:(classAssignments||[]).find(a=>a.id===t.assignment_id)})).filter(x=>x.a && x.a.class_id===c.id);
    const activities=ca.filter(x=>!['material','lesson'].includes(String(x.assignment_type||'').toLowerCase()));
    const contentAssignments=ca.filter(x=>['material','lesson'].includes(String(x.assignment_type||'').toLowerCase()));
    const fmt=x=>x?new Date(x).toLocaleString('pt-BR',{dateStyle:'short',timeStyle:'short'}):'—';
    const statusLabel=x=>({scheduled:'Agendada',completed:'Concluída',cancelled:'Cancelada',rescheduled:'Reagendada',pending:'Pendente',submitted:'Enviada',graded:'Corrigida'})[x]||x||'—';
    const typeLabel=x=>({material:'Material',lesson:'Lesson',assignment:'Atividade',task:'Tarefa',quiz:'Quiz',homework:'Homework'})[String(x||'').toLowerCase()]||x||'Conteúdo';
    const assignmentResource=(a)=>{const rs=Array.isArray(a.resource_items)?a.resource_items:[];return rs.map(r=>`<a class="student-class-resource" href="${esc(r.url||r.link||'#')}" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span class="resource-icon">${r.type==='video'?'🎬':r.type==='audio'?'🎧':r.type==='pdf'?'📄':'🔗'}</span><span><b>${esc(r.title||a.title)}</b><small>${esc(r.type||'link')}${r.description?' · '+esc(r.description):''}</small></span><span>↗</span></a>`).join('')};
    $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="student-class-page">
      <div class="student-class-switcher card"><div><span class="eyebrow">MY CLASS</span><h2>🏫 ${esc(c.name)}</h2><p>${esc(c.level||'')} ${c.schedule_text?'· '+esc(c.schedule_text):''}</p></div><select id="studentClassSelect" class="student-class-select">${activeClasses.map(x=>`<option value="${x.id}" ${x.id===c.id?'selected':''}>${esc(x.name)} · ${esc(x.level||'')}</option>`).join('')}</select></div>
      <div class="student-class-kpis"><div class="card"><span>📚 Aulas registradas</span><b>${cs.length}</b></div><div class="card"><span>📌 Conteúdos da Class</span><b>${ca.length+bi.length}</b></div><div class="card"><span>📝 Atividades</span><b>${activities.length+myTasks.length}</b></div><div class="card"><span>📌 Status</span><b>${esc(statusLabel(c.status))}</b></div></div>
      <div class="student-class-grid">
        <section class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>📅 Próxima aula</h2>${c.meeting_url?`<a class="btn sm primary" href="${esc(c.meeting_url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Entrar na aula ↗</a>`:''}</div>${upcoming?`<div class="student-class-next"><div><b>${esc(upcoming.lesson_title||'Aula')}</b><span>${fmt(upcoming.session_date)} · ${upcoming.duration_minutes||'—'} min</span></div><span class="badge blue">${esc(statusLabel(upcoming.status))}</span></div>${upcoming.summary?`<p class="student-class-summary">${esc(upcoming.summary)}</p>`:''}`:'<div class="empty">Nenhuma próxima aula registrada.</div>'}</section>
        <section class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>🔗 Materiais da turma</h2><span class="badge blue">${ml.length+contentAssignments.length}</span></div>${ml.map(x=>`<a class="student-class-resource" href="${esc(x.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><span class="resource-icon">${String(x.material_type||'').toLowerCase()==='video'?'🎬':String(x.material_type||'').toLowerCase()==='audio'?'🎧':String(x.material_type||'').toLowerCase()==='pdf'?'📄':'🔗'}</span><span><b>${esc(x.title)}</b><small>${esc(x.material_type||'link')}${x.note?' · '+esc(x.note):''}</small></span><span>↗</span></a>`).join('')}${contentAssignments.map(assignmentResource).join('')||(!ml.length?'<div class="empty">Nenhum material compartilhado nesta turma.</div>':'')}</section>
        <section class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>📚 Conteúdos da Class</h2><span class="badge blue">${ca.length}</span></div>${ca.map(x=>`<div class="student-class-board-item"><div><b>${esc(x.title)}</b><small>${esc(typeLabel(x.assignment_type))}${x.skill?' · '+esc(x.skill):''}${x.cefr_level?' · '+esc(x.cefr_level):''}${x.due_at?' · Prazo '+fmt(x.due_at):''}</small>${x.instructions?`<p style="margin:6px 0 0;white-space:pre-wrap">${esc(x.instructions)}</p>`:''}${assignmentResource(x)?`<div style="margin-top:8px">${assignmentResource(x)}</div>`:''}</div><span class="badge ${String(x.assignment_type).toLowerCase()==='material'?'blue':String(x.assignment_type).toLowerCase()==='lesson'?'green':'yellow'}">${esc(typeLabel(x.assignment_type))}</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="empty">Nenhum conteúdo publicado ainda.</div>'}</section>
