        <section class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>📝 Atividades da turma</h2><span class="badge yellow">${activities.length+myTasks.length}</span></div>${activities.map(x=>`<div class="row"><div><b>${esc(x.title||'Atividade')}</b><small>${esc(typeLabel(x.assignment_type))}${x.due_at?' · Prazo '+fmt(x.due_at):' · Sem prazo'}${x.skill?' · '+esc(x.skill):''}</small></div><span class="badge yellow">Disponível</span></div>`).join('')}${myTasks.map(x=>`<div class="row"><div><b>${esc(x.a.title||'Tarefa')}</b><small>${x.a.due_at?'Prazo '+fmt(x.a.due_at):'Sem prazo'}${x.a.skill?' · '+esc(x.a.skill):''}</small></div>${badge(x.ta?.status||'pending')}</div>`).join('')||(!activities.length?'<div class="empty">Nenhuma atividade vinculada.</div>':'')}</section>
        <section class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>📚 Aulas anteriores</h2><span class="badge green">${past.length}</span></div>${past.map(x=>`<div class="student-class-session"><div><b>${esc(x.lesson_title||'Aula')}</b><small>${fmt(x.session_date)} · ${x.duration_minutes||'—'} min</small></div><span class="badge ${x.status==='completed'?'green':'blue'}">${esc(statusLabel(x.status))}</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="empty">Nenhuma aula anterior registrada.</div>'}</section>
        <section class="card student-class-board-card"><div class="section-head"><h2>📌 Conteúdos do Board</h2><span class="badge blue">${bi.length}</span></div>${bi.map(x=>`<div class="student-class-board-item"><div><b>${esc(x.title)}</b><small>${esc(x.description||'')}${x.item_type?' · '+esc(x.item_type):''}</small></div><span class="badge ${x.status==='completed'?'green':x.status==='in_progress'?'yellow':'blue'}">${esc(statusLabel(x.status))}</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="empty">Nenhum item no Board ainda.</div>'}</section>
      </div>
    </div>`;
    $('studentClassSelect')?.addEventListener('change',e=>{selected=e.target.value;render();});
  };
  render();
}
async function studentLessons(){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Conta não vinculada.</div>';return}
 const {data:enrollments,error:ee}=await sb.from('tic_course_students').select('course_id,status,enrolled_at,completed_at').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('status','active').order('enrolled_at',{ascending:false});
 if(ee){$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention"><b>Não foi possível carregar seus cursos.</b><p>${esc(ee.message)}</p></div>`;return}
 const courseIds=(enrollments||[]).map(x=>x.course_id).filter(Boolean);let courses=[],modules=[],lessons=[];
 if(courseIds.length){
   const [{data:c},{data:m},{data:l}]=await Promise.all([
     sb.from('tic_courses').select('*').in('id',courseIds).eq('active',true),
     sb.from('tic_modules').select('*').in('course_id',courseIds).order('position'),
     sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').in('course_id',courseIds).eq('active',true).order('position')
   ]);courses=c||[];modules=m||[];lessons=l||[];
 }
 const courseBlocks=(courses||[]).map(course=>{
   const cm=(modules||[]).filter(m=>m.course_id===course.id).sort((a,b)=>(a.position||0)-(b.position||0));
   const cl=(lessons||[]).filter(l=>l.course_id===course.id).sort((a,b)=>(a.position||0)-(b.position||0));
   const moduleBlocks=cm.map(mod=>{
     const ml=cl.filter(l=>l.module_id===mod.id).sort((a,b)=>(a.position||0)-(b.position||0));
     return `<div class="card" style="margin-top:12px;padding:15px;border:1px solid #e8e5f2"><div class="section-head"><div><span class="badge purple">Module ${esc(String((mod.position||0)+1))}</span><h3 style="font:800 16px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin:7px 0 0">${esc(mod.title)}</h3>${mod.description?`<small>${esc(mod.description)}</small>`:''}</div><span class="badge blue">${ml.length} lesson${ml.length===1?'':'s'}</span></div><div style="display:grid;gap:8px;margin-top:12px">${ml.map((l,i)=>`<button class="row" style="width:100%;text-align:left;border:1px solid #ece9f4;background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;cursor:pointer" onclick="openStudentLesson('${l.id}')"><div style="display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center"><span class="badge gray">${i+1}</span><div><b>${esc(l.title)}</b><small>${esc(l.skill||l.lesson_type||'lesson')} · ${esc(l.level||course.level||'')}</small></div></div><span>→</span></button>`).join('')||'<div class="empty">Nenhuma lesson neste módulo.</div>'}</div></div>`;
   }).join('');
   const unmod=cl.filter(l=>!l.module_id);
   const unmodBlock=unmod.length?`<div class="card" style="margin-top:12px;padding:15px;border:1px dashed #d9d4e8"><div class="section-head"><div><span class="badge gray">Sem módulo</span><h3 style="font:800 16px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin:7px 0 0">Lessons gerais</h3></div><span class="badge blue">${unmod.length}</span></div><div style="display:grid;gap:8px;margin-top:12px">${unmod.map((l,i)=>`<button class="row" style="width:100%;text-align:left;border:1px solid #ece9f4;background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;cursor:pointer" onclick="openStudentLesson('${l.id}')"><div style="display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center"><span class="badge gray">${i+1}</span><div><b>${esc(l.title)}</b><small>${esc(l.skill||l.lesson_type||'lesson')}</small></div></div><span>→</span></button>`).join('')}</div></div>`:'';
   return `<article class="card" style="padding:20px"><div class="section-head"><div><span class="badge blue">${esc(course.level||'COURSE')}</span><h2 style="font:800 20px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin:8px 0 0">📚 ${esc(course.title)}</h2><p style="margin:5px 0 0;color:var(--muted)">${esc(course.description||'Seu currículo organizado por módulos e lessons.')}</p></div><span class="badge green">${cl.length} lesson${cl.length===1?'':'s'}</span></div><div class="notice success" style="margin-top:14px">🎓 <b>Seu currículo:</b> curso → módulo → lesson. Você pode abrir as lessons disponíveis sempre que quiser.</div>${moduleBlocks||unmodBlock||'<div class="empty" style="margin-top:12px">Este curso ainda não possui lessons publicadas.</div>'}${moduleBlocks&&unmodBlock?unmodBlock:''}</article>`;
 }).join('');
 let legacyLessons=[];
 if(!courseIds.length){const {data}=await sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').eq('level',s.current_level).eq('active',true).order('position');legacyLessons=data||[];}
 const lessonCards=(legacyLessons||[]).map(x=>`<button class="card" style="text-align:left;cursor:pointer" onclick="openStudentLesson('${x.id}')">${x.cover_image_url?`<img class="task-cover" src="${esc(x.cover_image_url)}" alt="">`:''}<span class="badge blue">${esc(x.level)}</span><h2 style="font:800 17px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin:9px 0">${esc(x.title)}</h2><p style="font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)">${esc(x.description||x.content||'')}</p></button>`).join('');
 const {data:mats}=await sb.from('tic_materials').select('*').eq('level',s.current_level).order('created_at',{ascending:false});
 const matCards=(mats||[]).map(x=>`<article class="card">${x.cover_image_url?`<img class="task-cover" src="${esc(x.cover_image_url)}" alt="">`:''}<span class="badge green">${esc(x.material_type||'material')}</span><h2 style="font:800 17px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin:9px 0">${esc(x.title)}</h2><p style="font-size:13px;color:var(--muted)">${esc(x.description||'')}</p>${Array.isArray(x.resource_items)&&x.resource_items.length?`<div class="resource-grid" style="margin-top:12px">${x.resource_items.map(resourceCard).join('')}</div>`:((x.external_url||x.file_url)?`<a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(x.external_url||x.file_url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Abrir material →</a>`:'')}</article>`).join('');
 $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="notice" style="margin-bottom:15px">📘 <b>My Lessons</b> — seu acesso às aulas é organizado por <b>Curso → Módulo → Lesson</b>. Aulas publicadas ficam disponíveis para você sem limite de abertura.</div>${courseBlocks||`<div class="section-head"><h2>📚 Lessons</h2></div><div class="grid cols2">${lessonCards||'<div class="card empty">Nenhuma lesson publicada para seu nível.</div>'}</div>`}<div class="section-head section"><h2>📂 Materials</h2></div><div class="grid cols2">${matCards||'<div class="card empty">Nenhum material publicado para seu nível.</div>'}</div>`;
}
async function openStudentLesson(lessonId){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;
 const {data:l,error}=await sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').eq('id',lessonId).eq('active',true).maybeSingle();if(error||!l)return toast('Lesson não encontrada ou não está disponível.','error');
 const resources=Array.isArray(l.resource_items)?l.resource_items:[];
 openModal(`📚 ${esc(l.title)}`,`<div class="form"><div class="notice success"><b>${esc(l.level||s.current_level||'')}</b> · ${esc(l.skill||l.lesson_type||'lesson')}</div>${l.cover_image_url?`<img class="task-cover" src="${esc(l.cover_image_url)}" alt="" style="margin-bottom:12px">`:''}${l.description?`<p style="color:var(--muted)">${esc(l.description)}</p>`:''}${l.content?`<div class="card" style="white-space:pre-wrap;line-height:1.7;margin:10px 0">${esc(l.content)}</div>`:''}${l.video_url?`<div style="margin-top:10px"><a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(l.video_url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">🎬 Abrir vídeo</a></div>`:''}${l.audio_url?`<div style="margin-top:8px"><a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(l.audio_url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">🎧 Abrir áudio</a></div>`:''}${l.pdf_url?`<div style="margin-top:8px"><a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(l.pdf_url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">📄 Abrir PDF</a></div>`:''}${resources.length?`<div style="margin-top:14px"><b>📎 Recursos</b><div class="resource-grid" style="margin-top:9px">${resources.map(resourceCard).join('')}</div></div>`:''}<div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Fechar</button></div></div>`);
}
async function openStudentView(id){const {data}=await sb.from('tic_students').select('*').eq('id',id).maybeSingle();if(!data)return;previewStudent=data;setPage(`Student View · ${data.display_name}`,'Visualização do dashboard do aluno.','<button class="btn secondary" onclick="loadView(&quot;students&quot;)">← Voltar para Students</button>');const [{data:p},{data:t}]=await Promise.all([sb.from('tic_progress').select('*').eq('student_id',id),sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('*,tic_assignments(title,due_at)').eq('student_id',id).limit(8)]);const ov=p?.find(x=>x.skill==='overall'&&x.level===data.current_level)?.progress||0;$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="notice" style="margin-bottom:15px">🎓 <b>Student View</b> — Teacher continua logado. Você está apenas visualizando ${esc(data.display_name)}.</div><div class="student-banner"><div style="font-size:9px;color:#aaa1bd">CURRENT LEVEL</div><h2>${esc(data.current_level)} → ${esc(data.target_level||'—')}</h2><p>Progresso geral: <b>${ov}%</b></p><div class="progress" style="margin-top:10px;background:#ffffff22"><i style="width:${ov}%;background:#fff"></i></div></div><div class="grid cols2 section"><div class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>Tasks</h2></div>${(t||[]).map(x=>`<div class="row"><b>${esc(x.tic_assignments?.title||'')}</b>${badge(x.status)}</div>`).join('')||'<div class="empty">Sem tarefas.</div>'}</div><div class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>Progress</h2></div>${skills.slice(0,7).map(k=>{let v=p?.find(x=>x.skill===k&&x.level===data.current_level)?.progress||0;return `<div class="mini"><span>${k}</span><b>${v}%</b></div><div class="progress" style="margin-bottom:8px"><i style="width:${v}%"></i></div>`}).join('')}</div></div>`}
async function studentViewChooser(){const {data}=await sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name,current_level').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active').order('display_name');openModal('🎓 Student View — selecionar aluno',`<div class="form"><div class="field"><label>Aluno</label><select id="sv">${(data||[]).map(s=>`<option value="${s.id}">${esc(s.display_name)} · ${s.current_level}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn primary" onclick="const id=$('sv').value;closeModal();openStudentView(id)">Abrir dashboard →</button></div></div>`)}

async function callTeacherFunction(body){
 const r=await sb.functions.invoke('tic-student-admin',{body:{...body,redirect_to:location.origin+location.pathname}});
 if(r.error)throw new Error(r.error.message||'Falha na função segura.');
 if(r.data?.error)throw new Error(r.data.error);
 return r.data;
}
function whatsappNumber(phone){return String(phone||'').replace(/\D/g,'')}
function shareStudentWhatsApp(id, contentTitle='Nova atividade'){const s=studentsCache.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!s?.phone)return toast('Cadastre o WhatsApp do aluno primeiro.','error');const n=whatsappNumber(s.phone);if(n.length<10)return toast('O WhatsApp cadastrado parece inválido.','error');const text=`Olá, ${s.display_name||'Aluno'}! 👋\n\nUma nova atividade foi atribuída a você na Teacher Platform.\n📚 ${contentTitle}\n\nAcesse sua plataforma para realizar a atividade.`;window.open(`https://wa.me/${n}?text=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`,'_blank','noopener');}

async function shareStudentAccess(id){
 try{
   const r=await callTeacherFunction({action:'reset_student_password',student_id:id});
   const link=r?.action_link || (location.origin+location.pathname);
   const student=studentsCache.find(x=>x.id===id);
   if(!student)return toast('Aluno não encontrado.','error');
   const phone=(student.phone||'').replace(/\D/g,'');
   const msgText=`Olá ${student.display_name}! 👋\n\nSeu acesso à Teacher Platform está pronto.\n\n🔗 Acesse: ${link}\n\nSe o link pedir, crie sua nova senha e depois entre na plataforma.\n\nTeacher Marcelo`;
   const waPhone=phone ? (phone.startsWith('55')?phone:'55'+phone) : '';
   const wa='https://wa.me/'+waPhone+'?text='+encodeURIComponent(msgText);
   openModal('📲 Compartilhar acesso',`<div class="notice success">Link seguro gerado para <b>${esc(student.display_name)}</b>.</div><div class="form"><div class="field"><label>WhatsApp cadastrado</label><input value="${esc(student.phone||'Não informado')}" readonly></div><div class="field"><label>Mensagem</label><textarea id="shareMessage" rows="7" readonly>${esc(msgText)}</textarea></div><div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Fechar</button><button class="btn secondary" onclick="copyShareMessage()">📋 Copiar</button>${phone?`<button class="btn primary" onclick="window.open('${wa}','_blank','noopener')">📲 Abrir WhatsApp</button>`:'<span class="notice warning">Cadastre o WhatsApp do aluno para abrir o WhatsApp diretamente.</span>'}</div></div>`);
 }catch(e){toast(e.message,'error')}
}
async function copyShareMessage(){const el=$('shareMessage');if(!el)return;try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(el.value);toast('Mensagem copiada.','success')}catch{el.select();document.execCommand('copy');toast('Mensagem copiada.','success')}}
async function resetStudentPassword(id){
 const s=studentsCache.find(x=>x.id===id);
 openModal('🔑 Senha temporária do aluno',`<form class="form" onsubmit="saveStudentPassword(event,'${id}')"><div class="notice">Aluno: <b>${esc(s?.display_name||'')}</b><br>O Teacher define uma nova senha temporária e entrega ao aluno.</div><div class="field"><label>Nova senha temporária</label><div style="display:flex;gap:8px"><input id="newTempPassword" type="text" minlength="6" required placeholder="Ex.: English@2026"><button type="button" class="btn secondary" onclick="generateResetPassword()">Gerar</button></div></div><div class="notice warning">Recomendação: entregue a senha ao aluno por um canal privado e peça que ele altere a senha após o primeiro acesso.</div><div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">🔑 Definir senha</button></div></form>`);
}
async function saveStudentPassword(e,id){e.preventDefault();const pw=$('newTempPassword').value;if(pw.length<6)return toast('A senha precisa ter pelo menos 6 caracteres.','error');try{const r=await callTeacherFunction({action:'set_student_password',student_id:id,temp_password:pw});closeModal();toast(r?.message||'Senha temporária definida.','success')}catch(e){toast(e.message,'error')}}
function generateTempPassword(){const chars='ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz23456789';let p='English@';for(let i=0;i<4;i++)p+=chars[Math.floor(Math.random()*chars.length)];$('sTempPassword').value=p}
function generateResetPassword(){const chars='ABCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijkmnopqrstuvwxyz23456789';let p='English@';for(let i=0;i<4;i++)p+=chars[Math.floor(Math.random()*chars.length)];$('newTempPassword').value=p}
function toast(text,type='info',ms=3800){const wrap=$('toastWrap');if(!wrap)return;const el=document.createElement('div');el.className='toast '+(type==='success'?'success':type==='error'?'error':'');el.innerHTML=`<span>${type==='success'?'✅':type==='error'?'⚠️':'ℹ️'}</span><div style="flex:1">${esc(text)}</div><button onclick="this.parentElement.remove()">✕</button>`;wrap.appendChild(el);setTimeout(()=>el.remove(),ms)}
function loading(){return '<div class="loading"><div class="spinner"></div>Carregando...</div>'}
async function deleteRow(table,id,view){if(!confirm('Excluir este registro?'))return;const r=await sb.from(table).delete().eq('id',id);if(r.error)return alert(r.error.message);loadView(view)}
function openGlobalSearch(){ if(!requireTeacherAction())return;$('searchModal').classList.remove('hidden');$('globalSearch').value='';$('globalSearch').focus();doSearch()}
function closeSearch(){$('searchModal').classList.add('hidden')}
async function doSearch(){const q=$('globalSearch').value.trim();if(!q){$('searchResults').innerHTML='<div class="empty">Digite algo para buscar.</div>';return}const [{data:s},{data:l},{data:c},{data:m}]=await Promise.all([sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name,current_level').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).ilike('display_name','%'+q+'%'),sb.from('tic_lessons').select('id,title,level').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).ilike('title','%'+q+'%'),sb.from('tic_courses').select('id,title,level').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).ilike('title','%'+q+'%'),sb.from('tic_materials').select('id,title,level').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).ilike('title','%'+q+'%')]);$('searchResults').innerHTML=[...(s||[]).map(x=>`<div class="row"><div><b>👤 ${esc(x.display_name)}</b><small>Student · ${x.current_level}</small></div><button class="btn secondary" onclick="closeSearch();openStudentView('${x.id}')">View</button></div>`),...(l||[]).map(x=>`<div class="row"><div><b>📝 ${esc(x.title)}</b><small>Lesson · ${x.level||''}</small></div></div>`),...(c||[]).map(x=>`<div class="row"><div><b>📚 ${esc(x.title)}</b><small>Course · ${x.level||''}</small></div></div>`),...(m||[]).map(x=>`<div class="row"><div><b>📂 ${esc(x.title)}</b><small>Material · ${x.level||''}</small></div></div>`)].join('')||'<div class="empty">Nenhum resultado.</div>'}
async function logout(){await sb.auth.signOut();location.reload()}
</script>
<style>
/* CURRICULUM UPGRADE — preserva o sistema existente */
.course-dashboard{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr .75fr;gap:16px}.course-card{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;background:#fff;padding:18px}.course-card:hover{box-shadow:var(--shadow);transform:translateY(-1px)}.course-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;align-items:flex-start}.course-top h3{margin:0;font:800 18px "Plus Jakarta Sans"}.course-top p{margin:5px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}.course-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:8px;margin:15px 0}.course-stat{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;padding:10px;background:#fbfaff}.course-stat b{display:block;font-size:18px}.course-stat small{font-size:9px;color:var(--muted)}.curriculum-panel{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}.curriculum-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:14px 16px;background:#faf9ff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.curriculum-head h3{margin:0;font-size:15px}.module-block{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.module-block:last-child{border-bottom:0}.module-title{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:12px 16px;background:#fff}.module-title b{font-size:13px}.module-title small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;margin-top:2px}.module-lessons{padding:0 16px 10px}.curriculum-lesson{display:grid;grid-template-columns:32px 1fr auto;gap:9px;align-items:center;border-top:1px solid #f0eef4;padding:9px 0}.lesson-number{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:8px;background:#eee8ff;color:var(--p);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:10px;font-weight:800}.lesson-copy b{font-size:12px}.lesson-copy small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px}.lesson-controls{display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center}.lesson-controls button{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:7px;padding:5px 7px;color:#6e6a7a}.lesson-controls button:hover{color:var(--p);border-color:#d8cef5}.course-student-list{max-height:330px;overflow:auto;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px}.course-student{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:10px 11px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}.course-student:last-child{border-bottom:0}.course-student input{width:auto}.course-student small{color:var(--muted);display:block}.course-empty{padding:25px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}.drag-handle{cursor:grab;color:#aaa}.dragging{opacity:.45}.drop-target{background:#f7f2ff!important;outline:2px dashed #bba7ee}
@media(max-width:900px){.course-dashboard{grid-template-columns:1fr}.course-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:600px){.course-stats{grid-template-columns:1fr}.curriculum-lesson{grid-template-columns:30px 1fr}.lesson-controls{grid-column:2;justify-content:flex-start}.course-top{flex-direction:column}}
</style>
<script>
/* ===== CURRICULUM / COURSE ENROLLMENT — additive patch ===== */
const __oldGenericTable=genericTable;
const __oldLessonsPage=lessonsPage;
const __oldStudentLessons=studentLessons;
const __oldOpenLessonForm=openLessonForm;
const __oldSaveLesson=saveLesson;

function __courseLessons(courseId){return (window.__ticLessons||[]).filter(l=>l.course_id===courseId)}
async function __loadCourseData(){
  const [cr,lr,mr]=await Promise.all([
    sb.from('tic_courses').select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('created_at',{ascending:false}),
    sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('position').order('created_at'),
    sb.from('tic_modules').select('*').order('position').order('created_at')
  ]);
  if(cr.error)throw cr.error;if(lr.error)throw lr.error;if(mr.error)throw mr.error;
  window.__ticCourses=cr.data||[];window.__ticLessons=lr.data||[];window.__ticModules=mr.data||[];
}
async function coursesPage(){
  try{await __loadCourseData();}catch(e){$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention"><b>Não foi possível carregar os cursos.</b><p>${esc(e.message)}</p></div>`;return}
  const cs=window.__ticCourses||[],ls=window.__ticLessons||[],ms=window.__ticModules||[];
  const memberCounts={};
  if(cs.length){const r=await sb.from('tic_course_students').select('course_id,status').in('course_id',cs.map(c=>c.id));if(!r.error)(r.data||[]).forEach(x=>{if(x.status!=='inactive')memberCounts[x.course_id]=(memberCounts[x.course_id]||0)+1})}
  $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="course-dashboard"><div class="grid">${cs.map(c=>{const cl=ls.filter(l=>l.course_id===c.id).length,cm=ms.filter(m=>m.course_id===c.id).length;return `<article class="course-card"><div class="course-top"><div><span class="badge blue">${esc(c.level||'—')}</span><h3>${esc(c.title||c.name||'Curso')}</h3><p>${esc(c.description||'Sem descrição')}</p></div><span class="badge ${c.active===false?'red':'green'}">${c.active===false?'Inativo':'Ativo'}</span></div><div class="course-stats"><div class="course-stat"><b>${cl}</b><small>LESSONS</small></div><div class="course-stat"><b>${cm}</b><small>MÓDULOS</small></div><div class="course-stat"><b>${memberCounts[c.id]||0}</b><small>ALUNOS</small></div></div><div class="actions"><button class="btn secondary" onclick="openCourseCurriculum('${c.id}')">📚 Currículo</button><button class="btn secondary" onclick="openCourseEnrollment('${c.id}')">👥 Alunos</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick='openCourseForm(${JSON.stringify(c)})'>Editar</button><button class="btn danger" onclick="deleteCourseSafe('${c.id}')">Excluir</button></div></article>`}).join('')||'<div class="card course-empty">Nenhum curso criado. Clique em <b>+ Novo curso</b> para começar.</div>'}</div><div class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>Como organizar</h2></div><div class="notice">Estrutura recomendada: <b>Curso → Módulos → Lessons</b>. Depois matricule o aluno no curso. O aluno verá esse currículo em <b>My Lessons</b>.</div><div class="section"><div class="metric"><span>Lessons sem curso</span><b>${ls.filter(l=>!l.course_id).length}</b></div><div class="metric"><span>Lessons sem módulo</span><b>${ls.filter(l=>l.course_id&&!l.module_id).length}</b></div><div class="metric"><span>Cursos</span><b>${cs.length}</b></div></div></div></div>`;
}
async function genericTable(type){if(type==='courses')return coursesPage();return __oldGenericTable(type)}

async function openCourseCurriculum(courseId){
  await __loadCourseData();const c=window.__ticCourses.find(x=>x.id===courseId);if(!c)return toast('Curso não encontrado.','error');
  const ms=window.__ticModules.filter(m=>m.course_id===courseId).sort((a,b)=>(a.position||0)-(b.position||0));
  const ls=window.__ticLessons.filter(l=>l.course_id===courseId).sort((a,b)=>(a.position||0)-(b.position||0));
  const body=`<div class="notice">Organize <b>${esc(c.title)}</b> em módulos. As lessons podem ser criadas aqui, vinculadas a um módulo e reordenadas com ↑ ↓ ou arrastando.</div><div class="actions section"><button class="btn primary" onclick="openModuleForm('${courseId}')">+ Novo módulo</button><button class="btn secondary" onclick="openLessonForm(null,false,'${courseId}')">+ Nova lesson neste curso</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="openCourseEnrollment('${courseId}')">👥 Alunos do curso</button></div><div class="curriculum-panel section"><div class="curriculum-head"><div><h3>📚 ${esc(c.title)}</h3><span style="font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)">${ls.length} lesson(s) · ${ms.length} módulo(s)</span></div><span class="badge blue">${esc(c.level||'')}</span></div>${ms.map(m=>{const ml=ls.filter(l=>l.module_id===m.id).sort((a,b)=>(a.position||0)-(b.position||0));return `<div class="module-block"><div class="module-title"><div><b>📁 ${esc(m.title)}</b><small>${esc(m.description||'')} · ${ml.length} lesson(s)</small></div><div class="row-actions"><button class="btn sm ghost" onclick='openModuleForm(${JSON.stringify(m)})'>Editar</button><button class="btn sm danger" onclick="deleteModuleSafe('${m.id}','${courseId}')">Excluir</button></div></div><div class="module-lessons" ondragover="event.preventDefault();this.classList.add('drop-target')" ondragleave="this.classList.remove('drop-target')" ondrop="dropLessonIntoModule(event,'${m.id}','${courseId}')">${ml.map((l,i)=>`<div class="curriculum-lesson" draggable="true" ondragstart="dragLesson(event,'${l.id}')" ondragend="clearDrag()"><div class="lesson-number drag-handle">${i+1}</div><div class="lesson-copy"><b>${esc(l.title)}</b><small>${esc(l.skill||'')} · ${esc(l.level||'')} · posição ${l.position||i+1}</small></div><div class="lesson-controls"><button title="Subir" onclick="moveCourseLesson('${l.id}',-1,'${courseId}')">↑</button><button title="Descer" onclick="moveCourseLesson('${l.id}',1,'${courseId}')">↓</button><button title="Editar" onclick="openLessonFormById('${l.id}')">✏️</button></div></div>`).join('')||'<div class="course-empty">Arraste uma lesson para este módulo ou crie uma nova.</div>'}</div></div>`}).join('')||'<div class="course-empty">Nenhum módulo. Crie o primeiro.</div>'}</div><div class="notice warning section">Lessons do curso que ainda não possuem módulo: <b>${ls.filter(l=>!l.module_id).length}</b>. Elas podem ser vinculadas ao editar a lesson.</div>`;
  openModal(`📚 Currículo · ${c.title}`,body);
}
function dragLesson(e,id){e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain',id);window.__dragLesson=id;e.currentTarget.classList.add('dragging')}
function clearDrag(){document.querySelectorAll('.dragging').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('dragging'));document.querySelectorAll('.drop-target').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('drop-target'))}
async function dropLessonIntoModule(e,moduleId,courseId){e.preventDefault();clearDrag();const id=e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain')||window.__dragLesson;if(!id)return;const l=window.__ticLessons?.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!l)return;const count=(window.__ticLessons||[]).filter(x=>x.module_id===moduleId).length;l.module_id=moduleId;l.position=count+1;const {error}=await sb.from('tic_lessons').update({module_id:moduleId,course_id:courseId,position:l.position}).eq('id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);if(error)return toast('Não foi possível mover a lesson: '+error.message,'error');toast('Lesson movida para o módulo.','success');openCourseCurriculum(courseId)}
async function moveCourseLesson(id,dir,courseId){await __loadCourseData();const l=window.__ticLessons.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!l)return;const same=window.__ticLessons.filter(x=>x.module_id===l.module_id&&x.course_id===courseId).sort((a,b)=>(a.position||0)-(b.position||0));const i=same.findIndex(x=>x.id===id),j=i+dir;if(i<0||j<0||j>=same.length)return;const a=same[i],b=same[j];const r1=await sb.from('tic_lessons').update({position:b.position}).eq('id',a.id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);if(r1.error)return toast(r1.error.message,'error');const r2=await sb.from('tic_lessons').update({position:a.position}).eq('id',b.id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);if(r2.error)return toast(r2.error.message,'error');openCourseCurriculum(courseId)}

function openModuleForm(mOrCourse){const isEdit=typeof mOrCourse==='object'&&mOrCourse!==null;const m=isEdit?mOrCourse:null;const courseId=isEdit?m.course_id:mOrCourse;openModal(isEdit?'Editar módulo':'Novo módulo',`<form class="form" onsubmit="saveModuleForm(event,'${m?.id||''}','${courseId}')"><div class="field"><label>Nome do módulo</label><input id="modTitle" value="${esc(m?.title||'')}" required placeholder="Ex.: Module 1 — Foundations"></div><div class="field"><label>Descrição</label><textarea id="modDesc">${esc(m?.description||'')}</textarea></div><div class="field"><label>Posição</label><input id="modPos" type="number" min="1" value="${m?.position||((window.__ticModules||[]).filter(x=>x.course_id===courseId).length+1)}"></div><div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">Salvar módulo</button></div></form>`)}
async function saveModuleForm(e,id,courseId){e.preventDefault();const o={course_id:courseId,title:$('modTitle').value.trim(),description:$('modDesc').value.trim()||null,position:Number($('modPos').value)||1};const r=id?await sb.from('tic_modules').update(o).eq('id',id):await sb.from('tic_modules').insert(o);if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível salvar o módulo: '+r.error.message,'error');closeModal();toast('Módulo salvo.','success');openCourseCurriculum(courseId)}
async function deleteModuleSafe(id,courseId){if(!confirm('Excluir este módulo? As lessons ficarão sem módulo, mas não serão apagadas.'))return;const r=await sb.from('tic_modules').delete().eq('id',id);if(r.error)return toast(r.error.message,'error');toast('Módulo excluído.','success');openCourseCurriculum(courseId)}

function openLessonForm(x=null,forcePlan=false,preCourseId=''){const isEdit=!!x;const courseId=x?.course_id||preCourseId||'';openModal(isEdit?'Editar lesson':(forcePlan?'Novo lesson plan':'Nova lesson'),`<form class="form" onsubmit="saveCourseAwareLesson(event,'${x?.id||''}')"><div class="field"><label>Título</label><input id="l1" value="${esc(x?.title||'')}" required></div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Nível</label><select id="l2">${levels.map(l=>`<option ${l===x?.level?'selected':''}>${l}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Skill</label><select id="l3">${['grammar','vocabulary','listening','reading','writing','speaking','pronunciation'].map(l=>`<option ${l===x?.skill?'selected':''}>${l}</option>`).join('')}</select></div></div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Curso</label><select id="lessonCourse" onchange="filterLessonModules()"><option value="">Sem curso</option>${(window.__ticCourses||[]).map(c=>`<option value="${c.id}" ${c.id===courseId?'selected':''}>${esc(c.title||c.name)} · ${esc(c.level||'')}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Módulo</label><select id="lessonModule"><option value="">Sem módulo</option>${(window.__ticModules||[]).filter(m=>!courseId||m.course_id===courseId).map(m=>`<option value="${m.id}" ${m.id===x?.module_id?'selected':''}>${esc(m.title)}</option>`).join('')}</select></div></div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Tipo</label><select id="l4"><option value="lesson" ${x?.lesson_type==='lesson'||!x?'selected':''}>Lesson</option><option value="plan" ${x?.lesson_type==='plan'?'selected':''}>Lesson Plan</option><option value="extra" ${x?.lesson_type==='extra'?'selected':''}>Extra</option><option value="review" ${x?.lesson_type==='review'?'selected':''}>Review</option><option value="live" ${x?.lesson_type==='live'?'selected':''}>Live</option></select></div><div class="field"><label>Posição no módulo</label><input id="l5" type="number" min="1" value="${x?.position||1}"></div></div><div class="field"><label>Descrição / conteúdo</label><textarea id="l6" rows="5">${esc(x?.content||x?.description||'')}</textarea></div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Vídeo URL principal</label><input id="l7" value="${esc(x?.video_url||'')}"></div><div class="field"><label>PDF URL principal</label><input id="l8" value="${esc(x?.pdf_url||'')}"></div></div><div class="field"><label>Imagem de capa</label><input id="lCover" value="${esc(x?.cover_image_url||'')}" placeholder="URL da imagem"></div><div class="resource-box"><div class="resource-head"><b>📚 Recursos da lesson</b><button type="button" class="btn secondary" onclick="addResourceRow('lResources')">+ Adicionar recurso</button></div><div id="lResources"></div></div><div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">Salvar lesson</button></div></form>`);renderResourceRows('lResources',x?.resource_items||[])}
function filterLessonModules(){const cid=$('lessonCourse')?.value||'';const cur=$('lessonModule')?.value||'';if(!$('lessonModule'))return;$('lessonModule').innerHTML='<option value="">Sem módulo</option>'+(window.__ticModules||[]).filter(m=>!cid||m.course_id===cid).sort((a,b)=>(a.position||0)-(b.position||0)).map(m=>`<option value="${m.id}" ${m.id===cur?'selected':''}>${esc(m.title)}</option>`).join('')}
async function saveCourseAwareLesson(e,id){e.preventDefault();const resources=collectResources('lResources');const courseId=$('lessonCourse').value||null;const moduleId=$('lessonModule').value||null;const pos=Number($('l5').value||1);const o={teacher_id:session.user.id,title:$('l1').value.trim(),level:$('l2').value,skill:$('l3').value,lesson_type:$('l4').value,position:pos,content:$('l6').value,video_url:$('l7').value.trim()||null,pdf_url:$('l8').value.trim()||null,resource_items:resources,cover_image_url:$('lCover').value.trim()||null,course_id:courseId,module_id:moduleId};const r=id?await sb.from('tic_lessons').update(o).eq('id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id):await sb.from('tic_lessons').insert(o);if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível salvar a lesson: '+r.error.message,'error');closeModal();toast(id?'Lesson atualizada e vinculada ao currículo.':'Lesson criada e vinculada ao currículo.','success');loadView('lessons')}

async function lessonsPage(plan=false){if(plan)return __oldLessonsPage(plan);try{await __loadCourseData();}catch(e){return __oldLessonsPage(false)}const rows=(window.__ticLessons||[]);$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card"><div class="section-head"><div><h2>Lessons</h2><span>${rows.length} aula(s) · organize por curso e módulo</span></div><button class="btn primary" onclick="openLessonForm()">+ Nova lesson</button></div><div class="table-wrap"><table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Lesson</th><th>Nível</th><th>Curso</th><th>Módulo</th><th>Skill</th><th>Posição</th><th>Ações</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows.map(l=>{const c=(window.__ticCourses||[]).find(x=>x.id===l.course_id),m=(window.__ticModules||[]).find(x=>x.id===l.module_id);return `<tr><td><b>${esc(l.title)}</b><br><small>${esc(ticLessonPreviewText(l.description||l.content||'',55))}</small></td><td>${esc(l.level||'—')}</td><td>${c?esc(c.title):'<span class="badge yellow">Sem curso</span>'}</td><td>${m?esc(m.title):'<span class="badge gray">Sem módulo</span>'}</td><td>${esc(l.skill||'—')}</td><td>${l.position||0}</td><td><div class="action-group"><button class="btn sm ghost" onclick="openLessonFormById('${l.id}')">Editar</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="openAssignLessonById('${l.id}')">📤 Atribuir</button><button class="btn sm danger" onclick="deleteRow('tic_lessons','${l.id}','lessons')">Excluir</button></div></td></tr>`}).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="7" class="empty">Nenhuma lesson criada.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div></div>`}

async function openCourseEnrollment(courseId){
 const c=(window.__ticCourses||[]).find(x=>x.id===courseId)|| (await sb.from('tic_courses').select('*').eq('id',courseId).maybeSingle()).data;if(!c)return toast('Curso não encontrado.','error');
 const [{data:sts},{data:links}]=await Promise.all([sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name,email,current_level,status').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('display_name'),sb.from('tic_course_students').select('student_id,status').eq('course_id',courseId)]);const selected=new Set((links||[]).filter(x=>x.status!=='inactive').map(x=>x.student_id));
 openModal(`👥 Alunos · ${c.title}`,`<form class="form" onsubmit="saveCourseEnrollment(event,'${courseId}')"><div class="notice">Matricule os alunos neste curso. A matrícula é independente da turma e define o currículo principal exibido em <b>My Lessons</b>.</div><div class="course-student-list">${(sts||[]).map(s=>`<label class="course-student"><input type="checkbox" name="courseStudent" value="${s.id}" ${selected.has(s.id)?'checked':''}><span><b>${esc(s.display_name)}</b><small>${esc(s.current_level||'—')} · ${esc(s.status||'')}</small></span></label>`).join('')||'<div class="course-empty">Nenhum aluno cadastrado.</div>'}</div><div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">💾 Salvar matrículas</button></div></form>`)}
async function saveCourseEnrollment(e,courseId){e.preventDefault();const ids=[...document.querySelectorAll('input[name="courseStudent"]:checked')].map(x=>x.value);const {data:old}=await sb.from('tic_course_students').select('id,student_id,status').eq('course_id',courseId);const oldActive=new Map((old||[]).map(x=>[x.student_id,x]));const selected=new Set(ids);const remove=(old||[]).filter(x=>!selected.has(x.student_id)).map(x=>x.id);if(remove.length){const r=await sb.from('tic_course_students').delete().in('id',remove);if(r.error)return toast(r.error.message,'error')}const add=ids.filter(id=>!oldActive.has(id)).map(student_id=>({course_id:courseId,student_id,status:'active'}));const reactivate=ids.filter(id=>oldActive.has(id)&&oldActive.get(id).status==='inactive');if(add.length){const r=await sb.from('tic_course_students').insert(add);if(r.error)return toast(r.error.message,'error')}if(reactivate.length){const r=await sb.from('tic_course_students').update({status:'active'}).eq('course_id',courseId).in('student_id',reactivate);if(r.error)return toast(r.error.message,'error')}closeModal();toast('Matrículas do curso atualizadas.','success');coursesPage()}
async function deleteCourseSafe(id){if(!confirm('Excluir este curso? As lessons não serão apagadas; ficarão sem vínculo de curso.'))return;const r=await sb.from('tic_courses').delete().eq('id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);if(r.error)return toast(r.error.message,'error');toast('Curso excluído.','success');coursesPage()}

async function studentLessons(){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Conta não vinculada.</div>';return}
 const {data:enroll}=await sb.from('tic_course_students').select('course_id,status').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('status','active');const ids=(enroll||[]).map(x=>x.course_id);let cs=[];if(ids.length){const r=await sb.from('tic_courses').select('*').in('id',ids).eq('active',true);cs=r.data||[]}
 if(!cs.length)return __oldStudentLessons();
 const [{data:ls},{data:ms},{data:mats}]=await Promise.all([sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').in('course_id',ids).eq('active',true).order('position'),sb.from('tic_modules').select('*').in('course_id',ids).order('position'),sb.from('tic_materials').select('*').eq('level',s.current_level).order('created_at',{ascending:false})]);
 const html=cs.map(c=>{const cm=(ms||[]).filter(m=>m.course_id===c.id).sort((a,b)=>(a.position||0)-(b.position||0));const cl=(ls||[]).filter(l=>l.course_id===c.id);return `<div class="card section"><div class="course-top"><div><span class="badge blue">${esc(c.level||'')}</span><h3 style="margin:8px 0 0;font:800 18px 'Plus Jakarta Sans'">📚 ${esc(c.title)}</h3><p>${esc(c.description||'')}</p></div><span class="badge green">${cl.length} lessons</span></div><div class="curriculum-panel section">${cm.map(m=>{const ml=cl.filter(l=>l.module_id===m.id).sort((a,b)=>(a.position||0)-(b.position||0));return `<div class="module-block"><div class="module-title"><div><b>📁 ${esc(m.title)}</b><small>${ml.length} lesson(s)</small></div></div><div class="module-lessons">${ml.map((l,i)=>`<div class="curriculum-lesson"><div class="lesson-number">${i+1}</div><div class="lesson-copy"><b>${esc(l.title)}</b><small>${esc(l.skill||'')} · ${esc(l.level||'')}</small></div><button class="btn secondary" onclick="viewStudentLesson('${l.id}')">Abrir</button></div>`).join('')||'<div class="course-empty">Nenhuma lesson neste módulo.</div>'}</div></div>`}).join('')||'<div class="course-empty">Este curso ainda não possui módulos.</div>'}</div></div>`}).join('');$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="notice success">🎓 Você está matriculado em <b>${cs.length} curso(s)</b>. Seu currículo está organizado abaixo por curso → módulo → lesson.</div>${html}<div class="section-head section"><h2>📂 Materials</h2></div><div class="grid cols2">${(mats||[]).map(x=>`<article class="card"><span class="badge green">${esc(x.material_type||'material')}</span><h3>${esc(x.title)}</h3><p style="color:var(--muted);font-size:12px">${esc(x.description||'')}</p>${x.external_url||x.file_url?`<a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(x.external_url||x.file_url)}" target="_blank">Abrir material →</a>`:''}</article>`).join('')||'<div class="card empty">Nenhum material para seu nível.</div>'}</div>`}
function viewStudentLesson(id){const l=window.__ticLessons?.find(x=>x.id===id);if(l)return viewLessonStudentLocal(l);sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').eq('id',id).maybeSingle().then(r=>{if(r.data)viewLessonStudentLocal(r.data);else toast('Lesson não encontrada.','error')})}
function viewLessonStudentLocal(l){openModal(esc(l.title),`<div class="notice">${esc(l.level||'')} · ${esc(l.skill||'')}</div>${l.cover_image_url?`<img class="task-cover" src="${esc(l.cover_image_url)}" alt="">`:''}<div class="manual-resource section">${esc(l.content||l.description||'Sem conteúdo')}</div>${l.video_url?`<p><a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(l.video_url)}" target="_blank">▶ Vídeo</a></p>`:''}${l.pdf_url?`<p><a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(l.pdf_url)}" target="_blank">📄 PDF</a></p>`:''}`)}

/* Ensure the old helper remains available under a different name when needed. */

/* ================================================================
   TIC LEARNING UPGRADE v3
   Preserves the existing platform and adds:
   - My Courses student area
   - Course -> Module -> Lesson navigation
   - Interactive HTML viewer (sandboxed)
   - HTML editor/preview in Lesson and Assignment forms
   - Lesson response submissions with attempt history
   - Task HTML submissions with attempt history
   - Teacher review of Lesson responses
   - Feedback + improvement links
   - robust task opening from Dashboard
   ================================================================ */

function ticSafeUrl(v){try{const u=new URL(v,location.href);if(['http:','https:'].includes(u.protocol))return u.href}catch(e){}return ''}
function ticHtmlBridge(){return `<scr${'ipt'}>(function(){
 const collect=()=>{const o={};document.querySelectorAll('input,textarea,select,[contenteditable="true"]').forEach((el,i)=>{const key=el.name||el.id||('field_'+i);if(el.type==='checkbox'||el.type==='radio')o[key]=el.checked;else o[key]=el.value??el.textContent??''});return o};
 const send=()=>parent.postMessage({type:'tic-html-submit',payload:{fields:collect(),text:document.body.innerText.slice(0,20000)}},'*');
 document.addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();send()},{capture:true});
 document.addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button,input[type=submit],[data-tic-submit]');if(!b)return;const t=(b.innerText||b.value||'').toLowerCase();if(b.dataset.ticSubmit!==undefined||/submit|enviar|send|check|finish|concluir|responder|salvar resposta|save answer/.test(t)){e.preventDefault();send()}});
 parent.postMessage({type:'tic-html-ready'},'*');
})();<\/script>`}

let ticHtmlViewerContext=null;
function openHtmlViewer(title,htmlContent,mode='preview',refId=''){
 const content=String(htmlContent||'').trim();
 if(!content)return toast('Esta atividade não possui conteúdo HTML.','info');
 const safeTitle=esc(title||'HTML Viewer');
 const actions=mode==='student'?`<div class="html-viewer-actions"><span class="badge green">Conteúdo interativo</span><span class="html-viewer-help">Responda dentro do conteúdo e use o botão Enviar/Submit da atividade.</span></div>`:`<div class="html-viewer-actions"><span class="badge blue">Preview</span><span class="html-viewer-help">O conteúdo é exibido isoladamente em um viewer responsivo.</span></div>`;
 openModal(`🧩 ${safeTitle}`,`${actions}<div class="html-devicebar"><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('desktop')">🖥 Desktop</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('tablet')">▣ Tablet</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('mobile')">📱 Mobile</button></div><div id="htmlViewerWrap" class="html-viewer-wrap desktop"><iframe id="htmlViewerFrame" title="HTML Viewer" sandbox="allow-scripts" loading="lazy"></iframe></div>${mode==='student'?'<div id="htmlViewerStatus" class="notice" style="margin-top:10px">Aguardando interação...</div>':''}`);
 ticHtmlViewerContext={mode,refId,html:content};
 const frame=$('htmlViewerFrame');
 if(frame){frame.srcdoc=content+ticHtmlBridge();}
}
function ticResizeViewer(size){const w=$('htmlViewerWrap');if(!w)return;w.className='html-viewer-wrap '+size}
window.addEventListener('message',async e=>{
 if(e.source!==$('htmlViewerFrame')?.contentWindow)return;
 if(e.data?.type==='tic-html-ready'){if($('htmlViewerStatus'))$('htmlViewerStatus').textContent='Conteúdo carregado. Você pode responder dentro da atividade.';return}
 if(e.data?.type!=='tic-html-submit')return;
 if(!ticHtmlViewerContext||ticHtmlViewerContext.mode!=='student')return;
 const {mode,refId}=ticHtmlViewerContext;
 if(mode==='studentLesson'){await submitInteractiveLesson(refId,e.data.payload||{});}
 if(mode==='studentTask'){await submitInteractiveTask(refId,e.data.payload||{});}
});

async function submitInteractiveLesson(lessonId,payload){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return toast('Conta de aluno não encontrada.','error');
 const {data:lesson}=await sb.from('tic_lessons').select('id,title,allow_student_response,active').eq('id',lessonId).eq('active',true).maybeSingle();
 if(!lesson)return toast('Lesson não encontrada ou desativada.','error');
 if(lesson.allow_student_response===false)return toast('Esta Lesson está disponível para estudo, mas o Teacher não ativou respostas.','info');
 const {data:last}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_responses').select('attempt').eq('lesson_id',lessonId).eq('student_id',s.id).order('attempt',{ascending:false}).limit(1).maybeSingle();
 const attempt=Number(last?.attempt||0)+1;
 const {data:r,error}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_responses').insert({lesson_id:lessonId,student_id:s.id,attempt,response_data:payload.fields||{},response_text:payload.text||null,status:'submitted'}).select().single();
 if(error)return toast('Não foi possível enviar sua resposta: '+error.message,'error');
 if($('htmlViewerStatus'))$('htmlViewerStatus').innerHTML=`<b>✅ Resposta enviada.</b> Tentativa ${attempt}. O Teacher poderá corrigir e enviar feedback.`;
 toast('Resposta da Lesson enviada.','success');
}

async function submitInteractiveTask(taskAssignmentId,payload){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return toast('Conta de aluno não encontrada.','error');
 const {data:ta,error:te}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,active,assignment_id').eq('id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();
 if(te||!ta)return toast('Task não encontrada.','error');
 if(ta.active===false)return toast('Esta atribuição foi removida pelo Teacher.','error');
 const {data:a}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').select('id,html_enabled,allow_multiple_attempts,active').eq('id',ta.assignment_id).maybeSingle();
 if(!a||a.active===false)return toast('Esta Task não está ativa.','error');
 const {data:last}=await sb.from('tic_submissions').select('attempt').eq('task_assignment_id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',s.id).order('attempt',{ascending:false}).limit(1).maybeSingle();
 if(a.allow_multiple_attempts===false && last)return toast('O Teacher configurou esta Task para uma única tentativa.','info');
 const attempt=Number(last?.attempt||0)+1;
 const {error}=await sb.from('tic_submissions').insert({task_assignment_id:taskAssignmentId,student_id:s.id,attempt,response_data:payload.fields||{},answer_text:payload.text||null,submitted_at:new Date().toISOString()});
 if(error)return toast('Não foi possível enviar a Task: '+error.message,'error');
 await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').update({status:'submitted'}).eq('id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',s.id);
 if($('htmlViewerStatus'))$('htmlViewerStatus').innerHTML=`<b>✅ Task enviada.</b> Tentativa ${attempt}. A atribuição continua ativa para novas tentativas.`;
 toast('Resposta da Task enviada.','success');
}


/* ---------- Student Dashboard v3: action-first learning home ---------- */
async function studentDashboardV3(){
 const s=await studentRecord();
 if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Sua conta ainda não está vinculada a um cadastro de aluno pelo Teacher.</div>';return}

  sb.from('tic_course_students').select('course_id').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('status','active'),

 ]);

   sb.from('tic_modules').select('id,title,course_id,position').in('course_id',courseIds).order('position')
  ]);courses=c.data||[];lessons=l.data||[];mods=m.data||[];
 }
 const pending=(ta||[]).filter(x=>!['submitted','completed'].includes(x.status)).length;

 const reviewed=(ta||[]).filter(x=>x.status==='completed').length;
 const firstTask=(ta||[])[0];
 const course=courses[0];

 setPage(`Hello, ${s.display_name?.split(' ')[0]||'Student'} 👋`,'Seu espaço de aprendizagem.');
 $('content').innerHTML=`
 <section class="student-welcome card"><div><span>MY LEARNING</span><h2>Continue your English journey</h2><p>Entre diretamente no curso, na próxima Lesson ou nas Tasks.</p></div><div class="welcome-level"><small>CURRENT LEVEL</small><b>${esc(s.current_level)} → ${esc(s.target_level||'—')}</b><div class="progress"><i style="width:${Math.min(100,overall)}%"></i></div><strong>${overall}% geral</strong></div></section>
 <div class="student-action-grid section">
  <button class="student-action-card" onclick="loadView('studentCourses')"><span>📚</span><b>My Courses</b><small>${courses.length} curso(s) ativo(s)</small></button>
  <button class="student-action-card" onclick="loadView('studentTasks')"><span>✅</span><b>My Tasks</b><small>${pending} pendente(s) · ${submitted} enviada(s)</small></button>
  <button class="student-action-card" onclick="loadView('studentProgress')"><span>📊</span><b>My Progress</b><small>${overall}% no nível atual</small></button>
  <button class="student-action-card" onclick="loadView('studentLessons')"><span>📖</span><b>My Lessons</b><small>${lessons.length} lesson(s) disponíveis</small></button>
 </div>
 <div class="grid cols2 section">
  <div class="card student-next-card"><div class="section-head"><div><h2>▶ Continue Learning</h2><span>${course?esc(course.title):'Nenhum curso'}</span></div>${course?`<span class="badge blue">${esc(course.level||s.current_level)}</span>`:''}</div>${nextLesson?`<div class="next-lesson-box"><div class="next-lesson-icon">📖</div><div><b>${esc(nextLesson.title)}</b><small>${esc(nextLesson.skill||'Lesson')} ${nextLesson.html_enabled?'· 🧩 Interativa':''}</small></div><button class="btn primary" onclick="viewStudentLessonInteractive('${nextLesson.id}')">Abrir Lesson →</button></div>`:'<div class="empty">O Teacher ainda não adicionou Lessons ao seu curso.</div>'}<button class="btn ghost" onclick="loadView('studentCourses')">Ver currículo completo</button></div>
  <div class="card"><div class="section-head"><div><h2>✅ My Tasks</h2><span>Atividades que precisam da sua atenção.</span></div><span class="badge ${pending?'yellow':'green'}">${pending} pendente(s)</span></div>${(ta||[]).slice(0,3).map(x=>`<div class="dashboard-task-row"><div><b>${esc(x.tic_assignments?.title||'Task')}</b><small>${x.tic_assignments?.due_at?'Prazo informativo: '+fmtDate(x.tic_assignments.due_at):'Sem prazo'} · ${x.tic_assignments?.html_enabled?'HTML interativo':''}</small></div><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="openStudentTask('${x.id}')">Abrir</button></div>`).join('')||'<div class="empty">Nenhuma Task ativa.</div>'}<button class="btn ghost" onclick="loadView('studentTasks')">Ver todas as Tasks →</button></div>
 </div>
 <div class="grid cols2 section">
  <div class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>📚 Course Snapshot</h2><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="loadView('studentCourses')">Abrir</button></div>${course?`<div class="course-snapshot"><b>${esc(course.title)}</b><small>${courseLessons.length} Lessons · ${(mods||[]).filter(m=>m.course_id===course.id).length} Módulos</small><div class="progress"><i style="width:${overall}%"></i></div><span>${overall}%</span></div>`:'<div class="empty">Nenhum curso ativo.</div>'}</div>
  <div class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>📝 Latest activity</h2></div><div class="student-mini-stats"><div><b>${pending}</b><small>Pending</small></div><div><b>${submitted}</b><small>Submitted</small></div><div><b>${reviewed}</b><small>Reviewed</small></div></div><div class="notice">💡 As Tasks permanecem abertas até o Teacher removê-las. Depois da correção, você pode fazer novas tentativas quando permitido.</div></div>
 </div>
 <div class="card section"><div class="section-head"><h2>💰 My Payments</h2><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="loadView('student')">Atualizar</button></div>${(pay||[]).map(x=>`<div class="row"><div><b>${monthLabel(x.reference_month)}</b><small>${x.payment_date?'Pago em '+fmtDate(x.payment_date):'Vencimento '+fmtDate(x.due_date)}</small></div><b>${money(x.amount)} ${badge(x.status)}</b></div>`).join('')||'<div class="empty">Nenhum registro.</div>'}</div>`;
}
