/* ---------- Student Courses ---------- */
async function studentCoursesPage(){
 const s=await studentRecord();
 if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Sua conta ainda não está vinculada a um aluno.</div>';return}
 const {data:enroll,error:ee}=await sb.from('tic_course_students').select('course_id,status,enrolled_at').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('status','active').order('enrolled_at',{ascending:false});
 if(ee)return $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention"><b>Não foi possível carregar seus cursos.</b><p>${esc(ee.message)}</p></div>`;
 const ids=(enroll||[]).map(x=>x.course_id).filter(Boolean);
 if(!ids.length){setPage('My Courses','Seus cursos, módulos e currículo.');$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Você ainda não está matriculado em nenhum curso. Peça ao Teacher para matricular você.</div>';return}
 const [{data:cs,error:ce},{data:ms,error:me},{data:ls,error:le},{data:p}]=await Promise.all([
  sb.from('tic_courses').select('*').in('id',ids).eq('active',true),
  sb.from('tic_modules').select('*').in('course_id',ids).order('position'),
  sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').in('course_id',ids).eq('active',true).order('position').order('created_at'),
  sb.from('tic_progress').select('level,skill,progress').eq('student_id',s.id)
 ]);
 if(ce||me||le)return $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention"><b>Erro no currículo.</b><p>${esc((ce||me||le).message)}</p></div>`;
 const courseCards=(cs||[]).map(c=>{
  const lessons=(ls||[]).filter(l=>l.course_id===c.id).sort((a,b)=>(a.position||0)-(b.position||0));
  const mods=(ms||[]).filter(m=>m.course_id===c.id).sort((a,b)=>(a.position||0)-(b.position||0));
  const levelProgress=Number((p||[]).find(x=>x.level===c.level&&x.skill==='overall')?.progress||0);
  const done=lessons.filter(l=>Number((p||[]).find(x=>x.level===c.level&&x.skill===l.skill)?.progress||0)>=100).length;
  return `<article class="student-course-hero card">
   <div class="student-course-head"><div><span class="badge blue">${esc(c.level||'')}</span><h2>📚 ${esc(c.title)}</h2><p>${esc(c.description||'Curso de inglês')}</p></div><span class="badge green">Acesso ativo</span></div>
   <div class="course-progress-row"><div><b>${levelProgress}%</b><small>progresso do nível</small></div><div class="progress wide"><i style="width:${Math.min(100,levelProgress)}%"></i></div><button class="btn primary" onclick="openStudentCourse('${c.id}')">Continuar →</button></div>
   <div class="student-course-metrics"><span><b>${mods.length}</b> módulos</span><span><b>${lessons.length}</b> lessons</span><span><b>${done}</b> concluídas</span></div>
  </article>`;
 }).join('');
 setPage('My Courses','Seus cursos, módulos e currículo.');
 $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="notice success">🎓 Você está matriculado em <b>${ids.length} curso(s)</b>. O acesso ao currículo permanece disponível enquanto sua matrícula estiver ativa.</div><div class="student-course-list-grid section">${courseCards}</div>`;
}
async function openStudentCourse(courseId){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;
 const {data:c}=await sb.from('tic_courses').select('*').eq('id',courseId).maybeSingle();if(!c)return toast('Curso não encontrado.','error');
 const {data:en}=await sb.from('tic_course_students').select('id').eq('course_id',courseId).eq('student_id',s.id).eq('status','active').maybeSingle();if(!en)return toast('Você não está matriculado neste curso.','error');
 const [{data:mods},{data:lessons},{data:prog}]=await Promise.all([
  sb.from('tic_modules').select('*').eq('course_id',courseId).order('position'),
  sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').eq('course_id',courseId).eq('active',true).order('position').order('created_at'),
  sb.from('tic_progress').select('*').eq('student_id',s.id)
 ]);
 const pmap=new Map((prog||[]).map(x=>[x.skill+':'+x.level,Number(x.progress||0)]));
 const renderLesson=(l,i)=>{const pct=pmap.get((l.skill||'')+':'+(l.level||c.level))||0;return `<button class="student-curriculum-item" onclick="viewStudentLessonInteractive('${l.id}')"><span class="lesson-number">${i+1}</span><span class="lesson-copy"><b>${esc(l.title)}</b><small>${esc(l.skill||'Lesson')} · ${pct>=100?'Concluída':pct?pct+'% em progresso':'Não iniciada'}</small></span><span class="btn sm secondary">Abrir →</span></button>`};
 const blocks=(mods||[]).map(m=>{const ml=(lessons||[]).filter(l=>l.module_id===m.id);return `<section class="student-module"><div class="student-module-head"><div><span>📁</span><div><h3>${esc(m.title)}</h3><small>${esc(m.description||'')} · ${ml.length} lesson(s)</small></div></div><span class="badge blue">${ml.length}</span></div><div>${ml.map(renderLesson).join('')||'<div class="course-empty">Nenhuma lesson neste módulo.</div>'}</div></section>`}).join('');
 const general=(lessons||[]).filter(l=>!l.module_id); const generalBlock=general.length?`<section class="student-module"><div class="student-module-head"><div><span>📖</span><div><h3>Lessons gerais</h3><small>Lessons do curso ainda sem módulo.</small></div></div><span class="badge yellow">${general.length}</span></div><div>${general.map(renderLesson).join('')}</div></section>`:'';
 setPage(c.title,'Curso · '+(c.level||''));
 $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="page-head"><div><h1>📚 ${esc(c.title)}</h1><p>${esc(c.description||'Currículo do curso')}</p></div><div class="actions"><button class="btn secondary" onclick="loadView('studentCourses')">← My Courses</button><button class="btn primary" onclick="loadView('studentTasks')">✅ My Tasks</button></div></div><div class="student-course-progress card"><div><span class="badge blue">${esc(c.level||'')}</span><h2>Seu currículo</h2><p>Curso → módulo → lesson. Você pode abrir uma Lesson quando quiser.</p></div><div class="progress wide"><i style="width:${Math.min(100,pmap.get('overall:'+c.level)||0)}%"></i></div></div><div class="student-module-stack">${blocks+generalBlock||'<div class="card empty">O Teacher ainda não adicionou Lessons.</div>'}</div>`;
}

/* ---------- Interactive Lesson opening ---------- */
async function viewStudentLessonInteractive(id){
 const {data:l,error}=await sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').eq('id',id).eq('active',true).maybeSingle();
 if(error||!l)return toast(error?.message||'Lesson não encontrada.','error');
 const s=await studentRecord();
 const {data:resp}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_responses').select('id,attempt,status,score,teacher_comment,improvement_skill,improvement_link,reviewed_at,created_at').eq('lesson_id',id).eq('student_id',s.id).order('attempt',{ascending:false});
 const latest=resp?.[0];
 const top=`<div class="lesson-student-header"><div><span class="badge blue">${esc(l.level||'')}</span><h2>${esc(l.title)}</h2><small>${esc(l.skill||'')} · ${esc(l.lesson_type||'lesson')}</small></div><span class="badge ${latest?.score!=null?'green':'yellow'}">${latest?.score!=null?'Nota '+latest.score:'Acesso ativo'}</span></div>`;
 const feedback=latest?.teacher_comment?`<div class="notice success lesson-feedback-box"><b>👨‍🏫 Correção do Teacher</b><div>${esc(latest.teacher_comment)}</div>${latest.improvement_skill||latest.improvement_link?`<div class="improvement-box"><b>🎯 Melhorar</b>${latest.improvement_skill?`<span>Habilidade: <b>${esc(latest.improvement_skill)}</b></span>`:''}${latest.improvement_link?`<a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(ticSafeUrl(latest.improvement_link))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">🔗 Praticar melhoria</a>`:''}</div>`:''}</div>`:'';
 openModal(`📖 ${esc(l.title)}`,`${top}${l.cover_image_url?`<img class="task-cover" src="${esc(l.cover_image_url)}" alt="">`:''}${l.content?`<div class="manual-resource lesson-content">${esc(l.content).replace(/\n/g,'<br>')}</div>`:''}${l.video_url?`<a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(ticSafeUrl(l.video_url))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">▶ Vídeo</a>`:''}${l.pdf_url?`<a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(ticSafeUrl(l.pdf_url))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">📄 PDF</a>`:''}${l.html_enabled&&l.html_content?`<div class="section"><div class="section-head"><h3>🧩 Atividade interativa</h3><span>Responsiva</span></div><div id="htmlViewerWrap" class="html-viewer-wrap desktop"><iframe id="htmlViewerFrame" title="Lesson interactive viewer" sandbox="allow-scripts"></iframe></div><div class="html-devicebar"><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('desktop')">🖥</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('tablet')">▣</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('mobile')">📱</button></div><div id="htmlViewerStatus" class="notice">Aguardando interação...</div></div>`:''}${l.allow_student_response?`<div class="section"><div class="notice">✍️ <b>Esta Lesson aceita resposta.</b> Você pode responder quantas vezes o Teacher permitir pela atividade.</div><button class="btn primary" onclick="document.getElementById('htmlViewerFrame')?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'})">Responder Lesson</button></div>`:''}${feedback}${resp?.length?`<div class="section"><h3>📚 Histórico</h3>${resp.map(r=>`<div class="row"><div><b>Tentativa ${r.attempt}</b><small>${r.score!=null?'Nota '+r.score+' · ':''}${fmtDate(r.created_at)}</small></div><span class="badge ${r.status==='reviewed'?'green':'yellow'}">${esc(r.status)}</span></div>`).join('')}</div>`:''}`);
 if(l.html_enabled&&l.html_content){ticHtmlViewerContext={mode:'studentLesson',refId:l.id,html:l.html_content};const f=$('htmlViewerFrame');if(f)f.srcdoc=l.html_content+ticHtmlBridge();}
}

/* ---------- Task UI: preserve existing task data, add HTML viewer ---------- */
async function studentTasks(){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Conta não vinculada.</div>';return}
 const {data,error}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,status,active,removed_at,completed_at,assigned_at,assignment_id,tic_assignments(title,instructions,due_at,points,resource_items,cover_image_url,assignment_type,html_enabled,html_content,allow_multiple_attempts,active)').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('active',true).order('assigned_at',{ascending:false});
 if(error){$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention"><b>Não foi possível carregar suas tarefas.</b><p>${esc(error.message)}</p></div>`;return}
 const ids=(data||[]).map(x=>x.id);let subs=[],feedback=[];
 if(ids.length){const r=await sb.from('tic_submissions').select('id,task_assignment_id,answer_text,file_url,audio_url,video_url,submitted_at,attempt,grade,response_data').in('task_assignment_id',ids).order('submitted_at',{ascending:false});subs=r.data||[];const subIds=subs.map(x=>x.id);if(subIds.length){const f=await sb.from('tic_feedback').select('id,submission_id,comment,grade,private_note,improvement_skill,improvement_link,created_at').in('submission_id',subIds).order('created_at',{ascending:false});feedback=f.data||[]}}
 const cards=(data||[]).map(x=>{const a=x.tic_assignments||{},resources=Array.isArray(a.resource_items)?a.resource_items:[],taskSubs=subs.filter(z=>z.task_assignment_id===x.id).sort((u,v)=>new Date(v.submitted_at)-new Date(u.submitted_at)),latest=taskSubs[0],fb=latest?feedback.find(z=>z.submission_id===latest.id):null;
  const history=taskSubs.map(z=>{const zf=feedback.find(q=>q.submission_id===z.id);return `<div class="task-history-item"><div><b>📤 Tentativa ${z.attempt||1}</b><small>${fmtDate(z.submitted_at)}${z.grade!=null?' · Nota '+z.grade:''}</small></div><span class="badge ${zf?'green':'yellow'}">${zf?'Corrigida':'Aguardando correção'}</span>${zf&&!zf.private_note?`<div class="history-feedback">${esc(zf.comment||'Sem comentário.')}${zf.improvement_skill||zf.improvement_link?`<div>🎯 ${zf.improvement_skill?esc(zf.improvement_skill):''}${zf.improvement_link?` · <a href="${esc(ticSafeUrl(zf.improvement_link))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Material de melhoria →</a>`:''}</div>`:''}`:''}</div>`}).join('');
  return `<article id="task_${x.id}" class="student-task-card card"><div class="task-card-head"><div><span class="badge blue">${esc(a.assignment_type||'assignment')}</span><h2>${esc(a.title||'Task')}</h2><small>🔓 Atribuição ativa · ${a.due_at?'Prazo informativo: '+fmtDate(a.due_at):'Sem prazo'}</small></div><span class="badge ${latest?'green':'yellow'}">${latest?'Enviada':'Pendente'}</span></div>${a.cover_image_url?`<img class="task-cover" src="${esc(a.cover_image_url)}" alt="">`:''}${a.instructions?`<div class="task-instructions">${esc(a.instructions).replace(/\n/g,'<br>')}</div>`:''}${a.html_enabled&&a.html_content?`<div class="task-html-box"><div class="section-head"><h3>🧩 Atividade interativa</h3><span>Responsiva</span></div><button class="btn primary" onclick="openStudentTaskViewer('${x.id}')">▶ Abrir atividade</button></div>`:''}${resources.length?`<div class="task-resources"><b>📚 Recursos</b><div class="resource-grid">${resources.map(resourceCard).join('')}</div></div>`:''}${fb&&!fb.private_note?`<div class="task-feedback"><b>👨‍🏫 Correção do Teacher</b>${fb.grade!=null?`<strong>Nota: ${fb.grade}</strong>`:''}<p>${esc(fb.comment||'Sem comentário.')}</p>${fb.improvement_skill||fb.improvement_link?`<div class="improvement-box"><b>🎯 Como melhorar</b>${fb.improvement_skill?`<span>Habilidade: <b>${esc(fb.improvement_skill)}</b></span>`:''}${fb.improvement_link?`<a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(ticSafeUrl(fb.improvement_link))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">🔗 Praticar melhoria</a>`:''}</div>`:''}</div>`:''}${history?`<div class="task-history"><h3>📚 Histórico de tentativas</h3>${history}</div>`:''}${a.html_enabled&&a.html_content?`<button class="btn primary task-open-btn" onclick="openStudentTaskViewer('${x.id}')">🧩 ${latest?'Abrir novamente':'Abrir Task'}</button>`:`<form class="task-answer-form" onsubmit="submitTaskWork(event,'${x.id}')"><div class="notice"><b>🔓 Task ativa.</b> Você pode enviar novas tentativas enquanto o Teacher mantiver a atribuição.</div><div class="field"><label>Sua resposta</label><textarea id="ans_${x.id}" rows="5" placeholder="Digite sua resposta..." required></textarea></div><div class="field"><label>Arquivo/link opcional</label><input id="file_${x.id}" type="url" placeholder="https://..."></div><button class="btn primary task-open-btn">📤 ${latest?'Enviar nova tentativa':'Enviar para o Teacher'}</button></form>`}</article>`;
 }).join('');
 setPage('My Tasks','Atividades atribuídas pelo Teacher.');$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="student-task-toolbar"><div><b>Suas atividades</b><small>As atribuições permanecem ativas até o Teacher removê-las.</small></div><span class="badge green">${data?.length||0} ativa(s)</span></div><div class="student-task-stack">${cards||'<div class="card empty">Nenhuma tarefa ativa.</div>'}</div>`;
}
async function openStudentTaskViewer(taskAssignmentId){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;
 const {data:x,error}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,active,assignment_id,tic_assignments(title,instructions,due_at,points,html_enabled,html_content,allow_multiple_attempts,cover_image_url)').eq('id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();
 if(error||!x||x.active===false)return toast(error?.message||'Task não encontrada ou removida.','error');
 const a=x.tic_assignments||{};if(!a.html_enabled||!a.html_content)return toast('Esta Task não possui HTML interativo.','info');
 const {data:subs}=await sb.from('tic_submissions').select('id,attempt,grade,submitted_at').eq('task_assignment_id',x.id).eq('student_id',s.id).order('attempt',{ascending:false});
 openModal(`🧩 ${esc(a.title||'Task')}`,`<div class="task-view-head"><span class="badge green">🔓 Atribuição ativa</span><p>${esc(a.instructions||'Complete a atividade abaixo.')}</p><div class="student-task-meta"><span>📅 ${a.due_at?'Prazo informativo: '+fmtDate(a.due_at):'Sem prazo'}</span><span>🎯 ${a.points||0} pontos</span><span>🔄 ${subs?.length||0} tentativa(s)</span></div></div><div class="html-devicebar"><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('desktop')">🖥 Desktop</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('tablet')">▣ Tablet</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('mobile')">📱 Mobile</button></div><div id="htmlViewerWrap" class="html-viewer-wrap desktop"><iframe id="htmlViewerFrame" title="Task interactive viewer" sandbox="allow-scripts"></iframe></div><div id="htmlViewerStatus" class="notice">Aguardando interação...</div><div class="notice success">💡 Depois da correção, esta Task continuará disponível enquanto a atribuição estiver ativa.</div>`);
 ticHtmlViewerContext={mode:'studentTask',refId:x.id,html:a.html_content};const f=$('htmlViewerFrame');if(f)f.srcdoc=a.html_content+ticHtmlBridge();
}

/* ---------- Lesson form with optional HTML ---------- */
function openLessonForm(x=null,forcePlan=false,preCourseId=''){
 const isEdit=!!x,courseId=x?.course_id||preCourseId||'';
 openModal(isEdit?'Editar lesson':(forcePlan?'Novo lesson plan':'Nova lesson'),`<form class="form" onsubmit="saveCourseAwareLessonV3(event,'${x?.id||''}')">
 <div class="field"><label>Título</label><input id="l1" value="${esc(x?.title||'')}" required></div>
 <div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Nível</label><select id="l2">${levels.map(l=>`<option ${l===x?.level?'selected':''}>${l}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Skill</label><select id="l3">${['grammar','vocabulary','listening','reading','writing','speaking','pronunciation'].map(l=>`<option ${l===x?.skill?'selected':''}>${l}</option>`).join('')}</select></div></div>
 <div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Curso</label><select id="lessonCourse" onchange="filterLessonModules()"><option value="">Sem curso</option>${(window.__ticCourses||[]).map(c=>`<option value="${c.id}" ${c.id===courseId?'selected':''}>${esc(c.title||c.name)} · ${esc(c.level||'')}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Módulo</label><select id="lessonModule"><option value="">Sem módulo</option>${(window.__ticModules||[]).filter(m=>!courseId||m.course_id===courseId).sort((a,b)=>(a.position||0)-(b.position||0)).map(m=>`<option value="${m.id}" ${m.id===x?.module_id?'selected':''}>${esc(m.title)}</option>`).join('')}</select></div></div>
 <div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Tipo</label><select id="l4"><option value="lesson" ${x?.lesson_type==='lesson'||!x?'selected':''}>Lesson</option><option value="plan" ${x?.lesson_type==='plan'?'selected':''}>Lesson Plan</option><option value="extra" ${x?.lesson_type==='extra'?'selected':''}>Extra</option><option value="review" ${x?.lesson_type==='review'?'selected':''}>Review</option><option value="live" ${x?.lesson_type==='live'?'selected':''}>Live</option></select></div><div class="field"><label>Posição no módulo</label><input id="l5" type="number" min="1" value="${x?.position||1}"></div></div>
 <div class="field"><label>Descrição / conteúdo</label><textarea id="l6" rows="5">${esc(x?.content||x?.description||'')}</textarea></div>
 <div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Vídeo URL principal</label><input id="l7" value="${esc(x?.video_url||'')}"></div><div class="field"><label>PDF URL principal</label><input id="l8" value="${esc(x?.pdf_url||'')}"></div></div>
 <div class="field"><label>Imagem de capa</label><input id="lCover" value="${esc(x?.cover_image_url||'')}" placeholder="URL da imagem"></div>
 <div class="resource-box"><div class="resource-head"><b>🧩 HTML interativo — opcional</b><label class="switchline"><input id="lHtmlEnabled" type="checkbox" ${x?.html_enabled?'checked':''} onchange="toggleLessonHtmlBox()"> Ativar</label></div><div id="lessonHtmlBox" class="html-editor-box ${x?.html_enabled?'':'hidden'}"><div class="field"><label>HTML da atividade</label><textarea id="lHtmlContent" rows="12" placeholder="Cole aqui o HTML da sua atividade interativa...">${esc(x?.html_content||'')}</textarea></div><div class="html-editor-actions"><button type="button" class="btn secondary" onclick="previewLessonHtml()">👁 Preview responsivo</button><label class="switchline"><input id="lAllowResponse" type="checkbox" ${x?.allow_student_response?'checked':''}> Permitir resposta do aluno</label></div><small>O conteúdo será executado isoladamente em um viewer sandbox no Teacher e no Student.</small></div></div>
 <div class="resource-box"><div class="resource-head"><b>📚 Recursos da lesson</b><button type="button" class="btn secondary" onclick="addResourceRow('lResources')">+ Adicionar recurso</button></div><div id="lResources"></div></div>
 <div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">💾 Salvar lesson</button></div></form>`);
 renderResourceRows('lResources',x?.resource_items||[]);
}
function toggleLessonHtmlBox(){$('lessonHtmlBox')?.classList.toggle('hidden',!$('lHtmlEnabled')?.checked)}
function previewLessonHtml(){const c=$('lHtmlContent')?.value.trim();if(!c)return toast('Cole o HTML primeiro.','info');openHtmlViewer($('l1')?.value||'Preview da Lesson',c,'preview')}
async function saveCourseAwareLessonV3(e,id){
 e.preventDefault();const resources=collectResources('lResources');const htmlEnabled=!!$('lHtmlEnabled')?.checked;const htmlContent=htmlEnabled?($('lHtmlContent')?.value||''):null;
 const courseId=$('lessonCourse').value||null,moduleId=$('lessonModule').value||null;
 if(moduleId){const mod=(window.__ticModules||[]).find(m=>m.id===moduleId);if(mod&&mod.course_id!==courseId)return toast('O módulo selecionado não pertence ao curso.','error')}
 const o={teacher_id:session.user.id,title:$('l1').value.trim(),level:$('l2').value,skill:$('l3').value,lesson_type:$('l4').value,position:Number($('l5').value||1),content:$('l6').value,video_url:$('l7').value.trim()||null,pdf_url:$('l8').value.trim()||null,resource_items:resources,cover_image_url:$('lCover').value.trim()||null,course_id:courseId,module_id:moduleId,html_enabled:htmlEnabled,html_content:htmlContent,html_version:htmlEnabled?Number((window.__ticEditingLesson?.html_version||0)+1):Number(window.__ticEditingLesson?.html_version||1),allow_student_response:htmlEnabled&&!!$('lAllowResponse')?.checked};
 const r=id?await sb.from('tic_lessons').update(o).eq('id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id):await sb.from('tic_lessons').insert(o);
 if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível salvar a lesson: '+r.error.message,'error');closeModal();toast(id?'Lesson atualizada.':'Lesson criada.','success');await __loadCourseData();loadView('lessons');
}

/* ---------- Assignment form: add HTML without removing old fields ---------- */
async function openAssignmentForm(x=null){
 const [{data:students,error},{data:classes}]=await Promise.all([sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active').order('display_name'),sb.from('tic_classes').select('id,name,level').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active').order('name')]);
 if(error)return toast('Não foi possível carregar os alunos: '+error.message,'error');
 openModal(x?'Editar tarefa':'Nova tarefa',`<form class="form" onsubmit="saveAssignmentV3(event,'${x?.id||''}')">
 <div class="field"><label>Título da tarefa</label><input id="a1" value="${esc(x?.title||'')}" placeholder="Ex.: Grammar Practice" required></div>
 <div class="field"><label>Instruções para o aluno</label><textarea id="a2" rows="4">${esc(x?.instructions||'')}</textarea></div>
 <div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Tipo</label><select id="a3">${['assignment','speaking','writing','listening','reading','project','quiz','audio','file'].map(v=>`<option ${v===x?.assignment_type?'selected':''}>${v}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Prioridade</label><select id="a4"><option value="normal" ${x?.priority==='normal'||!x?'selected':''}>normal</option><option value="low" ${x?.priority==='low'?'selected':''}>low</option><option value="high" ${x?.priority==='high'?'selected':''}>high</option></select></div></div>
 <div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Prazo</label><input id="a5" type="datetime-local" value="${x?.due_at?new Date(x.due_at).toISOString().slice(0,16):''}"></div><div class="field"><label>Pontos</label><input id="a6" type="number" min="0" value="${x?.points??10}"></div></div>
 <div class="field"><label>Imagem de capa</label><input id="aCover" value="${esc(x?.cover_image_url||'')}" placeholder="URL da imagem"></div>
 <div class="resource-box"><div class="resource-head"><b>🧩 HTML interativo — opcional</b><label class="switchline"><input id="aHtmlEnabled" type="checkbox" ${x?.html_enabled?'checked':''} onchange="$('assignmentHtmlBox')?.classList.toggle('hidden',!this.checked)"> Ativar</label></div><div id="assignmentHtmlBox" class="html-editor-box ${x?.html_enabled?'':'hidden'}"><div class="field"><label>HTML da Task</label><textarea id="aHtmlContent" rows="12" placeholder="Cole o HTML da atividade...">${esc(x?.html_content||'')}</textarea></div><div class="html-editor-actions"><button type="button" class="btn secondary" onclick="previewAssignmentHtml()">👁 Preview responsivo</button><label class="switchline"><input id="aMulti" type="checkbox" ${x?.allow_multiple_attempts!==false?'checked':''}> Permitir múltiplas tentativas</label></div></div></div>
 <div class="resource-box"><div class="resource-head"><b>📚 Materiais e recursos</b><button type="button" class="btn secondary" onclick="addResourceRow('aResources')">+ Adicionar recurso</button></div><div id="aResources"></div></div>
 <div class="resource-box"><div class="resource-head"><b>📤 Distribuição</b><span style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)">${x?'Os destinatários já definidos permanecem.':'Envie para alunos ou turma.'}</span></div>${x?'':`<div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Destino</label><select id="a7type" onchange="renderAssignmentTarget()"><option value="students">👤 Aluno(s)</option><option value="class">🏫 Turma inteira</option></select></div><div class="field"><label>Notificação</label><select id="a7notify"><option value="none">Somente plataforma</option><option value="whatsapp">📱 Preparar WhatsApp</option></select></div></div><div id="a7target"></div>`}</div>
 <div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary" id="assignmentSaveBtn">💾 Salvar tarefa</button></div></form>`);
 renderResourceRows('aResources',x?.resource_items||[]);if(!x)renderAssignmentTarget();
}
function previewAssignmentHtml(){const c=$('aHtmlContent')?.value.trim();if(!c)return toast('Cole o HTML primeiro.','info');openHtmlViewer($('a1')?.value||'Preview da Task',c,'preview')}
async function saveAssignmentV3(e,id){
 e.preventDefault();const btn=$('assignmentSaveBtn');if(btn){btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='Salvando...'}
 const htmlEnabled=!!$('aHtmlEnabled')?.checked,htmlContent=htmlEnabled?($('aHtmlContent')?.value||''):null;
 const o={teacher_id:session.user.id,title:$('a1').value.trim(),instructions:$('a2').value.trim(),assignment_type:$('a3').value,priority:$('a4').value,due_at:$('a5').value?new Date($('a5').value).toISOString():null,points:Number($('a6').value||0),resource_items:collectResources('aResources'),cover_image_url:$('aCover').value.trim()||null,html_enabled:htmlEnabled,html_content:htmlContent,allow_multiple_attempts:$('aMulti')?.checked!==false,active:true};
 let r=id?await sb.from('tic_assignments').update(o).eq('id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).select().single():await sb.from('tic_assignments').insert(o).select().single();
 if(r.error){if(btn){btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='Salvar tarefa'}return toast('Não foi possível salvar: '+r.error.message,'error')}
 if(!id){let studentIds=[],classId=null;if($('a7type')?.value==='class'){classId=$('a7class')?.value||null;const {data:members,error:me}=await sb.from('tic_class_students').select('student_id').eq('class_id',classId).eq('status','active');if(me){await sb.from('tic_assignments').delete().eq('id',r.data.id);return toast(me.message,'error')}studentIds=(members||[]).map(m=>m.student_id)}else studentIds=[...($('a7students')?.selectedOptions||[])].map(o=>o.value);studentIds=[...new Set(studentIds)].filter(Boolean);if(!studentIds.length){await sb.from('tic_assignments').delete().eq('id',r.data.id);return toast('Selecione pelo menos um aluno ou uma turma.','error')}if(classId){await sb.from('tic_assignments').update({class_id:classId}).eq('id',r.data.id)}const rows=studentIds.map(student_id=>({assignment_id:r.data.id,student_id,status:'pending',active:true}));const rr=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').insert(rows);if(rr.error){await sb.from('tic_assignments').delete().eq('id',r.data.id);return toast('A tarefa não foi vinculada: '+rr.error.message,'error')}}
 closeModal();toast(id?'Tarefa atualizada.':'Tarefa criada e distribuída.','success');loadView('assignments');
}

async function lessonResponsesPage(){

O histórico de tentativas é preservado.</div><div class="table-wrap"><table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Aluno</th><th>Lesson</th><th>Tentativa</th><th>Status</th><th>Nota</th><th>Ação</th></tr></thead><tbody>${(rows||[]).map(r=>`<tr><td><b>${esc(r.tic_students?.display_name||'')}</b></td><td>${esc(r.tic_lessons?.title||'')}</td><td>#${r.attempt}</td><td>${badge(r.status)}</td><td>${r.score!=null?badge(String(r.score)):'—'}</td><td><button class="btn sm primary" onclick="openLessonResponseFeedback('${r.id}')">📝 Corrigir</button></td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="6" class="empty">Nenhuma resposta enviada.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div></div>`;
}
async function openLessonResponseFeedback(id){
 const {data:r,error}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_responses').select('*,tic_lessons(title,level,skill),tic_students(display_name,email)').eq('id',id).maybeSingle();if(error||!r)return toast(error?.message||'Resposta não encontrada.','error');
 const {data:f}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_feedback').select('*').eq('response_id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(1).maybeSingle();
 openModal('📝 Corrigir resposta da Lesson',`<form class="form" onsubmit="saveLessonResponseFeedback(event,'${id}')"><div class="notice"><b>${esc(r.tic_students?.display_name||'Aluno')}</b><br>${esc(r.tic_lessons?.title||'Lesson')} · tentativa ${r.attempt}<div class="response-preview">${esc(r.response_text||JSON.stringify(r.response_data||{},null,2))}</div></div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Nota</label><input id="lrGrade" type="number" min="0" max="100" step="0.1" value="${f?.grade??r.score??''}"></div><div class="field"><label>Visibilidade</label><select id="lrPrivate"><option value="false" ${!f?.private_note?'selected':''}>Aluno pode ver</option><option value="true" ${f?.private_note?'selected':''}>Nota privada</option></select></div></div><div class="field"><label>Comentário / correção</label><textarea id="lrComment" rows="7">${esc(f?.comment||r.teacher_comment||'')}</textarea></div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>🎯 Habilidade para melhorar</label><select id="lrSkill"><option value="">Selecione</option>${['grammar','vocabulary','listening','reading','writing','speaking','pronunciation','fluency','communication'].map(v=>`<option value="${v}" ${v===(f?.improvement_skill||r.improvement_skill)?'selected':''}>${v}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>🔗 Link de melhoria</label><input id="lrLink" type="url" value="${esc(f?.improvement_link||r.improvement_link||'')}" placeholder="https://..."></div></div><div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">💾 Enviar correção</button></div></form>`);
}
async function saveLessonResponseFeedback(e,id){e.preventDefault();const grade=$('lrGrade')?.value.trim();const private_note=$('lrPrivate')?.value==='true';const comment=$('lrComment')?.value.trim()||null;const skill=$('lrSkill')?.value||null;const link=$('lrLink')?.value.trim()||null;
 const payload={response_id:id,teacher_id:session.user.id,grade:grade===''?null:Number(grade),comment,private_note,improvement_skill:skill,improvement_link:link};
 const {data:ex}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_feedback').select('id').eq('response_id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(1).maybeSingle();
 const r=ex?await sb.from('tic_lesson_feedback').update(payload).eq('id',ex.id):await sb.from('tic_lesson_feedback').insert(payload);if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível salvar a correção: '+r.error.message,'error');
 await sb.from('tic_lesson_responses').update({status:'reviewed',score:grade===''?null:Number(grade),teacher_id:session.user.id,teacher_comment:comment,improvement_skill:skill,improvement_link:link,reviewed_at:new Date().toISOString()}).eq('id',id);
 closeModal();toast('Correção enviada ao aluno.','success');lessonResponsesPage();
}

/* ================================================================
   TIC PLATFORM FULL UPGRADE v4
   Incremental layer: preserves previous features and fixes/extends them.
   - Student dashboard without financial data
   - My Courses + clickable curriculum
   - Lesson completion stored independently from skill progress
   - Rich formatted Lesson text + sandboxed HTML viewer
   - Lesson direct assignment
   - Reusable Tasks: same Assignment can be assigned to many students
   - Unlimited active Task/Lesson retries by design
   - Teacher feedback inside student activity
   - Public student registration links with defaults
   ================================================================ */

const TIC_WEEKLY_FEES={1:250,2:450,3:650};
function ticDigits(v){return String(v||'').replace(/\D/g,'')}
function ticRegistrationToken(){
  const a=new Uint8Array(24);crypto.getRandomValues(a);return [...a].map(x=>x.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join('');
}
function ticCourseOptions(selected=''){
 return (window.__ticCourses||[]).map(c=>`<option value="${c.id}" ${c.id===selected?'selected':''}>${esc(c.title||'Curso')} · ${esc(c.level||'')}</option>`).join('');
}

/* ---------- Student Tasks: robust, clickable, feedback-rich ---------- */
async function openStudentTask(taskId){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;
 let {data:x,error}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,status,active,completed_at,assigned_at,assignment_id,tic_assignments(id,title,instructions,due_at,points,resource_items,cover_image_url,assignment_type,html_enabled,html_content,allow_multiple_attempts,active,lesson_id)').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('active',true).eq('id',taskId).maybeSingle();
 if(!x&&!error){({data:x,error}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,status,active,completed_at,assigned_at,assignment_id,tic_assignments(id,title,instructions,due_at,points,resource_items,cover_image_url,assignment_type,html_enabled,html_content,allow_multiple_attempts,active,lesson_id)').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('active',true).eq('assignment_id',taskId).maybeSingle())}
 if(error||!x)return toast(error?.message||'Task não encontrada ou removida.','error');
 await loadView('studentTasks');
 setTimeout(()=>{const el=document.getElementById('task_'+x.id);if(el){el.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'center'});el.classList.add('task-focus')}} ,160);
}

  return `<article id="task_${x.id}" class="student-task-card card"><div class="task-card-head"><div><span class="badge blue">${esc(a.assignment_type||'assignment')}</span><h2>${esc(a.title||'Task')}</h2><small>🔓 Atribuição ativa · ${a.due_at?'Prazo informativo: '+fmtDate(a.due_at):'Sem prazo'}</small></div><span class="badge green">🟢 Ativa</span></div>${a.cover_image_url?`<img class="task-cover" src="${esc(a.cover_image_url)}" alt="">`:''}${a.instructions?`<div class="task-resources"><b>📚 Recursos</b><div class="resource-grid">${resources.map(resourceCard).join('')}</div></div>`:''}${fb&&!fb.private_note?`<div class="task-feedback"><b>👨‍🏫 Correção do Teacher</b>${fb.grade!=null?`<strong>Nota: ${fb.grade}</strong>`:''}<p>${esc(fb.comment||'Sem comentário.')}</p>${fb.improvement_skill||fb.improvement_link?`<div class="improvement-box"><b>🎯 Como melhorar</b>${fb.improvement_skill?`<span>Habilidade: <b>${esc(fb.improvement_skill)}</b></span>`:''}${fb.improvement_link?`<a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(ticSafeUrl(fb.improvement_link))}" estiver ativa.</div><div class="field"><label>✍️ Sua resposta</label><textarea id="ans_${x.id}" rows="6" placeholder="Digite sua resposta, produção escrita ou link..." required></textarea></div><div tentativa':'Enviar para o Teacher'}</button></form>`}</article>`;
 }).join('');
 setPage('My Tasks','Atividades atribuídas pelo Teacher.');

A atribuição permanece ativa até o Teacher removê-la.</small></div><span class="badge green">${data?.length||0} ativa(s)</span></div><div class="student-task-stack">${cards||'<div class="card empty">Nenhuma Task ativa.</div>'}</div>`;
}
async function submitTaskWorkV4(e,taskAssignmentId){
 e.preventDefault();const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;
 const {data:ta,error:te}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,active,assignment_id').eq('id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();if(te||!ta)return toast(te?.message||'Task não encontrada.','error');if(ta.active===false)return toast('Esta atribuição foi removida pelo Teacher.','error');
 const answer=$(`ans_${taskAssignmentId}`)?.value.trim()||'',file=$(`file_${taskAssignmentId}`)?.value.trim()||null;if(!answer&&!file)return toast('Digite uma resposta ou informe um link.','error');
 const {data:last}=await sb.from('tic_submissions').select('attempt').eq('task_assignment_id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',s.id).order('attempt',{ascending:false}).limit(1).maybeSingle();
 const attempt=Number(last?.attempt||0)+1;
 const {error}=await sb.from('tic_submissions').insert({task_assignment_id:taskAssignmentId,student_id:s.id,answer_text:answer||null,file_url:file,attempt,submitted_at:new Date().toISOString()});if(error)return toast('Não foi possível enviar: '+error.message,'error');
 await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').update({status:'submitted',completed_at:null}).eq('id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',s.id);toast(`Tentativa ${attempt} enviada ao Teacher. A Task continua ativa.`,'success');studentTasks();
}

/* ---------- Interactive viewer: fix mode bridge and display ---------- */
function openHtmlViewer(title,htmlContent,mode='preview',refId=''){
 const content=String(htmlContent||'').trim();if(!content)return toast('Não há conteúdo HTML para visualizar.','info');
 openModal(`🧩 ${esc(title||'HTML Viewer')}`,`<div class="html-viewer-actions"><span class="badge ${mode==='preview'?'blue':'green'}">${mode==='preview'?'Preview':'Atividade'}</span><span class="html-viewer-help">Conteúdo isolado e responsivo.</span></div><div class="html-devicebar"><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('desktop')">🖥 Desktop</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('tablet')">▣ Tablet</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('mobile')">📱 Mobile</button></div><div id="htmlViewerWrap" class="html-viewer-wrap desktop"><iframe id="htmlViewerFrame" title="HTML Viewer" sandbox="allow-scripts"></iframe></div>${mode!=='preview'?'<div id="htmlViewerStatus" class="notice">Conteúdo carregado. Responda e use Enviar/Submit.</div>':''}`);
 ticHtmlViewerContext={mode,refId,html:content};const f=$('htmlViewerFrame');if(f)f.srcdoc=content+ticHtmlBridge();
}

/* ---------- Rich formatted text editor for Lesson ---------- */
function syncLessonRich(){const r=$('lRich');if(r&&$('l6'))$('l6').value=r.innerHTML}
function execLessonCmd(cmd,val=null){document.execCommand(cmd,false,val);syncLessonRich();$('lRich')?.focus()}
function insertLessonColor(v){execLessonCmd('foreColor',v)}
function setLessonFont(v){execLessonCmd('fontName',v)}
function setLessonSize(v){execLessonCmd('fontSize',v)}
function toggleLessonSource(){const rich=$('lRich'),src=$('l6');if(!rich||!src)return;const source=rich.dataset.source==='1';if(source){rich.innerHTML=src.value;rich.dataset.source='0';rich.contentEditable='true'}else{syncLessonRich();rich.textContent=src.value;rich.dataset.source='1';rich.contentEditable='false'}rich.focus()}
function lessonTextInitial(v){return String(v||'')}
async function openLessonForm(x=null,forcePlan=false,preCourseId=''){
 await __loadCourseData();const isEdit=!!x,courseId=x?.course_id||preCourseId||'';window.__ticEditingLesson=x||null;
 openModal(isEdit?'Editar lesson':(forcePlan?'Novo lesson plan':'Nova lesson'),`<form class="form" onsubmit="saveCourseAwareLessonV4(event,'${x?.id||''}')">
 <div class="field"><label>Título</label><input id="l1" value="${esc(x?.title||'')}" required></div>
 <div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Nível</label><select id="l2">${levels.map(l=>`<option ${l===x?.level?'selected':''}>${l}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Skill</label><select id="l3">${['grammar','vocabulary','listening','reading','writing','speaking','pronunciation'].map(l=>`<option ${l===x?.skill?'selected':''}>${l}</option>`).join('')}</select></div></div>
 <div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Curso</label><select id="lessonCourse" onchange="filterLessonModules()"><option value="">Sem curso</option>${ticCourseOptions(courseId)}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Módulo</label><select id="lessonModule"><option value="">Sem módulo</option>${(window.__ticModules||[]).filter(m=>m.course_id===courseId).sort((a,b)=>(a.position||0)-(b.position||0)).map(m=>`<option value="${m.id}" ${m.id===x?.module_id?'selected':''}>${esc(m.title)}</option>`).join('')}</select></div></div>
 <div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Tipo</label><select id="l4"><option value="lesson" ${x?.lesson_type==='lesson'||!x?'selected':''}>Lesson</option><option value="plan" ${x?.lesson_type==='plan'?'selected':''}>Lesson Plan</option><option value="extra" ${x?.lesson_type==='extra'?'selected':''}>Extra</option><option value="review" ${x?.lesson_type==='review'?'selected':''}>Review</option><option value="live" ${x?.lesson_type==='live'?'selected':''}>Live</option></select></div><div class="field"><label>Posição</label><input id="l5" type="number" min="1" value="${x?.position||1}"></div></div>
 <div class="resource-box"><div class="resource-head"><b>✍️ Texto da Lesson — opcional</b><span class="badge blue">Formatação preservada</span></div><div class="lesson-toolbar"><button type="button" onclick="execLessonCmd('bold')"><b>B</b></button><button type="button" onclick="execLessonCmd('italic')"><i>I</i></button><button type="button" onclick="execLessonCmd('underline')"><u>U</u></button><button type="button" onclick="execLessonCmd('justifyLeft')">☰</button><button type="button" onclick="execLessonCmd('justifyCenter')">≡</button><button type="button" onclick="execLessonCmd('insertUnorderedList')">• Lista</button><select onchange="setLessonFont(this.value);this.selectedIndex=0"><option>Fonte</option><option value="Arial">Arial</option><option value="Georgia">Georgia</option><option value="Verdana">Verdana</option><option value="Trebuchet MS">Trebuchet</option></select><select onchange="setLessonSize(this.value);this.selectedIndex=0"><option>Tamanho</option><option value="2">Pequeno</option><option value="3">Normal</option><option value="5">Grande</option><option value="7">Muito grande</option></select><input type="color" title="Cor do texto" onchange="insertLessonColor(this.value)"><button type="button" onclick="toggleLessonSource()">&lt;/&gt; HTML</button></div><div id="lRich" class="lesson-rich-editor" contenteditable="true" spellcheck="true" data-source="0">${lessonTextInitial(x?.content||x?.description||'')}</div><textarea id="l6" class="hidden">${esc(x?.content||x?.description||'')}</textarea><small>Você pode escrever visualmente ou alternar para HTML. Negrito, fontes, cores, listas e alinhamento são preservados no conteúdo.</small></div>
 <div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Vídeo URL principal</label><input id="l7" value="${esc(x?.video_url||'')}"></div><div class="field"><label>PDF URL principal</label><input id="l8" value="${esc(x?.pdf_url||'')}"></div></div>
 <div class="field"><label>Imagem de capa</label><input id="lCover" value="${esc(x?.cover_image_url||'')}" placeholder="URL da imagem"></div>
 <div class="resource-box"><div class="resource-head"><b>🧩 HTML interativo — opcional</b><label class="switchline"><input id="lHtmlEnabled" type="checkbox" ${x?.html_enabled?'checked':''} onchange="toggleLessonHtmlBox()"> Ativar</label></div><div id="lessonHtmlBox" class="html-editor-box ${x?.html_enabled?'':'hidden'}"><div class="field"><label>HTML da atividade</label><textarea id="lHtmlContent" rows="14" placeholder="Cole aqui o HTML interativo...">${esc(x?.html_content||'')}</textarea></div><div class="html-editor-actions"><button type="button" class="btn secondary" onclick="previewLessonHtml()">👁 Preview responsivo</button><label class="switchline"><input id="lAllowResponse" type="checkbox" ${x?.allow_student_response?'checked':''}> Permitir resposta do aluno</label></div></div></div>
 <div class="resource-box"><div class="resource-head"><b>📚 Recursos da lesson</b><button type="button" class="btn secondary" onclick="addResourceRow('lResources')">+ Adicionar recurso</button></div><div id="lResources"></div></div>
 <div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">💾 Salvar lesson</button></div></form>`);
 renderResourceRows('lResources',x?.resource_items||[]);
 const rich=$('lRich');if(rich)rich.innerHTML=x?.content||x?.description||'';
}
async function saveCourseAwareLessonV4(e,id){
 e.preventDefault();syncLessonRich();const resources=collectResources('lResources'),htmlEnabled=!!$('lHtmlEnabled')?.checked;
 const courseId=$('lessonCourse').value||null,moduleId=$('lessonModule').value||null;if(moduleId){const m=(window.__ticModules||[]).find(q=>q.id===moduleId);if(m&&m.course_id!==courseId)return toast('O módulo selecionado não pertence ao curso.','error')}
 const content=$('l6').value||'';const o={teacher_id:session.user.id,title:$('l1').value.trim(),level:$('l2').value,skill:$('l3').value,lesson_type:$('l4').value,position:Number($('l5').value||1),content,video_url:$('l7').value.trim()||null,pdf_url:$('l8').value.trim()||null,resource_items:resources,cover_image_url:$('lCover').value.trim()||null,course_id:courseId,module_id:moduleId,html_enabled:htmlEnabled,html_content:htmlEnabled?($('lHtmlContent').value||''):null,html_version:htmlEnabled?Number((window.__ticEditingLesson?.html_version||0)+1):Number(window.__ticEditingLesson?.html_version||1),allow_student_response:htmlEnabled&&!!$('lAllowResponse')?.checked};
 const r=id?await sb.from('tic_lessons').update(o).eq('id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id):await sb.from('tic_lessons').insert(o);if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível salvar a lesson: '+r.error.message,'error');closeModal();toast(id?'Lesson atualizada.':'Lesson criada.','success');await __loadCourseData();loadView('lessons');
}
function toggleLessonHtmlBox(){ $('lessonHtmlBox')?.classList.toggle('hidden',!$('lHtmlEnabled')?.checked) }
function previewLessonHtml(){const c=$('lHtmlContent')?.value.trim();if(!c)return toast('Cole o HTML primeiro.','info');openHtmlViewer($('l1')?.value||'Preview da Lesson',c,'preview')}

/* ---------- Student Lesson: exact formatted content + first completion ---------- */
// v14 renderer is declared above and intentionally used by all lesson viewers.

async function markLessonCompleted(lessonId){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;
 const {data:existing}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').select('id,first_completed_at').eq('lesson_id',lessonId).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();
 const now=new Date().toISOString();
 if(existing){if(existing.first_completed_at)return toast('Lesson já registrada como concluída.','info');const r=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').update({first_completed_at:now,last_opened_at:now,updated_at:now}).eq('id',existing.id);if(r.error)return toast(r.error.message,'error')}
 else{const r=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').insert({lesson_id:lessonId,student_id:s.id,first_completed_at:now,last_opened_at:now,open_count:1,updated_at:now});if(r.error)return toast(r.error.message,'error')}
 toast('Lesson concluída. Você poderá abri-la e refazê-la novamente.','success');viewStudentLessonInteractive(lessonId);
}
async function viewStudentLessonInteractive(id){
 const {data:l,error}=await sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').eq('id',id).eq('active',true).maybeSingle();if(error||!l)return toast(error?.message||'Lesson não encontrada.','error');
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;
 const {data:lp}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').select('*').eq('lesson_id',id).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();
 if(lp)await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').update({last_opened_at:new Date().toISOString(),open_count:Number(lp.open_count||0)+1,updated_at:new Date().toISOString()}).eq('id',lp.id);else await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').insert({lesson_id:id,student_id:s.id,last_opened_at:new Date().toISOString(),open_count:1});
 const {data:resp}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_responses').select('id,attempt,status,score,teacher_comment,improvement_skill,improvement_link,reviewed_at,created_at').eq('lesson_id',id).eq('student_id',s.id).order('attempt',{ascending:false});
 const latest=resp?.[0],completed=!!lp?.first_completed_at;
 const feedback=latest?.teacher_comment?`<div class="notice success lesson-feedback-box"><b>👨‍🏫 Correção do Teacher</b>${latest.score!=null?`<div style="font-weight:800;font-size:18px">Nota: ${latest.score}</div>`:''}<div>${esc(latest.teacher_comment)}</div>${latest.improvement_skill||latest.improvement_link?`<div class="improvement-box"><b>🎯 Como melhorar</b>${latest.improvement_skill?`<span>Habilidade: <b>${esc(latest.improvement_skill)}</b></span>`:''}${latest.improvement_link?`<a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(ticSafeUrl(latest.improvement_link))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">🔗 Praticar melhoria</a>`:''}</div>`:''}</div>`:'';
 const contentFrame=l.content?`<div class="lesson-formatted-viewer"><iframe sandbox="allow-scripts" title="Conteúdo formatado da Lesson"></iframe></div>`:'';
 const htmlFrame=l.html_enabled&&l.html_content?`<div class="section"><div class="section-head"><div><h3>🧩 Atividade interativa</h3><span>Responsiva e isolada</span></div><span class="badge green">HTML</span></div><div class="html-devicebar"><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('desktop')">🖥 Desktop</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('tablet')">▣ Tablet</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('mobile')">📱 Mobile</button></div><div id="htmlViewerWrap" class="html-viewer-wrap desktop"><iframe id="htmlViewerFrame" title="Lesson interactive viewer" sandbox="allow-scripts"></iframe></div><div id="htmlViewerStatus" class="notice">Responda e use Enviar/Submit dentro da atividade.</div></div>`:'';
 const responseBox=l.allow_student_response&&!l.html_enabled?`<div class="section"><div class="notice">✍️ Esta Lesson aceita resposta.</div><form class="form" onsubmit="submitPlainLessonResponse(event,'${l.id}')"><div class="field"><label>Sua resposta</label><textarea id="lessonResponseText" rows="6" required placeholder="Escreva sua resposta..."></textarea></div><button class="btn primary">📤 Enviar resposta</button></form></div>`:'';
 openModal(`📖 ${esc(l.title)}`,`<div class="lesson-student-header"><div><span class="badge blue">${esc(l.level||'')}</span><h2>${esc(l.title)}</h2><small>${esc(l.skill||'')} · ${esc(l.lesson_type||'lesson')}</small></div><span class="badge ${completed?'green':'yellow'}">${completed?'✓ Concluída':'Acesso ativo'}</span></div>${l.cover_image_url?`<img class="task-cover" src="${esc(l.cover_image_url)}" alt="">`:''}${contentFrame}${htmlFrame}${l.video_url?`<p><a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(ticSafeUrl(l.video_url))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">▶ Vídeo</a></p>`:''}${l.pdf_url?`<p><a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(ticSafeUrl(l.pdf_url))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">📄 PDF</a></p>`:''}${responseBox}${feedback}${resp?.length?`<div class="section"><h3>📚 Histórico de respostas</h3>${resp.map(r=>`<div class="row"><div><b>Tentativa ${r.attempt}</b><small>${r.score!=null?'Nota '+r.score+' · ':''}${fmtDate(r.created_at)}</small></div><span class="badge ${r.status==='reviewed'?'green':'yellow'}">${esc(r.status)}</span></div>`).join('')}</div>`:''}<div class="modal-actions"><span class="badge ${completed?'green':'blue'}">${completed?'Concluída na primeira realização':'Ainda não concluída'}</span><button class="btn primary" onclick="markLessonCompleted('${l.id}')">${completed?'✓ Continuar / refazer':'✓ Marcar Lesson como concluída'}</button></div>`);
 if(contentFrame){const f=document.querySelector('.lesson-formatted-viewer iframe');if(f)f.srcdoc=ticPlainOrHtmlFrame(l.content)}
 if(htmlFrame){ticHtmlViewerContext={mode:'studentLesson',refId:l.id,html:l.html_content};const f=$('htmlViewerFrame');if(f)f.srcdoc=l.html_content+ticHtmlBridge()}
}
async function submitPlainLessonResponse(e,lessonId){e.preventDefault();const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;const {data:last}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_responses').select('attempt').eq('lesson_id',lessonId).eq('student_id',s.id).order('attempt',{ascending:false}).limit(1).maybeSingle();const attempt=Number(last?.attempt||0)+1;const r=await sb.from('tic_lesson_responses').insert({lesson_id:lessonId,student_id:s.id,attempt,response_text:$('lessonResponseText').value.trim(),response_data:{},status:'submitted'});if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível enviar: '+r.error.message,'error');await markLessonCompleted(lessonId)}

/* ---------- Direct Lesson assignment ---------- */
async function openAssignContent(sourceType,source){
 if(sourceType!=='lesson')return __oldOpenAssignContent?.(sourceType,source)||toast('Tipo de conteúdo não suportado.','error');
 const [{data:students},{data:classes}]=await Promise.all([sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name,current_level').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active').order('display_name'),sb.from('tic_classes').select('id,name,level').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active').order('name')]);
 const opts=(students||[]).map(s=>`<option value="${s.id}">${esc(s.display_name)} · ${esc(s.current_level||'')}</option>`).join('');const copts=(classes||[]).map(c=>`<option value="${c.id}">${esc(c.name)} · ${esc(c.level||'')}</option>`).join('');
 openModal(`📤 Atribuir Lesson · ${esc(source.title)}`,`<form class="form" onsubmit="saveLessonAssignmentV4(event,'${source.id}')"><div class="notice">Escolha se quer dar <b>acesso à Lesson</b> ou criar uma <b>Task baseada nela</b>.</div><div class="field"><label>Modo</label><select id="laMode" onchange="$('laTaskFields')?.classList.toggle('hidden',this.value!=='task')"><option value="lesson">📖 Acesso à Lesson</option><option value="task">📝 Criar Task a partir da Lesson</option></select></div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Destino</label><select id="laTarget" onchange="$('laStudents')?.classList.toggle('hidden',this.value!=='students');$('laClass')?.classList.toggle('hidden',this.value!=='class')"><option value="students">👤 Aluno(s)</option><option value="class">🏫 Turma</option></select></div><div class="field"><label>Mensagem (opcional)</label><input id="laNote" placeholder="Ex.: Faça esta Lesson antes da próxima aula."></div></div><div id="laStudents" class="field"><label>Aluno(s)</label><select id="laStudentSelect" multiple size="7">${opts||'<option value="">Nenhum aluno ativo</option>'}</select></div><div id="laClass" class="field hidden"><label>Turma</label><select id="laClassSelect">${copts||'<option value="">Nenhuma turma ativa</option>'}</select></div><div id="laTaskFields" class="resource-box hidden"><div class="field"><label>Prazo informativo</label><input id="laDue" type="datetime-local"></div><div class="field"><label>Pontos</label><input id="laPoints" type="number" min="0" value="10"></div></div><div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">📤 Atribuir</button></div></form>`);
}
async function saveLessonAssignmentV4(e,lessonId){
 e.preventDefault();const mode=$('laMode').value,target=$('laTarget').value;let ids=[];
 if(target==='class'){const {data}=await sb.from('tic_class_students').select('student_id').eq('class_id',$('laClassSelect').value).eq('status','active');ids=(data||[]).map(x=>x.student_id)}else ids=[...($('laStudentSelect')?.selectedOptions||[])].map(x=>x.value);ids=[...new Set(ids)].filter(Boolean);if(!ids.length)return toast('Selecione pelo menos um aluno ou uma turma com alunos.','error');
 const {data:lesson,error:le}=await sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').eq('id',lessonId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();if(le||!lesson)return toast(le?.message||'Lesson não encontrada.','error');
 if(mode==='lesson'){
  const rows=ids.map(student_id=>({lesson_id:lessonId,student_id,teacher_id:session.user.id,active:true,note:$('laNote').value.trim()||null}));const r=await sb.from('tic_lesson_assignments').upsert(rows,{onConflict:'lesson_id,student_id'});if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível atribuir a Lesson: '+r.error.message,'error');closeModal();toast(`Lesson atribuída para ${ids.length} aluno(s).`,'success');return loadView(currentView);
 }
 const {data:a,error:ae}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').insert({teacher_id:session.user.id,lesson_id:lessonId,title:lesson.title,instructions:$('laNote').value.trim()||lesson.description||lesson.content||'',assignment_type:'lesson',due_at:$('laDue').value?new Date($('laDue').value).toISOString():null,points:Number($('laPoints').value||0),priority:'normal',resource_items:Array.isArray(lesson.resource_items)?lesson.resource_items:[],cover_image_url:lesson.cover_image_url||null,source_type:'lesson',source_id:lessonId,html_enabled:!!lesson.html_enabled,html_content:lesson.html_content||null,allow_multiple_attempts:true,active:true}).select().single();if(ae)return toast('Não foi possível criar a Task: '+ae.message,'error');const rr=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').upsert(ids.map(student_id=>({assignment_id:a.id,student_id,status:'pending',active:true})),{onConflict:'assignment_id,student_id'});if(rr.error){await sb.from('tic_assignments').delete().eq('id',a.id);return toast('Task criada, mas não foi distribuída: '+rr.error.message,'error')}closeModal();toast(`Task baseada em ${lesson.title} atribuída para ${ids.length} aluno(s).`,'success');loadView('assignments');
}

/* ---------- Reuse an existing Task for other students ---------- */
async function openReassignTask(assignmentId){
 const {data:a,error:ae}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').select('id,title').eq('id',assignmentId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();if(ae||!a)return toast(ae?.message||'Task não encontrada.','error');
 const [{data:students},{data:assigned}]=await Promise.all([sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name,current_level').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active').order('display_name'),sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('student_id,active').eq('assignment_id',assignmentId)]);const taken=new Set((assigned||[]).filter(x=>x.active!==false).map(x=>x.student_id));
 openModal(`📤 Atribuir novamente · ${esc(a.title)}`,`<form class="form" onsubmit="saveReassignTask(event,'${assignmentId}')"><div class="notice">A Task é reutilizável. Cada aluno terá sua própria entrega, tentativas, nota e feedback.</div><div class="field"><label>Selecione outro(s) aluno(s)</label><select id="reassignStudents" multiple size="9">${(students||[]).map(s=>`<option value="${s.id}" ${taken.has(s.id)?'disabled':''}>${esc(s.display_name)} · ${esc(s.current_level||'')}</option>`).join('')||'<option>Nenhum aluno</option>'}</select></div><div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">📤 Atribuir Task</button></div></form>`)
}
async function saveReassignTask(e,assignmentId){e.preventDefault();const ids=[...($('reassignStudents')?.selectedOptions||[])].map(x=>x.value).filter(Boolean);if(!ids.length)return toast('Selecione pelo menos um aluno.','error');const r=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').upsert(ids.map(student_id=>({assignment_id:assignmentId,student_id,status:'pending',active:true,removed_at:null})),{onConflict:'assignment_id,student_id'});if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível atribuir: '+r.error.message,'error');closeModal();toast(`Task atribuída para ${ids.length} novo(s) aluno(s).`,'success');loadView('assignments')}

/* ---------- Teacher Lessons page: clickable curriculum + assign ---------- */
async function lessonsPage(plan=false){
 if(plan)return __oldLessonsPage(plan);await __loadCourseData();const rows=(window.__ticLessons||[]);$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card"><div class="section-head"><div><h2>Lessons</h2><span>${rows.length} aula(s) · Curso → Módulo → Lesson</span></div><button class="btn primary" onclick="openLessonForm()">+ Nova lesson</button></div><div class="table-wrap"><table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Lesson</th><th>Nível</th><th>Curso</th><th>Módulo</th><th>Skill</th><th>Posição</th><th>Ações</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows.map(l=>{const c=(window.__ticCourses||[]).find(x=>x.id===l.course_id),m=(window.__ticModules||[]).find(x=>x.id===l.module_id);return `<tr><td><button class="lesson-table-link" onclick="viewTeacherLesson('${l.id}')">📖 ${esc(l.title)}</button><br><small>${esc(ticLessonPreviewText(l.description||l.content||'',65))}</small></td><td>${esc(l.level||'—')}</td><td>${c?`<button class="inline-link" onclick="openCourseCurriculum('${c.id}')">${esc(c.title)}</button>`:'<span class="badge yellow">Sem curso</span>'}</td><td>${m?esc(m.title):'<span class="badge gray">Sem módulo</span>'}</td><td>${esc(l.skill||'—')}</td><td>${l.position||0}</td><td><div class="action-group"><button class="btn sm ghost" onclick="openLessonFormById('${l.id}')">Editar</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="openAssignLessonById('${l.id}')">📤 Atribuir</button><button class="btn sm danger" onclick="deleteRow('tic_lessons','${l.id}','lessons')">Excluir</button></div></td></tr>`}).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="7" class="empty">Nenhuma lesson criada.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div></div>`;
}
async function viewTeacherLesson(id){const {data:l,error}=await sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').eq('id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();if(error||!l)return toast(error?.message||'Lesson não encontrada.','error');const frame=l.content?`<div class="lesson-formatted-viewer"><iframe id="teacherLessonContentFrame" sandbox="allow-scripts"></iframe></div>`:'';openModal(`📖 ${esc(l.title)}`,`<div class="lesson-student-header"><div><span class="badge blue">${esc(l.level||'')}</span><h2>${esc(l.title)}</h2><small>${esc(l.skill||'')} · ${esc(l.lesson_type||'lesson')}</small></div><span class="badge ${l.html_enabled?'green':'gray'}">${l.html_enabled?'HTML':'Lesson'}</span></div>${frame}${l.html_enabled&&l.html_content?`<div class="section"><div class="section-head"><h3>🧩 HTML interativo</h3><span>Preview isolado</span></div><div class="html-devicebar"><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('desktop')">🖥</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('tablet')">▣</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('mobile')">📱</button></div><div id="htmlViewerWrap" class="html-viewer-wrap desktop"><iframe id="htmlViewerFrame" title="Teacher Lesson viewer" sandbox="allow-scripts"></iframe></div></div>`:''}<div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn secondary" onclick="openAssignLessonById('${l.id}')">📤 Atribuir Lesson</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="openLessonFormById('${l.id}')">✏️ Editar</button></div>`);if(frame){const f=$('teacherLessonContentFrame');if(f)f.srcdoc=ticPlainOrHtmlFrame(l.content)}if(l.html_enabled&&l.html_content){const f=$('htmlViewerFrame');if(f)f.srcdoc=l.html_content+ticHtmlBridge()}}

 setPage('Student Registration','Crie um link gratuito ou com mensalidade para o aluno fazer seu próprio cadastro.');
 $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="grid cols2"><div class="card"><div class="section-head"><div><h2>🔗 Link compartilhável</h2><span>Cadastro completo do aluno</span></div></div><div class="notice">O aluno poderá cadastrar nome, WhatsApp, e-mail, senha e nível. class="registration-mode"><label><input type="radio" name="regMode" value="free" checked onchange="toggleRegistrationMode()"> 🆓 <span><b>Gratuito</b><small>Sem padrão</option>${ticCourseOptions()}</select></div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Nível atual padrão</label><select id="regLevel">${levels.map((l,i)=>`<option ${i===0?'selected':''}>${l}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Nível objetivo padrão</label><select id="regTarget"><option>A1</option>${levels.filter(l=>l!=='A1').map(l=>`<option>${l}</option>`).join('')}</select></div></div><div id="regPaidFields" class="hidden"><div class="field"><label>Frequência semanal</label><select id="regWeeks" onchange="updateRegistrationFee()"><option value="1">1x por semana — R$ 250</option><option value="2">2x por semana — R$ 450</option><option value="3">3x por
