class="registration-free"><b>🆓 Cadastro gratuito</b><br><small>O aluno não terá mensalidade definida por este link.</small></div><div class="field"><label>Mensagem de boas-vindas (opcional)</label><textarea id="regWelcome" rows="3" placeholder="Bem-vindo à Teacher Platform!"></textarea></div><button class="btn primary">🔗 Criar link de cadastro</button></form></div><div class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>Como funciona</h2></div><div class="row"><div><b>1. Você cria o link</b><small>Escolha Gratuito ou Com mensalidade.</small></div><span class="badge blue">Teacher</span></div><div class="row"><div><b>2. Envie pelo WhatsApp</b><small>Copie ou envie diretamente o link ao aluno.</small></div><span class="badge green">Compartilhar</span></div><div class="row"><div><b>3. Aluno se cadastra</b><small>Cria sua própria conta e recebe o curso padrão, se definido.</small></div><span class="badge green">Automático</span></div><div class="row"><div><b>4. Teacher também pode cadastrar</b><small>Use <b>Students → + Novo aluno</b> para criar o acesso e enviar as informações ao aluno.</small></div><span class="badge blue">Manual</span></div></div></div><div class="card section"><div class="section-head"><div><h2>Links criados</h2><span>Compartilhe por WhatsApp ou copie o link.</span></div></div>${(links||[]).map(l=>{const url=location.origin+location.pathname+'?register='+encodeURIComponent(l.token);const free=Number(l.default_monthly_fee||0)===0;return `<div class="registration-link-row"><div><b>${free?'🆓 Cadastro gratuito':(l.default_course_id?'📚 Curso definido':'🔗 Cadastro com mensalidade')}</b><small>${free?'Gratuito':'Frequência: '+l.default_lessons_per_week+'x · '+money(l.default_monthly_fee)} · ${l.active?'Ativo':'Inativo'} · ${l.used_count||0} cadastro(s)</small><input readonly value="${esc(url)}"></div><div class="actions"><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="copyRegistrationLink('${esc(url)}')">📋 Copiar</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="shareRegistrationLink('${esc(url)}')">📱 WhatsApp</button><button class="btn sm ${l.active?'danger':'ghost'}" onclick="toggleRegistrationLink('${l.id}',${l.active?'false':'true'})">${l.active?'Desativar':'Ativar'}</button></div></div>`}).join('')||'<div class="empty">Nenhum link criado.</div>'}</div>`;
 toggleRegistrationMode();
}
function toggleRegistrationMode(){const paid=document.querySelector('input[name="regMode"]:checked')?.value==='paid';$('regPaidFields')?.classList.toggle('hidden',!paid);$('regFreeNote')?.classList.toggle('hidden',paid);if(paid)updateRegistrationFee()}
function updateRegistrationFee(){const w=Number($('regWeeks')?.value||1);const el=$('regFee');if(el)el.value=money(TIC_WEEKLY_FEES[w]||250)}
async function createStudentRegistrationLink(e){e.preventDefault();const paid=document.querySelector('input[name="regMode"]:checked')?.value==='paid';const weeks=paid?Number($('regWeeks').value||1):1;const courseId=$('regCourse').value||null;const token=ticRegistrationToken();const r=await sb.from('tic_student_registration_links').insert({teacher_id:session.user.id,token,default_course_id:courseId,default_level:$('regLevel').value,default_target_level:$('regTarget').value,default_lessons_per_week:weeks,default_monthly_fee:paid?(TIC_WEEKLY_FEES[weeks]||250):0,welcome_message:$('regWelcome').value.trim()||null}).select().single();if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível criar o link: '+r.error.message,'error');const url=location.origin+location.pathname+'?register='+encodeURIComponent(token);await copyRegistrationLink(url);toast(paid?'Link criado e copiado.':'Link gratuito criado e copiado.','success');studentRegistrationPage()}
async function copyRegistrationLink(url){try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);toast('Link copiado.','success')}catch{prompt('Copie o link:',url)}}
function shareRegistrationLink(url){const text=`Olá! 👋 Faça seu cadastro na Teacher Platform por este link:\n${url}`;window.open(`https://wa.me/?text=${encodeURIComponent(text)}`,'_blank','noopener')}
async function toggleRegistrationLink(id,active){const r=await sb.from('tic_student_registration_links').update({active}).eq('id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);if(r.error)return toast(r.error.message,'error');studentRegistrationPage()}
async function ticLoadRegistration(token){const {data,error}=await sb.rpc('tic_registration_info',{p_token:token});if(error||!data?.length)return showPublicRegistrationError('Link de cadastro inválido, expirado ou desativado.');const x=data[0],free=Number(x.monthly_fee||0)===0;$('login').innerHTML=`<div class="login-card"><h1>Teacher <span>Platform</span></h1><p>Cadastro de aluno · ${esc(x.teacher_name||'Teacher')}</p><div class="notice success">${esc(x.welcome_message||'Bem-vindo! Complete seu cadastro para entrar na plataforma.')}</div><form id="publicRegForm" class="form"><div class="field"><label>Nome completo</label><input id="prName" required></div><div class="field"><label>WhatsApp</label><input id="prWhatsapp" type="tel" inputmode="tel" required placeholder="(41) 99999-9999"></div><div class="field"><label>E-mail</label><input id="prEmail" type="email" required></div><div class="field"><label>Senha</label><input id="prPassword" type="password" minlength="6" required></div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Nível atual</label><select id="prLevel">${levels.map(l=>`<option ${l===x.level?'selected':''}>${l}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Nível objetivo</label><select id="prTarget">${levels.map(l=>`<option ${l===(x.target_level||'A1')?'selected':''}>${l}</option>`).join('')}</select></div></div>${free?`<div class="registration-free"><b>🆓 Cadastro gratuito</b><br><small>Este cadastro não possui mensalidade.</small></div>`:`<div class="field"><label>Quantas vezes por semana?</label><select id="prWeeks"><option value="1" ${x.lessons_per_week===1?'selected':''}>1x por semana — R$ 250</option><option value="2" ${x.lessons_per_week===2?'selected':''}>2x por semana — R$ 450</option><option value="3" ${x.lessons_per_week===3?'selected':''}>3x por semana — R$ 650</option></select></div><div class="notice">Mensalidade definida: <b>${money(x.monthly_fee)}</b>${x.course_title?` · Curso: <b>${esc(x.course_title)}</b>`:''}</div>`}${free&&x.course_title?`<div class="notice">Curso: <b>${esc(x.course_title)}</b></div>`:''}<button class="btn primary">Criar minha conta</button></form></div>`;$('publicRegForm').onsubmit=async ev=>{ev.preventDefault();const weeks=free?1:Number($('prWeeks').value);const {data:s,error:e}=await sb.auth.signUp({email:$('prEmail').value.trim().toLowerCase(),password:$('prPassword').value,data:{full_name:$('prName').value.trim(),whatsapp:$('prWhatsapp').value.trim(),current_level:$('prLevel').value,target_level:$('prTarget').value,lessons_per_week:String(weeks),monthly_fee:String(free?0:(TIC_WEEKLY_FEES[weeks]||250)),registration_token:token}});if(e)return toast(e.message,'error');if(s.session){toast('Cadastro concluído.','success');location.href=location.pathname}else{$('login').innerHTML=`<div class="login-card"><h1>Cadastro realizado ✅</h1><p>Confira seu e-mail para confirmar a conta e depois entre na plataforma.</p></div>`}}}
function showPublicRegistrationError(msg){$('login').innerHTML=`<div class="login-card"><h1>Teacher <span>Platform</span></h1><div class="card attention"><b>${esc(msg)}</b></div><button class="btn primary" onclick="location.href=location.pathname">Voltar</button></div>`}

/* ---------- Teacher student form: responsive + fast manual registration ---------- */
function syncStudentFee(){
 const w=Number($('sWeeks')?.value||1);
 const fee=TIC_WEEKLY_FEES[w]||250;
 if($('sFee')) $('sFee').value=fee;
}
function toggleStudentBilling(){
 const paid=document.querySelector('input[name="studentBilling"]:checked')?.value==='paid';
 $('sPaidFields')?.classList.toggle('hidden',!paid);
 $('sFreeNote')?.classList.toggle('hidden',paid);
 if($('sFee')){
   $('sFee').disabled=!paid;
   $('sFee').required=paid;
   if(!paid)$('sFee').value=0;
   else if(Number($('sFee').value||0)===0)syncStudentFee();
 }
}
function copyStudentTempPassword(){
 const el=$('sTempPassword'); if(!el?.value)return toast('Gere ou informe a senha primeiro.','error');
 navigator.clipboard?.writeText(el.value).then(()=>toast('Senha copiada.','success')).catch(()=>{el.select();document.execCommand('copy');toast('Senha copiada.','success')});
}
function openStudentForm(s=null){
 if(!requireTeacherAction())return;
 const weeks=Number(s?.lessons_per_week||1);
 const isPaid=Number(s?.monthly_fee??250)>0;
 const fee=s?.monthly_fee!=null?Number(s.monthly_fee):Number(TIC_WEEKLY_FEES[weeks]||250);
 openModal(s?'Editar aluno':'Novo aluno',`<form class="form student-form" onsubmit="saveStudentV4(event,'${s?.id||''}')">
 <div class="student-form-banner"><div><span class="student-form-kicker">👨‍🏫 CADASTRO PELO TEACHER</span><h4>${s?'Atualize os dados do aluno':'Crie o acesso do aluno em poucos passos'}</h4><small>Os dados ficam salvos no Supabase e continuam vinculados ao seu Teacher.</small></div><span class="student-form-badge">${s?'EDITAR':'NOVO ALUNO'}</span></div>
 <div class="student-form-section"><div class="student-form-title">1. Dados do aluno</div><div class="form-grid">
 <div class="field"><label>Nome completo *</label><input id="sName" value="${esc(s?.display_name||'')}" autocomplete="name" required autofocus></div>
 <div class="field"><label>E-mail *</label><input id="sEmail" type="email" value="${esc(s?.email||'')}" autocomplete="email" required></div>
 </div><div class="form-grid">
 <div class="field"><label>WhatsApp do aluno</label><input id="sPhone" type="tel" inputmode="tel" placeholder="(41) 99999-9999" value="${esc(s?.phone||'')}" autocomplete="tel"><small>Usado para compartilhar Tasks, Lessons, materiais e acesso.</small></div>
 
 </div></div>
 <div class="student-form-section"><div class="student-form-title">2. Nível e planejamento</div><div class="form-grid">
 <div class="field"><label>Nível atual</label><select id="sLevel">${levels.map(x=>`<option ${x===s?.current_level?'selected':''}>${x}</option>`).join('')}</select></div>
 <div class="field"><label>Nível objetivo</label><select id="sTarget"><option value="">—</option>${levels.map(x=>`<option ${x===s?.target_level?'selected':''}>${x}</option>`).join('')}</select></div>
 </div><div class="form-grid">
 <div class="field"><label>Frequência semanal</label><select id="sWeeks" onchange="syncStudentFee()"><option value="1" ${weeks===1?'selected':''}>1x por semana — R$ 250</option><option value="2" ${weeks===2?'selected':''}>2x por semana — R$ 450</option><option value="3" ${weeks===3?'selected':''}>3x por semana — R$ 650</option></select></div>
 
 </div></div>
 <div class="student-form-section"><div class="student-form-title">3. Condição financeira</div>
 <div class="student-billing-mode"><label class="billing-option"><input type="radio" name="studentBilling" value="free" ${!isPaid?'checked':''} onchange="toggleStudentBilling()"><span><b>🆓 Gratuito</b><small>Sem mensalidade</small></span></label><label class="billing-option"><input type="radio" name="studentBilling" value="paid" ${isPaid?'checked':''} onchange="toggleStudentBilling()"><span><b>💰 Com mensalidade</b><small>Valor definido pelo Teacher</small></span></label></div>
 <div id="sFreeNote" class="registration-free ${isPaid?'hidden':''}"><b>🆓 Aluno gratuito</b><br><small>Este aluno não terá mensalidade cadastrada.</small></div>
 <div id="sPaidFields" class="form-grid ${isPaid?'':'hidden'}"><div class="field"><label>Mensalidade (R$)</label><input id="sFee" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="${fee}" inputmode="decimal"><small>O valor é sugerido pela frequência, mas você pode alterar manualmente.</small></div></div>
 </div>
 ${!s?`<div class="student-form-section"><div class="student-form-title">4. Acesso à plataforma</div><div class="field"><label>🔑 Senha temporária *</label><div class="password-row"><input id="sTempPassword" type="text" minlength="6" placeholder="Definida pelo Teacher" required autocomplete="new-password"><button type="button" class="btn secondary" onclick="generateTempPassword()">Gerar</button><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="copyStudentTempPassword()">📋 Copiar</button></div><small>O Teacher define a senha inicial e pode enviá-la ao aluno pelo WhatsApp. O aluno poderá alterá-la depois.</small></div></div>`:''}
 <div class="student-form-section"><div class="student-form-title">${s?'4':'5'}. Observações</div><div class="field"><textarea id="sNotes" rows="3" placeholder="Ex.: objetivo do aluno, horários, observações pedagógicas...">${esc(s?.notes||'')}</textarea></div></div>
 <div class="student-save-summary"><div><b>Confira antes de salvar</b><small>Nome, nível, frequência e condição financeira poderão ser alterados depois.</small></div><div class="student-save-values"><span id="studentBillingPreview">${isPaid?'💰 '+money(fee)+'/mês':'🆓 Gratuito'}</span><span>·</span><span>${weeks}x/semana</span></div></div>
 <div class="modal-actions student-modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary student-save-btn">✓ ${s?'Salvar alterações':'Criar aluno'}</button></div>
 </form>`);
 toggleStudentBilling();
 const feeEl=$('sFee');
 if(feeEl)feeEl.addEventListener('input',()=>{const p=$('studentBillingPreview');if(p)p.textContent='💰 '+money(Number(feeEl.value||0))+'/mês'});
 const weeksEl=$('sWeeks');
 if(weeksEl)weeksEl.addEventListener('change',()=>{const p=$('studentBillingPreview');const paid=document.querySelector('input[name="studentBilling"]:checked')?.value==='paid';if(p&&paid)p.textContent='💰 '+money(Number($('sFee')?.value||0))+'/mês';});
}
async function saveStudentV4(e,id){
 e.preventDefault();
 const paid=document.querySelector('input[name="studentBilling"]:checked')?.value==='paid';
 const obj={display_name:$('sName').value.trim(),email:$('sEmail').value.trim().toLowerCase()||null,current_level:$('sLevel').value,target_level:$('sTarget').value||null,monthly_fee:paid?Number($('sFee').value||0):0,lessons_per_week:Number($('sWeeks').value||1),phone:$('sPhone').value.trim()||null,notes:$('sNotes').value.trim()||null,status:'active'};
 if(!obj.display_name)return toast('Informe o nome.','error');
 if(!obj.email)return toast('Informe o e-mail.','error');
 if(paid&&obj.monthly_fee<0)return toast('Informe uma mensalidade válida.','error');
 if(id){const r=await sb.from('tic_students').update(obj).eq('id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);if(r.error)return toast(r.error.message,'error');closeModal();toast('Aluno atualizado.','success');return loadView('students')}
 const pw=$('sTempPassword')?.value||'';if(pw.length<6)return toast('Defina uma senha temporária de 6+ caracteres.','error');
 const r=await sb.functions.invoke('tic-student-admin',{body:{action:'create_student',...obj,temp_password:pw,redirect_to:location.origin+location.pathname}});
 if(r.error)return toast(r.error.message||'Falha ao criar aluno.','error');
 if(r.data?.error)return toast(r.data.error,'error');
 let createdId=r.data?.student_id||r.data?.student?.id;
 if(!createdId&&obj.email){const sr=await sb.from('tic_students').select('id').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('email',obj.email).maybeSingle();createdId=sr.data?.id||null}
 closeModal();toast(r.data?.message||'Aluno criado.','success');await loadView('students');
 if(createdId&&obj.phone){setTimeout(()=>shareStudentAccess(createdId),150)}else if(!obj.phone){toast('Aluno criado. Cadastre o WhatsApp para enviar o acesso por mensagem.','info')}
}

/* ---------- Course curriculum teacher: show unassigned lessons + click-through ---------- */
async function openCourseCurriculum(courseId){
 await __loadCourseData();const c=window.__ticCourses.find(x=>x.id===courseId);if(!c)return toast('Curso não encontrado.','error');const ms=window.__ticModules.filter(m=>m.course_id===courseId).sort((a,b)=>(a.position||0)-(b.position||0));const ls=window.__ticLessons.filter(l=>l.course_id===courseId).sort((a,b)=>(a.position||0)-(b.position||0));
 const block=ms.map(m=>{const ml=ls.filter(l=>l.module_id===m.id);return `<div class="module-block"><div class="module-title"><div><b>📁 ${esc(m.title)}</b><small>${esc(m.description||'')} · ${ml.length} lesson(s)</small></div><div class="row-actions"><button class="btn sm ghost" onclick='openModuleForm(${JSON.stringify(m)})'>Editar</button><button class="btn sm danger" onclick="deleteModuleSafe('${m.id}','${courseId}')">Excluir</button></div></div><div class="module-lessons">${ml.map((l,i)=>`<div class="curriculum-lesson"><div class="lesson-number">${i+1}</div><button class="lesson-curriculum-link" onclick="viewTeacherLesson('${l.id}')"><div class="lesson-copy"><b>${esc(l.title)}</b><small>${esc(l.skill||'')} · posição ${l.position||i+1} ${l.html_enabled?'· 🧩 HTML':''}</small></div></button><div class="lesson-controls"><button title="Subir" onclick="moveCourseLesson('${l.id}',-1,'${courseId}')">↑</button><button title="Descer" onclick="moveCourseLesson('${l.id}',1,'${courseId}')">↓</button><button title="Atribuir" onclick="openAssignLessonById('${l.id}')">📤</button></div></div>`).join('')||'<div class="course-empty">Nenhuma lesson neste módulo.</div>'}</div></div>`}).join('');const general=ls.filter(l=>!l.module_id);const generalBlock=general.length?`<div class="module-block"><div class="module-title"><div><b>📖 Lessons sem módulo</b><small>Elas já pertencem ao curso e continuam disponíveis.</small></div><span class="badge yellow">${general.length}</span></div><div class="module-lessons">${general.map((l,i)=>`<div class="curriculum-lesson"><div class="lesson-number">${i+1}</div><button class="lesson-curriculum-link" onclick="viewTeacherLesson('${l.id}')"><div class="lesson-copy"><b>${esc(l.title)}</b><small>${esc(l.skill||'')} · sem módulo</small></div></button><div class="lesson-controls"><button onclick="moveLessonToFirstModule('${l.id}','${courseId}')">📁</button><button onclick="openAssignLessonById('${l.id}')">📤</button></div></div>`).join('')}</div></div>`:'';
 openModal(`📚 Currículo · ${esc(c.title)}`,`<div class="notice">Estrutura: <b>Curso → Módulo → Lesson</b>. Clique no nome da Lesson para abrir o conteúdo.</div><div class="actions section"><button class="btn primary" onclick="openModuleForm('${courseId}')">+ Novo módulo</button><button class="btn secondary" onclick="openLessonForm(null,false,'${courseId}')">+ Nova lesson neste curso</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="openCourseEnrollment('${courseId}')">👥 Alunos do curso</button></div><div class="curriculum-panel section"><div class="curriculum-head"><div><h3>📚 ${esc(c.title)}</h3><span>${ls.length} lesson(s) · ${ms.length} módulo(s)</span></div><span class="badge blue">${esc(c.level||'')}</span></div>${block||''}${generalBlock||(!block?'<div class="course-empty">Nenhum módulo criado.</div>':'')}</div>`)
}
async function moveLessonToFirstModule(lessonId,courseId){await __loadCourseData();const m=(window.__ticModules||[]).filter(x=>x.course_id===courseId).sort((a,b)=>(a.position||0)-(b.position||0))[0];if(!m)return toast('Crie um módulo primeiro.','info');const n=(window.__ticLessons||[]).filter(x=>x.module_id===m.id).length;const r=await sb.from('tic_lessons').update({module_id:m.id,position:n+1}).eq('id',lessonId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);if(r.error)return toast(r.error.message,'error');toast('Lesson colocada no primeiro módulo.','success');openCourseCurriculum(courseId)}

/* ---------- Reusable Task button in Assignments ---------- */
async function assignmentsPage(){
 const viewToken=window.__ticViewToken||0;
 const {data,error}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('created_at',{ascending:false});if(error){if((window.__ticViewToken||0)!==viewToken || currentView!=='assignments')return;$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention"><b>Não foi possível carregar as tarefas.</b><p>${esc(error.message)}</p></div>`;return}
 const ids=(data||[]).map(x=>x.id);let counts={};if(ids.length){const r=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('assignment_id,student_id,active').in('assignment_id',ids);if((window.__ticViewToken||0)!==viewToken || currentView!=='assignments')return;(r.data||[]).forEach(x=>{if(x.active!==false)counts[x.assignment_id]=(counts[x.assignment_id]||0)+1})}
 if((window.__ticViewToken||0)!==viewToken || currentView!=='assignments')return;
 $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card"><div class="section-head"><div><h2>Assignments / Tasks</h2><span>${data?.length||0} tarefas · reutilizáveis para vários alunos</span></div><button class="btn primary" onclick="openAssignmentForm()">+ Nova tarefa</button></div><div class="table-wrap"><table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Tarefa</th><th>Tipo</th><th>Alunos</th><th>Prazo</th><th>Prioridade</th><th>Ações</th></tr></thead><tbody>${(data||[]).map(x=>`<tr><td><b>${esc(x.title)}</b><br><small>${x.html_enabled?'🧩 HTML · ':''}${esc((x.instructions||'').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,'').slice(0,65))}</small></td><td>${esc(x.assignment_type||'assignment')}</td><td><span class="badge blue">${counts[x.id]||0}</span></td><td>${fmtDate(x.due_at)}</td><td>${badge(x.priority)}</td><td><div class="action-group"><button class="btn sm ghost" onclick='openAssignmentForm(${JSON.stringify(x)})'>Editar</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="openReassignTask('${x.id}')">📤 Atribuir</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="openAssignmentSubmissions('${x.id}')">📝 Entregas</button><button class="btn sm danger" onclick="deleteAssignment('${x.id}')">Excluir</button></div></td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="6" class="empty">Nenhuma tarefa.</td></tr>'}</tbody></table></div></div>`;
}

/* ---------- Routes: registration page + active nav ---------- */
const __ticLoadViewBase=loadView;
loadView=async function(v){
  // Cada clique inicia uma nova versão da navegação. Consultas antigas continuam podendo terminar,
  // mas não recebem mais permissão para pintar o conteúdo da aba atual.
  window.__ticViewToken=(window.__ticViewToken||0)+1;
  if(v==='studentRegistration')return studentRegistrationPage();
  return __ticLoadViewBase(v);
};

/* ---------- Public registration bootstrap ---------- */
(function ticRegistrationBootstrap(){const token=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('register');if(!token)return;const run=()=>{if(!$('login'))return;ticLoadRegistration(token)};if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',run);else setTimeout(run,0)})();

/* ===== TIC v5 final behavioral fixes ===== */
function ticResponsiveSrcdoc(content){
 const c=String(content||'').trim();
 if(!c)return '';
 const meta='<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1">';
 if(/<html[\s>]/i.test(c)) return c.replace(/<head([^>]*)>/i,`<head$1>${meta}`);
 return '<!doctype html><html><head>'+meta+'</head><body>'+c+'
<style id="tic-v54-student-activity-css">
.sa54-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;margin-bottom:16px}
.sa54-stat{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.sa54-stat span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;font-weight:700}
.sa54-stat b{display:block;font:800 25px "Plus Jakarta Sans";margin-top:5px}
.sa54-toolbar{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-bottom:14px}
.sa54-toolbar input,.sa54-toolbar select{border:1px solid var(--line);background:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;min-height:40px}
.sa54-toolbar input{flex:1;min-width:230px}
.sa54-students{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
.sa54-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:16px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.sa54-head{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start}
.sa54-avatar{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:14px;background:#eee8ff;color:var(--p);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:20px}
.sa54-head-main{min-width:0;flex:1}
.sa54-head-main b{display:block;font-size:14px}
.sa54-head-main small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;margin-top:2px}
.sa54-online{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 8px;background:#eaf8f0;color:#26734d;white-space:nowrap}
.sa54-offline{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;border-radius:999px;padding:5px 8px;background:#f1f1f5;color:#777585;white-space:nowrap}
.sa54-metrics{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:8px;margin-top:13px}
.sa54-metric{border:1px solid #eeeaf4;border-radius:12px;padding:9px;background:#fbfaff}
.sa54-metric span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:9px}
.sa54-metric b{display:block;font-size:11px;margin-top:3px}
.sa54-action{margin-top:12px;display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.sa54-timeline{margin-top:16px}
.sa54-event{display:grid;grid-template-columns:125px 1fr auto;gap:12px;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px solid #eeeaf4;padding:11px 4px}
.sa54-event:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.sa54-event-time{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}
.sa54-event-main b{display:block;font-size:11px}
.sa54-event-main small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:9px;margin-top:2px}

@media(max-width:560px){.sa54-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.sa54-event{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>

<script id="tic-v54-student-activity-js">
(function(){
'use strict';

const sa54Esc=v=>typeof esc==='function'?esc(v??''):String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,m=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[m]));
const sa54FmtDate=v=>v?new Date(v).toLocaleString('pt-BR',{dateStyle:'short',timeStyle:'short'}):'—';
const sa54FmtDur=sec=>{
  sec=Math.max(0,Number(sec)||0);
  const h=Math.floor(sec/3600),m=Math.floor((sec%3600)/60);
  if(h)return `${h}h ${m}min`;
  return `${m}min`;
};
const sa54Online=v=>v && (Date.now()-new Date(v).getTime()<=120000);
const sa54Label={
 login:'Login',
 view:'Navegação',
 material_open:'Material aberto',
 lesson_open:'Lesson aberta',
 task_open:'Tarefa aberta',
 resource_open:'Recurso aberto',
 class_open:'Class aberta',
 dashboard:'Dashboard',
 logout:'Saída'
};

async function sa54Student(){
  if(!session?.user?.id)return null;
  const {data}=await sb.from('tic_students')
    .select('id,teacher_id,auth_user_id,display_name,current_level,email,status')
    .eq('auth_user_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();
  return data||null;
}

async function sa54Log(event_type,label,extra={}){
  try{
    if(profile?.role!=='student'||!session?.user?.id)return;
    const st=await sa54Student();
    if(!st)return;
    await sb.from('tic_student_activity_events').insert({
      student_id:st.id,
      auth_user_id:session.user.id,
      event_type:String(event_type||'action').slice(0,60),
      event_label:String(label||event_type||'Ação').slice(0,180),
      view_name:extra.view_name?String(extra.view_name).slice(0,100):null,
      entity_type:extra.entity_type?String(extra.entity_type).slice(0,60):null,
      entity_id:extra.entity_id?String(extra.entity_id).slice(0,120):null,
      metadata:extra.metadata&&typeof extra.metadata==='object'?extra.metadata:{}
    });
  }catch(e){console.warn('[V54 activity]',e)}
}
window.ticLogStudentActivityV54=sa54Log;

/* Login/session event. The existing tic_student_activity table remains the source for duration. */
const oldStartV54=window.ticStartStudentActivityV41;
window.ticStartStudentActivityV41=async function(){
  const before=window.__ticV54ActivityStarted;
  if(oldStartV54)await oldStartV54();
  if(!before && !window.__ticV54ActivityStarted){
    window.__ticV54ActivityStarted=true;
    setTimeout(()=>sa54Log('login','Login realizado'),800);
  }
};

/* Log the student's internal navigation without capturing form contents or private text. */
const oldLoadViewV54=window.loadView;
window.loadView=async function(v){
  const r=await oldLoadViewV54.apply(this,arguments);
  try{
    if(profile?.role==='student'){
      const labels={
        student:'Dashboard',
        studentCourses:'My Courses',
        studentClass:'My Class',
        studentTasks:'My Tasks',
        studentProgress:'My Progress',
        studentLessons:'My Lessons',
        studentCalendar:'Calendar',
        studentMessages:'Messages'
      };
      sa54Log('view',labels[v]||String(v||'Página'),{view_name:String(v||'')});
    }
  }catch(_){}
  return r;
};

/* Known high-value actions inside the platform. */
const wrapOnce=(name,type,labeler)=>{
  const fn=window[name];
  if(typeof fn!=='function'||fn.__sa54Wrapped)return;
  const wrapped=async function(){
    try{
      if(profile?.role==='student'){
        const arg=arguments[0];
        sa54Log(type,labeler(arg),{
          entity_id:arg?String(arg):null
        });
      }
    }catch(_){}
    return fn.apply(this,arguments);
  };
  wrapped.__sa54Wrapped=true;
  window[name]=wrapped;
};
wrapOnce('openStudentMaterialV51','material_open',id=>'Material');
wrapOnce('viewStudentLessonAssignmentV51','lesson_open',id=>'Lesson');
wrapOnce('openStudentTask','task_open',id=>'Tarefa');

/* Track only links clicked inside the student workspace; never inspect typed form values. */
document.addEventListener('click',ev=>{
  if(profile?.role!=='student')return;
  const a=ev.target?.closest?.('a[href]');
  if(!a)return;
  const href=a.getAttribute('href')||'';
  if(!/^https?:/i.test(href))return;
  const label=(a.textContent||'Abrir recurso').trim().slice(0,140);
  let host='';
  try{host=new URL(href,location.href).hostname}catch(_){}
  sa54Log('resource_open',label,{metadata:{domain:host,target:a.target||'_self'}});
},{passive:true});

/* ---------------- Teacher Activity page ---------------- */
async function studentActivityPageV54(){
  currentView='studentActivity';
  document.querySelectorAll('#teacherNav [data-view]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.view==='studentActivity'));
  if(typeof setPage==='function')setPage('Student Activity','Entradas, sessões, tempo ativo e ações realizadas dentro da plataforma.','<button class="btn ghost" onclick="studentActivityPageV54()">↻ Atualizar</button>');
  const content=$('content');
  content.innerHTML='<div class="card"><b>Carregando Student Activity...</b><p class="desc">Consultando sessões e eventos registrados.</p></div>';

  const {data:students,error:se}=await sb.from('tic_students')
    .select('id,display_name,current_level,email,status,teacher_id')
    .eq('teacher_id',session.user.id)
    .order('display_name');
  if(se){
    content.innerHTML=`<div class="card attention"><b>Não foi possível carregar Student Activity.</b><p>${sa54Esc(se.message)}</p></div>`;
    return;
  }
  const ids=(students||[]).map(x=>x.id);
  if(!ids.length){
    content.innerHTML='<div class="sa54-empty">Nenhum aluno vinculado a este Teacher.</div>';
    return;
  }

  const [{data:sessions,error:ae},{data:events,error:ee}]=await Promise.all([
    sb.from('tic_student_activity').select('id,student_id,started_at,last_seen_at,duration_seconds').in('student_id',ids).order('started_at',{ascending:false}).limit(10000),
    sb.from('tic_student_activity_events').select('id,student_id,event_type,event_label,view_name,entity_type,entity_id,metadata,created_at').in('student_id',ids).order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(5000)
  ]);

  const activityError=ae?.message||ee?.message;
  if(activityError){
    content.innerHTML=`<div class="card attention"><b>Student Activity precisa da tabela de eventos.</b><p>${sa54Esc(activityError)}</p><small>Verifique se o SQL V54 foi aplicado ao Supabase.</small></div>`;
    return;
  }

  const map=new Map((students||[]).map(s=>[s.id,{student:s,total:0,sessions:0,last_login:null,last_seen:null,last_event:null}]));
  (sessions||[]).forEach(x=>{
    const a=map.get(x.student_id);if(!a)return;
    a.total+=Number(x.duration_seconds)||0;a.sessions++;
    if(!a.last_login||new Date(x.started_at)>new Date(a.last_login))a.last_login=x.started_at;
    if(!a.last_seen||new Date(x.last_seen_at)>new Date(a.last_seen))a.last_seen=x.last_seen_at;
  });
  (events||[]).forEach(e=>{
    const a=map.get(e.student_id);if(a&&!a.last_event)a.last_event=e;
  });

  const todayStart=new Date();todayStart.setHours(0,0,0,0);
  const todaySessions=(sessions||[]).filter(x=>new Date(x.started_at)>=todayStart);
  const online=[...map.values()].filter(x=>sa54Online(x.last_seen)).length;
  const activeToday=todaySessions.reduce((n,x)=>n+(Number(x.duration_seconds)||0),0);
  const recentEvents=(events||[]).slice(0,80);

  window.__sa54Data={students, sessions, events, map};
  content.innerHTML=`
    <div class="sa54-grid">
      <div class="sa54-stat"><span>👥 Alunos acompanhados</span><b>${students.length}</b></div>
      <div class="sa54-stat"><span>🟢 Online agora</span><b>${online}</b></div>
      <div class="sa54-stat"><span>🔐 Sessões hoje</span><b>${todaySessions.length}</b></div>
      <div class="sa54-stat"><span>⏱️ Tempo ativo hoje</span><b>${sa54FmtDur(activeToday)}</b></div>
    </div>

    <div class="card">
      <div class="section-head"><div><h2>👁️ Atividade dos alunos</h2><span>O que acontece dentro da Teacher Platform.</span></div></div>
      <div class="sa54-toolbar">
        <input id="sa54Search" placeholder="🔎 Buscar aluno..." oninput="renderStudentActivityV54()">
        <select id="sa54Filter" onchange="renderStudentActivityV54()">
          <option value="all">Todos os alunos</option>
          <option value="online">🟢 Online</option>
          <option value="offline">⚪ Offline</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div id="sa54Students" class="sa54-students"></div>
    </div>

    <div class="card sa54-timeline">
      <div class="section-head"><div><h2>🕘 Últimas ações</h2><span>Eventos registrados pela plataforma.</span></div><span>${recentEvents.length} eventos recentes</span></div>
      <div id="sa54Events"></div>
    </div>`;
  renderStudentActivityV54();
  renderStudentEventsV54(recentEvents);
}

window.renderStudentActivityV54=function(){
  const box=document.getElementById('sa54Students');if(!box)return;
  const q=(document.getElementById('sa54Search')?.value||'').toLowerCase().trim();
  const filter=document.getElementById('sa54Filter')?.value||'all';
  const map=window.__sa54Data?.map||new Map();
  const arr=[...map.values()].filter(a=>{
    const s=a.student||{};
    const text=`${s.display_name||''} ${s.email||''} ${s.current_level||''}`.toLowerCase();
    return (!q||text.includes(q))&&(filter==='all'||(filter==='online'&&sa54Online(a.last_seen))||(filter==='offline'&&!sa54Online(a.last_seen)));
  });
  box.innerHTML=arr.map(a=>{
    const s=a.student||{};
    const online=sa54Online(a.last_seen);
    return `<article class="sa54-card">
      <div class="sa54-head">
        <span class="sa54-avatar">👤</span>
        <div class="sa54-head-main"><b>${sa54Esc(s.display_name||'Aluno')}</b><small>${sa54Esc(s.current_level||'')} ${s.email?'· '+sa54Esc(s.email):''}</small></div>
        <span class="${online?'sa54-online':'sa54-offline'}">${online?'🟢 Online':'⚪ Offline'}</span>
      </div>
      <div class="sa54-metrics">
        <div class="sa54-metric"><span>Último login</span><b>${sa54FmtDate(a.last_login)}</b></div>
        <div class="sa54-metric"><span>Última atividade</span><b>${sa54FmtDate(a.last_seen)}</b></div>
        <div class="sa54-metric"><span>Tempo ativo</span><b>${sa54FmtDur(a.total)}</b></div>
        <div class="sa54-metric"><span>Sessões</span><b>${a.sessions}</b></div>
      </div>
      <div style="margin-top:10px;font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)">${a.last_event?`Última ação: <b>${sa54Esc(a.last_event.event_label||sa54Label[a.last_event.event_type]||a.last_event.event_type)}</b> · ${sa54FmtDate(a.last_event.created_at)}`:'Nenhuma ação registrada ainda.'}</div>
      <div class="sa54-action"><button class="btn sm primary" onclick="openStudentActivityDetailV54('${s.id}')">👁️ Ver atividade</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="openStudentView('${s.id}')">👤 Abrir aluno</button></div>
    </article>`;
  }).join('')||'<div class="sa54-empty">Nenhum aluno corresponde aos filtros.</div>';
};

window.renderStudentEventsV54=function(events){
  const box=document.getElementById('sa54Events');if(!box)return;
  box.innerHTML=(events||[]).map(e=>{
    const s=window.__sa54Data?.students?.find(x=>x.id===e.student_id);
    return `<div class="sa54-event">
      <div class="sa54-event-time">${sa54FmtDate(e.created_at)}</div>
      <div class="sa54-event-main"><b>${sa54Esc(s?.display_name||'Aluno')} · ${sa54Esc(e.event_label||sa54Label[e.event_type]||e.event_type)}</b><small>${sa54Esc(e.view_name||'')} ${e.metadata?.domain?'· '+sa54Esc(e.metadata.domain):''}</small></div>
      <span class="sa54-pill">${sa54Esc(sa54Label[e.event_type]||e.event_type)}</span>
    </div>`;
  }).join('')||'<div class="sa54-empty">Nenhuma ação registrada ainda.</div>';
};

window.openStudentActivityDetailV54=function(studentId){
  const d=window.__sa54Data;if(!d)return;
  const s=d.students.find(x=>x.id===studentId);if(!s)return;
  const ss=(d.sessions||[]).filter(x=>x.student_id===studentId);
  const ev=(d.events||[]).filter(x=>x.student_id===studentId).slice(0,100);
  const total=ss.reduce((n,x)=>n+(Number(x.duration_seconds)||0),0);
  openModal('👁️ Atividade · '+sa54Esc(s.display_name||'Aluno'),`
    <div class="form">
      <div class="sa54-grid" style="grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)">
        <div class="sa54-stat"><span>Último login</span><b>${sa54FmtDate(ss[0]?.started_at)}</b></div>
        <div class="sa54-stat"><span>Tempo total</span><b>${sa54FmtDur(total)}</b></div>
        <div class="sa54-stat"><span>Sessões</span><b>${ss.length}</b></div>
      </div>
      <div class="card"><h3>🕘 Ações recentes</h3>${ev.map(e=>`<div class="sa54-event"><div class="sa54-event-time">${sa54FmtDate(e.created_at)}</div><div class="sa54-event-main"><b>${sa54Esc(e.event_label||e.event_type)}</b><small>${sa54Esc(e.view_name||'')}${e.metadata?.domain?' · '+sa54Esc(e.metadata.domain):''}</small></div><span class="sa54-pill">${sa54Esc(sa54Label[e.event_type]||e.event_type)}</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="sa54-empty">Nenhum evento registrado.</div>'}</div>
      <div class="card" style="margin-top:12px"><h3>🔐 Sessões</h3>${ss.slice(0,30).map(x=>`<div class="row"><div><b>${sa54FmtDate(x.started_at)}</b><small>Última atividade: ${sa54FmtDate(x.last_seen_at)}</small></div><span class="badge blue">${sa54FmtDur(x.duration_seconds)}</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="sa54-empty">Nenhuma sessão registrada.</div>'}</div>
      <div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Fechar</button></div>
    </div>`);
};

/* Add the new teacher navigation item without replacing any existing item. */
(function addNav(){
  const nav=document.getElementById('teacherNav');if(!nav||document.querySelector('#teacherNav [data-view="studentActivity"]'))return;
  const b=document.createElement('button');
  b.dataset.view='studentActivity';
  b.innerHTML='👁️ <span>Student Activity</span>';
  const anchor=nav.querySelector('[data-view="progress"]');
  if(anchor)anchor.insertAdjacentElement('beforebegin',b); else nav.appendChild(b);
  b.onclick=()=>loadView('studentActivity');
})();

/* Extend the existing router; every previous route continues to the original router. */
const loadViewBaseV54=window.loadView;
window.loadView=async function(v){
  if(v==='studentActivity'){
    return studentActivityPageV54();
  }
  return loadViewBaseV54.apply(this,arguments);
};

/* Start login event logging after the existing session tracker is available. */
setTimeout(()=>{
  if(profile?.role==='student' && session?.user?.id && !window.__ticV54ActivityStarted){
    window.__ticV54ActivityStarted=true;
    sa54Log('login','Login realizado');
  }
},1800);

})();
</script>

</body></html>';
}

async function saveFeedback(e,submissionId,taskAssignmentId,studentId){
 e.preventDefault();const grade=$('fbGrade')?.value.trim();const comment=$('fbComment')?.value.trim()||null;const private_note=$('fbPrivate')?.value==='true';const improvement_skill=$('fbSkill')?.value||null;const improvement_link=$('fbImprovementLink')?.value.trim()||null;
 if(grade!==''&&(Number(grade)<0||Number(grade)>100))return toast('A nota deve ficar entre 0 e 100.','error');
 const payload={submission_id:submissionId,teacher_id:session.user.id,comment,grade:grade===''?null:Number(grade),private_note,improvement_skill,improvement_link};
 const {data:existing}=await sb.from('tic_feedback').select('id').eq('submission_id',submissionId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();const r=existing?await sb.from('tic_feedback').update(payload).eq('id',existing.id):await sb.from('tic_feedback').insert(payload);if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível salvar o feedback: '+r.error.message,'error');
 const tr=await sb.from('tic_submissions').update({grade:grade===''?null:Number(grade),status:'reviewed'}).eq('id',submissionId);if(tr.error)return toast('Feedback salvo, mas a entrega não foi atualizada: '+tr.error.message,'error');
 await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').update({status:'reviewed'}).eq('id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',studentId);closeModal();toast('Correção salva. A atribuição continua ativa.','success');loadView('feedback');
}

 ]);
 const cs=cr.data||[],ms=mr.data||[],ls=lr.data||[],direct=(dr.data||[]).map(x=>x.tic_lessons).filter(Boolean);const {data:lp}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').select('lesson_id,first_completed_at').eq('student_id',s.id);const pmap=new Map((lp||[]).map(x=>[x.lesson_id,x]));
 const item=(l,i)=>{const done=!!pmap.get(l.id)?.first_completed_at;return `<button class="student-curriculum-item" onclick="viewStudentLessonInteractive('${l.id}')"><span class="lesson-number">${i+1}</span><span class="lesson-copy"><b>${esc(l.title)}</b><small>${esc(l.skill||'Lesson')} · ${done?'✓ Concluída':'Não iniciada'}${l.html_enabled?' · 🧩 HTML':''}</small></span><span class="btn sm secondary">Abrir →</span></button>`};
 const courses=cs.map(c=>{const cl=ls.filter(l=>l.course_id===c.id),mods=ms.filter(m=>m.course_id===c.id);const modHtml=mods.map(m=>{const ml=cl.filter(l=>l.module_id===m.id);return `<section class="student-module"><div class="student-module-head"><div><span>📁</span><div><h3>${esc(m.title)}</h3><small>${ml.length} lesson(s)</small></div></div><span class="badge blue">${ml.length}</span></div>${ml.map(item).join('')||'<div class="course-empty">Nenhuma lesson neste módulo.</div>'}</section>`}).join('');const general=cl.filter(l=>!l.module_id);return `<article class="student-course-hero card"><div class="student-course-head"><div><span class="badge blue">${esc(c.level||'')}</span><h2>📚 ${esc(c.title)}</h2><p>${esc(c.description||'')}</p></div><span class="badge green">Acesso ativo</span></div><div class="student-course-metrics"><span><b>${mods.length}</b> módulos</span><span><b>${cl.length}</b> lessons</span><span><b>${cl.filter(l=>pmap.get(l.id)?.first_completed_at).length}</b> concluídas</span></div><div class="student-module-stack">${modHtml}${general.length?`<section class="student-module"><div class="student-module-head"><div><span>📖</span><div><h3>Lessons gerais</h3><small>Já pertencem ao curso, mas ainda sem módulo.</small></div></div><span class="badge yellow">${general.length}</span></div>${general.map(item).join('')}</section>`:''}</div></article>`}).join('');
 const courseLessonIds=new Set(ls.map(l=>l.id));const extra=direct.filter(l=>!courseLessonIds.has(l.id));const directHtml=extra.length?`<article class="card section"><div class="section-head"><div><h2>📌 Lessons atribuídas diretamente</h2><span>Enviadas pelo Teacher fora do currículo.</span></div><span class="badge blue">${extra.length}</span></div>${extra.map(item).join('')}</article>`:'';
 setPage('My Lessons','Curso → módulo → lesson.');$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="notice success">🎓 ${ids.length?`Você está matriculado em <b>${ids.length} curso(s)</b>.`:''} ${extra.length?`Há <b>${extra.length} Lesson(s)</b> atribuída(s) diretamente.`:''} Você pode abrir e refazer Lessons quando quiser.</div>${courses||'<div class="card empty">Nenhum curso ativo.</div>'}${directHtml}`;
}
async function viewTeacherLesson(id){const {data:l,error}=await sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').eq('id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();if(error||!l)return toast(error?.message||'Lesson não encontrada.','error');openModal(`📖 ${esc(l.title)}`,`<div class="lesson-student-header"><div><span class="badge blue">${esc(l.level||'')}</span><h2>${esc(l.title)}</h2><small>${esc(l.skill||'')} · ${esc(l.lesson_type||'lesson')}</small></div><span class="badge ${l.html_enabled?'green':'gray'}">${l.html_enabled?'HTML':'Lesson'}</span></div>${l.content?`<div class="lesson-formatted-viewer"><iframe id="teacherLessonContentFrame" sandbox="allow-scripts"></iframe></div>`:''}${l.html_enabled&&l.html_content?`<div class="section"><div class="section-head"><h3>🧩 HTML interativo</h3><span>Preview responsivo</span></div><div class="html-devicebar"><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('desktop')">🖥</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('tablet')">▣</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('mobile')">📱</button></div><div id="htmlViewerWrap" class="html-viewer-wrap desktop"><iframe id="htmlViewerFrame" title="HTML Preview" sandbox="allow-scripts"></iframe></div></div>`:''}<div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn secondary" onclick="openAssignLessonById('${l.id}')">📤 Atribuir Lesson</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="openLessonFormById('${l.id}')">✏️ Editar</button></div>`);if(l.content){const f=$('teacherLessonContentFrame');if(f)f.srcdoc=ticPlainOrHtmlFrame(l.content)}if(l.html_enabled&&l.html_content){const f=$('htmlViewerFrame');if(f)f.srcdoc=ticResponsiveSrcdoc(l.html_content)+ticHtmlBridge()}}

/* Make the generic viewer responsive too. */
const __ticOpenHtmlViewerV4=openHtmlViewer;
openHtmlViewer=function(title,content,mode='preview',refId=''){__ticOpenHtmlViewerV4(title,content,mode,refId);const f=$('htmlViewerFrame');if(f&&content)f.srcdoc=ticResponsiveSrcdoc(content)+ticHtmlBridge()};


/* Rich editor source-mode correction */
function syncLessonRich(){const r=$('lRich'),src=$('l6');if(!r||!src)return;src.value=r.dataset.source==='1'?r.textContent:r.innerHTML}
function toggleLessonSource(){const rich=$('lRich'),src=$('l6');if(!rich||!src)return;if(rich.dataset.source==='1'){src.value=rich.textContent;rich.innerHTML=src.value;rich.dataset.source='0';rich.contentEditable='true'}else{src.value=rich.innerHTML;rich.textContent=src.value;rich.dataset.source='1';rich.contentEditable='true'}rich.focus()}

/* ---------- Visual system ---------- */
</script>

<script>
/* ================================================================
   TIC v6 — final connected Lesson / Task / Feedback layer
   This layer intentionally overrides only the affected functions,
   preserving the rest of the platform.
   ================================================================ */
function ticResourceUrl(item){return ticSafeUrl(item?.url||item?.value||'')}
function ticResourceLabel(item){return String(item?.title||item?.name||'Recurso')}
function ticRenderLessonResources(lesson){
 const list=[];
 if(lesson?.video_url)list.push({type:'video',title:'Vídeo principal',url:lesson.video_url});
 if(lesson?.audio_url)list.push({type:'audio',title:'Áudio principal',url:lesson.audio_url});
 if(lesson?.pdf_url)list.push({type:'pdf',title:'PDF principal',url:lesson.pdf_url});
 if(Array.isArray(lesson?.resource_items))list.push(...lesson.resource_items);
 const seen=new Set();
 const unique=list.filter(x=>{const u=ticResourceUrl(x);if(!u||seen.has(u))return false;seen.add(u);return true});
 if(!unique.length)return '<div class="empty" style="padding:14px">Nenhum recurso adicional cadastrado.</div>';
 return `<div class="viewer-resource-grid">${unique.map(x=>{const u=ticResourceUrl(x),type=String(x.type||'link').toLowerCase();const icon=type==='pdf'?'📄':type==='video'?'🎥':type==='audio'?'🎧':type==='file'?'📎':'🔗';return `<div class="viewer-resource"><b>${icon} ${esc(ticResourceLabel(x))}</b>${x.description?`<small>${esc(x.description)}</small>`:''}<a class="btn sm secondary" href="${esc(u)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Abrir recurso →</a></div>`}).join('')}</div>`;
}
function ticViewerTextFrame(content){
 const c=String(content||'').trim();if(!c)return '';
 const looksHtml=/<(?:html|body|div|p|h[1-6]|ul|ol|table|span|strong|em|img|a\b|section|article)[\s>]/i.test(c);
 if(looksHtml)return ticResponsiveSrcdoc(c);
 return '<!doctype html><html><head><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><style>body{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;margin:0;padding:28px;line-height:1.7;color:#202033}*{box-sizing:border-box}a{overflow-wrap:anywhere}img{max-width:100%;height:auto}</style></head><body>'+esc(c).replace(/\n/g,'<br>')+'</body></html>';
}

function ticFrameHtml(content){ const c=String(content||'').trim(); return c ? ticPlainOrHtmlFrame(c) : ''; }
function ticViewerDevices(targetId='ticViewerFrame',wrapId='ticViewerWrap'){
 const w=$(wrapId); if(!w)return '';
 return `<div class="tic-viewer-toolbar"><div class="devices"><button type="button" class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticSetViewerDevice('desktop','${wrapId}')">🖥 Desktop</button><button type="button" class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticSetViewerDevice('tablet','${wrapId}')">▣ Tablet</button><button type="button" class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticSetViewerDevice('mobile','${wrapId}')">📱 Mobile</button></div></div>`;
}
function ticSetViewerDevice(device,wrapId){const w=$(wrapId);if(!w)return;w.className='tic-viewer-content '+(device==='mobile'?'tic-mobile':device==='tablet'?'tic-tablet':'');}
function ticRenderResourcesFinal(x){
 const arr=[];
 if(x?.video_url)arr.push({type:'video',title:'Vídeo principal',url:x.video_url});
 if(x?.audio_url)arr.push({type:'audio',title:'Áudio principal',url:x.audio_url});
 if(x?.pdf_url)arr.push({type:'pdf',title:'PDF principal',url:x.pdf_url});
 if(Array.isArray(x?.resource_items))arr.push(...x.resource_items);
 const seen=new Set(), list=arr.filter(a=>{const u=ticSafeUrl(a?.url||a?.value||'');if(!u||seen.has(u))return false;seen.add(u);return true});
 if(!list.length)return '<div class="empty">Nenhum recurso adicional cadastrado.</div>';
 return `<div style="display:grid;gap:8px">${list.map(a=>{const u=ticSafeUrl(a.url||a.value||'');const type=String(a.type||'link').toLowerCase();const icon=type==='pdf'?'📄':type==='video'?'🎥':type==='audio'?'🎧':type==='file'?'📎':'🔗';return `<div class="tic-resource-card"><div><b>${icon} ${esc(a.title||a.name||'Recurso')}</b>${a.description?`<small>${esc(a.description)}</small>`:''}</div><a class="btn sm secondary" href="${esc(u)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Abrir →</a></div>`}).join('')}</div>`;
}
async function ticMarkLessonOpen(id,s){
 const now=new Date().toISOString();
 const {data:lp}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').select('*').eq('lesson_id',id).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();
 if(lp){await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').update({last_opened_at:now,open_count:Number(lp.open_count||0)+1,updated_at:now}).eq('id',lp.id);return lp;}
 const {data:n}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').insert({lesson_id:id,student_id:s.id,last_opened_at:now,open_count:1,response_count:0,}).select().single();return n;
}
async function markLessonCompleted(lessonId){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;
 const now=new Date().toISOString();
 const {data:lp}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').select('id,first_completed_at').eq('lesson_id',lessonId).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();
 let r;
 if(lp)r=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').update({first_completed_at:lp.first_completed_at||now,updated_at:now}).eq('id',lp.id);
 else r=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').insert({lesson_id:lessonId,student_id:s.id,first_completed_at:now,open_count:1,response_count:0});
 if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível registrar a conclusão: '+r.error.message,'error');
 toast('Lesson concluída. Ela continua disponível para você refazer quando quiser.','success');
 viewStudentLessonInteractive(lessonId);
}
async function viewStudentLessonInteractive(id){
 const {data:l,error}=await sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').eq('id',id).eq('active',true).maybeSingle();
 if(error||!l)return toast(error?.message||'Lesson não encontrada.','error');
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;
 const {data:courseAccess}=l.course_id?await sb.from('tic_course_students').select('id').eq('course_id',l.course_id).eq('student_id',s.id).eq('status','active').maybeSingle():{data:null};
 const {data:direct}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_assignments').select('id').eq('lesson_id',id).eq('student_id',s.id).eq('active',true).maybeSingle();
 if(!courseAccess&&!direct)return toast('Esta Lesson não está disponível para sua conta.','error');
 const lp=await ticMarkLessonOpen(id,s);
 const {data:resp}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_responses').select('id,attempt,status,score,response_text,teacher_comment,improvement_skill,improvement_link,reviewed_at,created_at').eq('lesson_id',id).eq('student_id',s.id).order('attempt',{ascending:false});
 const completed=!!lp?.first_completed_at; const latest=resp?.[0];
 const content=l.content?`<section class="tic-viewer-content" id="ticLessonContentWrap"><iframe id="ticLessonContentFrame" title="Conteúdo da Lesson" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox"></iframe></section>`:'';
 const html=l.html_enabled&&l.html_content?`<section><div class="tic-viewer-toolbar"><b>🧩 Atividade HTML interativa</b><span class="badge green">Responsiva</span></div><div class="tic-viewer-toolbar"><div class="devices"><button type="button" class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticSetViewerDevice('desktop','ticLessonHtmlWrap')">🖥 Desktop</button><button type="button" class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticSetViewerDevice('tablet','ticLessonHtmlWrap')">▣ Tablet</button><button type="button" class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticSetViewerDevice('mobile','ticLessonHtmlWrap')">📱 Mobile</button></div></div><div class="tic-viewer-content" id="ticLessonHtmlWrap"><iframe id="ticLessonHtmlFrame" title="Atividade HTML da Lesson" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox"></iframe></div><div id="ticLessonStatus" class="notice">Você pode realizar a atividade e enviar sua resposta dentro do conteúdo.</div></section>`:'';
 const response=l.allow_student_response?`<section class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>✍️ Resposta ao Teacher</b><span class="badge blue">Tentativas ilimitadas</span></div><div class="tic-answer-box"><textarea id="lessonExternalResponse" placeholder="Escreva uma resposta para o Teacher..."></textarea><button class="btn primary" onclick="submitLessonExternalResponse('${l.id}')">📤 Enviar resposta</button></div></section>`:'';
 const feedback=latest&&(latest.teacher_comment||latest.score!=null)?`<section class="tic-feedback-card"><b>👨‍🏫 Feedback do Teacher</b>${latest.score!=null?`<div class="score">${latest.score}/100</div>`:''}${latest.teacher_comment?`<div style="white-space:pre-wrap;line-height:1.6">${esc(latest.teacher_comment)}</div>`:''}${latest.improvement_skill||latest.improvement_link?`<div class="improvement-box"><b>🎯 Como melhorar</b>${latest.improvement_skill?`<div>Habilidade: <b>${esc(latest.improvement_skill)}</b></div>`:''}${latest.improvement_link?`<a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(ticSafeUrl(latest.improvement_link))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">🔗 Abrir material</a>`:''}</div>`:''}</section>`:'';
 const history=(resp||[]).length?`<section class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>🔄 Histórico</b></div>${resp.map(r=>`<div class="tic-attempt"><b>Tentativa ${r.attempt}</b><small>${fmtDate(r.created_at)} · ${esc(r.status||'submitted')}</small>${r.score!=null?`<div><b>Nota:</b> ${r.score}</div>`:''}${r.response_text?`<div style="white-space:pre-wrap;margin-top:6px">${esc(r.response_text)}</div>`:''}</div>`).join('')}</section>`:'';
 openModal(`📖 ${esc(l.title)}`,`<div class="tic-full-viewer"><div class="lesson-student-header"><div><span class="badge blue">${esc(l.level||s.current_level||'')}</span><h2>${esc(l.title)}</h2><small>${esc(l.skill||'Lesson')} · ${esc(l.lesson_type||'lesson')}</small></div><div class="tic-task-state"><span class="badge ${completed?'green':'yellow'}">${completed?'✓ Concluída na primeira vez':'Não concluída'}</span><span class="badge green">Acesso ativo</span></div></div>${content}${l.content?'<div class="viewer-status">Conteúdo da Lesson</div>':''}${html}${response}<section class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>📚 Recursos e links</b></div>${ticRenderResourcesFinal(l)}</section>${feedback}${history}<div class="viewer-actions"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Fechar</button>${!completed?`<button class="btn primary" onclick="markLessonCompleted('${l.id}')">✓ Marcar como concluída</button>`:`<span class="badge green" style="padding:10px 13px">✓ Concluída — pode refazer</span>`}</div></div>`);
 if(content){const f=$('ticLessonContentFrame');if(f)f.srcdoc=ticPlainOrHtmlFrame(l.content)}
 if(html){const f=$('ticLessonHtmlFrame');if(f)f.srcdoc=ticFrameHtml(l.html_content)+ticHtmlBridge();}
}
async function submitLessonExternalResponse(lessonId){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;const el=$('lessonExternalResponse');const text=el?.value.trim()||'';if(!text)return toast('Digite uma resposta antes de enviar.','info');
 const {data:last}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_responses').select('attempt').eq('lesson_id',lessonId).eq('student_id',s.id).order('attempt',{ascending:false}).limit(1).maybeSingle();const attempt=Number(last?.attempt||0)+1;
 const r=await sb.from('tic_lesson_responses').insert({lesson_id:lessonId,student_id:s.id,attempt,response_text:text,response_data:{source:'external_text'},status:'submitted'});if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível enviar: '+r.error.message,'error');
 const now=new Date().toISOString();const {data:lp}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').select('id,first_completed_at,response_count').eq('lesson_id',lessonId).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();
 if(lp)await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').update({first_completed_at:lp.first_completed_at||now,response_count:Number(lp.response_count||0)+1,last_opened_at:now,updated_at:now}).eq('id',lp.id);else await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').insert({lesson_id:lessonId,student_id:s.id,first_completed_at:now,last_opened_at:now,response_count:1,open_count:1});
 toast(`Resposta enviada. Tentativa ${attempt}.`,'success');viewStudentLessonInteractive(lessonId);
}
async function submitInteractiveLesson(lessonId,payload){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;const {data:l,error}=await sb.from('tic_lessons').select('id,allow_student_response,active').eq('id',lessonId).eq('active',true).maybeSingle();if(error||!l)return toast(error?.message||'Lesson não encontrada.','error');if(l.allow_student_response===false)return toast('O Teacher não ativou respostas nesta Lesson.','info');
 const {data:last}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_responses').select('attempt').eq('lesson_id',lessonId).eq('student_id',s.id).order('attempt',{ascending:false}).limit(1).maybeSingle();const attempt=Number(last?.attempt||0)+1;
 const r=await sb.from('tic_lesson_responses').insert({lesson_id:lessonId,student_id:s.id,attempt,response_data:payload.fields||{},response_text:payload.text||null,status:'submitted'});if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível enviar sua resposta: '+r.error.message,'error');
 const now=new Date().toISOString();const {data:lp}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').select('id,first_completed_at,response_count').eq('lesson_id',lessonId).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();if(lp)await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').update({first_completed_at:lp.first_completed_at||now,response_count:Number(lp.response_count||0)+1,last_opened_at:now,updated_at:now}).eq('id',lp.id);else await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').insert({lesson_id:lessonId,student_id:s.id,first_completed_at:now,last_opened_at:now,response_count:1,open_count:1});if($('ticLessonStatus'))$('ticLessonStatus').innerHTML=`<b>✅ Resposta enviada.</b> Tentativa ${attempt}. A Lesson continua disponível para refazer.`;toast('Resposta da Lesson enviada.','success');
}
async function submitInteractiveTask(taskAssignmentId,payload){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;const {data:ta,error}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,active,assignment_id').eq('id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();if(error||!ta||ta.active===false)return toast(error?.message||'Task não encontrada ou removida.','error');
 const {data:a}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').select('allow_multiple_attempts,active').eq('id',ta.assignment_id).maybeSingle();if(a?.active===false)return toast('Esta Task foi desativada pelo Teacher.','error');
 if(a?.allow_multiple_attempts===false){const {data:already}=await sb.from('tic_submissions').select('id').eq('task_assignment_id',ta.id).eq('student_id',s.id).limit(1);if(already?.length)return toast('Esta Task permite apenas uma tentativa.','info');}
 const {data:last}=await sb.from('tic_submissions').select('attempt').eq('task_assignment_id',ta.id).eq('student_id',s.id).order('attempt',{ascending:false}).limit(1).maybeSingle();const attempt=Number(last?.attempt||0)+1;
 const r=await sb.from('tic_submissions').insert({task_assignment_id:ta.id,student_id:s.id,attempt,answer_text:payload.text||null,response_data:payload.fields||{},submitted_at:new Date().toISOString(),status:'submitted'});if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível enviar a Task: '+r.error.message,'error');
 await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').update({status:'submitted',completed_at:null}).eq('id',ta.id).eq('student_id',s.id);toast(`Task enviada. Tentativa ${attempt}.`,'success');if($('htmlViewerStatus'))$('htmlViewerStatus').innerHTML=`<b>✅ Enviada.</b> Tentativa ${attempt} registrada. A atribuição continua ativa.`;
}
async function submitTaskViewerText(id){const t=$('taskViewerText')?.value.trim()||'';if(!t)return toast('Digite sua resposta antes de enviar.','info');await submitInteractiveTask(id,{text:t,fields:{source:'external_text'}})}
async function openStudentTaskViewer(taskAssignmentId){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;const {data:x,error}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,active,assignment_id,status,tic_assignments(id,title,instructions,due_at,points,html_enabled,html_content,allow_multiple_attempts,cover_image_url,resource_items,lesson_id)').eq('id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();
 if(error||!x||x.active===false)return toast(error?.message||'Task não encontrada ou removida.','error');const a=x.tic_assignments||{};
 const {data:subs}=await sb.from('tic_submissions').select('id,attempt,grade,submitted_at,answer_text,file_url,audio_url,video_url,response_data,status').eq('task_assignment_id',x.id).eq('student_id',s.id).order('attempt',{ascending:false});
 const latest=subs?.[0];const fids=(subs||[]).map(q=>q.id);const {data:fbs}=fids.length?await sb.from('tic_feedback').select('id,submission_id,comment,grade,private_note,improvement_skill,improvement_link,created_at').in('submission_id',fids).order('created_at',{ascending:false}):{data:[]};const fb=latest?fbs?.find(q=>q.submission_id===latest.id):null;
 const html=a.html_enabled&&a.html_content?`<div class="tic-viewer-toolbar"><b>🧩 Atividade HTML</b><span class="badge green">Interativa</span></div><div class="tic-viewer-toolbar"><div class="devices"><button type="button" class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticSetViewerDevice('desktop','ticTaskHtmlWrap')">🖥 Desktop</button><button type="button" class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticSetViewerDevice('tablet','ticTaskHtmlWrap')">▣ Tablet</button><button type="button" class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticSetViewerDevice('mobile','ticTaskHtmlWrap')">📱 Mobile</button></div></div><div class="tic-viewer-content" id="ticTaskHtmlWrap"><iframe id="ticTaskHtmlFrame" title="Task HTML" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox"></iframe></div><div id="htmlViewerStatus" class="notice">Responda no conteúdo HTML e use Enviar/Submit.</div>`:'';
 const plain=`<div class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>✍️ Sua resposta</b><span class="badge blue">${a.allow_multiple_attempts===false?'1 tentativa':'Tentativas múltiplas'}</span></div>${a.instructions?`<div style="white-space:pre-wrap;line-height:1.6">${esc(a.instructions)}</div>`:''}<textarea id="taskViewerText" placeholder="Escreva sua resposta para o Teacher..."></textarea><button class="btn primary" onclick="submitTaskViewerText('${x.id}')">📤 Enviar para o Teacher</button></div>`;
 const feedback=fb&&!fb.private_note?`<div class="tic-feedback-card"><b>👨‍🏫 Correção do Teacher</b>${fb.grade!=null?`<div class="score">${fb.grade}/100</div>`:''}<div style="white-space:pre-wrap;line-height:1.6">${esc(fb.comment||'Sem comentário.')}</div>${fb.improvement_skill||fb.improvement_link?`<div class="improvement-box"><b>🎯 Como melhorar</b>${fb.improvement_skill?`<div>Habilidade: <b>${esc(fb.improvement_skill)}</b></div>`:''}${fb.improvement_link?`<a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(ticSafeUrl(fb.improvement_link))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">🔗 Abrir melhoria</a>`:''}</div>`:''}</div>`:'';
 const hist=(subs||[]).map(z=>{const zf=fbs?.find(q=>q.submission_id===z.id);return `<div class="tic-attempt"><b>Tentativa ${z.attempt||1}</b><small>${fmtDate(z.submitted_at)} · ${z.grade!=null?'Nota '+z.grade:(zf?'Corrigida':'Aguardando correção')}</small>${z.answer_text?`<div style="white-space:pre-wrap;margin-top:6px">${esc(z.answer_text)}</div>`:''}</div>`}).join('')||'<div class="empty">Nenhuma entrega ainda.</div>';
 openModal(`📝 ${esc(a.title||'Task')}`,`<div class="tic-full-viewer"><div class="task-view-head"><div class="tic-task-state"><span class="badge green">🔓 Atribuição ativa</span><span class="badge gray">${a.due_at?'Prazo: '+fmtDate(a.due_at):'Sem prazo'}</span><span class="badge blue">${a.points||0} pontos</span></div><h2>${esc(a.title||'Task')}</h2></div>${html}${plain}<section class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>📚 Recursos</b></div>${ticRenderResourcesFinal(a)}</section>${feedback}<section class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>🔄 Histórico de tentativas</b></div>${hist}</section><div class="notice success">💡 Corrigir a Task não encerra a atribuição. Você pode refazer enquanto o Teacher mantiver o acesso.</div><div class="viewer-actions"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Fechar</button></div></div>`);
 if(html){const f=$('ticTaskHtmlFrame');if(f)f.srcdoc=ticFrameHtml(a.html_content)+ticHtmlBridge();}
}

async function openFeedbackFromId(submissionId){
 const {data:x,error}=await sb.from('tic_submissions').select('id,task_assignment_id,student_id,answer_text,file_url,audio_url,video_url,submitted_at,attempt,grade,status,tic_students(display_name,email)').eq('id',submissionId).maybeSingle();if(error||!x)return toast(error?.message||'Entrega não encontrada.','error');
 const {data:f}=await sb.from('tic_feedback').select('id,comment,grade,private_note,improvement_skill,improvement_link,created_at').eq('submission_id',submissionId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();
 openFeedbackForm(x,f);
}
async function saveFeedback(e,submissionId,taskAssignmentId,studentId){
 e.preventDefault();const grade=$('fbGrade')?.value.trim();const comment=$('fbComment')?.value.trim()||null;const private_note=$('fbPrivate')?.value==='true';const improvement_skill=$('fbSkill')?.value||null;const improvement_link=$('fbImprovementLink')?.value.trim()||null;
 if(grade!==''&&(Number(grade)<0||Number(grade)>100))return toast('A nota deve ficar entre 0 e 100.','error');
 const payload={submission_id:submissionId,teacher_id:session.user.id,comment,grade:grade===''?null:Number(grade),private_note,improvement_skill,improvement_link};
 const {data:existing}=await sb.from('tic_feedback').select('id').eq('submission_id',submissionId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();const r=existing?await sb.from('tic_feedback').update(payload).eq('id',existing.id):await sb.from('tic_feedback').insert(payload);if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível salvar o feedback: '+r.error.message,'error');
 const tr=await sb.from('tic_submissions').update({grade:grade===''?null:Number(grade),status:'reviewed'}).eq('id',submissionId);if(tr.error)return toast('Feedback salvo, mas a entrega não foi atualizada: '+tr.error.message,'error');
 await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').update({status:'reviewed'}).eq('id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',studentId);closeModal();toast('Correção salva. A atribuição continua ativa.','success');loadView('feedback');
}


/* Student lesson: one real viewer, all resources, response, feedback, first completion. */
async function viewStudentLessonInteractive(id){
 const {data:l,error}=await sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').eq('id',id).eq('active',true).maybeSingle();
 if(error||!l)return toast(error?.message||'Lesson não encontrada.','error');
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;
 const {data:access}=await sb.from('tic_course_students').select('id').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('course_id',l.course_id).eq('status','active').maybeSingle();
 const {data:direct}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_assignments').select('id').eq('lesson_id',id).eq('student_id',s.id).eq('active',true).maybeSingle();
 if(!access&&!direct)return toast('Esta Lesson não está disponível para sua conta.','error');
 const {data:lp}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').select('*').eq('lesson_id',id).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();
 const now=new Date().toISOString();
 if(lp)await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').update({last_opened_at:now,open_count:Number(lp.open_count||0)+1,updated_at:now}).eq('id',lp.id);
 else await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').insert({lesson_id:id,student_id:s.id,last_opened_at:now,open_count:1,response_count:0});
 const {data:resp}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_responses').select('id,attempt,status,score,teacher_comment,improvement_skill,improvement_link,reviewed_at,response_text,created_at').eq('lesson_id',id).eq('student_id',s.id).order('attempt',{ascending:false});
 const latest=resp?.[0],completed=!!lp?.first_completed_at;
 const feedback=latest?.teacher_comment||latest?.score!=null?`<div class="notice success"><b>👨‍🏫 Feedback do Teacher</b>${latest.score!=null?`<div style="font-size:18px;font-weight:800;margin-top:5px">Nota: ${latest.score}</div>`:''}${latest.teacher_comment?`<div style="margin-top:7px;white-space:pre-wrap">${esc(latest.teacher_comment)}</div>`:''}${latest.improvement_skill||latest.improvement_link?`<div class="improvement-box" style="margin-top:10px"><b>🎯 Como melhorar</b>${latest.improvement_skill?`<div>Habilidade: <b>${esc(latest.improvement_skill)}</b></div>`:''}${latest.improvement_link?`<a class="btn secondary" style="margin-top:8px" href="${esc(ticSafeUrl(latest.improvement_link))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">🔗 Abrir material de melhoria</a>`:''}</div>`:''}</div>`:'';
 const content=l.content?`<div class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>📖 Conteúdo da Lesson</b><span class="badge blue">${completed?'Concluída':'Em estudo'}</span></div><iframe class="viewer-content-frame" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox" title="Conteúdo da Lesson"></iframe></div>`:'';
 const html=l.html_enabled&&l.html_content?`<div class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>🧩 Atividade HTML</b><span class="badge green">Interativa</span></div><div class="html-devicebar" style="padding:10px 14px"><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('desktop')">🖥 Desktop</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('tablet')">▣ Tablet</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('mobile')">📱 Mobile</button></div><div id="htmlViewerWrap" class="html-viewer-wrap desktop"><iframe id="htmlViewerFrame" class="viewer-html-frame" title="Atividade HTML" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox"></iframe></div><div id="htmlViewerStatus" class="viewer-status">Conteúdo carregado. Você pode realizar a atividade.</div>${l.allow_student_response?`<div class="viewer-response"><label><b>✍️ Resposta adicional</b></label><textarea id="lessonExternalResponse" placeholder="Você também pode enviar uma resposta escrita aqui."></textarea><div class="viewer-actions" style="padding:10px 0 0"><button class="btn primary" onclick="submitLessonExternalResponse('${l.id}')">📤 Enviar resposta</button></div></div>`:''}</div>`:'';
 const responseBox=l.allow_student_response&&!html?`<div class="viewer-response"><label><b>✍️ Sua resposta</b></label><textarea id="lessonExternalResponse" placeholder="Escreva sua resposta para o Teacher..."></textarea><div class="viewer-actions" style="padding:10px 0 0"><button class="btn primary" onclick="submitLessonExternalResponse('${l.id}')">📤 Enviar resposta</button></div></div>`:'';
 openModal(`📖 ${esc(l.title)}`,`<div class="lesson-viewer-shell"><div class="lesson-viewer-head"><div><span class="badge blue">${esc(l.level||s.current_level||'')}</span><h2>${esc(l.title)}</h2><small>${esc(l.skill||'Lesson')} · ${esc(l.lesson_type||'lesson')}</small><div class="lesson-viewer-meta"><span class="badge ${completed?'green':'yellow'}">${completed?'✓ Concluída na primeira realização':'Ainda não concluída'}</span>${latest?`<span class="badge gray">${resp.length} tentativa(s)</span>`:''}</div></div><span class="badge green">Acesso ativo</span></div>${content}${l.content?'<div class="viewer-status">O conteúdo acima é exibido em um viewer responsivo.</div>':''}${html}${responseBox}<div class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>📚 Recursos e links</b><span class="badge blue">Acesso direto</span></div>${ticRenderLessonResources(l)}</div>${feedback}<div class="viewer-actions"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Fechar</button>${completed?`<span class="badge green" style="padding:10px 13px">✓ Já concluída</span>`:`<button class="btn primary" onclick="markLessonCompleted('${l.id}')">✓ Marcar Lesson como concluída</button>`}</div></div>`);
 if(content){const f=document.querySelector('.modal-body iframe.viewer-content-frame');if(f)f.srcdoc=ticViewerTextFrame(l.content)}
 if(html){ticHtmlViewerContext={mode:'studentLesson',refId:l.id,html:l.html_content};const f=$('htmlViewerFrame');if(f)f.srcdoc=ticResponsiveSrcdoc(l.html_content)+ticHtmlBridge();}
}

async function submitLessonExternalResponse(lessonId){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;const text=$('lessonExternalResponse')?.value.trim()||'';if(!text)return toast('Digite uma resposta antes de enviar.','info');
 const {data:last}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_responses').select('attempt').eq('lesson_id',lessonId).eq('student_id',s.id).order('attempt',{ascending:false}).limit(1).maybeSingle();
 const attempt=Number(last?.attempt||0)+1;const now=new Date().toISOString();const r=await sb.from('tic_lesson_responses').insert({lesson_id:lessonId,student_id:s.id,attempt,response_text:text,response_data:{source:'external_text'},status:'submitted'});if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível enviar: '+r.error.message,'error');
 const {data:lp}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').select('id,first_completed_at,response_count').eq('lesson_id',lessonId).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();if(lp)await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').update({first_completed_at:lp.first_completed_at||now,response_count:Number(lp.response_count||0)+1,last_opened_at:now,updated_at:now}).eq('id',lp.id);else await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').insert({lesson_id:lessonId,student_id:s.id,first_completed_at:now,response_count:1,last_opened_at:now,open_count:1,updated_at:now});
 toast(`Resposta enviada. Tentativa ${attempt}.`,'success');viewStudentLessonInteractive(lessonId);
}

/* Interactive HTML messages: supports both Lesson and Task contexts. */
window.addEventListener('message',async e=>{
 const frame=$('htmlViewerFrame');if(!frame||e.source!==frame.contentWindow||e.data?.type!=='tic-html-submit')return;
 const ctx=window.ticHtmlViewerContext||ticHtmlViewerContext;if(!ctx)return;
 if(ctx.mode==='studentLesson'){await submitInteractiveLesson(ctx.refId,e.data.payload||{});return;}
 if(ctx.mode==='studentTask'){await submitInteractiveTask(ctx.refId,e.data.payload||{});return;}
});
async function submitInteractiveTask(taskAssignmentId,payload){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;const {data:ta,error}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,active,assignment_id').eq('id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();if(error||!ta||ta.active===false)return toast(error?.message||'Task não encontrada ou removida.','error');
 const {data:last}=await sb.from('tic_submissions').select('attempt').eq('task_assignment_id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',s.id).order('attempt',{ascending:false}).limit(1).maybeSingle();const attempt=Number(last?.attempt||0)+1;
 const r=await sb.from('tic_submissions').insert({task_assignment_id:taskAssignmentId,student_id:s.id,attempt,answer_text:payload.text||null,response_data:payload.fields||{},submitted_at:new Date().toISOString()});if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível enviar a Task: '+r.error.message,'error');
 await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').update({status:'submitted',completed_at:null}).eq('id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',s.id);if($('htmlViewerStatus'))$('htmlViewerStatus').innerHTML=`<b>✅ Enviado.</b> Tentativa ${attempt} registrada. A Task continua ativa.`;toast(`Task enviada. Tentativa ${attempt}.`,'success');
}

 const text=$('taskViewerText')?.value.trim()||'';if(!text)return toast('Digite sua resposta antes de enviar.','info');await submitInteractiveTask(taskAssignmentId,{text,fields:{source:'external_text'}});
}

 const content=l.content?`<div class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>📖 Conteúdo</b><span class="badge blue">Preview Teacher</span></div><iframe id="teacherLessonContentFrame" class="viewer-content-frame" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox" title="Preview da Lesson"></iframe></div>`:'';
 const html=l.html_enabled&&l.html_content?`<div class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>🧩 HTML interativo</b><span class="badge green">Preview</span></div><div class="html-devicebar" style="padding:10px 14px"><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('desktop')">🖥</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('tablet')">▣</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticResizeViewer('mobile')">📱</button></div><div id="htmlViewerWrap" class="html-viewer-wrap desktop"><iframe id="htmlViewerFrame" class="viewer-html-frame" title="Preview HTML" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox"></iframe></div><div class="viewer-status">Preview do Teacher: a atividade é exibida exatamente no mesmo viewer do aluno.</div></div>`:'';
