 openModal(`📖 ${esc(l.title)}`,`<div class="lesson-viewer-shell"><div class="lesson-viewer-head"><div><span class="badge blue">${esc(l.level||'')}</span><h2>${esc(l.title)}</h2><small>${esc(l.skill||'')} · ${esc(l.lesson_type||'lesson')}</small></div><span class="badge ${l.html_enabled?'green':'gray'}">${l.html_enabled?'🧩 HTML ativo':'Lesson'}</span></div>${content}${html}<div class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>📚 Recursos e links</b></div>${ticRenderLessonResources(l)}</div><div class="viewer-actions"><button class="btn secondary" onclick="openAssignLessonById('${l.id}')">📤 Atribuir Lesson</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="openLessonFormById('${l.id}')">✏️ Editar</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Fechar</button></div></div>`);
 if(content){const f=$('teacherLessonContentFrame');if(f)f.srcdoc=ticViewerTextFrame(l.content)}
 if(html){ticHtmlViewerContext={mode:'preview',refId:l.id,html:l.html_content};const f=$('htmlViewerFrame');if(f)f.srcdoc=ticResponsiveSrcdoc(l.html_content)+ticHtmlBridge()}
}

/* Teacher feedback: latest submission per active assignment, quick filtering and complete correction. */
async function feedbackPage(){
 const {data:tas,error}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,assignment_id,student_id,status,active,removed_at,assigned_at,completed_at,tic_assignments(id,title,due_at,assignment_type,points),tic_students(display_name,email)').order('assigned_at',{ascending:false});
 if(error){$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention"><b>Não foi possível carregar as atividades.</b><p>${esc(error.message)}</p></div>`;return}
 const ids=(tas||[]).map(x=>x.id);let subs=[];if(ids.length){const r=await sb.from('tic_submissions').select('id,task_assignment_id,student_id,answer_text,file_url,audio_url,video_url,submitted_at,attempt,grade,response_data').in('task_assignment_id',ids).order('submitted_at',{ascending:false});if(r.error)return $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention"><b>Não foi possível carregar as entregas.</b><p>${esc(r.error.message)}</p></div>`;subs=r.data||[]}
 const latestMap=new Map();subs.forEach(x=>{if(!latestMap.has(x.task_assignment_id))latestMap.set(x.task_assignment_id,x)});
 const latest=[...latestMap.values()];const awaiting=latest.filter(x=>x.grade==null).length;const corrected=latest.filter(x=>x.grade!=null).length;const active=(tas||[]).filter(x=>x.active!==false).length;const noDelivery=(tas||[]).filter(x=>!latestMap.has(x.id)&&x.active!==false).length;
 const rows=(tas||[]).map(t=>{const sub=latestMap.get(t.id),status=!sub?'Aguardando entrega':sub.grade!=null?'Corrigida':'Aguardando correção';const cls=!sub?'gray':sub.grade!=null?'green':'yellow';return `<article class="correction-card"><div class="correction-top"><div><b>👤 ${esc(t.tic_students?.display_name||'Aluno')}</b><small style="display:block">${esc(t.tic_assignments?.title||'Task')} · atribuição ${t.active===false?'removida':'ativa'}</small>${sub?`<small style="display:block">Tentativa ${sub.attempt||1} · ${fmtDate(sub.submitted_at)}</small>`:''}</div><span class="badge ${cls}">${status}</span></div>${sub?.answer_text?`<div class="correction-answer"><b>Resposta:</b><br>${esc(sub.answer_text)}</div>`:''}${sub?.file_url?`<div class="correction-actions"><a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(ticSafeUrl(sub.file_url))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">📎 Abrir arquivo/link</a></div>`:''}<div class="correction-actions">${sub?`<button class="btn primary" onclick="openFeedbackFromId('${sub.id}')">📝 ${sub.grade!=null?'Editar correção':'Corrigir e dar nota'}</button>`:'<span class="badge gray">Aluno ainda não enviou</span>'}${t.active!==false?`<button class="btn ghost" onclick="removeTaskAssignment('${t.id}','${t.student_id}','${esc(t.tic_students?.display_name||'Aluno')}')">🗑 Remover atribuição</button>`:''}<button class="btn secondary" onclick="openStudentTaskTeacherView('${t.id}')">👁 Ver Task</button></div></article>`}).join('');
 setPage('Feedback & Corrections','Corrija entregas, dê nota e envie orientações individuais.');$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="feedback-grid"><div class="feedback-stat"><b>${active}</b><small>Atribuições ativas</small></div><div class="feedback-stat"><b>${awaiting}</b><small>Aguardando correção</small></div><div class="feedback-stat"><b>${corrected}</b><small>Com nota</small></div><div class="feedback-stat"><b>${noDelivery}</b><small>Aguardando entrega</small></div></div><div class="card"><div class="notice">📌 <b>Fluxo:</b> aluno envia → Teacher corrige → nota + comentário + habilidade + link de melhoria → aluno visualiza. Corrigir a entrega <b>não remove a atribuição</b>.</div><div class="section-head"><div><h2>Entregas</h2><span>O histórico de tentativas permanece disponível.</span></div></div>${rows||'<div class="empty">Nenhuma atribuição encontrada.</div>'}</div>`;
}
async function openStudentTaskTeacherView(taskAssignmentId){
 const {data:x,error}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,student_id,assignment_id,tic_assignments(id,title,instructions,resource_items,html_enabled,html_content)').eq('id',taskAssignmentId).maybeSingle();if(error||!x)return toast(error?.message||'Task não encontrada.','error');const a=x.tic_assignments||{};openModal(`👁 ${esc(a.title||'Task')}`,`<div class="task-viewer-shell"><div class="notice"><b>Visualização do Teacher</b><br>${esc(a.instructions||'')}</div>${a.html_enabled&&a.html_content?`<div class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>🧩 HTML</b></div><iframe id="htmlViewerFrame" class="viewer-html-frame" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox"></iframe></div>`:''}<div class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>📚 Recursos</b></div>${ticRenderLessonResources(a)}</div></div>`);if(a.html_enabled&&a.html_content){ticHtmlViewerContext={mode:'preview',refId:x.id,html:a.html_content};const f=$('htmlViewerFrame');if(f)f.srcdoc=ticResponsiveSrcdoc(a.html_content)+ticHtmlBridge()}}
</script>

<style>
/* TIC FINAL — connected lesson/task viewer */
.tic-full-viewer{display:grid;gap:14px}.tic-viewer-content{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e8e3f0;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden}.tic-viewer-content iframe{display:block;width:100%;height:620px;border:0;background:#fff}.tic-viewer-content.tic-mobile iframe{width:390px;max-width:100%;margin:auto;height:700px}.tic-viewer-content.tic-tablet iframe{width:768px;max-width:100%;margin:auto;height:650px}.tic-viewer-toolbar{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}.tic-viewer-toolbar .devices{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}.tic-resource-card{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:12px;border:1px solid #ebe6f2;border-radius:12px;background:#fff}.tic-resource-card small{display:block;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px}.tic-answer-box{display:grid;gap:10px}.tic-attempt{border:1px solid #ebe6f2;border-radius:12px;padding:12px;background:#faf9fd}.tic-feedback-card{border:1px solid #cfeee0;background:#f2fcf7;border-radius:14px;padding:14px}.tic-feedback-card .score{font:800 25px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin:5px 0}.tic-task-state{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}.tic-course-link{cursor:pointer}.tic-course-link:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
@media(max-width:700px){.tic-viewer-content iframe{height:520px}.tic-resource-card{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.tic-viewer-toolbar{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}}
</style>

<script>
/* TIC v14 — safe lesson actions + text renderer */
async function openLessonFormById(id){
  const {data,error}=await sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').eq('id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();
  if(error||!data)return toast(error?.message||'Lesson não encontrada.','error');
  return openLessonForm(data);
}
async function openAssignLessonById(id){
  const {data,error}=await sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').eq('id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();
  if(error||!data)return toast(error?.message||'Lesson não encontrada.','error');
  return openAssignContent('lesson',data);
}
function ticLessonPreviewText(value,max=65){
  const raw=String(value??'').replace(/<[^>]*>/g,' ').replace(/&nbsp;/gi,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim();
  return raw.slice(0,max);
}
function ticPlainOrHtmlFrame(value){
  const c=String(value??'').trim();
  if(!c)return '';
  const looksHtml=/<(?:!doctype\s+html|html\b|body\b|head\b|div\b|p\b|h[1-6]\b|ul\b|ol\b|li\b|table\b|thead\b|tbody\b|tr\b|td\b|span\b|strong\b|em\b|a\b|img\b|section\b|article\b|br\b)[^>]*>/i.test(c);
  const css=`<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,maximum-scale=1"><style>
    *{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;padding:0;background:#fff;color:#242233}
    body{font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-size:16px;line-height:1.7;padding:26px;overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:normal}
    img{max-width:100%;height:auto;border-radius:10px}table{width:100%;max-width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;display:block;overflow-x:auto}
    th,td{padding:8px;border:1px solid #e7e3ee;text-align:left}a{overflow-wrap:anywhere}
    h1,h2,h3,h4{line-height:1.25;margin:1.1em 0 .55em}p{margin:.55em 0}ul,ol{padding-left:1.5em}
  </style>`;
  if(looksHtml){
    if(/<html[\s>]/i.test(c)){
      return c.replace(/<head([^>]*)>/i,`<head$1>${css}`);
    }
    return `<!doctype html><html><head>${css}</head><body>${c}</body></html>`;
  }
  return `<!doctype html><html><head>${css}</head><body><div style="white-space:pre-wrap">${esc(c)}</div></body></html>`;
}

/* TIC FINAL CONNECTIVITY LAYER — appended intentionally so it overrides broken/legacy viewer versions without removing existing features. */
function ticFrameHtml(content){ const c=String(content||'').trim(); return c ? ticPlainOrHtmlFrame(c) : ''; }
function ticViewerDevices(targetId='ticViewerFrame',wrapId='ticViewerWrap'){
 const w=$(wrapId); if(!w)return '';
 return `<div class="tic-viewer-toolbar"><div class="devices"><button type="button" class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticSetViewerDevice('desktop','${wrapId}')">🖥 Desktop</button><button type="button" class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticSetViewerDevice('tablet','${wrapId}')">▣ Tablet</button><button type="button" class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticSetViewerDevice('mobile','${wrapId}')">📱 Mobile</button></div></div>`;
}
function ticSetViewerDevice(device,wrapId){const w=$(wrapId);if(!w)return;w.className='tic-viewer-content '+(device==='mobile'?'tic-mobile':device==='tablet'?'tic-tablet':'');}
function ticRenderResourcesFinal(x){
 const arr=[];
 if(x?.video_url)arr.push({type:'video',title:'Vídeo principal',url:x.video_url});
 if(x?.audio_url)arr.push({type:'audio',title:'Áudio principal',url:x.audio_url});
 if(x?.pdf_url)arr.push({type:'pdf',title:'PDF principal',url:x.pdf_url});
 if(Array.isArray(x?.resource_items))arr.push(...x.resource_items);
 const seen=new Set(), list=arr.filter(a=>{const u=ticSafeUrl(a?.url||a?.value||'');if(!u||seen.has(u))return false;seen.add(u);return true});
 if(!list.length)return '<div class="empty">Nenhum recurso adicional cadastrado.</div>';
 return `<div style="display:grid;gap:8px">${list.map(a=>{const u=ticSafeUrl(a.url||a.value||'');const type=String(a.type||'link').toLowerCase();const icon=type==='pdf'?'📄':type==='video'?'🎥':type==='audio'?'🎧':type==='file'?'📎':'🔗';return `<div class="tic-resource-card"><div><b>${icon} ${esc(a.title||a.name||'Recurso')}</b>${a.description?`<small>${esc(a.description)}</small>`:''}</div><a class="btn sm secondary" href="${esc(u)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Abrir →</a></div>`}).join('')}</div>`;
}
async function ticMarkLessonOpen(id,s){
 const now=new Date().toISOString();
 const {data:lp}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').select('*').eq('lesson_id',id).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();
 if(lp){await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').update({last_opened_at:now,open_count:Number(lp.open_count||0)+1,updated_at:now}).eq('id',lp.id);return lp;}
 const {data:n}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').insert({lesson_id:id,student_id:s.id,last_opened_at:now,open_count:1,response_count:0,}).select().single();return n;
}
async function markLessonCompleted(lessonId){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;
 const now=new Date().toISOString();
 const {data:lp}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').select('id,first_completed_at').eq('lesson_id',lessonId).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();
 let r;
 if(lp)r=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').update({first_completed_at:lp.first_completed_at||now,updated_at:now}).eq('id',lp.id);
 else r=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').insert({lesson_id:lessonId,student_id:s.id,first_completed_at:now,open_count:1,response_count:0});
 if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível registrar a conclusão: '+r.error.message,'error');
 toast('Lesson concluída. Ela continua disponível para você refazer quando quiser.','success');
 viewStudentLessonInteractive(lessonId);
}
async function viewStudentLessonInteractive(id){
 const {data:l,error}=await sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').eq('id',id).eq('active',true).maybeSingle();
 if(error||!l)return toast(error?.message||'Lesson não encontrada.','error');
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;
 const {data:courseAccess}=l.course_id?await sb.from('tic_course_students').select('id').eq('course_id',l.course_id).eq('student_id',s.id).eq('status','active').maybeSingle():{data:null};
 const {data:direct}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_assignments').select('id').eq('lesson_id',id).eq('student_id',s.id).eq('active',true).maybeSingle();
 if(!courseAccess&&!direct)return toast('Esta Lesson não está disponível para sua conta.','error');
 const lp=await ticMarkLessonOpen(id,s);
 const {data:resp}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_responses').select('id,attempt,status,score,response_text,teacher_comment,improvement_skill,improvement_link,reviewed_at,created_at').eq('lesson_id',id).eq('student_id',s.id).order('attempt',{ascending:false});
 const completed=!!lp?.first_completed_at; const latest=resp?.[0];
 const content=l.content?`<section class="tic-viewer-content" id="ticLessonContentWrap"><iframe id="ticLessonContentFrame" title="Conteúdo da Lesson" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox"></iframe></section>`:'';
 const html=l.html_enabled&&l.html_content?`<section><div class="tic-viewer-toolbar"><b>🧩 Atividade HTML interativa</b><span class="badge green">Responsiva</span></div><div class="tic-viewer-toolbar"><div class="devices"><button type="button" class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticSetViewerDevice('desktop','ticLessonHtmlWrap')">🖥 Desktop</button><button type="button" class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticSetViewerDevice('tablet','ticLessonHtmlWrap')">▣ Tablet</button><button type="button" class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticSetViewerDevice('mobile','ticLessonHtmlWrap')">📱 Mobile</button></div></div><div class="tic-viewer-content" id="ticLessonHtmlWrap"><iframe id="ticLessonHtmlFrame" title="Atividade HTML da Lesson" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox"></iframe></div><div id="ticLessonStatus" class="notice">Você pode realizar a atividade e enviar sua resposta dentro do conteúdo.</div></section>`:'';
 const response=l.allow_student_response?`<section class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>✍️ Resposta ao Teacher</b><span class="badge blue">Tentativas ilimitadas</span></div><div class="tic-answer-box"><textarea id="lessonExternalResponse" placeholder="Escreva uma resposta para o Teacher..."></textarea><button class="btn primary" onclick="submitLessonExternalResponse('${l.id}')">📤 Enviar resposta</button></div></section>`:'';
 const feedback=latest&&(latest.teacher_comment||latest.score!=null)?`<section class="tic-feedback-card"><b>👨‍🏫 Feedback do Teacher</b>${latest.score!=null?`<div class="score">${latest.score}/100</div>`:''}${latest.teacher_comment?`<div style="white-space:pre-wrap;line-height:1.6">${esc(latest.teacher_comment)}</div>`:''}${latest.improvement_skill||latest.improvement_link?`<div class="improvement-box"><b>🎯 Como melhorar</b>${latest.improvement_skill?`<div>Habilidade: <b>${esc(latest.improvement_skill)}</b></div>`:''}${latest.improvement_link?`<a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(ticSafeUrl(latest.improvement_link))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">🔗 Abrir material</a>`:''}</div>`:''}</section>`:'';
 const history=(resp||[]).length?`<section class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>🔄 Histórico</b></div>${resp.map(r=>`<div class="tic-attempt"><b>Tentativa ${r.attempt}</b><small>${fmtDate(r.created_at)} · ${esc(r.status||'submitted')}</small>${r.score!=null?`<div><b>Nota:</b> ${r.score}</div>`:''}${r.response_text?`<div style="white-space:pre-wrap;margin-top:6px">${esc(r.response_text)}</div>`:''}</div>`).join('')}</section>`:'';
 openModal(`📖 ${esc(l.title)}`,`<div class="tic-full-viewer"><div class="lesson-student-header"><div><span class="badge blue">${esc(l.level||s.current_level||'')}</span><h2>${esc(l.title)}</h2><small>${esc(l.skill||'Lesson')} · ${esc(l.lesson_type||'lesson')}</small></div><div class="tic-task-state"><span class="badge ${completed?'green':'yellow'}">${completed?'✓ Concluída na primeira vez':'Não concluída'}</span><span class="badge green">Acesso ativo</span></div></div>${content}${l.content?'<div class="viewer-status">Conteúdo da Lesson</div>':''}${html}${response}<section class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>📚 Recursos e links</b></div>${ticRenderResourcesFinal(l)}</section>${feedback}${history}<div class="viewer-actions"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Fechar</button>${!completed?`<button class="btn primary" onclick="markLessonCompleted('${l.id}')">✓ Marcar como concluída</button>`:`<span class="badge green" style="padding:10px 13px">✓ Concluída — pode refazer</span>`}</div></div>`);
 if(content){const f=$('ticLessonContentFrame');if(f)f.srcdoc=ticPlainOrHtmlFrame(l.content)}
 if(html){const f=$('ticLessonHtmlFrame');if(f)f.srcdoc=ticFrameHtml(l.html_content)+ticHtmlBridge();}
}
async function submitLessonExternalResponse(lessonId){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;const el=$('lessonExternalResponse');const text=el?.value.trim()||'';if(!text)return toast('Digite uma resposta antes de enviar.','info');
 const {data:last}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_responses').select('attempt').eq('lesson_id',lessonId).eq('student_id',s.id).order('attempt',{ascending:false}).limit(1).maybeSingle();const attempt=Number(last?.attempt||0)+1;
 const r=await sb.from('tic_lesson_responses').insert({lesson_id:lessonId,student_id:s.id,attempt,response_text:text,response_data:{source:'external_text'},status:'submitted'});if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível enviar: '+r.error.message,'error');
 const now=new Date().toISOString();const {data:lp}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').select('id,first_completed_at,response_count').eq('lesson_id',lessonId).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();
 if(lp)await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').update({first_completed_at:lp.first_completed_at||now,response_count:Number(lp.response_count||0)+1,last_opened_at:now,updated_at:now}).eq('id',lp.id);else await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').insert({lesson_id:lessonId,student_id:s.id,first_completed_at:now,last_opened_at:now,response_count:1,open_count:1});
 toast(`Resposta enviada. Tentativa ${attempt}.`,'success');viewStudentLessonInteractive(lessonId);
}
async function submitInteractiveLesson(lessonId,payload){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;const {data:l,error}=await sb.from('tic_lessons').select('id,allow_student_response,active').eq('id',lessonId).eq('active',true).maybeSingle();if(error||!l)return toast(error?.message||'Lesson não encontrada.','error');if(l.allow_student_response===false)return toast('O Teacher não ativou respostas nesta Lesson.','info');
 const {data:last}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_responses').select('attempt').eq('lesson_id',lessonId).eq('student_id',s.id).order('attempt',{ascending:false}).limit(1).maybeSingle();const attempt=Number(last?.attempt||0)+1;
 const r=await sb.from('tic_lesson_responses').insert({lesson_id:lessonId,student_id:s.id,attempt,response_data:payload.fields||{},response_text:payload.text||null,status:'submitted'});if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível enviar sua resposta: '+r.error.message,'error');
 const now=new Date().toISOString();const {data:lp}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').select('id,first_completed_at,response_count').eq('lesson_id',lessonId).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();if(lp)await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').update({first_completed_at:lp.first_completed_at||now,response_count:Number(lp.response_count||0)+1,last_opened_at:now,updated_at:now}).eq('id',lp.id);else await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').insert({lesson_id:lessonId,student_id:s.id,first_completed_at:now,last_opened_at:now,response_count:1,open_count:1});if($('ticLessonStatus'))$('ticLessonStatus').innerHTML=`<b>✅ Resposta enviada.</b> Tentativa ${attempt}. A Lesson continua disponível para refazer.`;toast('Resposta da Lesson enviada.','success');
}
async function submitInteractiveTask(taskAssignmentId,payload){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;const {data:ta,error}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,active,assignment_id').eq('id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();if(error||!ta||ta.active===false)return toast(error?.message||'Task não encontrada ou removida.','error');
 const {data:a}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').select('allow_multiple_attempts,active').eq('id',ta.assignment_id).maybeSingle();if(a?.active===false)return toast('Esta Task foi desativada pelo Teacher.','error');
 if(a?.allow_multiple_attempts===false){const {data:already}=await sb.from('tic_submissions').select('id').eq('task_assignment_id',ta.id).eq('student_id',s.id).limit(1);if(already?.length)return toast('Esta Task permite apenas uma tentativa.','info');}
 const {data:last}=await sb.from('tic_submissions').select('attempt').eq('task_assignment_id',ta.id).eq('student_id',s.id).order('attempt',{ascending:false}).limit(1).maybeSingle();const attempt=Number(last?.attempt||0)+1;
 const r=await sb.from('tic_submissions').insert({task_assignment_id:ta.id,student_id:s.id,attempt,answer_text:payload.text||null,response_data:payload.fields||{},submitted_at:new Date().toISOString(),status:'submitted'});if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível enviar a Task: '+r.error.message,'error');
 await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').update({status:'submitted',completed_at:null}).eq('id',ta.id).eq('student_id',s.id);toast(`Task enviada. Tentativa ${attempt}.`,'success');if($('htmlViewerStatus'))$('htmlViewerStatus').innerHTML=`<b>✅ Enviada.</b> Tentativa ${attempt} registrada. A atribuição continua ativa.`;
}
async function submitTaskViewerText(id){const t=$('taskViewerText')?.value.trim()||'';if(!t)return toast('Digite sua resposta antes de enviar.','info');await submitInteractiveTask(id,{text:t,fields:{source:'external_text'}})}
async function openStudentTaskViewer(taskAssignmentId){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;const {data:x,error}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,active,assignment_id,status,tic_assignments(id,title,instructions,due_at,points,html_enabled,html_content,allow_multiple_attempts,cover_image_url,resource_items,lesson_id)').eq('id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();
 if(error||!x||x.active===false)return toast(error?.message||'Task não encontrada ou removida.','error');const a=x.tic_assignments||{};
 const {data:subs}=await sb.from('tic_submissions').select('id,attempt,grade,submitted_at,answer_text,file_url,audio_url,video_url,response_data,status').eq('task_assignment_id',x.id).eq('student_id',s.id).order('attempt',{ascending:false});
 const latest=subs?.[0];const fids=(subs||[]).map(q=>q.id);const {data:fbs}=fids.length?await sb.from('tic_feedback').select('id,submission_id,comment,grade,private_note,improvement_skill,improvement_link,created_at').in('submission_id',fids).order('created_at',{ascending:false}):{data:[]};const fb=latest?fbs?.find(q=>q.submission_id===latest.id):null;
 const html=a.html_enabled&&a.html_content?`<div class="tic-viewer-toolbar"><b>🧩 Atividade HTML</b><span class="badge green">Interativa</span></div><div class="tic-viewer-toolbar"><div class="devices"><button type="button" class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticSetViewerDevice('desktop','ticTaskHtmlWrap')">🖥 Desktop</button><button type="button" class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticSetViewerDevice('tablet','ticTaskHtmlWrap')">▣ Tablet</button><button type="button" class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticSetViewerDevice('mobile','ticTaskHtmlWrap')">📱 Mobile</button></div></div><div class="tic-viewer-content" id="ticTaskHtmlWrap"><iframe id="ticTaskHtmlFrame" title="Task HTML" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox"></iframe></div><div id="htmlViewerStatus" class="notice">Responda no conteúdo HTML e use Enviar/Submit.</div>`:'';
 const plain=`<div class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>✍️ Sua resposta</b><span class="badge blue">${a.allow_multiple_attempts===false?'1 tentativa':'Tentativas múltiplas'}</span></div>${a.instructions?`<div style="white-space:pre-wrap;line-height:1.6">${esc(a.instructions)}</div>`:''}<textarea id="taskViewerText" placeholder="Escreva sua resposta para o Teacher..."></textarea><button class="btn primary" onclick="submitTaskViewerText('${x.id}')">📤 Enviar para o Teacher</button></div>`;
 const feedback=fb&&!fb.private_note?`<div class="tic-feedback-card"><b>👨‍🏫 Correção do Teacher</b>${fb.grade!=null?`<div class="score">${fb.grade}/100</div>`:''}<div style="white-space:pre-wrap;line-height:1.6">${esc(fb.comment||'Sem comentário.')}</div>${fb.improvement_skill||fb.improvement_link?`<div class="improvement-box"><b>🎯 Como melhorar</b>${fb.improvement_skill?`<div>Habilidade: <b>${esc(fb.improvement_skill)}</b></div>`:''}${fb.improvement_link?`<a class="btn secondary" href="${esc(ticSafeUrl(fb.improvement_link))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">🔗 Abrir melhoria</a>`:''}</div>`:''}</div>`:'';
 const hist=(subs||[]).map(z=>{const zf=fbs?.find(q=>q.submission_id===z.id);return `<div class="tic-attempt"><b>Tentativa ${z.attempt||1}</b><small>${fmtDate(z.submitted_at)} · ${z.grade!=null?'Nota '+z.grade:(zf?'Corrigida':'Aguardando correção')}</small>${z.answer_text?`<div style="white-space:pre-wrap;margin-top:6px">${esc(z.answer_text)}</div>`:''}</div>`}).join('')||'<div class="empty">Nenhuma entrega ainda.</div>';
 openModal(`📝 ${esc(a.title||'Task')}`,`<div class="tic-full-viewer"><div class="task-view-head"><div class="tic-task-state"><span class="badge green">🔓 Atribuição ativa</span><span class="badge gray">${a.due_at?'Prazo: '+fmtDate(a.due_at):'Sem prazo'}</span><span class="badge blue">${a.points||0} pontos</span></div><h2>${esc(a.title||'Task')}</h2></div>${html}${plain}<section class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>📚 Recursos</b></div>${ticRenderResourcesFinal(a)}</section>${feedback}<section class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>🔄 Histórico de tentativas</b></div>${hist}</section><div class="notice success">💡 Corrigir a Task não encerra a atribuição. Você pode refazer enquanto o Teacher mantiver o acesso.</div><div class="viewer-actions"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Fechar</button></div></div>`);
 if(html){const f=$('ticTaskHtmlFrame');if(f)f.srcdoc=ticFrameHtml(a.html_content)+ticHtmlBridge();}
}
async function openStudentTaskTeacherView(taskAssignmentId){
 const {data:x,error}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,student_id,assignment_id,tic_assignments(id,title,instructions,resource_items,html_enabled,html_content)').eq('id',taskAssignmentId).maybeSingle();if(error||!x)return toast(error?.message||'Task não encontrada.','error');const a=x.tic_assignments||{};
 const {data:subs}=await sb.from('tic_submissions').select('id,attempt,answer_text,file_url,audio_url,video_url,submitted_at,grade,response_data,status').eq('task_assignment_id',x.id).eq('student_id',x.student_id).order('attempt',{ascending:false});
 openModal(`👁 ${esc(a.title||'Task')}`,`<div class="tic-full-viewer"><div class="notice"><b>Visualização do Teacher</b><br>${esc(a.instructions||'')}</div>${a.html_enabled&&a.html_content?`<div class="tic-viewer-toolbar"><b>🧩 HTML</b><span class="badge green">Preview</span></div><div class="tic-viewer-content" id="ticTeacherTaskHtmlWrap"><iframe id="ticTeacherTaskHtmlFrame" title="Task HTML" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox"></iframe></div>`:''}<section class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>📚 Recursos</b></div>${ticRenderResourcesFinal(a)}</section><section class="viewer-panel"><div class="viewer-panel-head"><b>📨 Entregas</b></div>${(subs||[]).map(z=>`<div class="tic-attempt"><b>Tentativa ${z.attempt||1}</b><small>${fmtDate(z.submitted_at)} · ${z.grade!=null?'Nota '+z.grade:'Sem nota'}</small>${z.answer_text?`<div style="white-space:pre-wrap;margin-top:6px">${esc(z.answer_text)}</div>`:''}</div>`).join('')||'<div class="empty">Nenhuma entrega.</div>'}</section></div>`);
 if(a.html_enabled&&a.html_content){const f=$('ticTeacherTaskHtmlFrame');if(f)f.srcdoc=ticFrameHtml(a.html_content)+ticHtmlBridge();}
}
async function openFeedbackFromId(submissionId){
 const {data:x,error}=await sb.from('tic_submissions').select('id,task_assignment_id,student_id,answer_text,file_url,audio_url,video_url,submitted_at,attempt,grade,status,tic_students(display_name,email)').eq('id',submissionId).maybeSingle();if(error||!x)return toast(error?.message||'Entrega não encontrada.','error');
 const {data:f}=await sb.from('tic_feedback').select('id,comment,grade,private_note,improvement_skill,improvement_link,created_at').eq('submission_id',submissionId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();
 openFeedbackForm(x,f);
}
async function saveFeedback(e,submissionId,taskAssignmentId,studentId){
 e.preventDefault();const grade=$('fbGrade')?.value.trim();const comment=$('fbComment')?.value.trim()||null;const private_note=$('fbPrivate')?.value==='true';const improvement_skill=$('fbSkill')?.value||null;const improvement_link=$('fbImprovementLink')?.value.trim()||null;
 if(grade!==''&&(Number(grade)<0||Number(grade)>100))return toast('A nota deve ficar entre 0 e 100.','error');
 const payload={submission_id:submissionId,teacher_id:session.user.id,comment,grade:grade===''?null:Number(grade),private_note,improvement_skill,improvement_link};
 const {data:existing}=await sb.from('tic_feedback').select('id').eq('submission_id',submissionId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();const r=existing?await sb.from('tic_feedback').update(payload).eq('id',existing.id):await sb.from('tic_feedback').insert(payload);if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível salvar o feedback: '+r.error.message,'error');
 const tr=await sb.from('tic_submissions').update({grade:grade===''?null:Number(grade),status:'reviewed'}).eq('id',submissionId);if(tr.error)return toast('Feedback salvo, mas a entrega não foi atualizada: '+tr.error.message,'error');
 await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').update({status:'reviewed'}).eq('id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',studentId);closeModal();toast('Correção salva. A atribuição continua ativa.','success');loadView('feedback');
}
</script>
<style>
/* ===== TIC v11 — ORDERED CURRICULUM ===== */
.tic-order-panel{margin:0 0 16px}.tic-order-header{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}.tic-order-list{display:grid;gap:8px;margin-top:12px;max-height:62vh;overflow:auto}.tic-order-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:28px 38px 1fr auto;gap:9px;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;background:#fff;padding:10px;cursor:grab}.tic-order-item.dragging{opacity:.4}.tic-order-handle{color:#aaa;font-size:18px}.tic-order-num{width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:9px;background:#eee8ff;color:var(--p);display:grid;place-items:center;font-weight:900;font-size:11px}.tic-order-copy b{font-size:12px}.tic-order-copy small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;margin-top:3px}.tic-order-actions{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap}.tic-curriculum-sort{display:grid;gap:10px;margin-top:12px}.tic-module-sort{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:15px;background:#fff;overflow:hidden}.tic-module-sort-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:28px 32px 1fr auto;gap:8px;align-items:center;padding:12px;background:#faf9fd;cursor:grab}.tic-module-sort-head.dragging{opacity:.45}.tic-module-lessons-sort{padding:8px 12px 12px;display:grid;gap:6px;min-height:44px}.tic-lesson-sort{display:grid;grid-template-columns:24px 28px 1fr auto;gap:8px;align-items:center;border:1px solid #eeeaf4;border-radius:10px;padding:8px;background:#fff;cursor:grab}.tic-lesson-sort.dragging{opacity:.45}.tic-drop-zone{outline:2px dashed #a98be9;outline-offset:-3px;background:#faf7ff}.tic-sort-muted{color:var(--muted);font-size:10px}.tic-course-track-badge{margin-top:5px}.tic-student-course-order{display:grid;gap:12px}.tic-student-course-order .student-course-hero{order:initial}.tic-course-order-chip{font-size:10px;color:var(--p);font-weight:800;background:#f0eaff;border-radius:99px;padding:5px 8px;white-space:nowrap}
@media(max-width:760px){.tic-order-item{grid-template-columns:22px 30px 1fr}.tic-order-item>.badge{grid-column:3}.tic-order-actions{grid-column:3}.tic-module-sort-head{grid-template-columns:22px 28px 1fr}.tic-lesson-sort{grid-template-columns:20px 25px 1fr}.tic-lesson-sort .tic-order-actions{grid-column:3}}
</style>
<script>
/* ================================================================
   COURSE ORDER: A0 → A1 → A2 → B1... controlled by Teacher.
   Existing courses are preserved. New courses are appended to the
   current principal Track automatically.
   ================================================================ */
const TIC_CEFR_ORDER_V11=['A0','A1','A2','B1','B2','C1','C2'];
let ticCourseDragV11=null, ticModuleDragV11=null, ticLessonDragV11=null;
function ticLevelRankV11(v){const i=TIC_CEFR_ORDER_V11.indexOf(String(v||'').toUpperCase());return i<0?999:i}
async function ticEnsureDefaultTrackV11(){
 const uid=await ticTeacherAuthIdV12();
 let r=await sb.from('tic_course_tracks').select('*').eq('teacher_id',uid).eq('active',true).order('is_default',{ascending:false}).order('created_at',{ascending:true}).limit(1);
 if(r.error)throw r.error;
 let track=r.data?.[0];
 if(!track){
   const cr=await sb.from('tic_course_tracks').insert({teacher_id:uid,name:'General English',description:'Sequência pedagógica dos cursos',is_default:true,active:true}).select().single();
   if(cr.error)throw cr.error;track=cr.data;
 }
 if(!track.is_default){
   const u=await sb.from('tic_course_tracks').update({is_default:false}).eq('teacher_id',uid);if(u.error)throw u.error;
   const d=await sb.from('tic_course_tracks').update({is_default:true}).eq('id',track.id).eq('teacher_id',uid);if(d.error)throw d.error;
   track={...track,is_default:true};
 }
 const {data:courses,error:ce}=await sb.from('tic_courses').select('id,title,level,created_at').eq('teacher_id',uid).eq('active',true);if(ce)throw ce;
 const {data:items,error:ie}=await sb.from('tic_course_track_items').select('course_id,position').eq('track_id',track.id);if(ie)throw ie;
 const have=new Set((items||[]).map(x=>x.course_id));
 const missing=(courses||[]).filter(c=>!have.has(c.id)).sort((a,b)=>ticLevelRankV11(a.level)-ticLevelRankV11(b.level)||new Date(a.created_at)-new Date(b.created_at));
 if(missing.length){
   let next=Math.max(0,...(items||[]).map(x=>Number(x.position)||0));
   const rows=missing.map(c=>({track_id:track.id,course_id:c.id,position:++next}));
   const ins=await sb.from('tic_course_track_items').insert(rows);if(ins.error)throw ins.error;
 }
 return track;
}

async function ticGetOrderedCoursesV11(){
 const track=await ticEnsureDefaultTrackV11();
 const [{data:courses,error:ce},{data:items,error:ie}]=await Promise.all([sb.from('tic_courses').select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id),sb.from('tic_course_track_items').select('course_id,position').eq('track_id',track.id)]);if(ce||ie)throw(ce||ie);
 const pos=new Map((items||[]).map(x=>[x.course_id,Number(x.position)||999999]));
 return {track,courses:(courses||[]).sort((a,b)=>{const ap=pos.get(a.id)??999999,bp=pos.get(b.id)??999999;return ap-bp||ticLevelRankV11(a.level)-ticLevelRankV11(b.level)||String(a.title||'').localeCompare(String(b.title||''))})};
}
async function ticOpenCourseOrderV11(){
 const {track,courses}=await ticGetOrderedCoursesV11();
 openModal('🛤️ Organizar sequência dos cursos',`<div class="notice success"><b>${esc(track.name)}</b><br>Arraste os cursos para a ordem que você quiser. Você pode criar A0, A1, A2... depois voltar aqui e reposicionar quando quiser.</div><div id="ticCourseOrderList" class="tic-order-list">${courses.map((c,i)=>`<div class="tic-order-item" draggable="true" tabindex="0" data-course-id="${esc(c.id)}" ondragstart="ticStartCourseDragV11(event)" ondragover="event.preventDefault()" ondrop="ticDropCourseV11(event)"><span class="tic-order-handle">☰</span><span class="tic-order-num">${i+1}</span><div class="tic-order-copy"><b>${esc(c.title||c.name||'Curso')}</b><small>${esc(c.level||'')} · ${c.active===false?'Inativo':'Ativo'}</small></div><span class="tic-course-order-chip">${c.level||'—'}</span></div>`).join('')}</div><div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn ghost" type="button" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary" type="button" onclick="ticSaveCourseOrderV11('${track.id}')">💾 Salvar sequência</button></div>`);
}
function ticStartCourseDragV11(e){ticCourseDragV11=e.currentTarget.dataset.courseId;e.currentTarget.classList.add('dragging')}
function ticDropCourseV11(e){e.preventDefault();const target=e.currentTarget;if(!ticCourseDragV11||target.dataset.courseId===ticCourseDragV11)return;const list=$('ticCourseOrderList'),drag=[...list.children].find(x=>x.dataset.courseId===ticCourseDragV11);if(!drag)return;const rect=target.getBoundingClientRect();list.insertBefore(drag,e.clientY<rect.top+rect.height/2?target:target.nextSibling);[...list.children].forEach((x,i)=>x.querySelector('.tic-order-num').textContent=i+1);document.querySelectorAll('.tic-order-item').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('dragging'));ticCourseDragV11=null}
async function ticSaveCourseOrderV11(trackId){const ids=[...document.querySelectorAll('#ticCourseOrderList .tic-order-item')].map(x=>x.dataset.courseId);for(let i=0;i<ids.length;i++){const r=await sb.from('tic_course_track_items').update({position:i+1}).eq('track_id',trackId).eq('course_id',ids[i]);if(r.error)return toast('Erro ao salvar posição: '+r.error.message,'error')}closeModal();toast('Sequência dos cursos salva.','success');coursesPage()}
function ticCourseOptionsOrderedV11(selected=''){const cs=window.__ticCourses||[];return cs.slice().sort((a,b)=>ticLevelRankV11(a.level)-ticLevelRankV11(b.level)||String(a.title).localeCompare(String(b.title))).map(c=>`<option value="${c.id}" ${c.id===selected?'selected':''}>${esc(c.level||'')} · ${esc(c.title)}</option>`).join('')}

/* v12: always resolve the real Supabase Auth user before course writes. */
async function ticTeacherAuthIdV12(){
 const {data,error}=await sb.auth.getUser();
 if(error||!data?.user?.id) throw new Error('Sessão do Teacher não está autenticada. Atualize a página e entre novamente.');
 return data.user.id;
}

/* New course form: preserve fields, append new course to Track. */
function openCourseFormV11(x=null){openModal(x?'Editar curso':'Novo curso',`<form class="form" onsubmit="saveCourseV11(event,'${x?.id||''}')"><div class="field"><label>Título</label><input id="g1" value="${esc(x?.title||'')}" required></div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Nível</label><select id="g2">${levels.map(l=>`<option ${l===x?.level?'selected':''}>${l}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Descrição</label><textarea id="g3">${esc(x?.description||'')}</textarea></div></div><div class="notice">💡 Depois de salvar, o curso entra na sequência do Track. Você poderá reposicioná-lo em <b>Organizar sequência</b>.</div><div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">💾 Salvar curso</button></div></form>`)}
async function saveCourseV11(e,id){
 e.preventDefault();
 try{
   const uid=await ticTeacherAuthIdV12();
   const o={teacher_id:uid,title:$('g1').value.trim(),level:$('g2').value,description:$('g3').value.trim()||null};
   if(!o.title)return toast('Informe o título.','error');
   let r;
   if(id) r=await sb.from('tic_courses').update(o).eq('id',id).eq('teacher_id',uid);
   else r=await sb.from('tic_courses').insert(o).select().single();
   if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível salvar: '+r.error.message,'error');
   if(!id){
     const track=await ticEnsureDefaultTrackV11();
     const {data:last}=await sb.from('tic_course_track_items').select('position').eq('track_id',track.id).order('position',{ascending:false}).limit(1).maybeSingle();
     const nextPosition=Number(last?.position||0)+1;
     // A relação Track + Curso é UNIQUE. Use upsert para não gerar erro
     // quando o curso já estiver na sequência (por exemplo, após duplo clique
     // ou quando o registro foi criado antes e a etapa de vínculo foi repetida).
     const ir=await sb.from('tic_course_track_items').upsert(
       {track_id:track.id,course_id:r.data.id,position:nextPosition},
       {onConflict:'track_id,course_id'}
     );
     if(ir.error)return toast('Curso criado, mas não foi possível atualizar a sequência: '+ir.error.message,'error');
   }
   closeModal();toast(id?'Curso atualizado.':'Curso criado e adicionado à sequência.','success');coursesPage();
 }catch(err){toast(err?.message||'Não foi possível salvar o curso.','error')}
}

openCourseForm=openCourseFormV11;

/* Teacher Courses page — ordered, no recursion, no dependency on the old wrapper. */
async function coursesPageV11(){
 try{await __loadCourseData();const {track,courses}=await ticGetOrderedCoursesV11();window.__ticCourses=courses;const ls=window.__ticLessons||[],ms=window.__ticModules||[];const memberCounts={};if(courses.length){const r=await sb.from('tic_course_students').select('course_id,status').in('course_id',courses.map(c=>c.id));if(!r.error)(r.data||[]).forEach(x=>{if(x.status!=='inactive')memberCounts[x.course_id]=(memberCounts[x.course_id]||0)+1})}
 $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="course-dashboard"><div class="card tic-order-panel"><div class="tic-order-header"><div><span class="badge purple">🛤️ COURSE TRACK</span><h2 style="margin:6px 0 2px">Sequência dos cursos</h2><p style="margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px">${esc(track.name)} · crie novos cursos e reposicione A0 → A1 → A2 → B1... quando quiser.</p></div><div class="actions"><button class="btn primary" onclick="ticOpenCourseOrderV11()">↕️ Reordenar cursos</button><button class="btn secondary" onclick="ticOpenMultiCourseEnrollmentV11()">👤 Atribuir múltiplos cursos</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="openCourseFormV11()">+ Novo curso</button></div></div><div class="tic-order-list" style="max-height:none">${courses.map((c,i)=>`<div class="tic-order-item" style="cursor:default"><span class="tic-order-num">${i+1}</span><span class="badge blue">${esc(c.level||'—')}</span><div class="tic-order-copy"><b>${esc(c.title||'Curso')}</b><small>${ls.filter(l=>l.course_id===c.id).length} lessons · ${ms.filter(m=>m.course_id===c.id).length} módulos</small></div><div class="tic-order-actions"><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="openCourseCurriculum('${c.id}')">📚 Currículo</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="openCourseEnrollment('${c.id}')">👥 Alunos</button><button class="btn sm ghost" onclick='openCourseFormV11(${JSON.stringify(c)})'>Editar</button><button class="btn sm danger" onclick="deleteCourseSafe('${c.id}')">Excluir</button></div></div>`).join('')||'<div class="empty">Nenhum curso criado.</div>'}</div></div></div>`;
 }catch(e){$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention"><b>Não foi possível carregar os cursos.</b><p>${esc(e.message||e)}</p><button class="btn primary" onclick="coursesPageV11()">Tentar novamente</button></div>`}
}
coursesPage=coursesPageV11;

/* Multi-course assignment, preserving existing course enrollment behavior. */
async function ticOpenMultiCourseEnrollmentV11(studentId=''){
 const [{data:students,error:se},{data:courses,error:ce}]=await Promise.all([sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name,email,current_level,status').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('display_name'),sb.from('tic_courses').select('id,title,level,description,active').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('active',true)]);if(se||ce)return toast((se||ce).message,'error');
 const ordered=(courses||[]).slice().sort((a,b)=>ticLevelRankV11(a.level)-ticLevelRankV11(b.level)||String(a.title).localeCompare(String(b.title)));
 openModal('👤 Atribuir múltiplos cursos',`<form class="form" onsubmit="ticSaveMultiCourseEnrollmentV11(event)"><div class="field"><label>Aluno</label><select id="ticMultiStudent" onchange="ticLoadStudentCourseChecksV11()"><option value="">Selecione...</option>${students?.map(s=>`<option value="${s.id}" ${s.id===studentId?'selected':''}>${esc(s.display_name)} · ${esc(s.current_level||'')}</option>`).join('')||''}</select></div><div id="ticMultiCourses" class="tic-course-picker"></div><div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">📚 Salvar matrículas</button></div></form>`);window.__ticMultiCourses=ordered;if(studentId)ticLoadStudentCourseChecksV11()}
async function ticLoadStudentCourseChecksV11(){const sid=$('ticMultiStudent')?.value,box=$('ticMultiCourses');if(!box)return;if(!sid){box.innerHTML='<div class="empty">Selecione um aluno.</div>';return}const r=await sb.from('tic_course_students').select('course_id,status').eq('student_id',sid);if(r.error)return box.innerHTML=`<div class="card attention">${esc(r.error.message)}</div>`;const active=new Set((r.data||[]).filter(x=>x.status!=='inactive').map(x=>x.course_id));box.innerHTML=(window.__ticMultiCourses||[]).map((c,i)=>`<label class="tic-course-picker-item"><input type="checkbox" name="ticMultiCourseV11" value="${c.id}" ${active.has(c.id)?'checked':''}><span><b>${i+1}. ${esc(c.level||'')} · ${esc(c.title)}</b><small>${esc(c.description||'')}</small></span><span class="${active.has(c.id)?'enrolled':''}">${active.has(c.id)?'✓ Matriculado':'Disponível'}</span></label>`).join('')}
async function ticSaveMultiCourseEnrollmentV11(e){e.preventDefault();const sid=$('ticMultiStudent')?.value;if(!sid)return toast('Selecione um aluno.','error');const ids=[...document.querySelectorAll('input[name="ticMultiCourseV11"]:checked')].map(x=>x.value);if(!ids.length)return toast('Selecione pelo menos um curso.','error');const old=await sb.from('tic_course_students').select('id,course_id,status').eq('student_id',sid);if(old.error)return toast(old.error.message,'error');const map=new Map((old.data||[]).map(x=>[x.course_id,x]));const add=ids.filter(id=>!map.has(id)).map(course_id=>({student_id:sid,course_id,status:'active'}));const react=ids.filter(id=>map.has(id)&&map.get(id).status==='inactive');if(add.length){const r=await sb.from('tic_course_students').insert(add);if(r.error)return toast(r.error.message,'error')}if(react.length){const r=await sb.from('tic_course_students').update({status:'active'}).eq('student_id',sid).in('course_id',react);if(r.error)return toast(r.error.message,'error')}closeModal();toast(`${ids.length} curso(s) atribuídos/ativos para o aluno.`,'success');coursesPage()}

/* ===== Curriculum order: modules + lessons, all drag-and-drop ===== */
async function ticLoadCurriculumV11(courseId){const [{data:course,error:ce},{data:mods,error:me},{data:lessons,error:le}]=await Promise.all([sb.from('tic_courses').select('*').eq('id',courseId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle(),sb.from('tic_modules').select('*').eq('course_id',courseId).order('position').order('created_at'),sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').eq('course_id',courseId).eq('active',true).order('position').order('created_at')]);if(ce||me||le)throw(ce||me||le);return {course,mods:mods||[],lessons:lessons||[]}}
function ticCurriculumHtmlV11(course,mods,lessons){return `<div class="notice success"><b>${esc(course.title)}</b><br>Arraste os <b>módulos</b> para definir a ordem. Dentro de cada módulo, arraste as <b>Lessons</b> para definir a sequência. Também é possível mover uma Lesson para outro módulo.</div><div class="actions section"><button class="btn primary" onclick="openModuleForm('${course.id}')">+ Novo módulo</button><button class="btn secondary" onclick="openLessonForm(null,false,'${course.id}')">+ Nova lesson neste curso</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="openCourseEnrollment('${course.id}')">👥 Alunos do curso</button></div><div id="ticCurriculumSortList" class="tic-curriculum-sort">${mods.map((m,mi)=>`<section class="tic-module-sort" data-module-id="${m.id}" draggable="true" ondragstart="ticStartModuleDragV11(event)" ondragover="ticAllowModuleDropV11(event)" ondrop="ticDropModuleV11(event)"><div class="tic-module-sort-head"><span class="tic-order-handle">☰</span><span class="tic-order-num">${mi+1}</span><div><b>📁 ${esc(m.title)}</b><small class="tic-sort-muted">${esc(m.description||'')} · ${lessons.filter(l=>l.module_id===m.id).length} lesson(s)</small></div><div class="tic-order-actions"><button class="btn sm ghost" onclick='event.stopPropagation();openModuleForm(${JSON.stringify(m)})'>Editar</button><button class="btn sm danger" onclick='event.stopPropagation();deleteModuleSafeV11("${m.id}","${course.id}")'>Excluir</button></div></div><div class="tic-module-lessons-sort" data-module-id="${m.id}" ondragover="ticAllowLessonDropV11(event)" ondrop="ticDropLessonV11(event)">${lessons.filter(l=>l.module_id===m.id).sort((a,b)=>(a.position||0)-(b.position||0)).map((l,li)=>`<div class="tic-lesson-sort" draggable="true" data-lesson-id="${l.id}" ondragstart="ticStartLessonDragV11(event)" ondragover="ticAllowLessonDropV11(event)" ondrop="ticDropLessonV11(event)"><span class="tic-order-handle">⋮⋮</span><span class="tic-order-num">${li+1}</span><div class="tic-order-copy"><b>${esc(l.title)}</b><small>${esc(l.skill||'')} · ${esc(l.level||'')} ${l.html_enabled?'· 🧩 HTML':''}</small></div><div class="tic-order-actions"><button class="btn sm ghost" onclick='event.stopPropagation();viewTeacherLesson("${l.id}")'>👁</button><button class="btn sm ghost" onclick="event.stopPropagation();openLessonFormById('${l.id}')">✏️</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="event.stopPropagation();openAssignLessonById('${l.id}')">📤</button></div></div>`).join('')||'<div class="tic-sort-muted" style="padding:8px">Solte uma Lesson aqui.</div>'}</div></section>`).join('')||'<div class="card empty">Nenhum módulo. Crie o primeiro.</div>'}</div><div class="notice warning section">Lessons sem módulo: <b>${lessons.filter(l=>!l.module_id).length}</b>. Edite a Lesson para vinculá-la a um módulo ou arraste-a para um módulo.</div>${lessons.filter(l=>!l.module_id).length?`<div id="ticGeneralLessonsV11" class="tic-module-lessons-sort" style="margin-top:8px;border:1px dashed #ddd5ed;border-radius:12px;padding:10px" ondragover="ticAllowLessonDropV11(event)" ondrop="ticDropLessonV11(event)">${lessons.filter(l=>!l.module_id).sort((a,b)=>(a.position||0)-(b.position||0)).map((l,li)=>`<div class="tic-lesson-sort" draggable="true" data-lesson-id="${l.id}" data-general="1" ondragstart="ticStartLessonDragV11(event)" ondragover="ticAllowLessonDropV11(event)" ondrop="ticDropLessonV11(event)"><span class="tic-order-handle">⋮⋮</span><span class="tic-order-num">${li+1}</span><div class="tic-order-copy"><b>${esc(l.title)}</b><small>Sem módulo · ${esc(l.skill||'')}</small></div></div>`).join('')}</div>`:''}`}
async function openCourseCurriculumV11(courseId){currentTeacherCourseIdV11=courseId;try{const {course,mods,lessons}=await ticLoadCurriculumV11(courseId);if(!course)return toast('Curso não encontrado.','error');openModal(`📚 Currículo · ${esc(course.title)}`,ticCurriculumHtmlV11(course,mods,lessons))}catch(e){toast(e.message||'Erro ao carregar currículo.','error')}}
function ticStartModuleDragV11(e){ticModuleDragV11=e.currentTarget.dataset.moduleId;e.currentTarget.classList.add('dragging')}
function ticAllowModuleDropV11(e){e.preventDefault();if(ticLessonDragV11)return;const t=e.currentTarget;t.classList.add('tic-drop-zone')}
async function ticDropModuleV11(e){e.preventDefault();document.querySelectorAll('.tic-drop-zone').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('tic-drop-zone'));if(!ticModuleDragV11)return;const target=e.currentTarget;if(target.dataset.moduleId===ticModuleDragV11)return;const list=$('ticCurriculumSortList'),drag=[...list.children].find(x=>x.dataset.moduleId===ticModuleDragV11);if(!drag)return;const rect=target.getBoundingClientRect();list.insertBefore(drag,e.clientY<rect.top+rect.height/2?target:target.nextSibling);[...list.children].forEach((x,i)=>{const n=x.querySelector('.tic-module-sort-head .tic-order-num');if(n)n.textContent=i+1});const ids=[...list.children].map(x=>x.dataset.moduleId);for(let i=0;i<ids.length;i++){const r=await sb.from('tic_modules').update({position:i+1}).eq('id',ids[i]).eq('course_id',currentTeacherCourseIdV11||'');if(r.error)return toast(r.error.message,'error')}ticModuleDragV11=null;toast('Ordem dos módulos salva.','success')}
let currentTeacherCourseIdV11='';
async function ticDropLessonV11(e){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();document.querySelectorAll('.tic-drop-zone').forEach(x=>x.classList.remove('tic-drop-zone'));if(!ticLessonDragV11)return;const zone=e.currentTarget.closest('.tic-module-lessons-sort')||e.currentTarget;const target=e.target.closest('.tic-lesson-sort');const lessonId=ticLessonDragV11;const source=document.querySelector(`.tic-lesson-sort[data-lesson-id="${lessonId}"]`);if(!source)return;const targetModuleId=zone.dataset.moduleId||null;if(target&&target.dataset.lessonId!==lessonId){const rect=target.getBoundingClientRect();zone.insertBefore(source,e.clientY<rect.top+rect.height/2?target:target.nextSibling)}else zone.appendChild(source);const lessonNodes=[...zone.querySelectorAll(':scope > .tic-lesson-sort')];for(let i=0;i<lessonNodes.length;i++){const r=await sb.from('tic_lessons').update({module_id:targetModuleId,position:i+1}).eq('id',lessonNodes[i].dataset.lessonId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);if(r.error)return toast(r.error.message,'error');const n=lessonNodes[i].querySelector('.tic-order-num');if(n)n.textContent=i+1}
 /* Re-number every affected source module after a cross-module move. */
 const zones=[...document.querySelectorAll('#ticCurriculumSortList .tic-module-lessons-sort'),$('ticGeneralLessonsV11')].filter(Boolean);for(const z of zones){const mid=z.dataset.moduleId||null;const nodes=[...z.querySelectorAll(':scope > .tic-lesson-sort')];for(let i=0;i<nodes.length;i++){const r=await sb.from('tic_lessons').update({module_id:mid,position:i+1}).eq('id',nodes[i].dataset.lessonId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);if(r.error)return toast(r.error.message,'error');const n=nodes[i].querySelector('.tic-order-num');if(n)n.textContent=i+1}}
ticLessonDragV11=null;toast('Sequência das Lessons salva.','success')}
function ticStartLessonDragV11(e){e.stopPropagation();ticLessonDragV11=e.currentTarget.dataset.lessonId;e.currentTarget.classList.add('dragging')}
function ticAllowLessonDropV11(e){e.preventDefault();e.stopPropagation();if(ticLessonDragV11)e.currentTarget.classList.add('tic-drop-zone')}
async function deleteModuleSafeV11(id,courseId){if(!confirm('Excluir este módulo? As Lessons serão preservadas e ficarão sem módulo.'))return;const r=await sb.from('tic_modules').delete().eq('id',id).eq('course_id',courseId);if(r.error)return toast(r.error.message,'error');toast('Módulo excluído.','success');openCourseCurriculumV11(courseId)}
const oldOpenCourseCurriculumV11=openCourseCurriculum;openCourseCurriculum=openCourseCurriculumV11;

/* Student sees the same course order and the same module/lesson order. */
async function ticGetStudentOrderedCoursesV11(studentId){const {data:en,error:ee}=await sb.from('tic_course_students').select('course_id,status,enrolled_at').eq('student_id',studentId).eq('status','active').order('enrolled_at',{ascending:true});if(ee)throw ee;const ids=(en||[]).map(x=>x.course_id);if(!ids.length)return [];const {data:cs,error:ce}=await sb.from('tic_courses').select('*').in('id',ids).eq('active',true);if(ce)throw ce;const {data:tracks,error:te}=await sb.from('tic_course_tracks').select('id,is_default').eq('active',true).order('is_default',{ascending:false}).order('created_at',{ascending:true}).limit(1);if(te)throw te;const track=tracks?.[0];if(!track)return cs||[];const {data:items,error:ie}=await sb.from('tic_course_track_items').select('course_id,position').eq('track_id',track.id);if(ie)throw ie;const pos=new Map((items||[]).map(x=>[x.course_id,Number(x.position)||999999]));return (cs||[]).sort((a,b)=>(pos.get(a.id)??999999)-(pos.get(b.id)??999999)||ticLevelRankV11(a.level)-ticLevelRankV11(b.level))}
const oldStudentCoursesPageV11=studentCoursesPage;
studentCoursesPage=async function(){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Sua conta ainda não está vinculada a um aluno.</div>';return}try{const courses=await ticGetStudentOrderedCoursesV11(s.id);setPage('My Courses','Seus cursos em ordem pedagógica.');if(!courses.length){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Você ainda não está matriculado em nenhum curso.</div>';return}const ids=courses.map(c=>c.id);const [{data:mods},{data:lessons},{data:prog}]=await Promise.all([sb.from('tic_modules').select('*').in('course_id',ids).order('position'),sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').in('course_id',ids).eq('active',true).order('position').order('created_at'),sb.from('tic_progress').select('level,skill,progress').eq('student_id',s.id)]);const pm=new Map((prog||[]).map(x=>[x.skill+':'+x.level,Number(x.progress||0)]));const cards=courses.map((c,ci)=>{const ms=(mods||[]).filter(m=>m.course_id===c.id).sort((a,b)=>(a.position||0)-(b.position||0));const ls=(lessons||[]).filter(l=>l.course_id===c.id).sort((a,b)=>(a.position||0)-(b.position||0));const done=ls.filter(l=>(pm.get((l.skill||'')+':'+(l.level||c.level))||0)>=100).length;return `<article class="student-course-hero card"><div class="student-course-head"><div><span class="badge blue">${ci+1}. ${esc(c.level||'')}</span><h2>📚 ${esc(c.title)}</h2><p>${esc(c.description||'Curso de inglês')}</p></div><span class="badge green">Acesso ativo</span></div><div class="student-course-metrics"><span><b>${ms.length}</b> módulos</span><span><b>${ls.length}</b> lessons</span><span><b>${done}</b> concluídas</span></div><button class="btn primary" onclick="openStudentCourse('${c.id}')">Abrir currículo →</button></article>`});$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="notice success">🛤️ <b>Sequência pedagógica:</b> os cursos aparecem na ordem definida pelo Teacher.</div><div class="tic-student-course-order section">${cards.join('')}</div>`}catch(e){$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention">${esc(e.message||e)}</div>`}}

/* Ensure new/current curriculum is clickable for Teacher and Student. */
window.TIC_ORDER_VERSION='11.0';
</script>


<script>
/* V18 — unified Student progress, Teacher-defined course order, and Student ↔ Teacher messages. */
async function ticRecalculateStudentProgressV18(studentId){
  try{
    const {data:student,error:se}=await sb.from('tic_students').select('id,current_level').eq('id',studentId).maybeSingle();
    if(se||!student)return;
    const {data:enroll}=await sb.from('tic_course_students').select('course_id').eq('student_id',studentId).eq('status','active');
    const ids=(enroll||[]).map(x=>x.course_id).filter(Boolean);
    if(!ids.length)return;
    const [{data:lessons,error:le},{data:done,error:pe}]=await Promise.all([
      sb.from('tic_lessons').select('id,level,skill,course_id').in('course_id',ids).eq('active',true),
      sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').select('lesson_id,first_completed_at').eq('student_id',studentId)
    ]);
    if(le||pe)return;
    const completed=new Set((done||[]).filter(x=>x.first_completed_at).map(x=>x.lesson_id));
    const current=(lessons||[]).filter(l=>(l.level||student.current_level)===(student.current_level));
    const up=[];
    const overall=current.length?Math.round(current.filter(l=>completed.has(l.id)).length/current.length*100):0;
    up.push({student_id:studentId,level:student.current_level,skill:'overall',progress:overall,updated_at:new Date().toISOString()});
    const skills=['grammar','vocabulary','listening','reading','writing','speaking','pronunciation'];
    for(const skill of skills){
      const arr=current.filter(l=>(l.skill||'').toLowerCase()===skill);
      const value=arr.length?Math.round(arr.filter(l=>completed.has(l.id)).length/arr.length*100):0;
      up.push({student_id:studentId,level:student.current_level,skill,progress:value,updated_at:new Date().toISOString()});
    }
    const r=await sb.from('tic_progress').upsert(up,{onConflict:'student_id,level,skill'});
    if(r.error)console.warn('tic_progress:',r.error.message);
  }catch(e){console.warn('Progress V18:',e)}
}

window.markLessonCompleted=async function(lessonId){
  const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;
  const now=new Date().toISOString();
  const {data:lp,error:findError}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').select('id,first_completed_at,response_count,open_count,last_opened_at').eq('lesson_id',lessonId).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();
  if(findError)return toast('Não foi possível verificar o progresso: '+findError.message,'error');
  let r;
  if(lp){
    r=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').update({first_completed_at:lp.first_completed_at||now,last_opened_at:now,open_count:Math.max(1,Number(lp.open_count||0)),response_count:Number(lp.response_count||0),updated_at:now}).eq('id',lp.id);
  }else{
    r=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').insert({lesson_id:lessonId,student_id:s.id,first_completed_at:now,last_opened_at:now,open_count:1,response_count:0});
  }
  if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível registrar a conclusão: '+r.error.message,'error');
  await ticRecalculateStudentProgressV18(s.id);
  toast('Lesson concluída e progresso atualizado.','success');
  await viewStudentLessonInteractive(lessonId);
};

async function studentLessons(){
  const s=await studentRecord();
  if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Conta não vinculada.</div>';return}
  try{
    const courses=await ticGetStudentOrderedCoursesV11(s.id);
    const ids=courses.map(c=>c.id);
    const [{data:ms,error:me},{data:ls,error:le},{data:lp,error:pe},{data:direct,error:de}]=await Promise.all([
      ids.length?sb.from('tic_modules').select('*').in('course_id',ids).order('position',{ascending:true}):Promise.resolve({data:[],error:null}),
      ids.length?sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').in('course_id',ids).eq('active',true).order('position',{ascending:true}).order('created_at',{ascending:true}):Promise.resolve({data:[],error:null}),
      sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').select('lesson_id,first_completed_at').eq('student_id',s.id),
      sb.from('tic_lesson_assignments').select('lesson_id,assigned_at,note,tic_lessons(*)').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('active',true).order('assigned_at',{ascending:false})
    ]);
    if(me||le||pe||de)throw(me||le||pe||de);
    const pmap=new Map((lp||[]).map(x=>[x.lesson_id,x]));
    const item=(l,i)=>{const done=!!pmap.get(l.id)?.first_completed_at;return `<button class="student-curriculum-item" onclick="viewStudentLessonInteractive('${l.id}')"><span class="lesson-number">${i+1}</span><span class="lesson-copy"><b>${esc(l.title)}</b><small>${esc(l.skill||'Lesson')} · ${done?'✓ Concluída':'Não iniciada'}${l.html_enabled?' · 🧩 HTML':''}</small></span><span class="btn sm secondary">Abrir →</span></button>`};
    const courseHtml=courses.map(c=>{
      const cl=(ls||[]).filter(l=>l.course_id===c.id).sort((a,b)=>(Number(a.position)||999999)-(Number(b.position)||999999));
      const mods=(ms||[]).filter(m=>m.course_id===c.id).sort((a,b)=>(Number(a.position)||999999)-(Number(b.position)||999999));
      const modHtml=mods.map(m=>{const ml=cl.filter(l=>l.module_id===m.id);return `<section class="student-module"><div class="student-module-head"><div><span>📁</span><div><h3>${esc(m.title)}</h3><small>${ml.length} lesson(s)</small></div></div><span class="badge blue">${ml.length}</span></div>${ml.map(item).join('')||'<div class="course-empty">Nenhuma lesson neste módulo.</div>'}</section>`}).join('');
      const general=cl.filter(l=>!l.module_id);
      const done=cl.filter(l=>pmap.get(l.id)?.first_completed_at).length;
      return `<article class="student-course-hero card"><div class="student-course-head"><div><span class="badge blue">${esc(c.level||'')}</span><h2>📚 ${esc(c.title)}</h2><p>${esc(c.description||'')}</p></div><span class="badge green">Acesso ativo</span></div><div class="student-course-metrics"><span><b>${mods.length}</b> módulos</span><span><b>${cl.length}</b> lessons</span><span><b>${done}</b> concluídas</span></div><div class="student-module-stack">${modHtml}${general.length?`<section class="student-module"><div class="student-module-head"><div><span>📖</span><div><h3>Lessons gerais</h3><small>Lessons sem módulo específico.</small></div></div><span class="badge yellow">${general.length}</span></div>${general.map(item).join('')}</section>`:''}</div></article>`;
    }).join('');
    const courseLessonIds=new Set((ls||[]).map(l=>l.id));
    const extra=(direct||[]).map(x=>x.tic_lessons).filter(Boolean).filter(l=>!courseLessonIds.has(l.id));
    const directHtml=extra.length?`<article class="card section"><div class="section-head"><div><h2>📌 Lessons atribuídas diretamente</h2><span>Enviadas pelo Teacher fora do currículo.</span></div><span class="badge blue">${extra.length}</span></div>${extra.sort((a,b)=>(Number(a.position)||999999)-(Number(b.position)||999999)).map(item).join('')}</article>`:'';
    setPage('My Lessons','Aulas na mesma ordem definida pelo Teacher.');
    $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="notice success">🛤️ <b>Ordem pedagógica:</b> os cursos seguem a sequência definida pelo Teacher. As Lessons seguem a posição definida dentro de cada curso/módulo.</div>${courseHtml||'<div class="card empty">Nenhum curso ativo.</div>'}${directHtml}`;
  }catch(e){$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention">${esc(e.message||e)}</div>`}
}

async function progressPage(student=false){
  let students=[];
  if(student){const {data:s}=await sb.from('tic_students').select('*').eq('auth_user_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Conta não vinculada.</div>';return}students=[s]}
  else{const {data:s}=await sb.from('tic_students').select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active');students=s||[]}
  for(const s of students)await ticRecalculateStudentProgressV18(s.id);
  const ids=students.map(s=>s.id);const {data:p}=ids.length?await sb.from('tic_progress').select('*').in('student_id',ids):{data:[]};
  $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="grid cols3">${students.map(s=>{const overall=Number(p?.find(x=>x.student_id===s.id&&x.skill==='overall'&&x.level===s.current_level)?.progress||0);return `<div class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>${esc(s.display_name)}</h2><span>${esc(s.current_level)}</span></div><div style="font:800 27px 'Plus Jakarta Sans'">${overall}%</div><div class="progress"><i style="width:${overall}%"></i></div><div style="margin-top:15px">${['grammar','vocabulary','listening','reading','writing','speaking','pronunciation'].map(k=>{const v=Number(p?.find(x=>x.student_id===s.id&&x.skill===k&&x.level===s.current_level)?.progress||0);return `<div class="mini"><span>${k}</span><b>${v}%</b></div><div class="progress" style="height:5px;margin-bottom:8px"><i style="width:${v}%"></i></div>`}).join('')}</div></div>`}).join('')||'<div class="card empty">Nenhum aluno.</div>'}</div>`;
}

async function studentDashboard(){
  const s=await studentRecord();if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Sua conta não está vinculada a um cadastro de aluno.</div>';return}
  await ticRecalculateStudentProgressV18(s.id);
  const [{data:p},{data:ta},{data:pay}]=await Promise.all([sb.from('tic_progress').select('*').eq('student_id',s.id),sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('*,tic_assignments(title,due_at)').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('active',true).limit(8),sb.from('tic_monthly_payments').select('*').eq('student_id',s.id).order('reference_month',{ascending:false}).limit(3)]);
  const overall=Number(p?.find(x=>x.skill==='overall'&&x.level===s.current_level)?.progress||0);
  setPage(`Hello, ${s.display_name?.split(' ')[0]||'Student'} 👋`,'Seu espaço de aprendizagem.');
  $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="student-banner"><div style="font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:#aaa1bd">CURRENT LEVEL</div><h2>${esc(s.current_level)} → ${esc(s.target_level||'—')}</h2><p>Progresso geral: <b>${overall}%</b></p><div class="progress" style="margin-top:10px;background:#ffffff22"><i style="width:${overall}%;background:#fff"></i></div></div><div class="grid cols2 section"><div class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>✅ My Tasks</h2></div>${(ta||[]).map(x=>`<div class="row task-row" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="openStudentTask('${x.id}')"><div><b>${esc(x.tic_assignments?.title||'Task')}</b><small>${x.tic_assignments?.due_at?'Prazo '+fmtDate(x.tic_assignments.due_at):'Sem prazo'}</small></div><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px"><span onclick="event.stopPropagation()">${badge(x.status)}</span><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="event.stopPropagation();openStudentTask('${x.id}')">Abrir</button></div></div>`).join('')||'<div class="empty">Nenhuma tarefa.</div>'}</div><div class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>📊 My Progress</h2></div>${['grammar','vocabulary','listening','reading','writing','speaking','pronunciation'].map(k=>{let v=Number(p?.find(x=>x.skill===k&&x.level===s.current_level)?.progress||0);return `<div class="mini"><span>${k}</span><b>${v}%</b></div><div class="progress" style="margin-bottom:10px"><i style="width:${v}%"></i></div>`}).join('')}</div></div><div class="card section"><div class="section-head"><h2>💰 My Payments</h2></div>${(pay||[]).map(x=>`<div class="row"><div><b>${monthLabel(x.reference_month)}</b><small>${x.payment_date?'Pago em '+fmtDate(x.payment_date):'Vencimento '+fmtDate(x.due_date)}</small></div><b>${money(x.amount)} ${badge(x.status)}</b></div>`).join('')||'<div class="empty">Nenhum registro.</div>'}</div>`;
}

async function messagesPage(student=false){
  let sid=null, teacherId=null;
  if(student){const {data:s}=await sb.from('tic_students').select('id,teacher_id,display_name').eq('auth_user_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Conta não vinculada.</div>';return}sid=s.id;teacherId=s.teacher_id}
  let q=sb.from('tic_messages').select('*').order('created_at',{ascending:true});
  if(student)q=q.eq('student_id',sid);else q=q.eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);
  const {data,error}=await q;if(error){$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention">${esc(error.message)}</div>`;return}
  const rows=(data||[]).map(m=>`<div class="row"><div style="flex:1"><b>${m.sender_id===session.user.id?'Você':student?'Teacher':'Aluno'}</b><small style="display:block;white-space:pre-wrap">${esc(m.body)}</small><small>${new Date(m.created_at).toLocaleString('pt-BR')}</small></div>${m.sender_id===session.user.id?'<span class="badge green">Enviada</span>':'<span class="badge blue">Nova</span>'}</div>`).join('');
  const composer=student?`<form class="form" onsubmit="sendStudentMessageV18(event)"><div class="field"><label>Responder ao Teacher</label><textarea id="studentMessageBody" rows="5" placeholder="Escreva sua mensagem..." required></textarea></div><div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn primary">📤 Enviar mensagem</button></div></form>`:'';
  setPage('Messages','Converse com seu Teacher.');
  $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>${student?'Conversa com seu Teacher':'Mensagens'}</h2>${student?'':'<button class="btn primary" onclick="openMessageForm()">+ Mensagem</button>'}</div>${rows||'<div class="empty">Nenhuma mensagem.</div>'}${student?`<div class="section" style="margin-top:16px">${composer}</div>`:''}</div>`;
}
async function sendStudentMessageV18(e){
  e.preventDefault();const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;
  const body=$('studentMessageBody')?.value.trim();if(!body)return;
  const r=await sb.from('tic_messages').insert({teacher_id:s.teacher_id,student_id:s.id,sender_id:session.user.id,body});
  if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível enviar: '+r.error.message,'error');
  toast('Mensagem enviada ao Teacher.','success');messagesPage(true);
}
</script>

<style id="tic-materials-workspace-v38">
.materials-workspace{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px;min-height:calc(100vh - 180px)}
.materials-overview-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
.material-stat{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line,#e5e1ef);border-radius:18px;padding:18px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(35,24,65,.05)}
.material-stat .num{font-size:28px;font-weight:900;color:#28243a;margin-top:5px}.material-stat small{color:var(--muted,#77748a)}
.materials-toolbar{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.materials-toolbar input{min-width:240px;flex:1}
.material-tabs{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}.material-tab{border:1px solid #e4dfef;background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:10px 14px;font-weight:800;color:#68637a;cursor:pointer}.material-tab.active{background:#eee7ff;color:#6840db;border-color:#d9c9ff}
.material-folder-strip{display:flex;gap:10px;overflow:auto;padding:2px 2px 8px}.material-folder-chip{min-width:150px;border:1px solid #e6e1ef;background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:13px;cursor:pointer;text-align:left}.material-folder-chip:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(35,24,65,.08)}.material-folder-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block;margin-right:7px}.material-folder-chip b{display:block;margin-top:7px}.material-folder-chip small{color:var(--muted,#77748a)}
.materials-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}.material-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5e1ef;border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 8px 25px rgba(35,24,65,.05);display:flex;flex-direction:column}.material-cover{height:105px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f2edff,#faf9fd);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}.material-cover img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}.material-icon{font-size:42px}.material-card-body{padding:16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px;flex:1}.material-card-title{font-size:17px;font-weight:900}.material-meta{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}.material-card-desc{font-size:13px;color:var(--muted,#77748a);min-height:34px}.material-actions{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:auto;padding-top:8px}.material-actions .btn{font-size:12px;padding:8px 10px}.material-created{font-size:11px;color:#8a8699}.material-section{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e5e1ef;border-radius:20px;padding:20px}.material-section-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:14px}.material-section-head h3{margin:0}.material-folder-admin{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}.material-folder-admin-card{border:1px solid #e5e1ef;border-radius:16px;padding:15px;background:#fff}.material-folder-admin-card .folder-name{font-weight:900;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.material-empty{padding:35px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted,#77748a);border:1px dashed #d8d1e7;border-radius:16px}
@media(max-width:950px){.materials-overview-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.materials-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.material-folder-admin{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:650px){.materials-overview-grid,.materials-grid,.material-folder-admin{grid-template-columns:1fr}.materials-toolbar input{min-width:100%}.material-section{padding:14px}}
</style>
<script>
/* MATERIALS WORKSPACE V38 — additive: preserves existing materials, editing, deletion and assignment. */
(function(){
  const materialIcon=(type)=>({pdf:'📕',video:'🎬',audio:'🎧',link:'🔗',file:'📄',worksheet:'📝',other:'📦'})[type]||'📂';
  const safeDate=v=>{try{return v?new Date(v).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR'):''}catch(e){return ''}};
  const escm=v=>typeof esc==='function'?esc(v??''):String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,m=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[m]));
  let materialState={tab:'overview',folder:'',search:'',level:'',type:''};
  window.ticMaterialState=materialState;

  async function materialData(){
    const [mr,fr]=await Promise.all([
      sb.from('tic_materials').select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('created_at',{ascending:false}),
      sb.from('tic_material_folders').select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('name')
    ]);
    if(mr.error){toast('Não foi possível carregar os materiais: '+mr.error.message,'error');return {materials:[],folders:[]};}
    if(fr.error){toast('Não foi possível carregar as pastas: '+fr.error.message,'error');return {materials:mr.data||[],folders:[]};}
    return {materials:mr.data||[],folders:fr.data||[]};
  }

  window.materialsPage=async function(){
    const token=window.__ticViewToken||0;
    const {materials,folders}=await materialData();
    if((window.__ticViewToken||0)!==token || currentView!=='materials')return;
    const folderMap=new Map(folders.map(f=>[f.id,f]));
    const legacyFolders=[...new Set(materials.map(m=>m.folder).filter(Boolean))].map(name=>({id:'legacy:'+name,name,color:'#6d4aff',legacy:true}));
    const allFolders=[...folders,...legacyFolders.filter(l=>!folders.some(f=>f.name===l.name))];
    const totalResources=materials.reduce((n,m)=>n+(Array.isArray(m.resource_items)?m.resource_items.length:((m.external_url||m.file_url)?1:0)),0);
    const now=Date.now(),recent=materials.filter(m=>now-new Date(m.created_at).getTime()<30*864e5).length;
    const types=[...new Set(materials.map(m=>m.material_type).filter(Boolean))].sort();
    const levels=[...new Set(materials.map(m=>m.level).filter(Boolean))].sort();
    const filtered=materials.filter(m=>{
      const q=materialState.search.toLowerCase();
      const folderOk=!materialState.folder || (m.folder_id===materialState.folder || m.folder===materialState.folder);
      const tabOk=materialState.tab==='folders'?false:true;
      return tabOk && folderOk && (!q||[m.title,m.description,m.material_type,m.level,m.folder].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(q)) && (!materialState.level||m.level===materialState.level) && (!materialState.type||m.material_type===materialState.type);
    });
    const selectedFolder=allFolders.find(f=>f.id===materialState.folder || f.name===materialState.folder);
    const tabs=`<div class="material-tabs">
      <button class="material-tab ${materialState.tab==='overview'?'active':''}" onclick="ticMaterialTab('overview')">📊 Overview</button>
      <button class="material-tab ${materialState.tab==='all'?'active':''}" onclick="ticMaterialTab('all')">📚 Todos os materiais</button>
      <button class="material-tab ${materialState.tab==='folders'?'active':''}" onclick="ticMaterialTab('folders')">📁 Pastas</button>
