    </div>`;
    $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="materials-workspace">
      ${tabs}
      ${materialState.tab==='folders'?renderFolderAdmin(allFolders,folders,materials):`
      <div class="materials-overview-grid">
        <div class="material-stat"><small>Materiais registrados</small><div class="num">${materials.length}</div><span>criados por você</span></div>
        <div class="material-stat"><small>Pastas</small><div class="num">${folders.length+legacyFolders.filter(x=>!folders.some(f=>f.name===x.name)).length}</div><span>organização</span></div>
        <div class="material-stat"><small>Recursos</small><div class="num">${totalResources}</div><span>links, PDFs, vídeos e áudios</span></div>
        <div class="material-stat"><small>Últimos 30 dias</small><div class="num">${recent}</div><span>novos registros</span></div>
      </div>
      <div class="material-section">
        <div class="material-section-head"><div><h3>📁 Pastas</h3><small>Organize por nome e cor.</small></div><button class="btn secondary" onclick="openMaterialFolderForm()">+ Nova pasta</button></div>
        <div class="material-folder-strip"><button class="material-folder-chip" onclick="ticMaterialFolder('')"><span class="material-folder-dot" style="background:#8b84a0"></span><b>Todos</b><small>${materials.length} materiais</small></button>${allFolders.map(f=>{const count=materials.filter(m=>m.folder_id===f.id||m.folder===f.name).length;return `<button class="material-folder-chip" onclick="ticMaterialFolder('${escm(f.id)}')"><span class="material-folder-dot" style="background:${escm(f.color||'#6d4aff')}"></span><b>${escm(f.name)}</b><small>${count} material(is)</small></button>`}).join('')}</div>
      </div>
      <div class="material-section">
        <div class="material-section-head"><div><h3>${selectedFolder?'📁 '+escm(selectedFolder.name):'📚 Materiais registrados'}</h3><small>Crie, edite, remova, organize e atribua.</small></div></div>
        <div class="materials-toolbar"><input id="ticMaterialSearch" placeholder="🔎 Buscar material, descrição ou pasta..." value="${escm(materialState.search)}" oninput="ticMaterialFilter()"><select id="ticMaterialLevel" onchange="ticMaterialFilter()"><option value="">Todos os níveis</option>${levels.map(l=>`<option ${l===materialState.level?'selected':''}>${escm(l)}</option>`).join('')}</select><select id="ticMaterialType" onchange="ticMaterialFilter()"><option value="">Todos os tipos</option>${types.map(t=>`<option ${t===materialState.type?'selected':''}>${escm(t)}</option>`).join('')}</select></div>
        <div id="ticMaterialResults" style="margin-top:16px">${renderMaterialCards(filtered,folderMap)}</div>
      </div>`}
    </div>`;
  };

  function renderMaterialCards(items,folderMap){
    if(!items.length)return '<div class="material-empty">📂 Nenhum material encontrado com esses filtros.<br><button class="btn primary" style="margin-top:12px" onclick="openMaterialForm()">+ Criar material</button></div>';
    return `<div class="materials-grid">${items.map(m=>{const folder=folderMap.get(m.folder_id);const folderName=folder?.name||m.folder||'Sem pasta';const folderColor=folder?.color||m.color||'#6d4aff';const url=m.external_url||m.file_url||((m.resource_items||[])[0]?.url);return `<article class="material-card" data-material-level="${escm(m.level||'')}" data-material-type="${escm(m.material_type||'')}"><div class="material-cover" style="border-top:5px solid ${escm(folderColor)}">${m.cover_image_url?`<img src="${escm(m.cover_image_url)}" alt="">`:`<span class="material-icon">${materialIcon(m.material_type)}</span>`}</div><div class="material-card-body"><div class="material-meta"><span class="badge blue">${escm(m.material_type||'material')}</span>${m.level?`<span class="badge gray">${escm(m.level)}</span>`:''}</div><div class="material-card-title">${escm(m.title)}</div><div class="material-card-desc">${escm(m.description||'Sem descrição')}</div><div><span class="material-folder-dot" style="background:${escm(folderColor)}"></span><small>${escm(folderName)}</small></div><div class="material-created">Criado em ${safeDate(m.created_at)}${m.updated_at&&m.updated_at!==m.created_at?' · atualizado '+safeDate(m.updated_at):''}</div><div class="material-actions">${url?`<a class="btn secondary" href="${escm(url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Abrir ↗</a>`:''}<button class="btn secondary" onclick='openMaterialForm(${JSON.stringify(m)})'>✏️ Editar</button><button class="btn secondary" onclick='openMaterialAssignV52(${JSON.stringify(m)})'>📤 Atribuir</button><button class="btn danger" onclick="deleteMaterialV38('${escm(m.id)}')">🗑️ Remover</button></div></div></article>`}).join('')}</div>`;
  }

  function renderFolderAdmin(allFolders,realFolders,materials){
    if(!allFolders.length)return `<div class="material-section"><div class="material-section-head"><div><h3>📁 Pastas</h3><small>Nenhuma pasta criada ainda.</small></div><button class="btn primary" onclick="openMaterialFolderForm()">+ Nova pasta</button></div><div class="material-empty">Crie sua primeira pasta para organizar os materiais.</div></div>`;
    return `<div class="material-section"><div class="material-section-head"><div><h3>📁 Gerenciar pastas</h3><small>Nome, cor, quantidade e ações.</small></div><button class="btn primary" onclick="openMaterialFolderForm()">+ Nova pasta</button></div><div class="material-folder-admin">${allFolders.map(f=>{const count=materials.filter(m=>m.folder_id===f.id||m.folder===f.name).length;return `<div class="material-folder-admin-card"><div class="folder-name"><span class="material-folder-dot" style="background:${escm(f.color||'#6d4aff')}"></span>${escm(f.name)}</div><small>${count} material(is) · ${f.legacy?'pasta antiga':''}</small><div class="material-actions">${!f.legacy?`<button class="btn secondary" onclick='openMaterialFolderForm(${JSON.stringify(f)})'>✏️ Editar</button><button class="btn danger" onclick="deleteMaterialFolderV38('${escm(f.id)}')">🗑️ Remover</button>`:`<button class="btn secondary" onclick="ticMaterialFolder('${escm(f.name)}')">Abrir</button>`}</div></div>`}).join('')}</div></div>`;
  }

  window.ticMaterialTab=function(tab){materialState.tab=tab;materialState.folder='';materialsPage();};
  window.ticMaterialFolder=function(id){materialState.tab='all';materialState.folder=id||'';materialsPage();};
  window.ticMaterialFilter=function(){materialState.search=$('ticMaterialSearch')?.value||'';materialState.level=$('ticMaterialLevel')?.value||'';materialState.type=$('ticMaterialType')?.value||'';const cards=[...document.querySelectorAll('.material-card')];if(!cards.length)return;const q=materialState.search.toLowerCase();cards.forEach(c=>{const text=c.innerText.toLowerCase();const okText=!q||text.includes(q);const okLevel=!materialState.level||c.dataset.materialLevel===materialState.level;const okType=!materialState.type||c.dataset.materialType===materialState.type;c.style.display=(okText&&okLevel&&okType)?'flex':'none';});};

  window.openMaterialFolderForm=function(x=null){openModal(x?'Editar pasta':'Nova pasta',`<form class="form" onsubmit="saveMaterialFolderV38(event,'${x?.id||''}')"><div class="field"><label>Nome da pasta</label><input id="mfName" value="${escm(x?.name||'')}" placeholder="Ex.: A1, Listening, PDFs, Business English..." required></div><div class="field"><label>Cor da pasta</label><div style="display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center"><input id="mfColor" type="color" value="${escm(x?.color||'#6d4aff')}" style="width:64px;height:44px;padding:3px"><input id="mfColorText" value="${escm(x?.color||'#6d4aff')}" oninput="document.getElementById('mfColor').value=this.value" placeholder="#6d4aff"></div></div><div class="notice">A pasta fica disponível para organizar seus materiais. Você poderá editar o nome e a cor depois.</div><div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">Salvar pasta</button></div></form>`);};
  window.saveMaterialFolderV38=async function(e,id){e.preventDefault();const name=$('mfName').value.trim(),color=$('mfColor').value;if(!name)return toast('Informe o nome da pasta.','error');const o={teacher_id:session.user.id,name,color};const r=id?await sb.from('tic_material_folders').update({name,color,updated_at:new Date().toISOString()}).eq('id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id):await sb.from('tic_material_folders').insert(o);if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível salvar a pasta: '+r.error.message,'error');closeModal();toast(id?'Pasta atualizada.':'Pasta criada.','success');materialsPage();};
  window.deleteMaterialFolderV38=async function(id){if(!confirm('Remover esta pasta? Os materiais serão mantidos e ficarão sem pasta.'))return;await sb.from('tic_materials').update({folder_id:null}).eq('folder_id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);const r=await sb.from('tic_material_folders').delete().eq('id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível remover a pasta: '+r.error.message,'error');toast('Pasta removida. Os materiais foram preservados.','success');materialsPage();};
  window.deleteMaterialV38=async function(id){if(!confirm('Remover este material? Esta ação exclui apenas o registro do material.'))return;const r=await sb.from('tic_materials').delete().eq('id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível remover o material: '+r.error.message,'error');toast('Material removido.','success');materialsPage();};

  const oldOpenMaterialForm=window.openMaterialForm;
  window.openMaterialForm=function(x=null){
    const oldFolder=x?.folder||'';
    sb.from('tic_material_folders').select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('name').then(({data})=>{
      const folders=data||[];
      openModal(x?'Editar material':'Novo material',`<form class="form" onsubmit="saveMaterialV38(event,'${x?.id||''}')"><div class="field"><label>Título</label><input id="g1" value="${escm(x?.title||'')}" required></div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Tipo principal</label><select id="g2">${['pdf','video','audio','link','file','worksheet','other'].map(l=>`<option value="${l}" ${l===x?.material_type?'selected':''}>${l}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Nível</label><select id="g3"><option value="">—</option>${levels.map(l=>`<option ${l===x?.level?'selected':''}>${l}</option>`).join('')}</select></div></div><div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Pasta</label><select id="gFolder"><option value="">📂 Sem pasta</option>${folders.map(f=>`<option value="${f.id}" ${f.id===x?.folder_id||f.name===oldFolder?'selected':''}>${escm(f.name)}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Cor do material</label><input id="gColor" type="color" value="${escm(x?.color||'#6d4aff')}" style="width:70px;height:42px"></div></div><div style="display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:-6px"><button type="button" class="btn secondary" onclick="openMaterialFolderForm()">+ Nova pasta</button></div><div class="field"><label>Imagem de capa (opcional)</label><div class="cover-upload"><input id="gCover" value="${escm(x?.cover_image_url||'')}" placeholder="URL da imagem ou upload"><input type="file" accept="image/*" onchange="uploadCover(this,'gCover')"></div></div><div class="field"><label>Descrição</label><textarea id="g5" rows="3">${escm(x?.description||'')}</textarea></div><div class="resource-box"><div class="resource-head"><b>📚 Recursos deste material</b><button type="button" class="btn secondary" onclick="addResourceRow('gResources')">+ Adicionar recurso</button></div><div id="gResources"></div><div class="resource-help">Um material pode conter quantos links, PDFs, vídeos, áudios ou atividades manuais você quiser.</div></div><div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">Salvar material</button></div></form>`);renderResourceRows('gResources',x?.resource_items||((x?.external_url||x?.file_url)?[{type:x?.material_type||'link',title:x?.title||'Recurso',url:x?.external_url||x?.file_url}]:[]));
    });
  };
  window.saveMaterialV38=async function(e,id){e.preventDefault();const folderId=$('gFolder')?.value||null;let folderName=null;if(folderId){const f=await sb.from('tic_material_folders').select('name').eq('id',folderId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();folderName=f.data?.name||null;}const o={teacher_id:session.user.id,title:$('g1').value.trim(),material_type:$('g2').value,level:$('g3').value||null,description:$('g5').value.trim()||null,resource_items:collectResources('gResources'),cover_image_url:$('gCover').value.trim()||null,folder_id:folderId,color:$('gColor')?.value||'#6d4aff',folder:folderName};const first=o.resource_items[0];if(first?.url){if(o.material_type==='pdf')o.file_url=first.url;else o.external_url=first.url}const r=id?await sb.from('tic_materials').update(o).eq('id',id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id):await sb.from('tic_materials').insert(o);if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível salvar o material: '+r.error.message,'error');closeModal();toast(id?'Material atualizado.':'Material criado.','success');materialsPage();};

  const oldLoadView=window.loadView;
  window.loadView=async function(v){if(v==='materials'){currentView=v;toggleMobile();const c=document.querySelector('.main>.container');if(c)c.scrollTo({top:0,left:0,behavior:'instant'});document.querySelectorAll('#teacherNav [data-view]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.view===v));setPage('Materials','PDF, links, vídeo, áudio e arquivos.','<button class="btn primary" onclick="openMaterialForm()">+ Novo material</button>');return materialsPage();}return oldLoadView(v);};
})();
</script>

<style id="tic-class-student-content-v38">
.class-center-student-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}
.class-center-student-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:15px;padding:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(35,20,75,.05)}
.class-center-student-main{display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:center}.class-center-student-main b{display:block;font-size:14px}.class-center-student-main small{display:block;color:var(--muted);margin:4px 0 7px;font-size:11px}.class-center-avatar{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:12px;background:#f0ebff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:20px}.class-center-student-actions{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
@media(max-width:760px){.class-center-student-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>


<style id="tic-v52-material-assignment">
.v52-assign-note{background:#f7f3ff;border:1px solid #e3d8f7;border-radius:12px;padding:11px 13px;font-size:10px;color:#5f5570;line-height:1.5}
.v52-assign-target{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
@media(max-width:700px){.v52-assign-target{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
.v52-material-preview{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:11px;border:1px solid #e9e3f1;border-radius:12px;background:#fbfaff}
.v52-material-preview-icon{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:11px;background:#eee7ff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:20px}
</style>
<script id="tic-v52-material-assignment-js">
(function(){
'use strict';
const e52=v=>{try{return typeof esc==='function'?esc(v??''):String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,m=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[m]) )}catch(_){return String(v??'')}};

window.openMaterialAssignV52=async function(material){
  const sourceId=material?.id;
  if(!sourceId)return toast('Material inválido.','error');

  const [{data:students,error:se},{data:classes,error:ce}]=await Promise.all([
    sb.from('tic_students')
      .select('id,display_name,current_level,email,status')
      .eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active').order('display_name'),
    sb.from('tic_classes')
      .select('id,name,level,status')
      .eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active').order('name')
  ]);
  if(se)return toast('Não foi possível carregar os alunos: '+se.message,'error');
  if(ce)return toast('Não foi possível carregar as turmas: '+ce.message,'error');
  if(!students?.length)return toast('Cadastre pelo menos um aluno antes de atribuir um Material.','info');
  if(!classes?.length)return toast('Crie pelo menos uma Class antes de atribuir um Material.','info');

  const title=material.title||'Material';
  const itemCount=Array.isArray(material.resource_items)?material.resource_items.filter(r=>r?.url).length:((material.external_url||material.file_url)?1:0);

  openModal('📤 Atribuir Material ao aluno',`
    <form class="form" onsubmit="saveMaterialAssignV52(event,'${e52(sourceId)}')">
      <div class="v52-material-preview">
        <div class="v52-material-preview-icon">📂</div>
        <div style="min-width:0;flex:1">
          <b>${e52(title)}</b>
          <small style="display:block;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px">${itemCount} recurso(s) · ${e52(material.level||'Material')}</small>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="v52-assign-note">
        <b>Como funciona:</b> este Material será entregue <b>somente ao aluno escolhido</b> e ficará ligado à <b>Class escolhida</b>. Assim ele aparecerá corretamente em <b>My Class → Materials</b>.
      </div>

      <div class="v52-assign-target">
        <div class="field">
          <label>👤 Aluno destinatário</label>
          <select id="v52Student" required onchange="loadStudentClassesV52()">
            <option value="">Selecione o aluno...</option>
            ${students.map(s=>`<option value="${e52(s.id)}">${e52(s.display_name)} · ${e52(s.current_level||'')}${s.email?' · '+e52(s.email):''}</option>`).join('')}
          </select>
        </div>
        <div class="field">
          <label>🏫 Class onde aparecerá</label>
          <select id="v52Class" required>
            <option value="">Selecione primeiro o aluno...</option>
          </select>
          <small id="v52ClassHelp" style="color:var(--muted)">O aluno precisa estar vinculado à Class.</small>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="field">
        <label>Mensagem para o aluno</label>
        <textarea id="v52Message" rows="3" placeholder="Ex.: Faça este material antes da próxima aula."></textarea>
      </div>

      <div class="field">
        <label>Prazo opcional</label>
        <input id="v52Due" type="datetime-local">
      </div>

      <div class="modal-actions">
        <button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button>
        <button class="btn primary" id="v52Save">📤 Atribuir somente a este aluno</button>
      </div>
    </form>`);
};

window.loadStudentClassesV52=async function(){
  const studentId=$('v52Student')?.value;
  const select=$('v52Class'),help=$('v52ClassHelp');
  if(!select)return;
  select.innerHTML='<option value="">Carregando Classes...</option>';
  if(!studentId){select.innerHTML='<option value="">Selecione primeiro o aluno...</option>';return;}

  const {data:members,error}=await sb.from('tic_class_students')
    .select('class_id,status')
    .eq('student_id',studentId).eq('status','active');
  if(error){select.innerHTML='<option value="">Erro ao carregar</option>';if(help)help.textContent=error.message;return;}

  const ids=(members||[]).map(x=>x.class_id).filter(Boolean);
  if(!ids.length){
    select.innerHTML='<option value="">Aluno sem Class ativa</option>';
    if(help)help.textContent='Vincule o aluno a uma Class em Class Center → Alunos.';
    return;
  }

  const {data:classes,error:ce}=await sb.from('tic_classes')
    .select('id,name,level,status').in('id',ids).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active').order('name');
  if(ce){select.innerHTML='<option value="">Erro ao carregar</option>';if(help)help.textContent=ce.message;return;}

  select.innerHTML=(classes||[]).map(c=>`<option value="${e52(c.id)}">${e52(c.name)} · ${e52(c.level||'')}</option>`).join('');
  if(help)help.textContent=`${classes?.length||0} Class(es) disponível(is) para este aluno.`;
};

window.saveMaterialAssignV52=async function(ev,sourceId){
  ev.preventDefault();
  const btn=$('v52Save');if(btn){btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='Atribuindo...';}
  try{
    const studentId=$('v52Student')?.value;
    const classId=$('v52Class')?.value;
    const message=$('v52Message')?.value.trim()||'';
    const due=$('v52Due')?.value;

    if(!studentId)throw new Error('Selecione o aluno.');
    if(!classId)throw new Error('Selecione a Class onde o material aparecerá.');

    // Verify the student really belongs to the selected Class.
    const {data:member,error:me}=await sb.from('tic_class_students')
      .select('student_id,class_id,status')
      .eq('student_id',studentId).eq('class_id',classId).eq('status','active').maybeSingle();
    if(me)throw me;
    if(!member)throw new Error('Este aluno não está vinculado à Class escolhida.');

    // Read the source material from the teacher's library.
    const {data:source,error:se}=await sb.from('tic_materials')
      .select('*').eq('id',sourceId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();
    if(se)throw se;
    if(!source)throw new Error('Material não encontrado na biblioteca.');

    let items=Array.isArray(source.resource_items)?source.resource_items.filter(r=>r&&r.url):[];
    if(!items.length && (source.external_url||source.file_url)){
      items=[{type:source.material_type||'link',title:source.title||'Recurso',url:source.external_url||source.file_url}];
    }
    if(!items.length)throw new Error('Este Material não possui nenhum link/arquivo para entregar.');

    // Reuse an existing assignment for the same material + Class when possible.
    let assignment=null;
    const {data:existing,error:ee}=await sb.from('tic_assignments')
      .select('id')
      .eq('teacher_id',session.user.id)
      .eq('class_id',classId)
      .eq('source_type','material')
      .eq('source_id',sourceId)
      .eq('assignment_type','material')
      .maybeSingle();
    if(ee)throw ee;

    if(existing?.id){
      const {data:a,error:ae}=await sb.from('tic_assignments')
        .update({
          title:source.title,
          instructions:message||source.description||'',
          resource_items:items,
          cover_image_url:source.cover_image_url||null,
          due_at:due?new Date(due).toISOString():null,
          active:true
        })
        .eq('id',existing.id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).select().single();
      if(ae)throw ae;
      assignment=a;
    }else{
      const {data:a,error:ae}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').insert({
        teacher_id:session.user.id,
        lesson_id:null,
        class_id:classId,
        title:source.title,
        instructions:message||source.description||'',
        assignment_type:'material',
        due_at:due?new Date(due).toISOString():null,
        points:0,
        priority:'normal',
        resource_items:items,
        cover_image_url:source.cover_image_url||null,
        source_type:'material',
        source_id:sourceId,
        active:true
      }).select().single();
      if(ae)throw ae;
      assignment=a;
    }

    // Avoid duplicate student assignments.
    const {data:already,error:de}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments')
      .select('id,active,status')
      .eq('assignment_id',assignment.id).eq('student_id',studentId).maybeSingle();
    if(de)throw de;

    if(already?.id){
      const {error:ue}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments')
        .update({active:true,status:already.status==='completed'?'completed':'pending',assigned_at:new Date().toISOString(),due_at:due?new Date(due).toISOString():null})
        .eq('id',already.id);
      if(ue)throw ue;
    }else{
      const {error:te}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').insert({
        assignment_id:assignment.id,
        student_id:studentId,
        status:'pending',
        active:true,
        assigned_at:new Date().toISOString(),
        due_at:due?new Date(due).toISOString():null
      });
      if(te)throw te;
    }

    closeModal();
    toast(`“${source.title}” foi atribuído somente a ${$('v52Student')?.selectedOptions?.[0]?.textContent?.split(' · ')[0]||'este aluno'}.`,'success');
    if(typeof materialsPage==='function' && currentView==='materials')await materialsPage();
  }catch(err){
    toast(err?.message||'Não foi possível atribuir o Material.','error');
    if(btn){btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='📤 Atribuir somente a este aluno';}
  }
};
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>


<script>
/* V17 — canonical lesson completion routine: matches tic_lesson_progress schema. */
window.markLessonCompleted = async function(lessonId){
  try {
    const s = await studentRecord();
    if(!s){ toast('Aluno não encontrado.','error'); return; }
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const { data: lp, error: findError } = await sb
      .from('tic_lesson_progress')
      .select('id,first_completed_at,response_count,open_count,last_opened_at')
      .eq('lesson_id', lessonId)
      .eq('student_id', s.id)
      .maybeSingle();
    if(findError){ toast('Não foi possível verificar o progresso: '+findError.message,'error'); return; }

    let error = null;
    if(lp){
      const r = await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress')
        .update({
          first_completed_at: lp.first_completed_at || now,
          last_opened_at: now,
          response_count: Number(lp.response_count || 0),
          open_count: Math.max(1, Number(lp.open_count || 0)),
          updated_at: now
        })
        .eq('id', lp.id);
      error = r.error;
    } else {
      const r = await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').insert({
        lesson_id: lessonId,
        student_id: s.id,
        first_completed_at: now,
        last_opened_at: now,
        open_count: 1,
        response_count: 0,
        updated_at: now
      });
      error = r.error;
    }
    if(error){ toast('Não foi possível registrar a conclusão: '+error.message,'error'); return; }
    toast('Lesson marcada como concluída.','success');
    if(typeof ticLoadStudentData==='function') await ticLoadStudentData();
    else if(typeof loadStudentDashboard==='function') await loadStudentDashboard();
    if(typeof closeModal==='function') closeModal();
  } catch(e){
    toast('Não foi possível registrar a conclusão: '+(e?.message||e),'error');
  }
};
</script>


<style id="tic-v19-visual">
/* V19 — readability upgrade: larger typography while preserving framed/card layout */

body{font-size:14px}

.modal-card{width:min(760px,calc(100vw - 32px));padding:24px}

.lesson-student-header h2,.student-course-head h2{font-size:22px}
.student-action-grid{gap:14px}.student-action-card{padding:19px}.student-action-card b{font-size:14px}.student-action-card small{font-size:11px}
.student-welcome{padding:28px}.student-welcome h2{font-size:29px}.student-welcome p{font-size:14px}.welcome-level b{font-size:24px}
.student-module-head h3{font-size:16px}.student-module-head small{font-size:12px}
.student-curriculum-item{padding:15px 16px!important}.student-curriculum-item .lesson-copy b{font-size:14px}.student-curriculum-item .lesson-copy small{font-size:12px}
.quick b{font-size:12px}.quick small{font-size:10px}
.metric{font-size:13px}
@media(max-width:1100px){.sidebar{width:235px}.main{margin-left:235px}.container{padding-left:22px;padding-right:22px}.quick-grid,.stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:760px){.sidebar{width:275px}.main{margin-left:0}.container{padding:20px 14px 55px}.page-head h1{font-size:24px}.card{padding:17px}.student-action-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.student-welcome h2{font-size:24px}.modal-card{padding:18px}}

/* ---------- Student tab / new-student form UX ---------- */
.modal-card{width:min(940px,calc(100vw - 36px));max-height:calc(100vh - 36px);padding:24px}
.modal-card:has(.student-form){width:min(1040px,calc(100vw - 28px));max-height:calc(100vh - 28px);padding:0;overflow:hidden}
.modal-card:has(.student-form) .modal-head{padding:22px 26px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);position:sticky;top:0;background:#fff;z-index:3}
.student-form{margin-top:0;gap:0;max-height:calc(100vh - 120px);overflow:auto;padding:20px 26px 26px}
.student-form-banner{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;align-items:center;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f5f0ff,#fbfaff);border:1px solid #e5ddfb;border-radius:16px;padding:17px 18px;margin-bottom:15px}
.student-form-kicker{display:block;font-size:9px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:1.2px;color:var(--p);margin-bottom:4px}
.student-form-banner h4{margin:0;font:800 18px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';color:#29263a}.student-form-banner small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;margin-top:4px}.student-form-badge{white-space:nowrap;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:99px;background:#eee8ff;color:var(--p);font-size:9px;font-weight:900}
.student-form-section{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:15px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:12px;background:#fff}.student-form-title{font:800 12px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';color:#363241;margin-bottom:12px}.student-form-section .field small{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.4}.optional{font-weight:500;color:#aaa8b6;font-size:9px}.student-billing-mode{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px;margin-bottom:11px}.billing-option{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:13px;padding:12px;display:flex!important;align-items:center;gap:10px;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s;background:#fff}.billing-option:has(input:checked){border-color:#bdaaf5;background:#faf8ff;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #6844d80c}.billing-option input{width:auto!important}.billing-option b{display:block;font-size:12px}.billing-option small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;margin-top:2px}.registration-free{margin:0 0 11px}.password-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto auto;gap:8px}.password-row .btn{white-space:nowrap}.student-save-summary{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:15px;border-radius:13px;background:#f7f6fa;border:1px solid var(--line);padding:12px 14px;margin-top:2px}.student-save-summary b{display:block;font-size:11px}.student-save-summary small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:9px;margin-top:2px}.student-save-values{display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;white-space:nowrap;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:var(--p)}.student-modal-actions{padding-top:4px}.student-save-btn{min-width:140px}
@media(max-width:760px){.modal{padding:0}.modal-card,.modal-card:has(.student-form){width:100vw;max-width:none;height:100vh;max-height:none;border-radius:0}.modal-card:has(.student-form) .modal-head{padding:16px 17px 13px}.student-form{max-height:calc(100vh - 72px);padding:14px 14px 28px}.student-form-banner{align-items:flex-start;padding:14px}.student-form-banner h4{font-size:16px}.student-form-badge{display:none}.student-form-section{padding:13px}.student-billing-mode{grid-template-columns:1fr}.password-row{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.password-row .btn:first-of-type{grid-column:1}.password-row .btn:last-of-type{grid-column:2}.student-save-summary{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.student-save-values{white-space:normal}.student-modal-actions{position:sticky;bottom:0;background:#fff;padding:11px 0 0;margin:0 -2px}.student-save-btn{flex:1}.student-modal-actions .ghost{min-width:90px}}
</style>
<script>
/* V19 — canonical data layer fixes. Existing data is preserved; no destructive migration. */
async function ticGetStudentOrderedCoursesV19(studentId){
  const {data:student,error:se}=await sb.from('tic_students').select('id,teacher_id').eq('id',studentId).maybeSingle();
  if(se)throw se;if(!student)return [];
  const {data:enroll,error:ee}=await sb.from('tic_course_students').select('course_id,enrolled_at').eq('student_id',studentId).eq('status','active').order('enrolled_at',{ascending:true});
  if(ee)throw ee;
  const ids=(enroll||[]).map(x=>x.course_id).filter(Boolean);if(!ids.length)return [];
  const [{data:courses,error:ce},{data:tracks,error:te}]=await Promise.all([
    sb.from('tic_courses').select('*').in('id',ids).eq('active',true),
    sb.from('tic_course_tracks').select('id,is_default,created_at').eq('teacher_id',student.teacher_id).eq('active',true).order('is_default',{ascending:false}).order('created_at',{ascending:true}).limit(1)
  ]);
  if(ce)throw ce;if(te)throw te;
  const track=tracks?.[0];if(!track)return (courses||[]).sort((a,b)=>ticLevelRankV11(a.level)-ticLevelRankV11(b.level));
  const {data:items,error:ie}=await sb.from('tic_course_track_items').select('course_id,position').eq('track_id',track.id);
  if(ie)throw ie;
  const pos=new Map((items||[]).map(x=>[x.course_id,Number(x.position)||999999]));
  return (courses||[]).sort((a,b)=>(pos.get(a.id)??999999)-(pos.get(b.id)??999999)||ticLevelRankV11(a.level)-ticLevelRankV11(b.level));
}
window.ticGetStudentOrderedCoursesV11=ticGetStudentOrderedCoursesV19;

async function ticRecalculateStudentProgressV19(studentId){
  try{
    const {data:student,error:se}=await sb.from('tic_students').select('id,current_level').eq('id',studentId).maybeSingle();
    if(se||!student)return null;
    const {data:enroll,error:ee}=await sb.from('tic_course_students').select('course_id').eq('student_id',studentId).eq('status','active');
    if(ee)throw ee;
    const ids=(enroll||[]).map(x=>x.course_id).filter(Boolean);
    if(!ids.length)return {overall:0,total:0,done:0,currentLevel:0};
    const [{data:lessons,error:le},{data:done,error:pe}]=await Promise.all([
      sb.from('tic_lessons').select('id,level,skill,course_id').in('course_id',ids).eq('active',true),
      sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').select('lesson_id,first_completed_at').eq('student_id',studentId)
    ]);
    if(le)throw le;if(pe)throw pe;
    const completed=new Set((done||[]).filter(x=>x.first_completed_at).map(x=>x.lesson_id));
    const all=lessons||[];
    const overall=all.length?Math.round(all.filter(l=>completed.has(l.id)).length/all.length*100):0;
    const current=all.filter(l=>(l.level||student.current_level)===(student.current_level));
    const up=[];
    up.push({student_id:studentId,level:student.current_level,skill:'overall',progress:overall,updated_at:new Date().toISOString()});
    const skills=['grammar','vocabulary','listening','reading','writing','speaking','pronunciation'];
    for(const skill of skills){
      const arr=current.filter(l=>(l.skill||'').toLowerCase()===skill);
      const value=arr.length?Math.round(arr.filter(l=>completed.has(l.id)).length/arr.length*100):0;
      up.push({student_id:studentId,level:student.current_level,skill,progress:value,updated_at:new Date().toISOString()});
    }
    const {error:ue}=await sb.from('tic_progress').upsert(up,{onConflict:'student_id,level,skill'});
    if(ue)console.warn('tic_progress V19:',ue.message);
    return {overall,total:all.length,done:all.filter(l=>completed.has(l.id)).length,currentLevel:current.length?Math.round(current.filter(l=>completed.has(l.id)).length/current.length*100):0};
  }catch(e){console.warn('Progress V19:',e);return null}
}
window.ticRecalculateStudentProgressV18=ticRecalculateStudentProgressV19;

window.markLessonCompleted=async function(lessonId){
  try{
    const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;
    const now=new Date().toISOString();
    const {data:lp,error:findError}=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').select('id,first_completed_at,response_count,open_count').eq('lesson_id',lessonId).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();
    if(findError)return toast('Não foi possível verificar o progresso: '+findError.message,'error');
    let error=null;
    if(lp){
      const r=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').update({first_completed_at:lp.first_completed_at||now,last_opened_at:now,open_count:Math.max(1,Number(lp.open_count||0)),response_count:Number(lp.response_count||0),updated_at:now}).eq('id',lp.id);error=r.error;
    }else{
      const r=await sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').insert({lesson_id:lessonId,student_id:s.id,first_completed_at:now,last_opened_at:now,open_count:1,response_count:0,updated_at:now});error=r.error;
    }
    if(error)return toast('Não foi possível registrar a conclusão: '+error.message,'error');
    const snap=await ticRecalculateStudentProgressV19(s.id);
    toast(`Lesson concluída. Progresso geral: ${snap?.overall??0}%.`,'success');
    if(typeof viewStudentLessonInteractive==='function')await viewStudentLessonInteractive(lessonId);else if(typeof loadView==='function')await loadView('studentLessons');
  }catch(e){toast('Não foi possível registrar a conclusão: '+(e?.message||e),'error')}
};

/* My Lessons: course order comes only from the Teacher's Track; lesson order from position. */
window.studentLessons=async function(){
  const s=await studentRecord();if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Conta não vinculada.</div>';return}
  try{
    const courses=await ticGetStudentOrderedCoursesV19(s.id),ids=courses.map(c=>c.id);
    const [{data:ms,error:me},{data:ls,error:le},{data:lp,error:pe},{data:direct,error:de}]=await Promise.all([
      ids.length?sb.from('tic_modules').select('*').in('course_id',ids).order('position',{ascending:true}):Promise.resolve({data:[],error:null}),
      ids.length?sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').in('course_id',ids).eq('active',true).order('position',{ascending:true}).order('created_at',{ascending:true}):Promise.resolve({data:[],error:null}),
      sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').select('lesson_id,first_completed_at').eq('student_id',s.id),
      sb.from('tic_lesson_assignments').select('lesson_id,assigned_at,note,tic_lessons(*)').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('active',true).order('assigned_at',{ascending:false})
    ]);
    if(me||le||pe||de)throw(me||le||pe||de);
    const pmap=new Map((lp||[]).map(x=>[x.lesson_id,x]));
    const item=(l,i)=>{const done=!!pmap.get(l.id)?.first_completed_at;return `<button class="student-curriculum-item" onclick="viewStudentLessonInteractive('${l.id}')"><span class="lesson-number">${i+1}</span><span class="lesson-copy"><b>${esc(l.title)}</b><small>${esc(l.skill||'Lesson')} · ${done?'✓ Concluída':'Não iniciada'}${l.html_enabled?' · 🧩 HTML':''}</small></span><span class="btn sm secondary">Abrir →</span></button>`};
    const courseHtml=courses.map(c=>{
      const cl=(ls||[]).filter(l=>l.course_id===c.id).sort((a,b)=>(Number(a.position)||999999)-(Number(b.position)||999999));
      const mods=(ms||[]).filter(m=>m.course_id===c.id).sort((a,b)=>(Number(a.position)||999999)-(Number(b.position)||999999));
      const modHtml=mods.map(m=>{const ml=cl.filter(l=>l.module_id===m.id);return `<section class="student-module"><div class="student-module-head"><div><span>📁</span><div><h3>${esc(m.title)}</h3><small>${ml.length} lesson(s)</small></div></div><span class="badge blue">${ml.length}</span></div>${ml.map(item).join('')||'<div class="course-empty">Nenhuma lesson neste módulo.</div>'}</section>`}).join('');
      const general=cl.filter(l=>!l.module_id),done=cl.filter(l=>pmap.get(l.id)?.first_completed_at).length;
      return `<article class="student-course-hero card"><div class="student-course-head"><div><span class="badge blue">${esc(c.level||'')}</span><h2>📚 ${esc(c.title)}</h2><p>${esc(c.description||'')}</p></div><span class="badge green">Acesso ativo</span></div><div class="student-course-metrics"><span><b>${mods.length}</b> módulos</span><span><b>${cl.length}</b> lessons</span><span><b>${done}</b> concluídas</span></div><div class="student-module-stack">${modHtml}${general.length?`<section class="student-module"><div class="student-module-head"><div><span>📖</span><div><h3>Lessons gerais</h3><small>Lessons sem módulo específico.</small></div></div><span class="badge yellow">${general.length}</span></div>${general.map(item).join('')}</section>`:''}</div></article>`;
    }).join('');
    const courseLessonIds=new Set((ls||[]).map(l=>l.id));const extra=(direct||[]).map(x=>x.tic_lessons).filter(Boolean).filter(l=>!courseLessonIds.has(l.id));
    const directHtml=extra.length?`<article class="card section"><div class="section-head"><div><h2>📌 Lessons atribuídas diretamente</h2><span>Enviadas pelo Teacher fora do currículo.</span></div><span class="badge blue">${extra.length}</span></div>${extra.sort((a,b)=>(Number(a.position)||999999)-(Number(b.position)||999999)).map(item).join('')}</article>`:'';
    setPage('My Lessons','Aulas na mesma ordem definida pelo Teacher.');$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="notice success">🛤️ <b>Ordem pedagógica:</b> os cursos seguem a sequência definida pelo Teacher. As Lessons seguem a posição definida dentro de cada curso/módulo.</div>${courseHtml||'<div class="card empty">Nenhum curso ativo.</div>'}${directHtml}`;
  }catch(e){$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention">${esc(e.message||e)}</div>`}
};

/* Dashboard uses the same source of truth as My Lessons: completed lessons. */
window.studentDashboard=async function(){
  const s=await studentRecord();if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Sua conta não está vinculada a um cadastro de aluno.</div>';return}
  const snap=await ticRecalculateStudentProgressV19(s.id);
  const [{data:ta},{data:pay}]=await Promise.all([sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('*,tic_assignments(title,due_at)').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('active',true).limit(8),sb.from('tic_monthly_payments').select('*').eq('student_id',s.id).order('reference_month',{ascending:false}).limit(3)]);
  const overall=Number(snap?.overall||0);
  setPage(`Hello, ${s.display_name?.split(' ')[0]||'Student'} 👋`,'Seu espaço de aprendizagem.');
  $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="student-banner"><div style="font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:#aaa1bd">CURRENT LEVEL</div><h2>${esc(s.current_level)} → ${esc(s.target_level||'—')}</h2><p>Progresso geral: <b>${overall}%</b> · ${snap?.done||0}/${snap?.total||0} Lessons concluídas</p><div class="progress" style="margin-top:10px;background:#ffffff22"><i style="width:${overall}%;background:#fff"></i></div></div><div class="grid cols2 section"><div class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>✅ My Tasks</h2></div>${(ta||[]).map(x=>`<div class="row task-row" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="openStudentTask('${x.id}')"><div><b>${esc(x.tic_assignments?.title||'Task')}</b><small>${x.tic_assignments?.due_at?'Prazo '+fmtDate(x.tic_assignments.due_at):'Sem prazo'}</small></div><div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px"><span onclick="event.stopPropagation()">${badge(x.status)}</span><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="event.stopPropagation();openStudentTask('${x.id}')">Abrir</button></div></div>`).join('')||'<div class="empty">Nenhuma tarefa.</div>'}</div><div class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>📊 My Progress</h2><span>${overall}% do currículo</span></div><div class="metric"><span>Lessons concluídas</span><b>${snap?.done||0} / ${snap?.total||0}</b></div><div class="progress" style="margin:8px 0 16px"><i style="width:${overall}%"></i></div>${['grammar','vocabulary','listening','reading','writing','speaking','pronunciation'].map(k=>`<div class="mini"><span>${k}</span><b>nível ${esc(s.current_level)}</b></div>`).join('')}</div></div><div class="card section"><div class="section-head"><h2>💰 My Payments</h2></div>${(pay||[]).map(x=>`<div class="row"><div><b>${monthLabel(x.reference_month)}</b><small>${x.payment_date?'Pago em '+fmtDate(x.payment_date):'Vencimento '+fmtDate(x.due_date)}</small></div><b>${money(x.amount)} ${badge(x.status)}</b></div>`).join('')||'<div class="empty">Nenhum registro.</div>'}</div>`;
};

/* My Courses also uses the teacher-defined order through V19 resolver. */
window.studentCoursesPage=async function(){
  const s=await studentRecord();if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Sua conta ainda não está vinculada a um aluno.</div>';return}
  try{
    const courses=await ticGetStudentOrderedCoursesV19(s.id);setPage('My Courses','Seus cursos em ordem pedagógica.');
    if(!courses.length){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Você ainda não está matriculado em nenhum curso.</div>';return}
    const ids=courses.map(c=>c.id);const [{data:mods},{data:lessons},{data:lp}]=await Promise.all([sb.from('tic_modules').select('*').in('course_id',ids).order('position'),sb.from('tic_lessons').select('*').in('course_id',ids).eq('active',true).order('position').order('created_at'),sb.from('tic_lesson_progress').select('lesson_id,first_completed_at').eq('student_id',s.id)]);const doneSet=new Set((lp||[]).filter(x=>x.first_completed_at).map(x=>x.lesson_id));
    const cards=courses.map((c,ci)=>{const ms=(mods||[]).filter(m=>m.course_id===c.id).sort((a,b)=>(a.position||0)-(b.position||0));const ls=(lessons||[]).filter(l=>l.course_id===c.id).sort((a,b)=>(a.position||0)-(b.position||0));const done=ls.filter(l=>doneSet.has(l.id)).length;return `<article class="student-course-hero card"><div class="student-course-head"><div><span class="badge blue">${ci+1}. ${esc(c.level||'')}</span><h2>📚 ${esc(c.title)}</h2><p>${esc(c.description||'Curso de inglês')}</p></div><span class="badge green">Acesso ativo</span></div><div class="student-course-metrics"><span><b>${ms.length}</b> módulos</span><span><b>${ls.length}</b> lessons</span><span><b>${done}</b> concluídas</span></div><button class="btn primary" onclick="openStudentCourse('${c.id}')">Abrir currículo →</button></article>`}).join('');
    $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="notice success">🛤️ <b>Sequência pedagógica:</b> os cursos aparecem na ordem definida pelo Teacher.</div><div class="tic-student-course-order section">${cards}</div>`;
  }catch(e){$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention">${esc(e.message||e)}</div>`}
};

/* Teacher progress cards read the recalculated data; student view remains consistent. */
window.progressPage=async function(student=false){
  let students=[];
  if(student){const {data:s}=await sb.from('tic_students').select('*').eq('auth_user_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Conta não vinculada.</div>';return}students=[s]}
  else{const {data:s}=await sb.from('tic_students').select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active');students=s||[]}
  for(const s of students)await ticRecalculateStudentProgressV19(s.id);
  const ids=students.map(s=>s.id);const {data:p}=ids.length?await sb.from('tic_progress').select('*').in('student_id',ids):{data:[]};
  $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="grid cols3">${students.map(s=>{const overall=Number(p?.find(x=>x.student_id===s.id&&x.skill==='overall'&&x.level===s.current_level)?.progress||0);return `<div class="card"><div class="section-head"><h2>${esc(s.display_name)}</h2><span>${esc(s.current_level)}</span></div><div style="font:800 30px 'Plus Jakarta Sans'">${overall}%</div><div class="progress"><i style="width:${overall}%"></i></div><div style="margin-top:15px">${['grammar','vocabulary','listening','reading','writing','speaking','pronunciation'].map(k=>{const v=Number(p?.find(x=>x.student_id===s.id&&x.skill===k&&x.level===s.current_level)?.progress||0);return `<div class="mini"><span>${k}</span><b>${v}%</b></div><div class="progress" style="height:6px;margin-bottom:9px"><i style="width:${v}%"></i></div>`}).join('')}</div></div>`}).join('')||'<div class="card empty">Nenhum aluno.</div>'}</div>`;
};
</script>
<!-- V33 SAFE ADDITIVE PATCH: Student Tasks navigation/viewer. No existing function removed. -->
<style id="tic-v33-task-patch">

#ticStudentTaskFull .tic-panel{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e7e1ef;border-radius:18px;padding:20px;box-shadow:0 8px 28px rgba(42,25,70,.05)}
#ticStudentTaskFull .tic-panel h2,#ticStudentTaskFull .tic-panel h3{margin-top:0;color:#241d35}

#ticStudentTaskFull textarea{width:100%;min-height:170px;resize:vertical;border:1px solid #ddd6e9;border-radius:13px;padding:13px;font:inherit;box-sizing:border-box}
#ticStudentTaskFull .tic-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:12px}
#ticStudentTaskFull .tic-html-wrap{background:#f1eff6;border:1px solid #ddd6e9;border-radius:14px;overflow:auto;min-height:420px;display:flex;justify-content:center;padding:14px}
#ticStudentTaskFull .tic-html-frame{width:100%;height:620px;border:0;background:#fff;border-radius:10px;display:block}
#ticStudentTaskFull .tic-html-wrap.tablet .tic-html-frame{width:768px;max-width:100%}
#ticStudentTaskFull .tic-html-wrap.mobile .tic-html-frame{width:390px;max-width:100%}
#ticStudentTaskFull .tic-history-item{padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #eeeaf3}
#ticStudentTaskFull .tic-history-item:last-child{border-bottom:0}
#ticStudentTaskFull .tic-history-item small{display:block;color:#81798f;margin-top:3px}

.class-center-page{width:calc(100% + 64px);margin:-28px -32px -80px;min-height:calc(100vh - 74px);height:calc(100vh - 74px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:#f7f6fb;border-radius:0;}
.class-center-page .class-center-top{flex:0 0 auto;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:35;padding:22px 30px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #e9e5f0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.98);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(35,24,70,.04)}
.class-center-page .class-center-title{max-width:1500px;margin:0 auto;padding-bottom:16px}.class-center-page .class-center-title h2{font-size:28px}.class-center-page .class-center-tabs{max-width:1500px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 0 13px;position:static}
.class-center-page .class-center-body{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow:auto;padding:24px 30px 110px}.class-center-page .class-center-body>*{max-width:1500px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
.class-board-toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;margin-bottom:12px}.class-board-toolbar small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;margin-top:3px}.tic-draggable-board{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(245px,1fr));overflow-x:auto;padding:4px 2px 14px}.tic-draggable-board .class-center-column{min-height:390px;transition:.18s;background:#f5f3fa}.tic-draggable-board .class-center-column.drag-over{background:#ece5ff;border-color:#8b6be8;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #8b6be833}.board-column-body{min-height:320px}.board-task-card{cursor:grab;position:relative;border-left-width:4px;transition:transform .16s,box-shadow .16s,opacity .16s}.board-task-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 9px 24px rgba(38,22,78,.11)}.board-task-card.dragging{opacity:.45;transform:rotate(1deg)}.board-card-type{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;margin-bottom:8px}.board-card-type small{margin:0;font-size:9px}.board-card-actions{margin-top:10px;display:flex;justify-content:flex-end}.board-card-actions .btn{padding:6px 9px;font-size:10px}.board-drop-empty{min-height:80px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.class-center-page .class-center-float{bottom:22px;right:28px;z-index:45}
@media(max-width:760px){.class-center-page{width:calc(100% + 30px);margin:-18px -15px -90px;height:calc(100vh - 74px)}.class-center-page .class-center-top{padding:16px 15px 0}.class-center-page .class-center-body{padding:18px 15px 100px}.tic-draggable-board{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(230px,1fr))}.class-board-toolbar{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}}
</style>
<div id="ticStudentTaskFull" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<script>
(function(){
  function escV(v){try{return esc(v)}catch(e){return String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,m=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[m]))}}
  function closeV33(){const el=document.getElementById('ticStudentTaskFull');if(el){el.classList.remove('open');el.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');el.innerHTML='';document.body.style.overflow='';}}
  window.closeStudentTaskFull=closeV33;
  window.ticV33Device=function(mode){const w=document.getElementById('ticV33HtmlWrap');if(!w)return;w.classList.remove('tablet','mobile');if(mode!=='desktop')w.classList.add(mode)};
  window.openStudentTask=async function(taskAssignmentId){
    const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;
    const {data:x,error}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,active,status,assignment_id,assigned_at,completed_at,tic_assignments(id,title,instructions,due_at,points,html_enabled,html_content,allow_multiple_attempts,cover_image_url,resource_items,lesson_id)').eq('id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();
    if(error||!x)return toast(error?.message||'Não foi possível abrir esta Task.','error');
    if(x.active===false)return toast('Esta Task foi encerrada pelo Teacher.','info');
    const a=x.tic_assignments||{};
    const {data:subs}=await sb.from('tic_submissions').select('id,attempt,grade,submitted_at,answer_text,file_url,audio_url,video_url,status,response_data').eq('task_assignment_id',x.id).eq('student_id',s.id).order('attempt',{ascending:false});
    const latest=(subs||[])[0];
    const ids=(subs||[]).map(z=>z.id);
    const {data:fbs}=ids.length?await sb.from('tic_feedback').select('id,submission_id,comment,grade,private_note,improvement_skill,improvement_link,created_at').in('submission_id',ids).order('created_at',{ascending:false}):{data:[]};
    const feedback=latest?(fbs||[]).find(f=>f.submission_id===latest.id):null;
    const resources=Array.isArray(a.resource_items)?a.resource_items:[];
    const resourceHtml=resources.length?resources.map((r,i)=>{const url=r.url||r.href||r.link||r.value||'';return url?`<a class="tic-resource" href="${escV(ticSafeUrl(url))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">🔗 ${escV(r.title||r.name||`Recurso ${i+1}`)}</a>`:''}).join(''):'';
    const htmlEnabled=!!(a.html_enabled&&a.html_content);
    const attemptNote=a.allow_multiple_attempts===false?'1 tentativa permitida':'Tentativas múltiplas permitidas';
    const history=(subs||[]).map(z=>{const f=(fbs||[]).find(q=>q.submission_id===z.id);return `<div class="tic-history-item"><b>📤 Tentativa ${z.attempt||1}</b><small>${fmtDate(z.submitted_at)} · ${z.grade!=null?'Nota '+z.grade:(f?'Corrigida':'Aguardando correção')}</small>${z.answer_text?`<div style="margin-top:7px;white-space:pre-wrap">${escV(z.answer_text)}</div>`:''}</div>`}).join('')||'<div class="empty">Nenhuma tentativa enviada ainda.</div>';
    const feedbackHtml=feedback&&!feedback.private_note?`<div class="tic-panel"><h3>👨‍🏫 Correção do Teacher</h3>${feedback.grade!=null?`<div class="badge green" style="margin-bottom:10px">Nota: ${feedback.grade}</div>`:''}<div style="white-space:pre-wrap;line-height:1.6">${escV(feedback.comment||'Sem comentário.')}</div>${feedback.improvement_skill||feedback.improvement_link?`<div class="notice" style="margin-top:12px"><b>🎯 Como melhorar</b>${feedback.improvement_skill?`<div>Habilidade: ${escV(feedback.improvement_skill)}</div>`:''}${feedback.improvement_link?`<a class="btn secondary" href="${escV(ticSafeUrl(feedback.improvement_link))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">🔗 Material de melhoria</a>`:''}</div>`:''}</div>`:'';
    const viewer=htmlEnabled?`<section class="tic-panel"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap"><h3>🧩 Atividade interativa</h3><div class="tic-actions" style="margin:0"><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticV33Device('desktop')">🖥 Desktop</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticV33Device('tablet')">▣ Tablet</button><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="ticV33Device('mobile')">📱 Mobile</button></div></div><div id="ticV33HtmlWrap" class="tic-html-wrap"><iframe id="ticV33HtmlFrame" class="tic-html-frame" title="Atividade interativa" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox"></iframe></div><div id="ticV33Status" class="notice">Responda a atividade e use o botão de envio dentro dela. Você também pode enviar uma resposta adicional abaixo.</div></section>`:'';
    const answer=htmlEnabled?'':`<section class="tic-panel"><h3>✍️ Sua resposta</h3><div class="notice">🔓 A atribuição está ativa. ${attemptNote}.</div>${a.instructions?`<div class="tic-instructions" style="margin-bottom:14px">${escV(a.instructions)}</div>`:''}<textarea id="ticV33Answer" placeholder="Digite sua resposta para o Teacher..."></textarea><div class="tic-actions"><button class="btn primary" onclick="submitStudentTaskV33('${x.id}')">📤 Enviar resposta</button></div></section>`;
    const el=document.getElementById('ticStudentTaskFull');
    el.innerHTML=`<div class="tic-task-shell"><header class="tic-task-top"><div><small>Teacher Platform / My Tasks</small><h1>📝 ${escV(a.title||'Task')}</h1></div><div style="display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center"><span class="badge ${x.status==='submitted'?'green':'yellow'}">${x.status==='submitted'?'Enviada':'Pendente'}</span><button class="btn secondary tic-close" onclick="closeStudentTaskFull()">✕ Fechar</button></div></header><main class="tic-task-body"><div class="tic-task-inner"><div><section class="tic-panel"><div class="tic-status"><span class="badge green">🔓 Atribuição ativa</span><span class="badge blue">${a.points||0} pontos</span><span class="badge gray">${a.due_at?'Prazo: '+fmtDate(a.due_at):'Sem prazo'}</span></div>${a.cover_image_url?`<img src="${escV(a.cover_image_url)}" alt="" style="width:100%;max-height:300px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:15px">`:''}${a.instructions?`<div class="tic-instructions">${escV(a.instructions)}</div>`:''}</section>${viewer}${answer}</div><aside><section class="tic-panel"><h3>📚 Recursos</h3>${resourceHtml||'<div class="empty">Nenhum recurso adicional.</div>'}</section><section class="tic-panel"><h3>🔄 Histórico</h3>${history}</section>${feedbackHtml}</aside></div></main></div>`;
    el.classList.add('open');el.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
    if(htmlEnabled){const f=document.getElementById('ticV33HtmlFrame');if(f&&typeof ticFrameHtml==='function'){f.srcdoc=ticFrameHtml(a.html_content)+(typeof ticHtmlBridge==='function'?ticHtmlBridge():'');}}
  };
  window.submitStudentTaskV33=async function(taskAssignmentId){const text=document.getElementById('ticV33Answer')?.value.trim()||'';if(!text)return toast('Digite sua resposta antes de enviar.','info');await submitInteractiveTask(taskAssignmentId,{text,fields:{source:'student_fullscreen'}});if(document.getElementById('ticV33Status'))document.getElementById('ticV33Status').innerHTML='<b>✅ Enviado.</b> Sua resposta foi registrada.';setTimeout(()=>window.openStudentTask(taskAssignmentId),350)};
  window.openStudentTaskViewer=window.openStudentTask;
  document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape'&&document.getElementById('ticStudentTaskFull')?.classList.contains('open'))closeV33()});
})();
</script>


<script>
/* V34 TASK ACCESS HARDENING — additive patch; preserves all previous functions. */
(function(){
  const originalOpen = window.openStudentTask;
  async function openStudentTaskV34(taskAssignmentId){
    try{
      if(!taskAssignmentId){ return toast('Esta Task não possui uma atribuição válida.','error'); }
      const s=await studentRecord();
      if(!s){ return toast('Não foi possível identificar o aluno conectado. Entre novamente.','error'); }
      /* IMPORTANT: tic_assignments does NOT contain video_url/audio_url/pdf_url in the current schema. */
      const q=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments')
        .select('id,active,status,assignment_id,assigned_at,completed_at,tic_assignments(id,title,instructions,due_at,points,html_enabled,html_content,allow_multiple_attempts,cover_image_url,resource_items,lesson_id)')
        .eq('id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',s.id).maybeSingle();
      if(q.error) return toast('Não foi possível abrir a Task: '+q.error.message,'error');
      if(!q.data) return toast('Esta Task não está atribuída a este aluno ou foi encerrada.','error');
      if(q.data.active===false) return toast('Esta Task foi encerrada pelo Teacher.','info');
      /* Delegate rendering to the existing professional full-screen viewer after validating the assignment. */
      if(typeof originalOpen==='function'){
        try { return await originalOpen(taskAssignmentId); }
        catch(e){ console.warn('V34 fallback:',e); }
      }
      /* If the previous renderer is unavailable, render a minimal but fully usable viewer from the validated data. */
      const x=q.data,a=x.tic_assignments||{};
      const el=document.getElementById('ticStudentTaskFull');
      if(!el) return toast('Visualizador de Task não encontrado na página.','error');
      const escx=v=>{try{return esc(v)}catch(e){return String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,m=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[m]))}};
      const resources=Array.isArray(a.resource_items)?a.resource_items:[];
      const resourceHtml=resources.map((r,i)=>{const u=r?.url||r?.href||r?.link||r?.value||'';return u?`<a class="tic-resource" href="${escx(ticSafeUrl(u))}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">🔗 ${escx(r.title||r.name||('Recurso '+(i+1)))}</a>`:''}).join('');
      const viewer=(a.html_enabled&&a.html_content)?`<section class="tic-panel"><h3>🧩 Atividade interativa</h3><div id="ticV34HtmlWrap" class="tic-html-wrap"><iframe id="ticV34HtmlFrame" class="tic-html-frame" sandbox="allow-scripts allow-forms allow-popups allow-popups-to-escape-sandbox"></iframe></div></section>`:'';
      el.innerHTML=`<div class="tic-task-shell"><header class="tic-task-top"><div><small>Teacher Platform / My Tasks</small><h1>📝 ${escx(a.title||'Task')}</h1></div><button class="btn secondary tic-close" onclick="closeStudentTaskFull()">✕ Fechar</button></header><main class="tic-task-body"><div class="tic-task-inner"><div><section class="tic-panel"><div class="tic-status"><span class="badge green">🔓 Atribuição ativa</span><span class="badge blue">${a.points||0} pontos</span><span class="badge gray">${a.due_at?'Prazo: '+fmtDate(a.due_at):'Sem prazo'}</span></div>${a.instructions?`<div class="tic-instructions">${escx(a.instructions)}</div>`:''}</section>${viewer}</div><aside><section class="tic-panel"><h3>📚 Recursos</h3>${resourceHtml||'<div class="empty">Nenhum recurso adicional.</div>'}</section></aside></div></main></div>`;
      el.classList.add('open');el.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
      if(a.html_enabled&&a.html_content){const f=document.getElementById('ticV34HtmlFrame');if(f)f.srcdoc=(typeof ticFrameHtml==='function'?ticFrameHtml(a.html_content):a.html_content)+(typeof ticHtmlBridge==='function'?ticHtmlBridge():'');}
    }catch(e){console.error(e);toast('Erro ao abrir Task: '+(e?.message||e),'error');}
  }
  window.openStudentTask=openStudentTaskV34;
  window.openStudentTaskViewer=openStudentTaskV34;
  window.openStudentTaskFromAnyPlace=openStudentTaskV34;
})();
document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key==='Escape'&&document.querySelector('.class-center-page')){e.preventDefault();loadView('classes')}});
</script>

<script>
/* V39 — Resource Library: additive, reuses tic_materials/resource_items so existing data is preserved. */
(function(){
  const escR=v=>typeof esc==='function'?esc(v??''):String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,m=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[m]));
  const iconR=t=>({pdf:'📕',video:'🎬',audio:'🎧',link:'🔗',drive:'📁',doc:'📄',worksheet:'📝',website:'🌐',file:'📎',other:'📦'})[String(t||'').toLowerCase()]||'🔗';
  const typeLabelR=t=>({pdf:'PDF',video:'Vídeo',audio:'Áudio',link:'Link',drive:'Google Drive',doc:'Documento',worksheet:'Worksheet',website:'Website',file:'Arquivo',other:'Outro'})[String(t||'').toLowerCase()]||t||'Resource';

  window.resourcesPageV39=async function(){
    const [{data:materials,error:me},{data:folders,error:fe}]=await Promise.all([
      sb.from('tic_materials').select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('created_at',{ascending:false}),
      sb.from('tic_material_folders').select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('name')
    ]);
    if(me)return $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention">${escR(me.message)}</div>`;
    const mats=materials||[], fs=folders||[];
    const resources=[];
    mats.forEach(m=>{
      const rs=Array.isArray(m.resource_items)&&m.resource_items.length?m.resource_items:[(m.external_url||m.file_url)?{type:m.material_type||'link',title:m.title,url:m.external_url||m.file_url,description:m.description||''}:null].filter(Boolean);
      rs.forEach((r,i)=>resources.push({...r,_material:m,_index:i,_id:`${m.id}:${i}`}));
    });
    const q=(window.__ticResourceSearchV39||'').toLowerCase();
    const filtered=resources.filter(r=>`${r.title||''} ${r.description||''} ${r.type||''} ${r._material.title||''}`.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    setPage('Resources','Biblioteca do Teacher: links, PDFs, vídeos, áudios, Drive, Docs e vários recursos.','<button class="btn primary" onclick="openResourceFormV39()">+ Novo resource</button>');
    $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="resource-library-v39">
      <div class="resource-overview-v39">
        <div class="resource-stat-v39"><span>🧰 Resources</span><b>${resources.length}</b><small>recursos cadastrados</small></div>
        <div class="resource-stat-v39"><span>📂 Materials</span><b>${mats.length}</b><small>materiais preservados</small></div>
        <div class="resource-stat-v39"><span>📁 Pastas</span><b>${fs.length}</b><small>pastas disponíveis</small></div>
        <div class="resource-stat-v39"><span>🔗 Links</span><b>${resources.filter(r=>String(r.type||'link').toLowerCase()==='link').length}</b><small>links e URLs</small></div>
      </div>
      <div class="resource-toolbar-v39"><input id="resourceSearchV39" value="${escR(window.__ticResourceSearchV39||'')}" placeholder="🔎 Buscar resource, material, tipo..." oninput="window.__ticResourceSearchV39=this.value;resourcesPageV39()"><button class="btn secondary" onclick="openResourceFormV39()">+ Adicionar resource</button><button class="btn ghost" onclick="loadView('materials')">📂 Materials</button></div>
      <div class="resource-help-v39"><b>💡 Como usar:</b> crie um resource com quantos links/arquivos quiser. Depois use <b>Inserir na Class</b> para disponibilizar para toda a turma ou escolha um aluno específico.</div>
      <div class="resource-grid-v39">${filtered.map(r=>`<article class="resource-card-v39"><div class="resource-card-top-v39"><span class="resource-big-icon-v39">${iconR(r.type)}</span><span class="badge blue">${escR(typeLabelR(r.type))}</span></div><h3>${escR(r.title||r._material.title||'Resource')}</h3><p>${escR(r.description||r._material.description||'')}</p><small>${escR(r._material.title)}${r._material.level?' · '+escR(r._material.level):''}</small><div class="resource-actions-v39"><a class="btn sm secondary" href="${escR(r.url||r.link||'#')}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Abrir ↗</a><button class="btn sm primary" onclick="openResourceTargetV39('${r._material.id}')">📤 Inserir na Class</button><button class="btn sm ghost" onclick="openMaterialForm(${JSON.stringify(r._material).replace(/"/g,'&quot;')})">✏️ Editar</button></div></article>`).join('')||'<div class="card empty">Nenhum resource encontrado. Clique em “+ Novo resource” para começar.</div>'}</div>
    </div>`;
  };

  window.openResourceFormV39=function(classId=''){
    const formId='resourceV39Form';
    openModal('🧰 Novo Resource',`<form class="form" id="${formId}" onsubmit="saveResourceV39(event,'${escR(classId)}')">
      <div class="notice">Crie um recurso reutilizável. Você pode cadastrar vários links, PDFs, vídeos, áudios, Drive, Docs ou worksheets dentro do mesmo resource.</div>
      <div class="field"><label>Nome do resource</label><input id="r39Title" required placeholder="Ex.: Listening — Travel A2"></div>
      <div class="form-grid"><div class="field"><label>Nível</label><select id="r39Level"><option value="">—</option>${(typeof levels!=='undefined'?levels:['A0','A1','A2','B1','B2','C1','C2']).map(x=>`<option>${x}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="field"><label>Cor</label><input id="r39Color" type="color" value="#6d4aff" style="width:70px;height:42px"></div></div>
      <div class="field"><label>Descrição</label><textarea id="r39Desc" rows="2" placeholder="Como o Teacher deve usar este resource..."></textarea></div>
      <div class="resource-box"><div class="resource-head"><b>🔗 Links e recursos</b><button type="button" class="btn secondary" onclick="addResourceRow('r39Rows')">+ Adicionar recurso</button></div><div id="r39Rows"></div><div class="resource-help">Adicione quantos recursos quiser. Cada linha pode ser PDF, vídeo, áudio, link, Drive, documento, worksheet etc.</div></div>
      <div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">💾 Salvar resource</button></div>
    </form>`);
    renderResourceRows('r39Rows',[]);
  };

  window.saveResourceV39=async function(e,classId=''){
    e.preventDefault();
    const title=$('r39Title')?.value.trim(); const rows=typeof collectResources==='function'?collectResources('r39Rows'):[];
    if(!title)return toast('Informe o nome do resource.','error');
    if(!rows.length)return toast('Adicione pelo menos um link ou recurso.','error');
    const o={teacher_id:session.user.id,title,material_type:rows[0]?.type||'link',level:$('r39Level')?.value||null,description:$('r39Desc')?.value.trim()||null,resource_items:rows,color:$('r39Color')?.value||'#6d4aff'};
    const {data:mat,error}=await sb.from('tic_materials').insert(o).select().single();
    if(error)return toast('Não foi possível salvar o resource: '+error.message,'error');
    closeModal();toast('Resource criado e preservado em Materials.','success');
    if(classId){await assignResourceMaterialToClassV39(classId,mat.id);return;}
    resourcesPageV39();
  };

  window.openResourceTargetV39=async function(materialId){
    const {data:classes}=await sb.from('tic_classes').select('id,name,level').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).eq('status','active').order('name');
    if(!classes?.length)return toast('Crie uma Class antes de inserir o resource.','info');
    openModal('📤 Inserir Resource na Class',`<div class="form"><div class="field"><label>Class</label><select id="r39Class">${classes.map(c=>`<option value="${c.id}">${escR(c.name)} · ${escR(c.level||'')}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="notice">Depois de escolher a Class, você poderá disponibilizar para <b>todos os alunos</b> ou somente para um aluno.</div><div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn primary" onclick="const cid=$('r39Class').value;closeModal();openResourceAudienceV39(cid,'${materialId}')">Continuar →</button></div></div>`);
  };

  window.openResourceAudienceV39=async function(classId,materialId){
    const {data:students}=await sb.from('tic_class_students').select('student_id').eq('class_id',classId).eq('status','active');
    const ids=(students||[]).map(x=>x.student_id); const {data:people}=ids.length?await sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name,current_level').in('id',ids).order('display_name'):({data:[]});
    openModal('👥 Quem receberá este Resource?',`<div class="form"><div class="notice">Escolha <b>toda a turma</b> ou selecione alunos específicos.</div><div class="field"><label>Destino</label><select id="r39Audience" onchange="document.getElementById('r39StudentBox').style.display=this.value==='students'?'block':'none'"><option value="class">👥 Todos os alunos da Class</option><option value="students">👤 Alunos específicos</option></select></div><div id="r39StudentBox" style="display:none" class="field"><label>Alunos</label><select id="r39Students" multiple size="8">${(people||[]).map(x=>`<option value="${x.id}">${escR(x.display_name)} · ${escR(x.current_level||'')}</option>`).join('')}</select></div><div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary" onclick="assignResourceAudienceV39('${classId}','${materialId}')">📤 Inserir</button></div></div>`);
  };

  window.assignResourceAudienceV39=async function(classId,materialId){
    const mode=$('r39Audience')?.value||'class'; let studentIds=null;
    if(mode==='students'){
      studentIds=[...($('r39Students')?.selectedOptions||[])].map(x=>x.value).filter(Boolean);
      if(!studentIds.length)return toast('Selecione pelo menos um aluno.','error');
    }
    /* 'class' means publish to the Class itself. It must work even when the Class has zero active students. */
    await assignResourceMaterialToClassV39(classId,materialId,studentIds); closeModal();
  };

  async function assignResourceMaterialToClassV39(classId,materialId,studentIds=null){
    const {data:source,error:se}=await sb.from('tic_materials').select('*').eq('id',materialId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();
    if(se||!source)return toast('Resource não encontrado.','error');
    const payload={teacher_id:session.user.id,class_id:classId,title:source.title,instructions:source.description||'',assignment_type:'material',due_at:null,points:0,priority:'normal',resource_items:Array.isArray(source.resource_items)?source.resource_items:[],cover_image_url:source.cover_image_url||null,source_type:'material',source_id:source.id};
    const {data:a,error:ae}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').insert(payload).select().single();
    if(ae)return toast('Não foi possível inserir na Class: '+ae.message,'error');

    /* If studentIds is null, the content belongs to the Class and will be visible to students
       who are linked to it now or later. No student row is required at creation time. */
    if(Array.isArray(studentIds) && studentIds.length){
      const {error:te}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').insert(studentIds.map(student_id=>({assignment_id:a.id,student_id,status:'pending'})));
      if(te){await sb.from('tic_assignments').delete().eq('id',a.id);return toast('Não foi possível disponibilizar para os alunos: '+te.message,'error');}
    }
    const count=Array.isArray(studentIds)?studentIds.length:0;
    toast(count?`Resource “${source.title}” disponibilizado para ${count} aluno(s).`:`Resource “${source.title}” registrado na Class. Os alunos vinculados posteriormente também poderão vê-lo.`, 'success');
    if(document.querySelector(`.class-center-shell[data-class-center="${classId}"]`))setTimeout(()=>openClassCenter(classId,'resources'),250);
  }
  window.assignResourceMaterialToClassV39=assignResourceMaterialToClassV39;

  window.openResourcePickerV39=async function(classId){
    const {data,error}=await sb.from('tic_materials').select('id,title,level,material_type,resource_items,description').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('created_at',{ascending:false});
    if(error)return toast(error.message,'error');
    openModal('📚 Inserir Resources existentes',`<div class="form"><div class="field"><label>Resources / Materials <span style="font-weight:500;color:var(--muted)">— selecione vários</span></label><select id="r39Pick" multiple size="10" style="min-height:230px">${(data||[]).map(x=>`<option value="${x.id}">${escR(x.title)} · ${escR(x.level||'')} · ${escR(x.material_type||'resource')}</option>`).join('')||'<option value="">Nenhum resource cadastrado</option>'}</select><small style="color:var(--muted)">Ctrl/Cmd para selecionar vários.</small></div><div class="field"><label>Destino</label><select id="r39PickAudience"><option value="class">👥 Todos os alunos da Class</option><option value="student">👤 Um aluno específico</option></select></div><div id="r39PickStudentBox"></div><div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary" onclick="insertPickedResourcesV39('${classId}')">📤 Inserir selecionados</button></div></div>`);
    $('r39PickAudience').addEventListener('change',async()=>{
      if($('r39PickAudience').value!=='student'){ $('r39PickStudentBox').innerHTML=''; return; }
      const {data:m}=await sb.from('tic_class_students').select('student_id').eq('class_id',classId).eq('status','active'); const ids=(m||[]).map(x=>x.student_id); const {data:st}=ids.length?await sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name,current_level').in('id',ids).order('display_name'):({data:[]});
      $('r39PickStudentBox').innerHTML=`<div class="field"><label>Aluno</label><select id="r39PickStudent">${(st||[]).map(x=>`<option value="${x.id}">${escR(x.display_name)} · ${escR(x.current_level||'')}</option>`).join('')}</select></div>`;
    });
  };
  window.insertPickedResourcesV39=async function(classId){
    const ids=[...($('r39Pick')?.selectedOptions||[])].map(o=>o.value).filter(Boolean);if(!ids.length)return toast('Selecione pelo menos um resource.','error');
    const target=$('r39PickAudience')?.value||'class';let studentIds=null;
    if(target==='student')studentIds=[$('r39PickStudent')?.value].filter(Boolean);
    for(const id of ids)await assignResourceMaterialToClassV39(classId,id,studentIds);
    closeModal();setTimeout(()=>openClassCenter(classId,'resources'),250);
  };

  window.loadClassResourcesV39=async function(classId){
    const box=$('classResourceListV39');if(!box)return;
    const {data,error}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').select('id,title,assignment_type,resource_items,created_at,source_id').eq('class_id',classId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('created_at',{ascending:false});
    if(error){box.innerHTML=`<div class="class-center-empty">${escR(error.message)}</div>`;return;}
    const rows=[];(data||[]).forEach(a=>(Array.isArray(a.resource_items)?a.resource_items:[]).forEach(r=>rows.push({...r,assignment:a})));
    box.innerHTML=rows.map(r=>`<article class="class-resource-card-v39"><div class="resource-big-icon-v39">${iconR(r.type)}</div><div style="flex:1"><b>${escR(r.title||r.assignment.title)}</b><small>${escR(typeLabelR(r.type))} · inserido em ${new Date(r.assignment.created_at).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR')}</small>${r.description?`<p>${escR(r.description)}</p>`:''}</div><a class="btn sm secondary" href="${escR(r.url||r.link||'#')}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Abrir ↗</a></article>`).join('')||'<div class="class-center-empty">Nenhum resource inserido nesta Class ainda.</div>';
  };
})();
</script>
<style id="tic-resource-library-v39">
.resource-library-v39{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}.resource-overview-v39{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}.resource-stat-v39{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:16px}.resource-stat-v39 span{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)}.resource-stat-v39 b{display:block;font-size:28px;margin-top:5px}.resource-stat-v39 small{color:var(--muted)}.resource-toolbar-v39{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}.resource-toolbar-v39 input{flex:1;min-width:260px}.resource-help-v39{background:#f5f1ff;border:1px solid #e4d9ff;border-radius:14px;padding:13px;color:#62577b;font-size:12px}.resource-grid-v39{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}.resource-card-v39,.class-resource-card-v39{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:17px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(35,24,65,.05)}.resource-card-top-v39{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center}.resource-big-icon-v39{font-size:27px}.resource-card-v39 h3{margin:10px 0 5px;font-size:16px}.resource-card-v39 p,.class-resource-card-v39 p{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);min-height:30px}.resource-card-v39>small,.class-resource-card-v39 small{color:var(--muted);display:block}.resource-actions-v39{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:13px}.class-resource-grid-v39{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:11px}.class-resource-card-v39{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center}.class-resource-card-v39 .resource-big-icon-v39{flex:0 0 auto}.class-resource-card-v39 b{display:block}.class-resource-card-v39 small{margin-top:4px}.class-resource-card-v39 a{margin-left:auto}.class-center-tabs button[data-tab="resources"]{border-color:#cfc0ff}.class-center-tabs button[data-tab="resources"].active{box-shadow:0 8px 20px #6844d833}
