@media(max-width:950px){.resource-overview-v39{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.resource-grid-v39{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.class-resource-grid-v39{grid-template-columns:1fr}}@media(max-width:650px){.resource-overview-v39,.resource-grid-v39{grid-template-columns:1fr}.resource-toolbar-v39 input{min-width:100%}}
</style>
<script>
/* V39 route: preserve the previous loadView and add Resources as a new teacher workspace. */
(function(){
 const previousLoadView=window.loadView;
 window.loadView=async function(v){
   if(v==='resources'){
     currentView=v;toggleMobile();
     document.querySelectorAll('#teacherNav [data-view]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.view===v));
     const c=document.querySelector('.main>.container');if(c)c.scrollTo({top:0,left:0,behavior:'instant'});
     return resourcesPageV39();
   }
   return previousLoadView(v);
 };
})();
</script>


<style id="tic-class-center-v41-css">
/* V41 — Class Center: dedicated Teacher workspace + reliable student activity */
.class-center-v41{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px}
.class-center-v41 .v41-hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#4d24a8,#7650df);color:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:22px;box-shadow:0 14px 35px rgba(76,36,168,.18)}
.class-center-v41 .v41-hero h1{margin:5px 0 6px;font:800 28px 'Plus Jakarta Sans'}
.class-center-v41 .v41-hero p{margin:0;opacity:.84;font-size:12px}
.v41-class-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
.v41-class-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 5px 18px rgba(35,20,75,.05);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.v41-class-card h3{margin:0;font:800 17px 'Plus Jakarta Sans'}
.v41-class-card .v41-meta{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px}
.v41-class-card .v41-meta div{background:#faf9fd;border:1px solid #eee9f6;border-radius:11px;padding:9px}
.v41-class-card .v41-meta span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px}
.v41-class-card .v41-meta b{display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:12px}
.v41-class-actions{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.v41-toolbar{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.v41-toolbar input{flex:1;min-width:240px}
.v41-kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:11px}
.v41-kpi{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:15px;padding:14px}
.v41-kpi span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px}
.v41-kpi b{display:block;font:800 25px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin-top:5px}
.v41-class-shell{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;overflow:hidden}
.v41-class-head{padding:20px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fff,#fbfaff)}
.v41-class-head-main{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;align-items:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap}
.v41-class-head h2{margin:6px 0 4px;font:800 25px 'Plus Jakarta Sans'}
.v41-class-head small{color:var(--muted)}
.v41-class-head-actions{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end}
.v41-tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;overflow-x:auto;padding:13px 20px 0;scrollbar-width:thin}
.v41-tabs button{border:1px solid transparent;background:#f5f2fc;color:#625b73;border-radius:10px;padding:9px 12px;white-space:nowrap;font-weight:800;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer}
.v41-tabs button.active{background:var(--p);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 7px 18px rgba(104,68,216,.18)}
.v41-body{padding:18px 20px 30px}
.v41-panel{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:14px}
.v41-panel h3{margin:0 0 5px;font:800 16px 'Plus Jakarta Sans'}
.v41-panel>p{margin:0 0 13px;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px}
.v41-student-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}
.v41-student-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.v41-student-top{display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:center}
.v41-student-avatar{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:13px;background:#f0ebff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:21px;flex:0 0 auto}
.v41-student-top b{display:block;font-size:14px}
.v41-student-top small{display:block;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px;font-size:10px;word-break:break-word}
.v41-activity-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:8px;margin-top:2px}
.v41-activity-box{border:1px solid #eee9f6;background:#faf9fd;border-radius:11px;padding:9px}
.v41-activity-box span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:9px}
.v41-activity-box b{display:block;margin-top:3px;font-size:11px}
.v41-online{color:#198754!important}.v41-offline{color:#7a7288!important}
.v41-student-actions{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.v41-empty{border:1px dashed #d9d2e6;border-radius:14px;padding:30px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);background:#fbfaff}
.v41-list{display:grid;gap:8px}
.v41-list-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:11px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:11px}
.v41-board{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(210px,1fr));gap:11px;overflow-x:auto}
.v41-board-col{background:#f7f5fb;border:1px solid #e7e1f2;border-radius:14px;padding:10px;min-height:220px}
.v41-board-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-weight:800;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:9px}
.v41-board-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:4px solid var(--p);border-radius:11px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;cursor:grab}
.v41-board-card b{font-size:11px}.v41-board-card small{display:block;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px;font-size:9px}
.v41-board-drop{min-height:120px}
.v41-loading{padding:25px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted)}
@media(max-width:1050px){.v41-class-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.v41-kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:760px){.v41-class-grid,.v41-student-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.v41-kpis{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.v41-body{padding:14px 12px 25px}.v41-class-head{padding:15px}.v41-tabs{padding-left:12px;padding-right:12px}.v41-class-head h2{font-size:20px}.v41-activity-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:450px){.v41-kpis{grid-template-columns:1fr}.v41-activity-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>

<script id="tic-class-center-v41-js">
(function(){
  'use strict';

  const escV41 = v => {
    try { return typeof esc==='function' ? esc(v ?? '') : String(v ?? '').replace(/[&<>"']/g,m=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[m])); }
    catch(e){ return String(v ?? ''); }
  };
  const fmtV41 = v => {
    if(!v) return '—';
    const d = new Date(v);
    if(Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return '—';
    return d.toLocaleString('pt-BR',{dateStyle:'short',timeStyle:'short'});
  };
  const fmtDateV41 = v => {
    if(!v) return '—';
    const d=new Date(v); if(Number.isNaN(d.getTime())) return '—';
    return d.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR');
  };
  const fmtDurationV41 = sec => {
    sec=Math.max(0,Math.round(Number(sec)||0));
    const h=Math.floor(sec/3600), m=Math.floor((sec%3600)/60), s=sec%60;
    if(h) return `${h}h ${String(m).padStart(2,'0')}min`;
    if(m) return `${m}min`;
    return `${s}s`;
  };
  const onlineV41 = last => {
    if(!last) return false;
    const ms=Date.now()-new Date(last).getTime();
    return ms>=0 && ms<=120000;
  };

  /* ---------- Student activity tracking ---------- */
  let activityRowV41=null;
  let activityStudentV41=null;
  let activityTimerV41=null;
  let activityLastTickV41=0;
  let activityAccumV41=0;
  let activityStartingV41=false;

  async function findStudentForSessionV41(){
    if(!session?.user?.id) return null;
    const {data,error}=await sb.from('tic_students')
      .select('id,teacher_id,auth_user_id,display_name,status')
      .eq('auth_user_id',session.user.id)
      .maybeSingle();
    if(error){ console.warn('[V41 activity]',error.message); return null; }
    return data||null;
  }

  async function flushActivityV41(force=false){
    if(!activityRowV41 || !activityStudentV41) return;
    const now=Date.now();
    if(document.visibilityState!=='visible' && !force){
      return;
    }
    if(activityLastTickV41){
      const delta=Math.max(0,Math.min(120,Math.floor((now-activityLastTickV41)/1000)));
      if(delta>0) activityAccumV41 += delta;
    }
    activityLastTickV41=now;
    const payload={
      last_seen_at:new Date(now).toISOString(),
      duration_seconds:Math.round(activityAccumV41)
    };
    const {error}=await sb.from('tic_student_activity').update(payload).eq('id',activityRowV41);
    if(error) console.warn('[V41 activity flush]',error.message);
    activityAccumV41=0;
  }

  async function stopActivityV41(){
    if(activityTimerV41){clearInterval(activityTimerV41);activityTimerV41=null;}
    if(activityRowV41){
      await flushActivityV41(true);
    }
    activityRowV41=null;activityStudentV41=null;activityLastTickV41=0;activityAccumV41=0;
  }

  async function startActivityV41(){
    if(activityStartingV41 || activityRowV41 || !session?.user?.id) return;
    activityStartingV41=true;
    try{
      const st=await findStudentForSessionV41();
      if(!st){activityStartingV41=false;return;}
      activityStudentV41=st;
      const now=new Date().toISOString();
      const {data,error}=await sb.from('tic_student_activity').insert({
        student_id:st.id,
        auth_user_id:session.user.id,
        started_at:now,
        last_seen_at:now,
        duration_seconds:0,
        user_agent:navigator.userAgent.slice(0,500)
      }).select('id').single();
      if(error){console.warn('[V41 activity start]',error.message);activityStartingV41=false;return;}
      activityRowV41=data.id;
      activityLastTickV41=Date.now();
      activityAccumV41=0;
      if(activityTimerV41)clearInterval(activityTimerV41);
      activityTimerV41=setInterval(()=>{ if(document.visibilityState==='visible') flushActivityV41(false); },30000);
      activityStartingV41=false;
    }catch(e){
      console.warn('[V41 activity]',e);
      activityStartingV41=false;
    }
  }

  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{
    if(!activityRowV41) return;
    if(document.visibilityState==='hidden'){
      flushActivityV41(true);
    }else{
      activityLastTickV41=Date.now();
    }
  });

  window.addEventListener('beforeunload',()=>{ try{ flushActivityV41(true); }catch(_){} });
  window.ticStartStudentActivityV41=startActivityV41;
  window.ticStopStudentActivityV41=stopActivityV41;

  /* Supabase can fire INITIAL_SESSION after this module loads. */
  if(window.sb?.auth){
    sb.auth.onAuthStateChange((event,s)=>{
      if(s && s.user){
        setTimeout(()=>{
          if(profile?.role==='student') startActivityV41();
        },400);
      }else{
        stopActivityV41();
      }
    });
  }
  setTimeout(()=>{ if(profile?.role==='student' && session?.user?.id) startActivityV41(); },700);

  /* ---------- Activity aggregation for Teacher ---------- */
  async function getActivityMapV41(studentIds){
    const ids=[...(new Set(studentIds||[]))].filter(Boolean);
    const map={};
    ids.forEach(id=>map[id]={last_login:null,last_seen:null,total_seconds:0,sessions:0});
    if(!ids.length) return map;
    const {data,error}=await sb.from('tic_student_activity')
      .select('id,student_id,started_at,last_seen_at,duration_seconds')
      .in('student_id',ids)
      .order('started_at',{ascending:false})
      .limit(10000);
    if(error){
      console.warn('[V41 activity read]',error.message);
      return map;
    }
    (data||[]).forEach(row=>{
      const x=map[row.student_id]||(map[row.student_id]={last_login:null,last_seen:null,total_seconds:0,sessions:0});
      x.sessions++;
      x.total_seconds += Number(row.duration_seconds)||0;
      if(!x.last_login || new Date(row.started_at)>new Date(x.last_login)) x.last_login=row.started_at;
      if(!x.last_seen || new Date(row.last_seen_at)>new Date(x.last_seen)) x.last_seen=row.last_seen_at;
    });
    return map;
  }
  window.ticRefreshStudentActivityV41=async function(studentIds){
    const map=await getActivityMapV41(studentIds);
    const s=window.__ticClassCenterV41;
    if(s?.classId && Array.isArray(s.students)) renderStudentsV41(s.classId,s.students,map);
    return map;
  };

  function activityStatusHtmlV41(a){
    return onlineV41(a?.last_seen)
      ? '<span class="badge green">🟢 Online</span>'
      : '<span class="badge gray">⚪ Offline</span>';
  }

  function renderStudentsV41(classId,students,activityMap){
    const body=document.getElementById('ticV41StudentsBody');
    if(!body)return;
    const rows=(students||[]).map(st=>{
      const a=activityMap?.[st.id]||{};
      return `<article class="v41-student-card">
        <div class="v41-student-top">
          <span class="v41-student-avatar">👤</span>
          <div style="min-width:0;flex:1">
            <b>${escV41(st.display_name||'Aluno')}</b>
            <small>${escV41(st.current_level||'')} ${st.email?'· '+escV41(st.email):''}</small>
            <div style="margin-top:6px">${activityStatusHtmlV41(a)}</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="v41-activity-grid">
          <div class="v41-activity-box"><span>🕐 Último login</span><b>${fmtV41(a.last_login)}</b></div>
          <div class="v41-activity-box"><span>👀 Última atividade</span><b>${fmtV41(a.last_seen)}</b></div>
          <div class="v41-activity-box"><span>⏱️ Tempo ativo</span><b>${fmtDurationV41(a.total_seconds)}</b></div>
          <div class="v41-activity-box"><span>🔁 Sessões</span><b>${a.sessions||0}</b></div>
        </div>
        <div class="v41-student-actions">
          <button class="btn sm primary" onclick="openClassStudentContent('${classId}','${st.id}')">➕ Conteúdo</button>
          <button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="openStudentView('${st.id}')">👤 Abrir aluno</button>
        </div>
      </article>`;
    }).join('');
    body.innerHTML=rows||'<div class="v41-empty">Nenhum aluno ativo nesta Class.</div>';
  }

  /* ---------- Dedicated Class Center home ---------- */
  async function classCenterHomeV41(){
    currentView='classCenter';
    document.querySelectorAll('#teacherNav [data-view]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.view==='classCenter'));
    if(typeof setPage==='function') setPage('Class Center','Gerencie turmas, alunos, conteúdo, Board e atividade em um único workspace.','<button class="btn primary" onclick="openClassForm()">+ Nova Class</button>');
    const content=$('content');
    content.innerHTML='<div class="class-center-v41"><div class="v41-loading">Carregando Class Center...</div></div>';
    const {data:classes,error}=await sb.from('tic_classes').select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('created_at',{ascending:false});
    if(error){
      content.innerHTML=`<div class="card attention"><b>Não foi possível carregar o Class Center.</b><p>${escV41(error.message)}</p><button class="btn primary" onclick="window.classCenterHomeV41()">Tentar novamente</button></div>`;
      return;
    }
    const ids=(classes||[]).map(c=>c.id);
    let members=[];
    if(ids.length){
      const r=await sb.from('tic_class_students').select('class_id,student_id,status').in('class_id',ids);
      if(!r.error) members=r.data||[];
    }
    const counts={}; (members||[]).forEach(m=>{if(m.status==='active')counts[m.class_id]=(counts[m.class_id]||0)+1;});
    const q=(window.__ticV41ClassSearch||'').toLowerCase().trim();
    const filtered=(classes||[]).filter(c=>`${c.name||''} ${c.level||''} ${c.schedule_text||''}`.toLowerCase().includes(q));
    content.innerHTML=`<div class="class-center-v41">
      <section class="v41-hero"><small>TEACHER COMMAND CENTER</small><h1>🎯 Class Center</h1><p>Um espaço completo para administrar cada turma, seus alunos e o que acontece dentro da Class.</p></section>
      <div class="v41-kpis">
        <div class="v41-kpi"><span>🏫 Classes</span><b>${classes?.length||0}</b></div>
        <div class="v41-kpi"><span>👥 Alunos vinculados</span><b>${members.filter(m=>m.status==='active').length}</b></div>
        <div class="v41-kpi"><span>🟢 Classes ativas</span><b>${classes.filter(c=>c.status==='active').length}</b></div>
        <div class="v41-kpi"><span>📚 Níveis</span><b>${new Set(classes.map(c=>c.level).filter(Boolean)).size}</b></div>
        <div class="v41-kpi"><span>📅 Com horário</span><b>${classes.filter(c=>c.schedule_text).length}</b></div>
      </div>
      <div class="v41-toolbar">
        <input value="${escV41(window.__ticV41ClassSearch||'')}" placeholder="🔎 Buscar Class por nome, nível ou horário..." oninput="window.__ticV41ClassSearch=this.value;window.classCenterHomeV41()">
        <button class="btn secondary" onclick="openClassForm()">+ Nova Class</button>
        <button class="btn ghost" onclick="loadView('classes')">📋 Ver lista Classes</button>
      </div>
      <div class="v41-class-grid">
        ${filtered.map(c=>`<article class="v41-class-card">
          <div><span class="badge blue">${escV41(c.level||'A1')}</span><h3>${escV41(c.name||'Class')}</h3><small>${escV41(c.schedule_text||'Horário não definido')}</small></div>
          <div class="v41-meta">
            <div><span>👥 Alunos</span><b>${counts[c.id]||0}</b></div>
            <div><span>🔗 Aula online</span><b>${c.meeting_url?'Configurada':'Não definida'}</b></div>
          </div>
          <div>${c.status==='active'?'<span class="badge green">Ativa</span>':'<span class="badge gray">'+escV41(c.status||'inactive')+'</span>'}</div>
          <div class="v41-class-actions">
            <button class="btn sm primary" onclick="openClassCenterV41('${c.id}')">🎯 Abrir Class Center</button>
            <button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="openClassMembers('${c.id}')">👥 Alunos</button>
            <button class="btn sm ghost" onclick="openClassFormById('${c.id}')">✏️ Editar</button>
          </div>
        </article>`).join('')||'<div class="v41-empty">Nenhuma Class encontrada. Clique em “Nova Class” para criar a primeira.</div>'}
      </div>
    </div>`;
  }

  async function openClassCenterV41(classId,initialTab='overview'){
    const {data:cls,error}=await sb.from('tic_classes').select('*').eq('id',classId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();
    if(error||!cls)return toast(error?.message||'Class não encontrada.','error');

    const {data:members,error:memberError}=await sb.from('tic_class_students')
      .select('student_id,status').eq('class_id',classId);
    if(memberError)return toast('Não foi possível carregar os alunos da Class: '+memberError.message,'error');

    const activeIds=(members||[]).filter(x=>x.status==='active').map(x=>x.student_id);
    const [{data:students,error:se},{data:assignments,error:ae},{data:events,error:ee}]=await Promise.all([
      activeIds.length?sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name,current_level,email,status').in('id',activeIds).order('display_name'):Promise.resolve({data:[],error:null}),
      sb.from('tic_assignments').select('id,title,instructions,due_at,points,assignment_type,active,created_at,task_level,cefr_level,skill,resource_items,class_id').eq('class_id',classId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('created_at',{ascending:false}),
      sb.from('tic_events').select('id,title,event_type,starts_at,ends_at,notes,meeting_url,status,created_at').eq('class_id',classId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('starts_at',{ascending:false})
    ]);
    if(se)return toast('Erro ao carregar alunos: '+se.message,'error');
    if(ae)return toast('Erro ao carregar conteúdo da Class: '+ae.message,'error');
    if(ee)return toast('Erro ao carregar aulas da Class: '+ee.message,'error');

    /* Board is optional here: if the table/policy has an issue, the rest of Class Center still opens. */
    let boardItems=[];
    const br=await sb.from('tic_class_board_items').select('id,title,description,item_type,status,position,source_type,source_id,created_at,updated_at').eq('class_id',classId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('position').order('created_at');
    if(!br.error) boardItems=br.data||[];

    window.__ticClassCenterV41={classId,cls,students:students||[],tasks:assignments||[],evs:events||[],boardItems};
    const tabs=[
      ['overview','📊 Visão geral'],['board','📌 Board'],['lessons','📚 Aulas'],
      ['students','👥 Alunos'],['tasks','📝 Tasks'],['materials','🔗 Materiais'],
      ['resources','🧰 Resources'],['notes','💬 Observações'],['progress','📈 Progresso']
    ];
    $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="v41-class-shell" data-v41-class="${escV41(classId)}">
      <header class="v41-class-head">
        <div class="v41-class-head-main">
          <div><span class="badge blue">${escV41(cls.level||'A1')}</span><h2>🎯 ${escV41(cls.name||'Class')}</h2><small>${escV41(cls.schedule_text||'Horário não definido')} · ${cls.meeting_url?'Aula online configurada':'Aula online não definida'}</small></div>
          <div class="v41-class-head-actions">
            <button class="btn secondary" onclick="openClassMembers('${classId}')">👥 Alunos</button>
            <button class="btn primary" onclick="openClassAssign('${classId}')">📤 Atribuir</button>
            <button class="btn ghost" onclick="openClassFormById('${classId}')">✏️ Editar</button>
            <button class="btn ghost" onclick="classCenterHomeV41()">← Class Center</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="v41-tabs">${tabs.map(([id,label])=>`<button data-tab="${id}" class="${initialTab===id?'active':''}" onclick="classCenterTabV41('${classId}','${id}')">${label}</button>`).join('')}</div>
      </header>
      <main id="ticV41ClassBody" class="v41-body"><div class="v41-loading">Carregando...</div></main>
    </div>`;
    await classCenterTabV41(classId,initialTab);
    window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
  }

  function boardHtmlV41(s){
    const tasks=s.tasks||[], items=s.boardItems||[];
    const statusMap=new Map(items.map(x=>[x.source_id,x.status]));
    const cols=[['planned','📋 Planejado'],['doing','🔵 Em andamento'],['review','🟡 Revisão'],['done','🟢 Concluído']];
    const fallback=t=>t.active===false?'done':'planned';
    return `<div class="v41-board">${cols.map(([key,label])=>{
      const list=tasks.filter(t=>(statusMap.get(t.id)||fallback(t))===key);
      return `<section class="v41-board-col" data-v41-board="${key}" ondragover="event.preventDefault();this.style.background='#eee8fb'" ondragleave="this.style.background=''" ondrop="ticV41BoardDrop(event,'${key}')">
        <div class="v41-board-head"><span>${label}</span><span>${list.length}</span></div>
        <div class="v41-board-drop">${list.map(t=>`<article class="v41-board-card" draggable="true" ondragstart="ticV41BoardStart(event,'${t.id}')"><b>${escV41(t.title)}</b><small>${escV41(t.assignment_type||'task')}${t.cefr_level?' · '+escV41(t.cefr_level):''}</small></article>`).join('')||'<div class="v41-empty">Solte aqui</div>'}</div>
      </section>`;
    }).join('')}</div>`;
  }

  window.ticV41BoardStart=(e,id)=>{window.__ticV41Drag=id;try{e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain',id);e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed='move'}catch(_){}};
  window.ticV41BoardDrop=async(e,status)=>{
    e.preventDefault();
    const id=e.dataTransfer?.getData('text/plain')||window.__ticV41Drag;
    const s=window.__ticClassCenterV41||{};
    if(!id||!s.classId)return;
    const task=(s.tasks||[]).find(x=>x.id===id);if(!task)return;
    const map={planned:'planned',doing:'doing',review:'review',done:'done'};
    const newStatus=map[status];if(!newStatus)return;
    const existing=(s.boardItems||[]).find(x=>x.source_id===id);
    let r;
    if(existing){
      r=await sb.from('tic_class_board_items').update({status:newStatus,updated_at:new Date().toISOString()}).eq('id',existing.id).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);
    }else{
      r=await sb.from('tic_class_board_items').insert({teacher_id:session.user.id,class_id:s.classId,title:task.title,description:task.instructions||null,item_type:task.assignment_type||'task',status:newStatus,position:Date.now(),source_type:'assignment',source_id:id});
    }
    if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível salvar o Board: '+r.error.message,'error');
    await openClassCenterV41(s.classId,'board');
  };

  async function classCenterTabV41(classId,tab){
    const s=window.__ticClassCenterV41||{};
    if(s.classId!==classId)return;
    const body=document.getElementById('ticV41ClassBody');if(!body)return;
    document.querySelectorAll('.v41-tabs button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.tab===tab));
    const tasks=s.tasks||[],evs=s.evs||[],students=s.students||[],cls=s.cls||{};
    const kpis=`<div class="v41-kpis">
      <div class="v41-kpi"><span>👥 Alunos</span><b>${students.length}</b></div>
      <div class="v41-kpi"><span>📝 Conteúdos</span><b>${tasks.length}</b></div>
      <div class="v41-kpi"><span>📚 Aulas</span><b>${evs.length}</b></div>
      <div class="v41-kpi"><span>🧰 Resources</span><b>${tasks.reduce((n,t)=>n+(Array.isArray(t.resource_items)?t.resource_items.length:0),0)}</b></div>
      <div class="v41-kpi"><span>📅 Nível</span><b>${escV41(cls.level||'—')}</b></div>
    </div>`;

    if(tab==='overview'){
      body.innerHTML=kpis+`<div class="v41-panel"><h3>📊 Resumo da Class</h3><p>O conteúdo abaixo pertence à Class e permanece registrado mesmo quando ainda não existem alunos ativos.</p>${boardHtmlV41(s)}</div>
      <div class="v41-panel"><h3>🕐 Últimas atividades</h3><div class="v41-list">${[...evs.map(x=>({...x,_date:x.starts_at||x.created_at})),...tasks.map(x=>({...x,_date:x.created_at,event_type:'content'}))].sort((a,b)=>new Date(b._date||0)-new Date(a._date||0)).slice(0,8).map(x=>`<div class="v41-list-row"><div><b>${escV41(x.title||'Registro')}</b><small>${escV41(x.event_type||'atividade')}</small></div><small>${fmtV41(x._date)}</small></div>`).join('')||'<div class="v41-empty">Nenhum registro ainda.</div>'}</div></div>`;
      return;
    }
    if(tab==='board'){
      body.innerHTML=kpis+`<div class="v41-panel"><h3>📌 Board da Class</h3><p>Arraste os conteúdos entre as colunas. O status é salvo no Supabase.</p>${boardHtmlV41(s)}</div>`;
      return;
    }
    if(tab==='lessons'){
      body.innerHTML=kpis+`<div class="v41-panel"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap"><div><h3>📚 Aulas</h3><p>Registre aulas ministradas e próximas aulas.</p></div><button class="btn primary" onclick="openClassLessonForm('${classId}')">+ Registrar aula</button></div><div class="v41-list">${evs.map(e=>`<div class="v41-list-row"><div><b>${escV41(e.title)}</b><small>${escV41(e.event_type||'aula')} · ${escV41(e.notes||'')}</small></div><small>${fmtV41(e.starts_at||e.created_at)}</small></div>`).join('')||'<div class="v41-empty">Nenhuma aula registrada.</div>'}</div></div>`;
      return;
    }
    if(tab==='students'){
      body.innerHTML=kpis+`<div class="v41-panel"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap"><div><h3>👥 Alunos da Class</h3><p>Veja último login, última atividade e tempo ativo. A Class pode existir sem alunos.</p></div><button class="btn primary" onclick="openClassMembers('${classId}')">👥 Gerenciar alunos</button></div><div id="ticV41StudentsBody" class="v41-student-grid" style="margin-top:14px"><div class="v41-loading">Carregando atividade...</div></div></div>`;
      const activity=await getActivityMapV41(students.map(x=>x.id));
      renderStudentsV41(classId,students,activity);
      return;
    }
    if(tab==='tasks'){
      body.innerHTML=kpis+`<div class="v41-panel"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap"><div><h3>📝 Tasks / Conteúdos</h3><p>Registro de tudo que foi publicado nesta Class.</p></div><button class="btn primary" onclick="openClassAssign('${classId}')">📤 Atribuir conteúdo</button></div><div class="v41-list">${tasks.map(t=>`<div class="v41-list-row"><div><b>${escV41(t.title)}</b><small>${escV41(t.assignment_type||'task')} ${t.skill?'· '+escV41(t.skill):''} ${t.cefr_level?'· '+escV41(t.cefr_level):''}</small></div><small>${t.due_at?'Prazo '+fmtV41(t.due_at):'Sem prazo'}</small></div>`).join('')||'<div class="v41-empty">Nenhum conteúdo registrado nesta Class.</div>'}</div></div>`;
      return;
    }
    if(tab==='materials'){
      /* V50: Materiais is a private-to-student workspace. The old branch only
         listed resource_items and had no creation/assignment mechanism. */
      if(typeof window.renderPrivateMaterialsV49==='function'){
        await window.renderPrivateMaterialsV49(classId);
        return;
      }
      body.innerHTML=kpis+`<div class="v41-panel">
        <div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap">
          <div><h3>👤 Materiais exclusivos por aluno</h3><p>Crie materiais com vários links/arquivos e envie somente ao aluno escolhido.</p></div>
          <div style="display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap">
            <button class="btn primary" onclick="openPrivateMaterialFormV49('${classId}')">＋ Novo material para aluno</button>
            <button class="btn secondary" onclick="openPrivateMaterialLibraryV49('${classId}')">📚 Inserir material existente</button>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="v41-empty">Nenhum material individual encontrado.</div>
      </div>`;
      return;
    }
    if(tab==='resources'){
      body.innerHTML=kpis+`<div class="v41-panel"><div style="display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap"><div><h3>🧰 Resources</h3><p>Biblioteca reutilizável e publicação na Class.</p></div><div style="display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap"><button class="btn primary" onclick="openResourceFormV39('${classId}')">+ Novo resource</button><button class="btn secondary" onclick="openResourcePickerV39('${classId}')">📚 Inserir existente</button></div></div><div id="classResourceListV39" class="resource-grid-v39"><div class="v41-loading">Carregando...</div></div></div>`;
      if(typeof loadClassResourcesV39==='function') loadClassResourcesV39(classId);
      return;
    }
    if(tab==='notes'){
      body.innerHTML=kpis+`<div class="v41-panel"><h3>💬 Observações</h3><p>Use Feedback & Corrections para registrar devolutivas. As observações de aula aparecem na aba Aulas.</p><button class="btn primary" onclick="openClassSubmissions('${classId}')">📝 Feedback & Corrections</button></div>`;
      return;
    }
    if(tab==='progress'){
      body.innerHTML=kpis+`<div class="v41-panel"><h3>📈 Progresso</h3><p>Acompanhe o progresso dos alunos atualmente vinculados.</p><button class="btn primary" onclick="openClassProgress('${classId}')">Abrir progresso</button></div>`;
      return;
    }
  }

  window.classCenterHomeV41=classCenterHomeV41;
  window.openClassCenterV41=openClassCenterV41;
  window.classCenterTabV41=classCenterTabV41;

  /* Make the new sidebar item functional without disturbing the existing router. */
  const previousLoadViewV41=window.loadView;
  window.loadView=async function(v){
    if(v==='classCenter') return classCenterHomeV41();
    return previousLoadViewV41(v);
  };

  /* Keep existing Class Center buttons working, but route them to the corrected workspace. */
  window.openClassCenter=openClassCenterV41;
  window.classCenterTab=classCenterTabV41;

  /* ---------- Fix: Class-level assignment must work with ZERO active students ---------- */
  window.assignClassContentV41=async function(classId,type){
    const selected=[...($('caSource')?.selectedOptions||[])].map(o=>o.value).filter(Boolean);
    const sourceIds=selected.length?selected:($('caSource')?.value?[ $('caSource').value ]:[]);
    if(!sourceIds.length)return toast(type==='material'?'Selecione pelo menos um material.':'Selecione um conteúdo.','error');

    const sourceType=type==='plan'?'lesson':type;
    const table=sourceType==='lesson'?'tic_lessons':'tic_materials';
    let created=0,distributed=0;

    const {data:members,error:me}=await sb.from('tic_class_students').select('student_id').eq('class_id',classId).eq('status','active');
    if(me)return toast('Não foi possível ler os alunos da Class: '+me.message,'error');
    const studentIds=[...new Set((members||[]).map(x=>x.student_id).filter(Boolean))];

    for(const sourceId of sourceIds){
      const {data:source,error:se}=await sb.from(table).select('*').eq('id',sourceId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();
      if(se||!source){toast(`Conteúdo não encontrado: ${sourceId}`,'error');continue;}

      const payload={
        teacher_id:session.user.id,
        lesson_id:sourceType==='lesson'?source.id:null,
        class_id:classId,
        title:source.title,
        instructions:$('caMessage')?.value.trim()||source.description||source.content||'',
        assignment_type:type==='plan'?'lesson_plan':sourceType==='lesson'?'lesson':'material',
        due_at:$('caDue')?.value?new Date($('caDue').value).toISOString():null,
        points:Number($('caPoints')?.value||0),
        priority:'normal',
        resource_items:Array.isArray(source.resource_items)?source.resource_items:[],
        cover_image_url:source.cover_image_url||null,
        source_type:type==='plan'?'lesson_plan':sourceType,
        source_id:source.id
      };
      const {data:a,error:ae}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').insert(payload).select().single();
      if(ae){toast(`Não foi possível registrar ${source.title}: ${ae.message}`,'error');continue;}
      created++;
      if(studentIds.length){
        const rows=studentIds.map(student_id=>({assignment_id:a.id,student_id,status:'pending',active:true}));
        const {error:te}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').insert(rows);
        if(te){
          await sb.from('tic_assignments').delete().eq('id',a.id);
          toast(`${source.title} foi criado, mas não foi possível distribuir aos alunos: ${te.message}`,'error');
          created--; continue;
        }
        distributed+=studentIds.length;
      }
    }

    if(!created)return;
    closeModal();
    const message=studentIds.length
      ? `${created} conteúdo(s) registrado(s) na Class e disponibilizado(s) para ${distributed} vínculo(s).`
      : `${created} conteúdo(s) registrado(s) na Class. A Class está sem alunos ativos; quando alunos forem vinculados, o conteúdo continuará registrado na turma.`;
    toast(message,'success');
    setTimeout(()=>openClassCenterV41(classId,type==='material'?'materials':'overview'),250);
  };

  window.assignExistingTaskToClassV41=async function(classId){
    const assignmentId=$('caSource')?.value;
    if(!assignmentId)return toast('Selecione uma tarefa.','error');
    const {data:task,error:te}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').select('id,title,class_id').eq('id',assignmentId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();
    if(te||!task)return toast('Tarefa não encontrada.','error');

    const {data:members,error:me}=await sb.from('tic_class_students').select('student_id').eq('class_id',classId).eq('status','active');
    if(me)return toast(me.message,'error');
    const ids=[...new Set((members||[]).map(x=>x.student_id).filter(Boolean))];
    if(!ids.length){
      const r=await sb.from('tic_assignments').update({class_id:classId}).eq('id',assignmentId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);
      if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível registrar a tarefa na Class: '+r.error.message,'error');
      closeModal();toast('Tarefa registrada na Class, mesmo sem alunos ativos.','success');
      setTimeout(()=>openClassCenterV41(classId,'tasks'),250);
      return;
    }
    const {data:existing}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('student_id').eq('assignment_id',assignmentId).in('student_id',ids);
    const have=new Set((existing||[]).map(x=>x.student_id));
    const rows=ids.filter(id=>!have.has(id)).map(student_id=>({assignment_id:assignmentId,student_id,status:'pending',active:true}));
    if(rows.length){
      const r=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').insert(rows);
      if(r.error)return toast(r.error.message,'error');
    }
    await sb.from('tic_assignments').update({class_id:classId}).eq('id',assignmentId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);
    closeModal();toast(`Tarefa registrada na Class e vinculada a ${rows.length} aluno(s).`,'success');
    setTimeout(()=>openClassCenterV41(classId,'tasks'),250);
  };

  /* Replace the existing functions used by the Class Center assignment UI. */
  window.assignClassContent=window.assignClassContentV41;
  window.assignExistingTaskToClass=window.assignExistingTaskToClassV41;

  /* ---------- Fix: member management reactivates existing rows instead of inserting duplicates ---------- */
  window.saveClassMembers=async function(e,classId){
    e.preventDefault();
    const ids=[...($('cmStudents')?.selectedOptions||[])].map(o=>o.value).filter(Boolean);
    const {data:old,error:oe}=await sb.from('tic_class_students').select('id,student_id,status').eq('class_id',classId);
    if(oe)return toast('Não foi possível ler os vínculos: '+oe.message,'error');
    const wanted=new Set(ids);
    const oldMap=new Map((old||[]).map(x=>[x.student_id,x]));
    const remove=(old||[]).filter(x=>!wanted.has(x.student_id)&&x.status==='active').map(x=>x.id);
    if(remove.length){
      const r=await sb.from('tic_class_students').update({status:'inactive'}).in('id',remove);
      if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível atualizar vínculos: '+r.error.message,'error');
    }
    for(const id of ids){
      const existing=oldMap.get(id);
      if(existing){
        if(existing.status!=='active'){
          const r=await sb.from('tic_class_students').update({status:'active'}).eq('id',existing.id);
          if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível reativar aluno: '+r.error.message,'error');
        }
      }else{
        const r=await sb.from('tic_class_students').insert({class_id:classId,student_id:id,status:'active'});
        if(r.error)return toast('Não foi possível adicionar aluno: '+r.error.message,'error');
      }
    }
    closeModal();
    toast('Alunos da Class atualizados.','success');
    if(document.querySelector(`[data-v41-class="${classId}"]`)) setTimeout(()=>openClassCenterV41(classId,'students'),200);
    else if(currentView==='classCenter') setTimeout(()=>classCenterHomeV41(),200);
    else loadView('classes');
  };

  /* Start/restart tracker when Teacher/student session changes. */
  window.addEventListener('focus',()=>{if(profile?.role==='student'&&!activityRowV41)startActivityV41();});
})();
</script>



<style id="tic-student-dashboard-v42">
/* V42 — Student experience upgrade. Existing content/functions are preserved. */
.student-v42-hero{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#43208f 0%,#6d42d8 58%,#815ee5 100%);
  color:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:25px 27px;margin-bottom:16px;
  box-shadow:0 16px 42px rgba(74,39,155,.18);position:relative;overflow:hidden;
}
.student-v42-hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:230px;height:230px;border-radius:50%;
right:-70px;top:-100px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);box-shadow:0 0 0 45px rgba(255,255,255,.035)}
.student-v42-hero>*{position:relative;z-index:1}
.student-v42-kicker{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.15em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.75;font-weight:800}
.student-v42-hero h2{margin:6px 0 4px;font:800 27px 'Plus Jakarta Sans'}
.student-v42-hero p{margin:0;opacity:.86;font-size:12px}
.student-v42-progress{height:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:16px}
.student-v42-progress i{display:block;height:100%;background:#fff;border-radius:99px}
.student-v42-quick{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px}
.student-v42-quick .card{padding:15px 17px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.student-v42-quick span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px}
.student-v42-quick b{display:block;font:800 23px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin-top:6px}
.student-v42-quick small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:9px;margin-top:4px}
.student-v42-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.25fr) minmax(310px,.75fr);gap:16px}
.student-v42-panel{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:17px;min-width:0}
.student-v42-panel h2{font:800 16px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin:0}
.student-v42-panel .sub{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;margin-top:3px}
.student-v42-section-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px;margin-bottom:12px}
.student-v42-tabs{display:flex;gap:7px;overflow:auto;padding:4px;background:#f6f3fb;border-radius:13px;margin-bottom:14px}
.student-v42-tabs button{border:0;background:transparent;color:#6d657a;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:9px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer}
.student-v42-tabs button.active{background:#fff;color:var(--p);box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(60,30,110,.08)}
.student-v42-tabpane{display:none}.student-v42-tabpane.active{display:block}
.student-v42-material{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:12px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #eeeaf4;text-decoration:none;color:inherit}
.student-v42-material:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.student-v42-material-icon{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px;background:#f0ebff;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 38px;font-size:17px}
.student-v42-material-main{min-width:0;flex:1}
.student-v42-material-main b{display:block;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.student-v42-material-main small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:9px;margin-top:3px}
.student-v42-material-arrow{color:var(--p);font-weight:900}
.student-v42-empty{padding:26px 10px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;border:1px dashed #ddd5eb;border-radius:12px;background:#fbfaff}
.student-v42-task{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #eeeaf4}
.student-v42-task:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.student-v42-task-main{flex:1;min-width:0}
.student-v42-task-main b{display:block;font-size:12px}
.student-v42-task-main small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:9px;margin-top:3px}
.student-v42-payment{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:center;padding:11px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #eeeaf4}
.student-v42-payment:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.student-v42-payment small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:9px;margin-top:3px}
.student-v42-class-card{padding:14px;border-radius:14px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#fbfaff,#fff);border:1px solid #ebe5f4}
.student-v42-class-card h3{margin:6px 0 2px;font:800 15px 'Plus Jakarta Sans'}
.student-v42-class-card p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px}
.student-v42-class-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin-top:12px}
.student-v42-statline{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:7px;margin-top:11px}
.student-v42-statline div{background:#f7f4fc;border-radius:9px;padding:8px}
.student-v42-statline b{display:block;font-size:13px}.student-v42-statline span{font-size:8px;color:var(--muted)}
.student-v42-class-shell{display:grid;gap:10px}
.student-v42-myclass-tabs{display:flex;gap:7px;overflow:auto;padding:4px;background:#f6f3fb;border-radius:13px;margin-bottom:14px}
.student-v42-myclass-tabs button{border:0;background:transparent;color:#6d657a;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:9px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer}
.student-v42-myclass-tabs button:hover{color:var(--p)}
.student-v42-myclass-tabs button.active{background:#fff;color:var(--p);box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(60,30,110,.08)}
.student-v42-scroll-target{scroll-margin-top:20px}
@media(max-width:1050px){.student-v42-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.student-v42-quick{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:650px){.student-v42-quick{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.student-v42-hero{padding:20px}.student-v42-hero h2{font-size:23px}}
@media(max-width:430px){.student-v42-quick{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>

<script id="tic-student-dashboard-v42-js">
(function(){
  'use strict';
  const esc42=v=>{try{return typeof esc==='function'?esc(v??''):String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,m=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[m]));}catch(e){return String(v??'')}};
  const fmt42=v=>v?new Date(v).toLocaleString('pt-BR',{dateStyle:'short',timeStyle:'short'}):'—';
  const fmtD42=v=>v?new Date(v).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR'):'—';
  const type42=x=>({material:'Material',lesson:'Lesson',assignment:'Atividade',task:'Tarefa',quiz:'Quiz',homework:'Homework'})[String(x||'').toLowerCase()]||x||'Conteúdo';
  const icon42=x=>{const t=String(x||'').toLowerCase();return t==='video'?'🎬':t==='audio'?'🎧':t==='pdf'?'📄':t==='lesson'?'📚':'🔗'};

  /* Dashboard: new visual shell, same underlying Supabase sources. */
  window.studentDashboardV42=async function(){
    const s=await studentRecord();
    if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Sua conta não está vinculada a um cadastro de aluno.</div>';return}
    let snap={overall:0,done:0,total:0};
    try{snap=await ticRecalculateStudentProgressV19(s.id)||snap}catch(_){}
    const [{data:ta},{data:pay},{data:members}]=await Promise.all([
      sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,assignment_id,status,due_at,active,tic_assignments(title,due_at,assignment_type,class_id,resource_items,created_at)').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('active',true).order('due_at',{ascending:true}).limit(12),
      sb.from('tic_monthly_payments').select('*').eq('student_id',s.id).order('reference_month',{ascending:false}).limit(5),
      sb.from('tic_class_students').select('class_id,status').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('status','active')
    ]);
    const classIds=[...(members||[]).map(x=>x.class_id).filter(Boolean)];
    const [{data:classes},{data:links},{data:ca}]=classIds.length?await Promise.all([
      sb.from('tic_classes').select('id,name,level,schedule_text,meeting_url,status').in('id',classIds).eq('status','active').order('name'),
      sb.from('tic_class_material_links').select('id,class_id,title,url,material_type,note,created_at').in('class_id',classIds).order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(30),
      sb.from('tic_assignments').select('id,title,assignment_type,due_at,class_id,resource_items,created_at,cefr_level,skill').in('class_id',classIds).order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(30)
    ]):[{data:[]},{data:[]},{data:[]}];
    const allRecent=[
      ...(links||[]).map(x=>({...x,_source:'link',_date:x.created_at,_type:x.material_type||'link'})),
      ...(ca||[]).filter(x=>['material','lesson'].includes(String(x.assignment_type||'').toLowerCase())).map(x=>({...x,_source:'assignment',_date:x.created_at,_type:x.assignment_type||'material'}))
    ].sort((a,b)=>new Date(b._date||0)-new Date(a._date||0)).slice(0,8);
    const upcoming=(ta||[]).filter(x=>x.status!=='graded'&&x.status!=='submitted').slice(0,6);
    const overall=Number(snap.overall||0);
    setPage(`Hello, ${s.display_name?.split(' ')[0]||'Student'} 👋`,'Seu espaço de aprendizagem.');
    $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="student-v42">
      <section class="student-v42-hero">
        <span class="student-v42-kicker">MY LEARNING</span>
        <h2>${esc42(s.display_name||'Student')} · ${esc42(s.current_level||'')}</h2>
        <p>Nível atual <b>${esc42(s.current_level||'—')}</b> → objetivo <b>${esc42(s.target_level||'—')}</b> · ${snap.done||0}/${snap.total||0} Lessons concluídas</p>
        <div class="student-v42-progress"><i style="width:${Math.max(0,Math.min(100,overall))}%"></i></div>
        <p style="margin-top:7px;font-size:10px">${overall}% do seu progresso geral</p>
      </section>

      <div class="student-v42-quick">
        <div class="card"><span>📝 Tarefas abertas</span><b>${upcoming.length}</b><small>Atividades aguardando você</small></div>
        <div class="card"><span>📚 Lessons concluídas</span><b>${snap.done||0}</b><small>De ${snap.total||0} no currículo</small></div>
        <div class="card"><span>🏫 Minhas Classes</span><b>${(classes||[]).length}</b><small>Turmas ativas</small></div>
        <div class="card"><span>📂 Materiais recentes</span><b>${allRecent.length}</b><small>Últimos conteúdos enviados</small></div>
      </div>

      <div class="student-v42-layout">
        <main class="student-v42-panel">
          <div class="student-v42-tabs">
            <button class="active" data-v42tab="recent">🆕 Últimos materiais enviados</button>
            <button data-v42tab="tasks">📝 Minhas tarefas</button>
            <button data-v42tab="classes">🏫 Minhas Classes</button>
            <button data-v42tab="payments">💰 Pagamentos</button>
          </div>

          <section class="student-v42-tabpane active" data-v42pane="recent">
            <div class="student-v42-section-head"><div><h2>🆕 Últimos materiais enviados</h2><span class="sub">Os conteúdos mais recentes publicados nas suas Classes.</span></div><span class="badge blue">${allRecent.length}</span></div>
            ${allRecent.map(x=>{
              const href=x.url||x.external_url||x.file_url||((Array.isArray(x.resource_items)&&x.resource_items[0])?.url);
              const title=x.title||'Material';
              return `<div class="student-v42-material">
                <span class="student-v42-material-icon">${icon42(x._type)}</span>
                <div class="student-v42-material-main"><b>${esc42(title)}</b><small>${esc42(type42(x._type))} · ${fmt42(x._date)}${x.skill?' · '+esc42(x.skill):''}</small></div>
                ${href?`<a class="student-v42-material-arrow" href="${esc42(href)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Abrir ↗</a>`:`<span class="student-v42-material-arrow">Ver</span>`}
              </div>`;
            }).join('')||'<div class="student-v42-empty">Nenhum material novo foi enviado para suas Classes ainda.</div>'}
          </section>

          <section class="student-v42-tabpane" data-v42pane="tasks">
            <div class="student-v42-section-head"><div><h2>📝 Minhas tarefas</h2><span class="sub">Acesse rapidamente o que precisa ser feito.</span></div><span class="badge yellow">${upcoming.length}</span></div>
            ${upcoming.map(x=>`<div class="student-v42-task"><div class="student-v42-material-icon">📝</div><div class="student-v42-task-main"><b>${esc42(x.tic_assignments?.title||'Task')}</b><small>${x.tic_assignments?.assignment_type?type42(x.tic_assignments.assignment_type):'Atividade'} · ${x.tic_assignments?.due_at?'Prazo '+fmtD42(x.tic_assignments.due_at):(x.due_at?'Prazo '+fmtD42(x.due_at):'Sem prazo')}</small></div><button class="btn sm primary" onclick="openStudentTask('${x.id}')">Abrir</button></div>`).join('')||'<div class="student-v42-empty">Você não tem tarefas abertas no momento.</div>'}
          </section>

          <section class="student-v42-tabpane" data-v42pane="classes">
            <div class="student-v42-section-head"><div><h2>🏫 Minhas Classes</h2><span class="sub">Turmas, horários e acesso rápido.</span></div></div>
            <div class="student-v42-class-shell">${(classes||[]).map(c=>`<div class="student-v42-class-card"><span class="badge blue">${esc42(c.level||'')}</span><h3>${esc42(c.name)}</h3><p>${esc42(c.schedule_text||'Horário não definido')}</p><div class="student-v42-class-row">${c.meeting_url?`<a class="btn sm primary" href="${esc42(c.meeting_url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Entrar ↗</a>`:'<span class="badge gray">Sem link</span>'}<button class="btn sm secondary" onclick="loadView('studentClass')">Abrir My Class</button></div></div>`).join('')||'<div class="student-v42-empty">Você ainda não está vinculado a uma Class.</div>'}</div>
          </section>

          <section class="student-v42-tabpane" data-v42pane="payments">
            <div class="student-v42-section-head"><div><h2>💰 Pagamentos</h2><span class="sub">Seus últimos registros.</span></div></div>
            ${(pay||[]).map(x=>`<div class="student-v42-payment"><div><b>${esc42(monthLabel(x.reference_month))}</b><small>${x.payment_date?'Pago em '+fmtD42(x.payment_date):'Vencimento '+fmtD42(x.due_date)}</small></div><b>${money(x.amount)} ${badge(x.status)}</b></div>`).join('')||'<div class="student-v42-empty">Nenhum registro financeiro.</div>'}
          </section>
        </main>

        <aside style="display:grid;gap:16px;align-content:start">
          <section class="student-v42-panel">
            <div class="student-v42-section-head"><div><h2>📊 Meu progresso</h2><span class="sub">Visão rápida do currículo.</span></div><b style="font-size:22px">${overall}%</b></div>
            <div class="progress" style="margin:8px 0 14px"><i style="width:${overall}%"></i></div>
            ${['grammar','vocabulary','listening','reading','writing','speaking','pronunciation'].map(k=>`<div class="mini"><span>${k}</span><b>${esc42(s.current_level||'')}</b></div>`).join('')}
          </section>
          <section class="student-v42-panel">
            <div class="student-v42-section-head"><div><h2>🏫 Minha turma</h2><span class="sub">Acesso rápido ao ambiente da Class.</span></div></div>
            ${(classes||[]).slice(0,2).map(c=>`<div class="student-v42-class-card" style="margin-bottom:8px"><span class="badge blue">${esc42(c.level||'')}</span><h3>${esc42(c.name)}</h3><p>${esc42(c.schedule_text||'')}</p><button class="btn sm primary" style="margin-top:9px" onclick="loadView('studentClass')">Abrir My Class →</button></div>`).join('')||'<div class="student-v42-empty">Nenhuma Class ativa.</div>'}
          </section>
        </aside>
      </div>
    </div>`;

    document.querySelectorAll('[data-v42tab]').forEach(btn=>{
      btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-v42tab]').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
        document.querySelectorAll('[data-v42pane]').forEach(p=>p.classList.remove('active'));
        btn.classList.add('active');
        document.querySelector(`[data-v42pane="${btn.dataset.v42tab}"]`)?.classList.add('active');
      });
    });
  };

  /* My Class enhancement: preserve every existing section, but add a visual navigation
     and a dedicated "Últimos materiais enviados" block. */
  const originalStudentClassV42=window.studentClassPage;
  window.studentClassPage=async function(){
    await originalStudentClassV42();
    const root=document.querySelector('.student-class-page');
    if(!root)return;

    const grid=root.querySelector('.student-class-grid');
    if(!grid)return;

    const sections=[...grid.querySelectorAll(':scope > section')];
    const ids=['next-class','class-materials','class-content','class-activities','past-lessons','class-board'];
    sections.forEach((el,i)=>{if(ids[i])el.id='v42-'+ids[i];el.classList.add('student-v42-scroll-target')});

    const nav=document.createElement('div');
    nav.className='student-v42-myclass-tabs';
    nav.innerHTML=[
      ['next-class','📅 Próxima aula'],
      ['latest-materials','🆕 Últimos materiais'],
      ['class-materials','🔗 Materiais da turma'],
      ['class-content','📚 Conteúdos'],
      ['class-activities','📝 Atividades'],
      ['past-lessons','📖 Aulas anteriores'],
      ['class-board','📌 Board']
    ].map(([id,label],i)=>`<button class="${i===0?'active':''}" data-v42scroll="${id}">${label}</button>`).join('');
    const switcher=root.querySelector('.student-class-switcher');
    switcher?.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',nav);

    nav.querySelectorAll('[data-v42scroll]').forEach(btn=>{
      btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{
        nav.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active'));
        btn.classList.add('active');
        if(btn.dataset.v42scroll==='latest-materials'){
          document.getElementById('v42-latest-materials')?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
        }else{
          document.getElementById('v42-'+btn.dataset.v42scroll)?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
        }
      });
    });

    /* Build latest-materials from the same visible Class data already rendered by My Class.
       This does not remove the original "Materiais da turma" card. */
    const materialSection=document.createElement('section');
    materialSection.className='card student-v42-scroll-target';
    materialSection.id='v42-latest-materials';
    const sourceLinks=[...root.querySelectorAll('#v42-class-materials .student-class-resource')];
    const sourceContent=[...root.querySelectorAll('#v42-class-content .student-class-board-item')].filter(el=>{
      const text=(el.textContent||'').toLowerCase();
      return text.includes('material')||text.includes('lesson');
    });
    materialSection.innerHTML=`<div class="section-head"><div><h2>🆕 Últimos materiais enviados</h2><span style="display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;margin-top:3px">Materiais e conteúdos mais recentes disponibilizados pela sua turma.</span></div><span class="badge blue">${sourceLinks.length+sourceContent.length}</span></div>
      <div>${sourceLinks.slice(0,6).map(a=>a.outerHTML).join('')}${sourceContent.slice(0,6).map(a=>a.outerHTML).join('')||(!sourceLinks.length?'<div class="student-v42-empty">Nenhum material enviado recentemente.</div>':'')}</div>`;
    grid.insertBefore(materialSection,grid.firstElementChild);
  };

  /* New Dashboard becomes the default student home; My Class remains intact. */
  window.studentDashboard=window.studentDashboardV42;
})();
</script>



<style id="tic-student-dashboard-v43-clean">
/* V43 — clean, separated Student Dashboard.
   Existing platform/features remain untouched; this only replaces the student home view. */
.s43{--s43p:#5b2bbd;--s43bg:#f7f5fb;--s43line:#e9e4f1}
.s43-hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#45219a,#6940d2 62%,#7d59e4);color:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:25px 27px;margin-bottom:16px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 15px 40px rgba(72,38,154,.16)}
.s43-hero:after{content:"";position:absolute;width:250px;height:250px;border-radius:50%;right:-75px;top:-115px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);box-shadow:0 0 0 50px rgba(255,255,255,.025)}
.s43-hero>*{position:relative;z-index:1}.s43-kicker{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.16em;font-weight:800;opacity:.72;text-transform:uppercase}
.s43-hero h2{margin:7px 0 4px;font:800 27px 'Plus Jakarta Sans'}.s43-hero p{margin:0;font-size:11px;opacity:.88}
.s43-progress{height:8px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:16px}.s43-progress i{display:block;height:100%;background:#fff;border-radius:99px}
.s43-progress-label{margin-top:7px!important;font-size:10px!important}
.s43-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin-bottom:16px}.s43-stat{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--s43line);border-radius:17px;padding:15px 17px}
.s43-stat span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px}.s43-stat b{display:block;font:800 23px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin-top:5px}.s43-stat small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:9px;margin-top:3px}
.s43-main{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--s43line);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden}
.s43-tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;padding:9px;background:#f4f1f9;border-bottom:1px solid var(--s43line);overflow:auto}
.s43-tabs button{border:0;background:transparent;color:#6e667a;border-radius:10px;padding:10px 13px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer}
.s43-tabs button.active{background:#fff;color:var(--s43p);box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(61,33,112,.08)}
.s43-pane{display:none;padding:20px}.s43-pane.active{display:block}
.s43-head{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:14px}.s43-head h2{font:800 17px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin:0}.s43-head p{margin:4px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px}
.s43-list{border:1px solid var(--s43line);border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff}
.s43-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:13px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid #eeeaf3}.s43-item:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.s43-icon{width:39px;height:39px;border-radius:11px;background:#f0ebff;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 39px;font-size:17px}
.s43-copy{min-width:0;flex:1}.s43-copy b{display:block;font-size:12px}.s43-copy small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:9px;margin-top:3px}
.s43-action{flex:0 0 auto}.s43-empty{padding:35px 18px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;border:1px dashed #ddd5ea;border-radius:13px;background:#fcfbfe}
.s43-session{display:grid;grid-template-columns:54px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:13px;align-items:center;padding:14px;border-bottom:1px solid #eeeaf3}.s43-session:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.s43-date{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:13px;background:#f0ebff;color:var(--s43p);display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center;font-weight:800;line-height:1.05}.s43-date b{font-size:17px}.s43-date small{font-size:8px;text-transform:uppercase}
.s43-session b{font-size:12px}.s43-session small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:9px;margin-top:4px}
.s43-next{background:#fbf9ff;border:1px solid #e5dcf5;border-radius:14px;padding:15px;margin-bottom:15px}.s43-next .label{font-size:9px;color:var(--s43p);font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em}.s43-next h3{font:800 16px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin:5px 0 3px}.s43-next p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px}
.s43-class{border:1px solid var(--s43line);border-radius:14px;padding:14px;margin-bottom:10px}.s43-class:last-child{margin-bottom:0}.s43-class h3{font:800 15px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin:6px 0 3px}.s43-class p{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin:0}.s43-class-actions{display:flex;gap:7px;margin-top:11px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.s43-overview{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.25fr) minmax(280px,.75fr);gap:16px}.s43-side{display:grid;gap:16px;align-content:start}
.s43-side-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--s43line);border-radius:18px;padding:17px}.s43-side-card h3{font:800 15px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin:0 0 4px}.s43-side-card>p{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 13px}
.s43-mini{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:9px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #eeeaf3;font-size:10px}.s43-mini:last-child{border-bottom:0}.s43-mini span{color:var(--muted)}
.s43-overview-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--s43line);border-radius:18px;padding:18px}.s43-overview-card h2{font:800 17px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin:0}.s43-overview-card p{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin:4px 0 15px}
.s43-section-title{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:#62596e;margin:17px 0 8px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
@media(max-width:1050px){.s43-overview{grid-template-columns:1fr}.s43-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:650px){.s43-stats{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.s43-hero{padding:20px}.s43-hero h2{font-size:23px}.s43-pane{padding:14px}}
@media(max-width:430px){.s43-stats{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>

<script id="tic-student-dashboard-v43-clean-js">
(function(){
'use strict';

const e43=v=>{try{return typeof esc==='function'?esc(v??''):String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,m=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[m]))}catch(_){return String(v??'')}};
const d43=v=>v?new Date(v).toLocaleString('pt-BR',{dateStyle:'short',timeStyle:'short'}):'—';
const day43=v=>v?new Date(v).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR',{day:'2-digit'}):'—';
const month43=v=>v?new Date(v).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR',{month:'short'}).replace('.','').toUpperCase():'—';
const type43=v=>({material:'Material',lesson:'Lesson',assignment:'Atividade',task:'Tarefa',quiz:'Quiz',homework:'Homework'})[String(v||'').toLowerCase()]||v||'Conteúdo';
const icon43=v=>{const x=String(v||'').toLowerCase();return x==='video'?'🎬':x==='audio'?'🎧':x==='pdf'?'📄':x==='lesson'?'📚':'🔗'};

window.studentDashboard=async function(){
  const s=await studentRecord();
  if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Sua conta não está vinculada a um cadastro de aluno.</div>';return}

  let snap={overall:0,done:0,total:0};
  try{snap=await ticRecalculateStudentProgressV19(s.id)||snap}catch(_){}

  const {data:members,error:me}=await sb.from('tic_class_students').select('class_id,status').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('status','active');
  if(me){$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention">Não foi possível carregar suas turmas: ${e43(me.message)}</div>`;return}

  const classIds=[...(members||[]).map(x=>x.class_id).filter(Boolean)];

  const [
    {data:classes},
    {data:sessions},
    {data:materials},
    {data:classAssignments},
    {data:taskAssignments},
    {data:payments}
  ]=await Promise.all([
    classIds.length?sb.from('tic_classes').select('id,name,level,schedule_text,meeting_url,status').in('id',classIds).eq('status','active').order('name'):Promise.resolve({data:[]}),
    classIds.length?sb.from('tic_class_sessions').select('id,class_id,session_date,duration_minutes,lesson_title,summary,status').in('class_id',classIds).order('session_date',{ascending:false}).limit(100):Promise.resolve({data:[]}),
    classIds.length?sb.from('tic_class_material_links').select('id,class_id,title,url,material_type,note,created_at,updated_at').in('class_id',classIds).order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(100):Promise.resolve({data:[]}),
    classIds.length?sb.from('tic_assignments').select('id,title,instructions,assignment_type,due_at,points,priority,class_id,resource_items,cover_image_url,source_type,source_id,cefr_level,skill,task_level,created_at').in('class_id',classIds).order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(100):Promise.resolve({data:[]}),
    sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,assignment_id,status,due_at,active').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('active',true).order('due_at',{ascending:true}).limit(100),
    sb.from('tic_monthly_payments').select('*').eq('student_id',s.id).order('reference_month',{ascending:false}).limit(8)
  ]);

  const classMap=new Map((classes||[]).map(c=>[c.id,c]));
  const now=new Date();

  /* IMPORTANT: Teacher-registered lessons live in tic_class_sessions.
     They are intentionally kept separate from materials/tasks. */
  const previousLessons=(sessions||[])
    .filter(x=>new Date(x.session_date)<now)
    .sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.session_date)-new Date(a.session_date));

  const nextLessons=(sessions||[])
    .filter(x=>new Date(x.session_date)>=now)
    .sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.session_date)-new Date(b.session_date));

  const latestMaterials=[
    ...(materials||[]).map(x=>({...x,_kind:'link',_date:x.created_at})),
    ...(classAssignments||[])
      .filter(x=>['material','lesson'].includes(String(x.assignment_type||'').toLowerCase()))
      .map(x=>({...x,_kind:'assignment',_date:x.created_at}))
  ].sort((a,b)=>new Date(b._date||0)-new Date(a._date||0));

  const taskMap=new Map((taskAssignments||[]).map(x=>[x.assignment_id,x]));
  const openTasks=(classAssignments||[])
    .filter(x=>taskMap.has(x.id))
    .map(x=>({...x,_task:taskMap.get(x.id)}))
    .filter(x=>!['submitted','graded'].includes(String(x._task?.status||'').toLowerCase()))
    .sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.due_at||'2999-01-01')-new Date(b.due_at||'2999-01-01'));

  const completedTasks=(classAssignments||[])
    .filter(x=>taskMap.has(x.id))
    .map(x=>({...x,_task:taskMap.get(x.id)}))
    .filter(x=>['submitted','graded'].includes(String(x._task?.status||'').toLowerCase()));

  const overall=Number(snap.overall||0);
  const firstNext=nextLessons[0];
  const firstClass=firstNext?classMap.get(firstNext.class_id):classes?.[0];

  setPage('My Dashboard','Seu espaço de aprendizagem.');

  const materialHTML=(x)=>{
    let href=x.url||x.external_url||x.file_url;
    if(!href && Array.isArray(x.resource_items)) href=x.resource_items[0]?.url||x.resource_items[0]?.link;
    const subtitle=`${type43(x.material_type||x.assignment_type)} · ${d43(x._date)}${x.class_id&&classMap.get(x.class_id)?' · '+e43(classMap.get(x.class_id).name):''}`;
    return `<div class="s43-item">
      <span class="s43-icon">${icon43(x.material_type||x.assignment_type)}</span>
      <div class="s43-copy"><b>${e43(x.title||'Material')}</b><small>${subtitle}</small></div>
      <div class="s43-action">${href?`<a class="btn sm primary" href="${e43(href)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Abrir material ↗</a>`:'<span class="badge gray">Sem link</span>'}</div>
    </div>`;
  };

  const sessionHTML=(x)=>{
    const c=classMap.get(x.class_id);
    return `<div class="s43-session">
      <div class="s43-date"><b>${day43(x.session_date)}</b><small>${month43(x.session_date)}</small></div>
      <div><b>${e43(x.lesson_title||'Aula')}</b><small>${d43(x.session_date)} · ${x.duration_minutes||'—'} min${c?' · '+e43(c.name):''}</small>${x.summary?`<small>${e43(x.summary)}</small>`:''}</div>
      <span class="badge ${x.status==='completed'?'green':'blue'}">${e43(x.status||'Registrada')}</span>
    </div>`;
  };

  const classHTML=(c)=>{
    const cSessions=(sessions||[]).filter(x=>x.class_id===c.id);
    return `<div class="s43-class">
      <span class="badge blue">${e43(c.level||'')}</span>
      <h3>${e43(c.name)}</h3>
      <p>${e43(c.schedule_text||'Horário não definido')}</p>
      <div class="s43-class-actions">
        <button class="btn sm primary" onclick="loadView('studentClass')">Abrir minha Class</button>
        ${c.meeting_url?`<a class="btn sm secondary" href="${e43(c.meeting_url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Entrar na aula ↗</a>`:''}
      </div>
      <div style="margin-top:9px;font-size:9px;color:var(--muted)">📚 ${cSessions.length} aula(s) registrada(s)</div>
    </div>`;
  };

  const taskHTML=(x)=>{
    const status=x._task?.status||'pending';
    return `<div class="s43-item">
      <span class="s43-icon">📝</span>
      <div class="s43-copy"><b>${e43(x.title||'Tarefa')}</b><small>${type43(x.assignment_type)} · ${x.due_at?'Prazo '+d43(x.due_at):'Sem prazo'}${x.class_id&&classMap.get(x.class_id)?' · '+e43(classMap.get(x.class_id).name):''}</small></div>
      <div class="s43-action"><button class="btn sm primary" onclick="loadView('studentTasks')">Ver tarefa</button></div>
    </div>`;
  };

  $('content').innerHTML=`
  <div class="s43">
    <section class="s43-hero">
      <span class="s43-kicker">MY LEARNING</span>
      <h2>Olá, ${e43(s.display_name?.split(' ')[0]||'Student')} 👋</h2>
      <p>${e43(s.current_level||'—')} · Objetivo ${e43(s.target_level||'—')} · ${snap.done||0} de ${snap.total||0} lessons concluídas</p>
      <div class="s43-progress"><i style="width:${Math.max(0,Math.min(100,overall))}%"></i></div>
      <p class="s43-progress-label">${overall}% de progresso geral</p>
    </section>

    <div class="s43-stats">
      <div class="s43-stat"><span>📝 Tarefas abertas</span><b>${openTasks.length}</b><small>Somente suas tarefas</small></div>
      <div class="s43-stat"><span>📚 Aulas anteriores</span><b>${previousLessons.length}</b><small>Registradas pelo Teacher</small></div>
      <div class="s43-stat"><span>🏫 Minhas Classes</span><b>${(classes||[]).length}</b><small>Turmas ativas</small></div>
      <div class="s43-stat"><span>🆕 Materiais novos</span><b>${latestMaterials.length}</b><small>Materiais publicados</small></div>
    </div>

    <div class="s43-overview">
      <section class="s43-overview-card">
        <div class="s43-head"><div><h2>Visão geral</h2><p>Informações organizadas por área. Cada botão leva somente ao conteúdo correspondente.</p></div></div>

        ${firstNext?`<div class="s43-next">
          <div class="label">📅 Próxima aula registrada</div>
          <h3>${e43(firstNext.lesson_title||'Aula')}</h3>
          <p>${d43(firstNext.session_date)} · ${firstNext.duration_minutes||'—'} min${firstClass?' · '+e43(firstClass.name):''}</p>
        </div>`:`<div class="s43-empty" style="margin-bottom:15px">Nenhuma próxima aula foi registrada pelo Teacher.</div>`}

        <div class="s43-section-title">Acessos rápidos</div>
        <div class="s43-list">
          <div class="s43-item"><span class="s43-icon">🆕</span><div class="s43-copy"><b>Últimos materiais enviados</b><small>Somente materiais e conteúdos publicados.</small></div><button class="btn sm primary" data-s43go="materials">Abrir</button></div>
          <div class="s43-item"><span class="s43-icon">📖</span><div class="s43-copy"><b>Aulas anteriores</b><small>Somente aulas registradas pelo Teacher.</small></div><button class="btn sm primary" data-s43go="previous">Abrir</button></div>
          <div class="s43-item"><span class="s43-icon">📝</span><div class="s43-copy"><b>Minhas tarefas</b><small>Somente atividades atribuídas a você.</small></div><button class="btn sm primary" data-s43go="tasks">Abrir</button></div>
          <div class="s43-item"><span class="s43-icon">🏫</span><div class="s43-copy"><b>Minhas Classes</b><small>Somente suas turmas ativas.</small></div><button class="btn sm primary" data-s43go="classes">Abrir</button></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <aside class="s43-side">
        <section class="s43-side-card">
          <h3>📈 Meu progresso</h3><p>Resumo do currículo.</p>
          <div class="progress" style="margin:8px 0 12px"><i style="width:${overall}%"></i></div>
          <div class="s43-mini"><span>Lessons concluídas</span><b>${snap.done||0}</b></div>
          <div class="s43-mini"><span>Total de lessons</span><b>${snap.total||0}</b></div>
          <div class="s43-mini"><span>Nível atual</span><b>${e43(s.current_level||'—')}</b></div>
        </section>
        <section class="s43-side-card">
          <h3>📅 Próxima aula</h3><p>Somente a próxima aula registrada.</p>
          ${firstNext?`<div class="s43-mini"><span>${e43(firstNext.lesson_title||'Aula')}</span><b>${day43(firstNext.session_date)}/${month43(firstNext.session_date)}</b></div><div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:8px">${d43(firstNext.session_date)}${firstClass?' · '+e43(firstClass.name):''}</div>`:'<div class="s43-empty">Nenhuma aula agendada.</div>'}
        </section>
      </aside>
    </div>

    <section class="s43-main" style="margin-top:16px">
      <nav class="s43-tabs">
        <button class="active" data-s43tab="materials">🆕 Últimos materiais</button>
        <button data-s43tab="previous">📖 Aulas anteriores</button>
        <button data-s43tab="tasks">📝 Minhas tarefas</button>
        <button data-s43tab="classes">🏫 Minhas Classes</button>
        <button data-s43tab="payments">💰 Pagamentos</button>
      </nav>

      <section class="s43-pane active" data-s43pane="materials">
        <div class="s43-head"><div><h2>🆕 Últimos materiais enviados</h2><p>Apenas materiais publicados pelo Teacher nas suas Classes. Nenhuma aula registrada aparece aqui.</p></div><span class="badge blue">${latestMaterials.length}</span></div>
        <div class="s43-list">${latestMaterials.slice(0,20).map(materialHTML).join('')||'<div class="s43-empty">Nenhum material foi enviado ainda.</div>'}</div>
      </section>

      <section class="s43-pane" data-s43pane="previous">
        <div class="s43-head"><div><h2>📖 Aulas anteriores</h2><p>Estas são as aulas registradas pelo Teacher em <b>Class → Aulas → Registrar aula</b>.</p></div><span class="badge green">${previousLessons.length}</span></div>
        <div class="s43-list">${previousLessons.slice(0,30).map(sessionHTML).join('')||'<div class="s43-empty">Nenhuma aula anterior foi registrada pelo Teacher.</div>'}</div>
      </section>

      <section class="s43-pane" data-s43pane="tasks">
        <div class="s43-head"><div><h2>📝 Minhas tarefas</h2><p>Apenas tarefas que foram atribuídas ao seu aluno.</p></div><span class="badge yellow">${openTasks.length}</span></div>
        <div class="s43-list">${openTasks.slice(0,30).map(taskHTML).join('')||'<div class="s43-empty">Você não tem tarefas abertas.</div>'}</div>
      </section>

      <section class="s43-pane" data-s43pane="classes">
        <div class="s43-head"><div><h2>🏫 Minhas Classes</h2><p>Apenas suas turmas ativas e seus acessos.</p></div><span class="badge blue">${(classes||[]).length}</span></div>
        ${(classes||[]).map(classHTML).join('')||'<div class="s43-empty">Você ainda não está vinculado a uma Class.</div>'}
      </section>

      <section class="s43-pane" data-s43pane="payments">
        <div class="s43-head"><div><h2>💰 Pagamentos</h2><p>Somente seus registros financeiros.</p></div><span class="badge blue">${(payments||[]).length}</span></div>
        <div class="s43-list">${(payments||[]).map(x=>`<div class="s43-item"><span class="s43-icon">💰</span><div class="s43-copy"><b>${e43(x.reference_month||'Pagamento')}</b><small>${x.payment_date?'Pago em '+new Date(x.payment_date).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR'):x.due_date?'Vencimento '+new Date(x.due_date).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR'):'Registro financeiro'}</small></div><div><b>${typeof money==='function'?money(x.amount):('R$ '+Number(x.amount||0).toFixed(2).replace('.',','))}</b><br>${typeof badge==='function'?badge(x.status):e43(x.status||'—')}</div></div>`).join('')||'<div class="s43-empty">Nenhum pagamento registrado.</div>'}</div>
      </section>
    </section>
  </div>`;

  const activate=(name)=>{
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-s43tab]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.s43tab===name));
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-s43pane]').forEach(p=>p.classList.toggle('active',p.dataset.s43pane===name));
    document.querySelector('.s43-main')?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
  };
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-s43tab]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>activate(b.dataset.s43tab)));
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-s43go]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>activate(b.dataset.s43go)));
};
})();
</script>



<style id="tic-v44-separated-content-css">
/* V44 — strict content separation + clean Student Dashboard/My Class */
.v44-hub{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e8e3f0;border-radius:18px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:16px}
.v44-hub-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:13px}.v44-hub-head h2{font:800 17px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin:0}.v44-hub-head p{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin:4px 0 0}
.v44-type-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px}.v44-type-btn{border:1px solid #e6e0ef;background:#fbfaff;border-radius:13px;padding:12px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s}.v44-type-btn:hover{border-color:#b9a5eb;transform:translateY(-1px)}.v44-type-btn b{display:block;font-size:11px}.v44-type-btn small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:9px;margin-top:3px}
.v44-filterbar{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:13px}.v44-filterbar select,.v44-filterbar input{height:38px;border:1px solid #e3ddea;border-radius:10px;padding:0 10px;background:#fff;font-size:11px}.v44-filterbar input{min-width:230px;flex:1}
.v44-legacy{border:1px solid #eadfc9;background:#fffaf0;border-radius:14px;padding:13px;margin-bottom:14px}.v44-legacy h3{margin:0;font-size:12px}.v44-legacy p{margin:4px 0 9px;font-size:10px;color:#786b56}
.v44-class-page{display:grid;gap:15px}.v44-class-hero{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#44209a,#7045d7);color:#fff;border-radius:21px;padding:22px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px;align-items:center}.v44-class-hero h2{font:800 23px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin:5px 0}.v44-class-hero p{font-size:10px;opacity:.82;margin:0}.v44-class-select{min-width:210px;border:0;border-radius:11px;padding:10px;background:#fff;color:#30254a;font-weight:700}
.v44-class-nav{display:flex;gap:7px;overflow:auto;background:#f3f0f8;border:1px solid #e7e1ef;border-radius:13px;padding:6px}.v44-class-nav button{border:0;background:transparent;color:#6b6377;border-radius:9px;padding:10px 12px;font-size:10px;font-weight:800;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer}.v44-class-nav button.active{background:#fff;color:#5b2bbd;box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(60,30,110,.08)}
