.v44-class-pane{display:none}.v44-class-pane.active{display:block}.v44-class-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.3fr) minmax(280px,.7fr);gap:15px}.v44-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e8e3f0;border-radius:17px;padding:17px}.v44-card h3{font:800 16px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin:0}.v44-card .desc{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin:4px 0 13px}
.v44-list{border:1px solid #e9e4f0;border-radius:13px;overflow:hidden}.v44-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:12px 13px;border-bottom:1px solid #eeeaf3}.v44-row:last-child{border-bottom:0}.v44-row-icon{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:11px;background:#f0ebff;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 38px}.v44-row-main{min-width:0;flex:1}.v44-row-main b{display:block;font-size:12px}.v44-row-main small{display:block;font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:3px}.v44-empty{padding:30px 15px;text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;border:1px dashed #ddd5e9;border-radius:12px;background:#fcfbfe}
.v44-kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:10px}.v44-kpi{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e8e3f0;border-radius:15px;padding:13px}.v44-kpi span{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:9px}.v44-kpi b{display:block;font:800 20px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin-top:4px}
.v44-session{display:grid;grid-template-columns:52px minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:12px;border-bottom:1px solid #eeeaf3}.v44-session:last-child{border-bottom:0}.v44-date{width:52px;height:52px;border-radius:12px;background:#f0ebff;color:#5b2bbd;display:grid;place-items:center;text-align:center}.v44-date b{font-size:16px}.v44-date small{font-size:8px;text-transform:uppercase}.v44-class-actions{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:10px}
@media(max-width:950px){.v44-type-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.v44-class-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.v44-kpis{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}@media(max-width:600px){.v44-type-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.v44-kpis{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.v44-class-hero{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.v44-class-select{width:100%}}
</style>

<script id="tic-v44-separated-content-js">
(function(){
'use strict';
const x44=v=>{try{return typeof esc==='function'?esc(v??''):String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,m=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[m]))}catch(_){return String(v??'')}};
const dt44=v=>v?new Date(v).toLocaleString('pt-BR',{dateStyle:'short',timeStyle:'short'}):'—';
const dl44=v=>v?new Date(v).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR'): '—';
const typ44=v=>({assignment:'Assignment',quiz:'Quiz',speaking:'Speaking',writing:'Writing',listening:'Listening',reading:'Reading',project:'Project',audio:'Audio',file:'File',material:'Material',lesson:'Lesson'})[String(v||'').toLowerCase()]||v||'Conteúdo';

/* One explicit creation router. Existing builders remain the actual editors. */
window.openContentRouterV44=function(){
 openModal('✨ Criar conteúdo — escolha o destino',`
 <div class="v44-hub" style="border:0;padding:0">
   <div class="v44-hub-head"><div><h2>Escolha exatamente o que deseja criar</h2><p>Cada tipo será salvo e direcionado para sua área própria.</p></div></div>
   <div class="v44-type-grid">
    <button class="v44-type-btn" onclick="closeModal();openAssignmentForm()"><b>📝 Assignment</b><small>Tarefa para o aluno realizar/entregar.</small></button>
    <button class="v44-type-btn" onclick="closeModal();openLessonForm()"><b>📚 Lesson</b><small>Aula do currículo.</small></button>
    <button class="v44-type-btn" onclick="closeModal();openResourceFormV39()"><b>🔗 Resource</b><small>Links, PDFs, vídeos e recursos de apoio.</small></button>
    <button class="v44-type-btn" onclick="closeModal();openMaterialForm()"><b>📂 Material</b><small>Material didático organizado.</small></button>
   </div>
 </div>`);
};

/* Teacher Assignments: only real tasks. Materials/Lessons are no longer listed here. */
window.assignmentsPage=async function(){
 const {data,error}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').select('*').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('created_at',{ascending:false});
 if(error){$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention"><b>Não foi possível carregar Assignments.</b><p>${x44(error.message)}</p></div>`;return}
 const real=(data||[]).filter(a=>!['material','lesson'].includes(String(a.assignment_type||'').toLowerCase()));
 const legacy=(data||[]).filter(a=>['material','lesson'].includes(String(a.assignment_type||'').toLowerCase()));
 let counts={};
 if(real.length){
   const ids=real.map(a=>a.id);
   const {data:c}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('assignment_id,status').in('assignment_id',ids);
   (c||[]).forEach(r=>{counts[r.assignment_id]=(counts[r.assignment_id]||0)+1});
 }
 setPage('Assignments','Somente tarefas e atividades atribuídas aos alunos.');
 $('content').innerHTML=`
 <div class="v44-hub">
   <div class="v44-hub-head"><div><h2>📝 Assignments</h2><p>Aqui entram somente tarefas/atividades. Lessons, Materials e Resources ficam separados.</p></div><button class="btn primary" onclick="openContentRouterV44()">＋ Criar conteúdo</button></div>
   <div class="v44-filterbar"><input id="v44AsSearch" placeholder="🔎 Buscar tarefa..." oninput="v44FilterAssignments()"><select id="v44AsType" onchange="v44FilterAssignments()"><option value="">Todos os tipos de tarefa</option>${[...new Set(real.map(a=>a.assignment_type).filter(Boolean))].map(t=>`<option value="${x44(t)}">${x44(typ44(t))}</option>`).join('')}</select></div>
 </div>
 ${legacy.length?`<div class="v44-legacy"><h3>⚠️ ${legacy.length} item(ns) antigo(s) estão classificados como ${legacy.every(a=>String(a.assignment_type).toLowerCase()==='material')?'Material/Lesson':''} e não aparecem na lista de Assignments.</h3><p>Eles foram preservados no banco para não perder seus dados. Use a área correta (Materials/Lessons) para novos conteúdos.</p></div>`:''}
 <div class="card"><div class="table-wrap"><table class="table"><thead><tr><th>Tarefa</th><th>Tipo</th><th>Alunos</th><th>Prazo</th><th>Prioridade</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody>
 ${real.map(a=>`<tr data-v44-assignment data-type="${x44(a.assignment_type||'')}"><td><b>${x44(a.title)}</b><small>${x44(a.cefr_level||'')} ${a.skill?'· '+x44(a.skill):''}</small></td><td><span class="badge blue">${x44(typ44(a.assignment_type))}</span></td><td><span class="badge blue">${counts[a.id]||0}</span></td><td>${a.due_at?dl44(a.due_at):'—'}</td><td>${x44(a.priority||'normal')}</td><td><button class="btn sm secondary" onclick='openAssignmentForm(${JSON.stringify(a)})'>Editar</button></td></tr>`).join('')||`<tr><td colspan="6"><div class="v44-empty">Nenhum Assignment criado ainda. Use <b>Criar conteúdo</b> para escolher o tipo correto.</div></td></tr>`}
 </tbody></table></div></div>`;
};
window.v44FilterAssignments=function(){
 const q=($('v44AsSearch')?.value||'').toLowerCase(),t=$('v44AsType')?.value||'';
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-v44-assignment]').forEach(r=>{const ok=(!q||r.innerText.toLowerCase().includes(q))&&(!t||r.dataset.type===t);r.style.display=ok?'':'none'});
};

/* Add the same router to Resources and Materials so creation always starts with a clear choice. */
const oldResourcesV44=window.resourcesPageV39;
window.resourcesPageV39=async function(){
 await oldResourcesV44();
 const c=document.querySelector('.main>.container'); if(!c)return;
 const oldToolbar=c.querySelector('.resource-toolbar-v39');
 if(oldToolbar&&!oldToolbar.querySelector('[data-v44-create]')){
   const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='btn primary';b.dataset.v44Create='1';b.textContent='✨ Criar conteúdo';b.onclick=()=>openContentRouterV44();oldToolbar.appendChild(b);
 }
};
const oldMaterialsV44=window.materialsPage;
window.materialsPage=async function(){
 await oldMaterialsV44();
 const c=document.querySelector('.main>.container');if(!c)return;
 const heads=[...c.querySelectorAll('.material-section-head')];
 if(heads[0]&&!heads[0].querySelector('[data-v44-create]')){
   const b=document.createElement('button');b.className='btn primary';b.dataset.v44Create='1';b.textContent='✨ Criar conteúdo';b.onclick=()=>openContentRouterV44();heads[0].appendChild(b);
 }
};

/* Re-route loadView to the clean Assignment workspace without breaking existing routes. */
const loadViewBaseV44=window.loadView;
window.loadView=async function(v){
 if(v==='assignments'){currentView=v;toggleMobile();document.querySelectorAll('#teacherNav [data-view]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.view===v));const c=document.querySelector('.main>.container');if(c)c.scrollTo({top:0,left:0,behavior:'instant'});return assignmentsPage();}
 return loadViewBaseV44(v);
};

/* Clean Student My Class: every tab owns one content category. */
window.studentClassPage=async function(){
 const s=await studentRecord();
 if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Sua conta ainda não está vinculada a um cadastro de aluno pelo Teacher.</div>';return}
 const {data:members,error:me}=await sb.from('tic_class_students').select('class_id,status').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('status','active');
 if(me){$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention">${x44(me.message)}</div>`;return}
 const ids=[...(members||[]).map(m=>m.class_id).filter(Boolean)];
 if(!ids.length){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="v44-empty">🏫 Você ainda não está em uma Class.</div>';return}
 const [{data:classes},{data:sessions},{data:links},{data:assignments},{data:tas},{data:boards}]=await Promise.all([
  sb.from('tic_classes').select('id,name,level,schedule_text,meeting_url,status').in('id',ids).eq('status','active').order('name'),
  sb.from('tic_class_sessions').select('id,class_id,session_date,duration_minutes,lesson_title,summary,status').in('class_id',ids).order('session_date',{ascending:false}).limit(100),
  sb.from('tic_class_material_links').select('id,class_id,title,url,material_type,note,position,created_at').in('class_id',ids).order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(100),
  sb.from('tic_assignments').select('id,title,instructions,assignment_type,due_at,points,priority,class_id,resource_items,cefr_level,skill,created_at').in('class_id',ids).order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(100),
  sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,assignment_id,status,due_at,active').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('active',true).limit(100),
  sb.from('tic_class_board_items').select('id,class_id,title,description,item_type,status,position,created_at').in('class_id',ids).order('position').order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(100)
 ]);
 const cls=classes||[],map=new Map(cls.map(c=>[c.id,c])),taMap=new Map((tas||[]).map(t=>[t.assignment_id,t]));
 let selected=cls[0]?.id||'';
 const go=name=>{document.querySelectorAll('[data-v44cp]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.v44cp===name));document.querySelectorAll('[data-v44pane]').forEach(p=>p.classList.toggle('active',p.dataset.v44pane===name))};
 const render=()=>{
  const c=map.get(selected)||cls[0];if(!c)return;selected=c.id;
  const cs=(sessions||[]).filter(x=>x.class_id===c.id),now=new Date(),past=cs.filter(x=>new Date(x.session_date)<now).sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.session_date)-new Date(a.session_date)),next=cs.filter(x=>new Date(x.session_date)>=now).sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.session_date)-new Date(b.session_date))[0];
  const rs=(links||[]).filter(x=>x.class_id===c.id);
  const as=(assignments||[]).filter(x=>x.class_id===c.id);
  const lessons=as.filter(x=>String(x.assignment_type||'').toLowerCase()==='lesson');
  const materials=as.filter(x=>String(x.assignment_type||'').toLowerCase()==='material');
  const tasks=as.filter(x=>!['lesson','material'].includes(String(x.assignment_type||'').toLowerCase()));
  const myTasks=tasks.filter(x=>taMap.has(x.id));
  const bi=(boards||[]).filter(x=>x.class_id===c.id);
  setPage('My Class',`${c.name} · conteúdo separado por categoria`);
  $('content').innerHTML=`
  <div class="v44-class-page">
   <div class="v44-class-hero"><div><span class="eyebrow" style="color:#fff">MY CLASS</span><h2>🏫 ${x44(c.name)}</h2><p>${x44(c.level||'')} ${c.schedule_text?'· '+x44(c.schedule_text):''}</p></div><select id="v44ClassSelect" class="v44-class-select">${cls.map(z=>`<option value="${z.id}" ${z.id===c.id?'selected':''}>${x44(z.name)} · ${x44(z.level||'')}</option>`).join('')}</select></div>
   <div class="v44-kpis"><div class="v44-kpi"><span>📖 Aulas anteriores</span><b>${past.length}</b></div><div class="v44-kpi"><span>📚 Lessons da Class</span><b>${lessons.length}</b></div><div class="v44-kpi"><span>🔗 Resources</span><b>${rs.length}</b></div><div class="v44-kpi"><span>📝 Minhas tarefas</span><b>${myTasks.length}</b></div></div>
   <nav class="v44-class-nav">
    <button class="active" data-v44cp="home">🏠 Visão geral</button><button data-v44cp="lessons">📚 Lessons</button><button data-v44cp="materials">📂 Materials</button><button data-v44cp="resources">🔗 Resources</button><button data-v44cp="tasks">📝 Minhas tarefas</button><button data-v44cp="previous">📖 Aulas anteriores</button><button data-v44cp="board">📌 Board</button>
   </nav>
   <section class="v44-class-pane active" data-v44pane="home">
    <div class="v44-class-grid"><div class="v44-card"><h3>📅 Próxima aula</h3><p class="desc">Somente a próxima aula registrada pelo Teacher.</p>${next?`<div class="v44-row"><div class="v44-row-icon">📅</div><div class="v44-row-main"><b>${x44(next.lesson_title||'Aula')}</b><small>${dt44(next.session_date)} · ${next.duration_minutes||'—'} min</small></div>${c.meeting_url?`<a class="btn sm primary" href="${x44(c.meeting_url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Entrar ↗</a>`:''}</div>`:'<div class="v44-empty">Nenhuma próxima aula registrada.</div>'}</div>
    <div class="v44-card"><h3>🏫 Minha Class</h3><p class="desc">Informações da turma, sem misturar conteúdos.</p><div class="v44-row"><div class="v44-row-icon">🏫</div><div class="v44-row-main"><b>${x44(c.name)}</b><small>${x44(c.level||'')} · ${x44(c.schedule_text||'Horário não definido')}</small></div></div><div class="v44-class-actions">${c.meeting_url?`<a class="btn sm primary" href="${x44(c.meeting_url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Entrar na aula ↗</a>`:''}</div></div></div>
   </section>
   <section class="v44-class-pane" data-v44pane="lessons"><div class="v44-card"><h3>📚 Lessons</h3><p class="desc">Somente conteúdos classificados como Lesson para esta Class.</p><div class="v44-list">${lessons.map(a=>`<div class="v44-row"><div class="v44-row-icon">📚</div><div class="v44-row-main"><b>${x44(a.title)}</b><small>Lesson${a.cefr_level?' · '+x44(a.cefr_level):''}${a.skill?' · '+x44(a.skill):''}</small></div><span class="badge green">Lesson</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="v44-empty">Nenhuma Lesson foi disponibilizada para esta Class.</div>'}</div></div></section>
   <section class="v44-class-pane" data-v44pane="materials"><div class="v44-card"><h3>📂 Materials</h3><p class="desc">Somente itens classificados como Material. Resources ficam na aba ao lado.</p><div class="v44-list">${materials.map(a=>`<div class="v44-row"><div class="v44-row-icon">📂</div><div class="v44-row-main"><b>${x44(a.title)}</b><small>${a.cefr_level?'Nível '+x44(a.cefr_level)+' · ':''}${a.created_at?dt44(a.created_at):''}</small></div><span class="badge blue">Material</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="v44-empty">Nenhum Material foi disponibilizado para esta Class.</div>'}</div></div></section>
   <section class="v44-class-pane" data-v44pane="resources"><div class="v44-card"><h3>🔗 Resources</h3><p class="desc">Somente links/arquivos inseridos como Resource. Não são tarefas nem Lessons.</p><div class="v44-list">${rs.map(r=>`<div class="v44-row"><div class="v44-row-icon">${String(r.material_type||'').toLowerCase()==='video'?'🎬':String(r.material_type||'').toLowerCase()==='audio'?'🎧':String(r.material_type||'').toLowerCase()==='pdf'?'📄':'🔗'}</div><div class="v44-row-main"><b>${x44(r.title)}</b><small>${x44(r.material_type||'link')}${r.note?' · '+x44(r.note):''}</small></div><a class="btn sm secondary" href="${x44(r.url||'#')}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Abrir ↗</a></div>`).join('')||'<div class="v44-empty">Nenhum Resource foi disponibilizado para esta Class.</div>'}</div></div></section>
   <section class="v44-class-pane" data-v44pane="tasks"><div class="v44-card"><h3>📝 Minhas tarefas</h3><p class="desc">Somente Assignments que foram atribuídos a você nesta Class.</p><div class="v44-list">${myTasks.map(a=>{const t=taMap.get(a.id);return `<div class="v44-row"><div class="v44-row-icon">📝</div><div class="v44-row-main"><b>${x44(a.title)}</b><small>${typ44(a.assignment_type)} · ${a.due_at?'Prazo '+dt44(a.due_at):'Sem prazo'}${a.skill?' · '+x44(a.skill):''}</small></div>${typeof badge==='function'?badge(t?.status||'pending'):'<span class="badge yellow">Pendente</span>'}</div>`}).join('')||'<div class="v44-empty">Nenhuma tarefa atribuída a você nesta Class.</div>'}</div></div></section>
   <section class="v44-class-pane" data-v44pane="previous"><div class="v44-card"><h3>📖 Aulas anteriores</h3><p class="desc">Somente aulas que o Teacher registrou em Class → Aulas.</p><div class="v44-list">${past.map(a=>`<div class="v44-session"><div class="v44-date"><b>${new Date(a.session_date).getDate()}</b><small>${new Date(a.session_date).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR',{month:'short'}).replace('.','')}</small></div><div><b>${x44(a.lesson_title||'Aula')}</b><small>${dt44(a.session_date)} · ${a.duration_minutes||'—'} min${a.summary?' · '+x44(a.summary):''}</small></div><span class="badge ${a.status==='completed'?'green':'blue'}">${x44(a.status||'Registrada')}</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="v44-empty">Nenhuma aula anterior foi registrada pelo Teacher.</div>'}</div></div></section>
   <section class="v44-class-pane" data-v44pane="board"><div class="v44-card"><h3>📌 Board</h3><p class="desc">Somente avisos e itens publicados no Board desta Class.</p><div class="v44-list">${bi.map(b=>`<div class="v44-row"><div class="v44-row-icon">📌</div><div class="v44-row-main"><b>${x44(b.title)}</b><small>${x44(b.description||'')}${b.item_type?' · '+x44(b.item_type):''}</small></div><span class="badge ${b.status==='completed'?'green':b.status==='in_progress'?'yellow':'blue'}">${x44(b.status||'Publicado')}</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="v44-empty">Nenhum item no Board.</div>'}</div></div></section>
  </div>`;
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-v44cp]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>go(b.dataset.v44cp)));
  $('v44ClassSelect')?.addEventListener('change',ev=>{selected=ev.target.value;render()});
 };
 render();
};

/* Student dashboard: concise cards, no duplicated content lists. */
window.studentDashboard=async function(){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Conta não vinculada.</div>';return}
 let prog={overall:0,done:0,total:0};try{prog=await ticRecalculateStudentProgressV19(s.id)||prog}catch(_){}
 const {data:members}=await sb.from('tic_class_students').select('class_id').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('status','active');
 const ids=(members||[]).map(x=>x.class_id).filter(Boolean);
 const [{data:classes},{data:sessions},{data:materials},{data:tas}]=await Promise.all([
  ids.length?sb.from('tic_classes').select('id,name,level,schedule_text,meeting_url,status').in('id',ids).eq('status','active').order('name'):Promise.resolve({data:[]}),
  ids.length?sb.from('tic_class_sessions').select('id,class_id,session_date,lesson_title,duration_minutes,status').in('class_id',ids).order('session_date',{ascending:false}).limit(50):Promise.resolve({data:[]}),
  ids.length?sb.from('tic_assignments').select('id,title,assignment_type,class_id,created_at').in('class_id',ids).eq('assignment_type','material').order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(20):Promise.resolve({data:[]}),
  sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,assignment_id,status').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('active',true)
 ]);
 const cmap=new Map((classes||[]).map(c=>[c.id,c]));
 const open=(tas||[]).filter(t=>!['submitted','graded'].includes(String(t.status||'').toLowerCase())).length;
 const now=new Date(),past=(sessions||[]).filter(x=>new Date(x.session_date)<now),next=(sessions||[]).filter(x=>new Date(x.session_date)>=now).sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.session_date)-new Date(b.session_date))[0];
 setPage('My Dashboard','Seu espaço de aprendizagem.');
 $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="s43">
  <section class="s43-hero"><span class="s43-kicker">MY LEARNING</span><h2>Olá, ${x44(s.display_name?.split(' ')[0]||'Student')} 👋</h2><p>${x44(s.current_level||'—')} · Objetivo ${x44(s.target_level||'—')} · ${prog.done||0}/${prog.total||0} lessons concluídas</p><div class="s43-progress"><i style="width:${Math.max(0,Math.min(100,Number(prog.overall||0)))}%"></i></div><p class="s43-progress-label">${Number(prog.overall||0)}% de progresso geral</p></section>
  <div class="s43-stats">
   <button class="s43-stat" onclick="loadView('studentTasks')" style="text-align:left;cursor:pointer"><span>📝 Minhas tarefas</span><b>${open}</b><small>Ir para My Tasks →</small></button>
   <button class="s43-stat" onclick="loadView('studentClass')" style="text-align:left;cursor:pointer"><span>📖 Aulas anteriores</span><b>${past.length}</b><small>Ver somente aulas registradas →</small></button>
   <button class="s43-stat" onclick="loadView('studentClass')" style="text-align:left;cursor:pointer"><span>🏫 Minhas Classes</span><b>${(classes||[]).length}</b><small>Abrir My Class →</small></button>
   <button class="s43-stat" onclick="loadView('studentClass')" style="text-align:left;cursor:pointer"><span>🆕 Materiais enviados</span><b>${(materials||[]).length}</b><small>Ver Materials da Class →</small></button>
  </div>
  <div class="s43-overview">
   <section class="s43-overview-card"><div class="s43-head"><div><h2>🎯 Acesso rápido</h2><p>Um único destino para cada tipo de conteúdo.</p></div></div>
    <div class="s43-list">
     <div class="s43-item"><span class="s43-icon">📚</span><div class="s43-copy"><b>My Lessons</b><small>Currículo e aulas do curso.</small></div><button class="btn sm primary" onclick="loadView('studentLessons')">Abrir</button></div>
     <div class="s43-item"><span class="s43-icon">📝</span><div class="s43-copy"><b>My Tasks</b><small>Somente tarefas atribuídas a você.</small></div><button class="btn sm primary" onclick="loadView('studentTasks')">Abrir</button></div>
     <div class="s43-item"><span class="s43-icon">🏫</span><div class="s43-copy"><b>My Class</b><small>Resources, Materials, Lessons, Board e aulas anteriores separados.</small></div><button class="btn sm primary" onclick="loadView('studentClass')">Abrir</button></div>
    </div>
   </section>
   <aside class="s43-side">
    <section class="s43-side-card"><h3>📅 Próxima aula</h3><p>Somente a próxima aula registrada pelo Teacher.</p>${next?`<div class="s43-mini"><span>${x44(next.lesson_title||'Aula')}</span><b>${new Date(next.session_date).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR')}</b></div><div style="font-size:9px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:7px">${dt44(next.session_date)} · ${x44(cmap.get(next.class_id)?.name||'Class')}</div>`:'<div class="s43-empty">Nenhuma próxima aula registrada.</div>'}</section>
    <section class="s43-side-card"><h3>📈 Meu progresso</h3><p>Resumo do currículo.</p><div class="progress" style="margin:8px 0 12px"><i style="width:${prog.overall||0}%"></i></div><div class="s43-mini"><span>Lessons concluídas</span><b>${prog.done||0}</b></div><div class="s43-mini"><span>Total</span><b>${prog.total||0}</b></div></section>
   </aside>
  </div>
 </div>`;
};
})();
</script>



<style id="tic-v45-material-center">
/* V45 — Materials are a separate Class Center area.
   Class Materials use tic_class_material_links and are NOT converted into Assignments. */
.v45-material-wrap{display:grid;gap:15px}
.v45-material-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.v45-material-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.v45-material-banner{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f4efff,#fbfaff);border:1px solid #e3d9f8;border-radius:16px;padding:14px 16px;color:#655a77;font-size:11px}
.v45-material-banner b{color:#4f299f}
.v45-material-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:13px}
.v45-material-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e8e2f1;border-radius:18px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 7px 22px rgba(46,28,81,.055);transition:.18s;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:11px}
.v45-material-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(46,28,81,.09)}
.v45-material-card-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:10px}
.v45-material-icon{width:43px;height:43px;border-radius:13px;background:#f0eaff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:21px;flex:0 0 43px}
.v45-material-card h3{font:800 15px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin:0;line-height:1.25}
.v45-material-card p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;line-height:1.5}
.v45-material-links{display:grid;gap:7px;margin-top:2px}
.v45-material-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;background:#faf9fd;border:1px solid #eeeaf4;border-radius:11px;padding:9px 10px;text-decoration:none;color:inherit}
.v45-material-link:hover{border-color:#d8ccf1;background:#f7f3ff}
.v45-material-link .mini-icon{width:29px;height:29px;border-radius:8px;background:#eee7ff;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 29px;font-size:13px}
.v45-material-link .link-copy{min-width:0;flex:1}.v45-material-link b{display:block;font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.v45-material-link small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:8px;margin-top:2px}
.v45-material-card-footer{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:auto;padding-top:2px}
.v45-material-empty{padding:38px 18px;text-align:center;border:1px dashed #dcd3eb;border-radius:16px;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;background:#fcfbfe}
.v45-material-counts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
.v45-material-count{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e8e2f1;border-radius:14px;padding:12px}.v45-material-count span{font-size:9px;color:var(--muted)}.v45-material-count b{display:block;font:800 20px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin-top:3px}
.v45-multi-help{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:5px}
.v45-audience-box{border:1px solid #e7e0f1;border-radius:13px;padding:12px;background:#fbf9fe}
@media(max-width:850px){.v45-material-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.v45-material-counts{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}}
@media(max-width:560px){.v45-material-counts{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>

<script id="tic-v45-material-center-js">
(function(){
'use strict';

const e45=v=>{try{return typeof esc==='function'?esc(v??''):String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,m=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[m]))}catch(_){return String(v??'')}};
const icon45=t=>{const x=String(t||'link').toLowerCase();return x==='pdf'?'📄':x==='video'?'🎬':x==='audio'?'🎧':x==='file'?'📎':x==='worksheet'?'📝':x==='drive'?'📁':x==='doc'?'📃':'🔗'};
const label45=t=>({pdf:'PDF',video:'Vídeo',audio:'Áudio',file:'Arquivo',worksheet:'Worksheet',drive:'Drive',doc:'Documento',link:'Link'})[String(t||'link').toLowerCase()]||String(t||'Link');

async function fetchClassMaterials45(classId){
  const {data,error}=await sb.from('tic_class_material_links')
    .select('id,class_id,title,url,material_type,note,position,created_at,updated_at')
    .eq('class_id',classId)
    .order('position',{ascending:true})
    .order('created_at',{ascending:false});
  return {data:data||[],error};
}

function renderMaterialCards45(rows){
  /* Group consecutive links with the same title/note into a single beautiful card. */
  const groups=[];
  const map=new Map();
  (rows||[]).forEach(r=>{
    const key=`${r.title||'Material'}|${r.note||''}`;
    let g=map.get(key);
    if(!g){g={title:r.title||'Material',note:r.note||'',links:[],created_at:r.created_at};map.set(key,g);groups.push(g)}
    g.links.push(r);
  });
  return groups.map(g=>`
    <article class="v45-material-card">
      <div class="v45-material-card-top">
        <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;min-width:0">
          <span class="v45-material-icon">${icon45(g.links[0]?.material_type)}</span>
          <div style="min-width:0"><h3>${e45(g.title)}</h3><p>${g.links.length} recurso(s) neste material${g.note?' · '+e45(g.note):''}</p></div>
        </div>
        <span class="badge blue">Material</span>
      </div>
      <div class="v45-material-links">
        ${g.links.map(r=>`<a class="v45-material-link" href="${e45(r.url||'#')}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
          <span class="mini-icon">${icon45(r.material_type)}</span>
          <span class="link-copy"><b>${e45(r.title||'Abrir recurso')}</b><small>${e45(label45(r.material_type))}</small></span>
          <span style="color:var(--p);font-weight:900">↗</span>
        </a>`).join('')}
      </div>
      <div class="v45-material-card-footer">
        <small style="color:var(--muted);font-size:8px">Adicionado ${g.created_at?new Date(g.created_at).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR'):'—'}</small>
        <span class="badge green">Disponível na Class</span>
      </div>
    </article>`).join('')||`<div class="v45-material-empty" style="grid-column:1/-1">
      <div style="font-size:28px;margin-bottom:8px">📂</div>
      <b>Nenhum material nesta Class ainda.</b>
      <div style="margin-top:5px">Use <b>+ Novo material</b> ou <b>Inserir da biblioteca</b> para adicionar.</div>
    </div>`;
}

window.renderMaterialsTab45=async function renderMaterialsTab45(classId){
  /* The original Class Center shell does not carry data-class-center.
     It uses one #classCenterBody in the active workspace, so target that
     real body instead of returning silently. */
  const root=document.querySelector('.class-center-shell');
  const body = root?.querySelector('#classCenterBody, #ticV41ClassBody')
    || document.getElementById('classCenterBody')
    || document.getElementById('ticV41ClassBody');
  if(!body)return;
  body.innerHTML=`<div class="v45-material-wrap">
    <div class="v45-material-head">
      <div><h3 style="margin:0;font:800 18px 'Plus Jakarta Sans'">📂 Materiais da Class</h3>
        <p style="margin:4px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px">Área exclusiva para materiais. <b>Não cria Task, Assignment ou Lesson.</b></p>
      </div>
      <div class="v45-material-actions">
        <button class="btn primary" onclick="openClassMaterialFormV45('${classId}')">＋ Novo material</button>
        <button class="btn secondary" onclick="openClassMaterialLibraryV45('${classId}')">📚 Inserir da biblioteca</button>
        <button class="btn ghost" onclick="openClassStudentContentChooserV45('${classId}')">👤 Material para aluno</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="v45-material-banner">💡 <b>Como funciona:</b> materiais inseridos aqui ficam vinculados à <b>Class</b>. Você pode colocar vários links/arquivos dentro de um único card. Para uma atribuição individual, use <b>Material para aluno</b>.</div>
    <div id="v45MaterialCounts" class="v45-material-counts"></div>
    <div id="v45MaterialGrid" class="v45-material-grid"><div class="loading">Carregando materiais...</div></div>
  </div>`;
  const {data,error}=await fetchClassMaterials45(classId);
  if(error){$('v45MaterialGrid').innerHTML=`<div class="v45-material-empty">${e45(error.message)}</div>`;return}
  const rows=data||[];
  const types=new Set(rows.map(x=>String(x.material_type||'link').toLowerCase()));
  $('v45MaterialCounts').innerHTML=`
    <div class="v45-material-count"><span>📂 Materiais</span><b>${new Set(rows.map(x=>`${x.title}|${x.note||''}`)).size}</b></div>
    <div class="v45-material-count"><span>🔗 Links/arquivos</span><b>${rows.length}</b></div>
    <div class="v45-material-count"><span>🧩 Tipos usados</span><b>${types.size}</b></div>`;
  $('v45MaterialGrid').innerHTML=renderMaterialCards45(rows);
}

window.openClassMaterialFormV45=function(classId){
  openModal(`📂 Novo material · ${e45(window.__ticClassCenter?.cls?.name||'Class')}`,`
    <form class="form" onsubmit="saveClassMaterialV45(event,'${classId}')">
      <div class="notice"><b>Este formulário cria MATERIAL, não Assignment.</b> O card pode ter vários links, PDFs, vídeos, áudios, Drive ou documentos.</div>
      <div class="field"><label>Nome do material</label><input id="cm45Title" required placeholder="Ex.: A0 — Personal Information"></div>
      <div class="field"><label>Observação / instrução</label><textarea id="cm45Note" rows="2" placeholder="Ex.: Use estes materiais para revisar antes da próxima aula."></textarea></div>
      <div class="resource-box">
        <div class="resource-head"><b>🔗 Links e arquivos deste material</b><button type="button" class="btn secondary" onclick="addResourceRow('cm45Rows')">＋ Adicionar item</button></div>
        <div id="cm45Rows"></div>
        <div class="v45-multi-help">Você pode adicionar quantos itens quiser no mesmo card: PDF + vídeo + áudio + link + Drive etc.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">💾 Salvar material na Class</button></div>
    </form>`);
  renderResourceRows('cm45Rows',[]);
  addResourceRow('cm45Rows');
};

window.saveClassMaterialV45=async function(ev,classId){
  ev.preventDefault();
  const title=$('cm45Title')?.value.trim();
  const note=$('cm45Note')?.value.trim()||null;
  const resources=typeof collectResources==='function'?collectResources('cm45Rows'):[];
  if(!title)return toast('Informe o nome do material.','error');
  if(!resources.length)return toast('Adicione pelo menos um link/arquivo.','error');
  const rows=resources.filter(r=>r.url).map((r,i)=>({
    class_id:classId,
    title:title,
    url:r.url,
    material_type:r.type||'link',
    note:note,
    position:Date.now()+i
  }));
  if(!rows.length)return toast('Cada item precisa ter uma URL/link válido.','error');
  const {error}=await sb.from('tic_class_material_links').insert(rows);
  if(error)return toast('Não foi possível salvar o material: '+error.message,'error');
  closeModal();
  toast(`Material criado com ${rows.length} recurso(s) e disponibilizado na Class.`,'success');
  await renderMaterialsTab45(classId);
};

window.openClassMaterialLibraryV45=async function(classId){
  const {data,error}=await sb.from('tic_materials').select('id,title,level,material_type,resource_items,description,external_url,file_url,created_at').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('created_at',{ascending:false});
  if(error)return toast(error.message,'error');
  openModal('📚 Inserir materiais da biblioteca',`
    <div class="form">
      <div class="notice">Selecione <b>um ou vários materiais</b>. Eles serão copiados para a Class como materiais independentes. Isso <b>não cria Assignment</b>.</div>
      <div class="field"><label>Materiais</label>
        <select id="cm45Library" multiple size="10" style="min-height:230px">
          ${(data||[]).map(x=>`<option value="${x.id}">${e45(x.title)} · ${e45(x.level||'')} · ${e45(x.material_type||'material')}</option>`).join('')||'<option value="">Nenhum material cadastrado</option>'}
        </select>
        <div class="v45-multi-help">Use Ctrl/Cmd para selecionar vários materiais.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="field"><label>Observação para a Class</label><textarea id="cm45LibraryNote" rows="2" placeholder="Opcional"></textarea></div>
      <div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary" onclick="insertClassLibraryMaterialsV45('${classId}')">📂 Inserir selecionados</button></div>
    </div>`);
};

window.insertClassLibraryMaterialsV45=async function(classId){
  const ids=[...($('cm45Library')?.selectedOptions||[])].map(o=>o.value).filter(Boolean);
  if(!ids.length)return toast('Selecione pelo menos um material.','error');
  const {data:materials,error}=await sb.from('tic_materials').select('id,title,material_type,resource_items,description,external_url,file_url').in('id',ids).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);
  if(error)return toast(error.message,'error');
  const note=$('cm45LibraryNote')?.value.trim()||null;
  const rows=[];
  (materials||[]).forEach(m=>{
    let rs=Array.isArray(m.resource_items)?m.resource_items.filter(r=>r?.url):[];
    if(!rs.length&&(m.external_url||m.file_url))rs=[{type:m.material_type||'link',title:m.title,url:m.external_url||m.file_url}];
    rs.forEach((r,i)=>rows.push({class_id:classId,title:m.title,url:r.url,material_type:r.type||m.material_type||'link',note:note||m.description||null,position:Date.now()+rows.length}));
  });
  if(!rows.length)return toast('Os materiais selecionados não possuem links/arquivos para inserir.','error');
  const {error:ie}=await sb.from('tic_class_material_links').insert(rows);
  if(ie)return toast('Não foi possível inserir os materiais: '+ie.message,'error');
  closeModal();toast(`${ids.length} material(is) inserido(s) na Class com ${rows.length} recurso(s).`,'success');await renderMaterialsTab45(classId);
};

window.openClassStudentContentChooserV45=async function(classId){
  /* Reuse the existing individual-content flow, but open it from Materials
     and explain that it is a private/student-specific assignment. */
  const {data:students}=await sb.from('tic_class_students').select('student_id').eq('class_id',classId).eq('status','active');
  const ids=(students||[]).map(x=>x.student_id);
  const {data:people}=ids.length?await sb.from('tic_students').select('id,display_name,current_level,email').in('id',ids).order('display_name'):({data:[]});
  if(!people?.length)return toast('Não há alunos ativos nesta Class.','info');
  openModal('👤 Material para aluno específico',`
    <div class="form">
      <div class="notice">Este caminho cria uma <b>atribuição individual</b>. O material ficará somente para o aluno escolhido e não aparecerá como material geral da Class.</div>
      <div class="field"><label>Aluno</label><select id="cm45Student">${people.map(x=>`<option value="${x.id}">${e45(x.display_name)} · ${e45(x.current_level||'')}</option>`).join('')}</select></div>
      <div class="field"><label>Material</label><select id="cm45StudentMaterial"></select></div>
      <div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary" onclick="insertIndividualMaterialV45('${classId}')">📤 Enviar para este aluno</button></div>
    </div>`);
  const {data:mats}=await sb.from('tic_materials').select('id,title,level,material_type').eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).order('created_at',{ascending:false});
  $('cm45StudentMaterial').innerHTML=(mats||[]).map(m=>`<option value="${m.id}">${e45(m.title)} · ${e45(m.level||'')}</option>`).join('')||'<option value="">Nenhum material</option>';
};

window.insertIndividualMaterialV45=async function(classId){
  const studentId=$('cm45Student')?.value, materialId=$('cm45StudentMaterial')?.value;
  if(!studentId||!materialId)return toast('Selecione aluno e material.','error');
  /* Use the existing individual attribution mechanism; it stays separate from
     class-wide tic_class_material_links. */
  const {data:source,error}=await sb.from('tic_materials').select('*').eq('id',materialId).eq('teacher_id',session.user.id).maybeSingle();
  if(error||!source)return toast('Material não encontrado.','error');
  const payload={
    teacher_id:session.user.id,class_id:classId,title:source.title,
    instructions:source.description||'',assignment_type:'material',due_at:null,points:0,
    priority:'normal',resource_items:Array.isArray(source.resource_items)?source.resource_items:[],
    cover_image_url:source.cover_image_url||null,source_type:'material',source_id:source.id
  };
  const {data:a,error:ae}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').insert(payload).select().single();
  if(ae)return toast('Não foi possível criar a atribuição individual: '+ae.message,'error');
  const {error:te}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').insert({assignment_id:a.id,student_id:studentId,status:'pending'});
  if(te){await sb.from('tic_assignments').delete().eq('id',a.id);return toast('Não foi possível enviar ao aluno: '+te.message,'error');}
  closeModal();toast(`Material “${source.title}” enviado somente para o aluno.`,'success');
};

window.deleteClassMaterialV45=async function(id,classId){
  if(!confirm('Remover este material desta Class? O material original da biblioteca não será apagado.'))return;
  const {error}=await sb.from('tic_class_material_links').delete().eq('id',id).eq('class_id',classId);
  if(error)return toast(error.message,'error');
  toast('Item removido da Class.','success');renderMaterialsTab45(classId);
};

/* Override only the Materials tab. All other Class Center tabs keep the existing implementation. */
const oldClassCenterTabV45=window.classCenterTab;
window.classCenterTab=async function(classId,tab){
  if(tab==='materials'){
    const root=document.querySelector('.class-center-shell');
    if(root)root.querySelectorAll('.class-center-tabs button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.tab===tab));
    document.querySelectorAll('.class-center-tabs button').forEach(b=>{
      if(b.dataset.tab) b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.tab===tab);
    });
    await renderMaterialsTab45(classId);
    return;
  }
  return oldClassCenterTabV45.apply(this,arguments);
};
})();
</script>



<script id="tic-v46-material-visible-action">
(function(){
  function addVisibleMaterialAction(){
    const shell=document.querySelector('.class-center-shell');
    if(!shell)return;
    const actions=shell.querySelector('.class-center-actions');
    if(!actions || actions.querySelector('[data-v46-material-action]'))return;
    const b=document.createElement('button');
    b.className='btn primary';
    b.setAttribute('data-v46-material-action','1');
    b.innerHTML='📂＋ Material';
    b.onclick=function(){
      const id=window.__ticClassCenter?.classId;
      if(id)openClassMaterialFormV45(id);
    };
    actions.insertBefore(b,actions.firstChild);
  }
  window.addEventListener('load',addVisibleMaterialAction);
  const old=window.classCenterTab;
  window.classCenterTab=async function(classId,tab){
    const r=await old.apply(this,arguments);
    addVisibleMaterialAction();
    if(tab==='materials'){
      const body=document.getElementById('classCenterBody') || document.getElementById('ticV41ClassBody');
      if(body && !body.querySelector('.v45-material-wrap') && typeof renderMaterialsTab45==='function'){
        await renderMaterialsTab45(classId);
      }
    }
    return r;
  };
})();
</script>



<style id="tic-v49-private-materials">
.v49-private-wrap{display:grid;gap:16px}
.v49-private-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.v49-private-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.v49-private-banner{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f4efff,#fbfaff);border:1px solid #e3d9f8;border-radius:16px;padding:14px 16px;color:#655a77;font-size:11px}
.v49-private-banner b{color:#4f299f}
.v49-private-kpis{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
.v49-private-kpi{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e8e2f1;border-radius:14px;padding:13px}
.v49-private-kpi span{font-size:9px;color:var(--muted)}
.v49-private-kpi b{display:block;font:800 21px 'Plus Jakarta Sans';margin-top:4px}
.v49-private-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:13px}
.v49-private-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #e8e2f1;border-radius:18px;padding:16px;box-shadow:0 7px 22px rgba(46,28,81,.055)}
.v49-private-card-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start}
.v49-private-icon{width:43px;height:43px;border-radius:13px;background:#f0eaff;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:21px}
.v49-private-card h3{margin:0;font:800 15px 'Plus Jakarta Sans'}
.v49-private-card p{margin:4px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px;line-height:1.5}
.v49-private-links{display:grid;gap:7px;margin-top:12px}
.v49-private-link{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;background:#faf9fd;border:1px solid #eeeaf4;border-radius:11px;padding:9px 10px;text-decoration:none;color:inherit}
.v49-private-link .mini{width:29px;height:29px;border-radius:8px;background:#eee7ff;display:grid;place-items:center}
.v49-private-link .copy{min-width:0;flex:1}
.v49-private-link b{display:block;font-size:10px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.v49-private-link small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-size:8px;margin-top:2px}
.v49-private-footer{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-top:12px}
.v49-private-empty{padding:34px 18px;text-align:center;border:1px dashed #dcd3eb;border-radius:16px;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;background:#fcfbfe;grid-column:1/-1}
@media(max-width:850px){.v49-private-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media(max-width:650px){.v49-private-kpis{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
</style>

<script id="tic-v49-private-materials-js">
(function(){
'use strict';

const e49=v=>{try{return typeof esc==='function'?esc(v??''):String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,m=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[m]))}catch(_){return String(v??'')}};
const icon49=t=>{const x=String(t||'link').toLowerCase();return x==='pdf'?'📄':x==='video'?'🎬':x==='audio'?'🎧':x==='file'?'📎':x==='worksheet'?'📝':x==='drive'?'📁':x==='doc'?'📃':'🔗'};

async function getClassStudentIds49(classId){
  const {data,error}=await sb.from('tic_class_students')
    .select('student_id,status')
    .eq('class_id',classId)
    .eq('status','active');
  if(error) return {ids:[],error};
  return {ids:(data||[]).map(x=>x.student_id),error:null};
}

async function getClassStudents49(classId){
  const {ids,error}=await getClassStudentIds49(classId);
  if(error||!ids.length)return {data:[],error};
  return await sb.from('tic_students')
    .select('id,display_name,current_level,email,status')
    .in('id',ids)
    .order('display_name');
}

function renderPrivateCards49(rows){
  const groups=new Map();
  (rows||[]).forEach(x=>{
    const a=x.tic_assignments||{};
    const key=x.assignment_id||a.id;
    if(!groups.has(key)){
      groups.set(key,{assignmentId:key,title:a.title||'Material',student:x.tic_students||{},instructions:a.instructions||'',created_at:a.created_at,items:Array.isArray(a.resource_items)?a.resource_items:[]});
    }
  });
  const list=[...groups.values()];
  if(!list.length)return `<div class="v49-private-empty">
    <div style="font-size:28px;margin-bottom:8px">👤</div>
    <b>Nenhum material individual ainda.</b>
    <div style="margin-top:5px">Use <b>＋ Novo material para aluno</b> ou <b>📚 Inserir material existente</b>.</div>
  </div>`;
  return list.map(g=>`
    <article class="v49-private-card">
      <div class="v49-private-card-top">
        <div style="display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;min-width:0">
          <span class="v49-private-icon">👤</span>
          <div style="min-width:0">
            <h3>${e49(g.title)}</h3>
            <p>Para: <b>${e49(g.student?.display_name||'Aluno')}</b>${g.student?.current_level?' · '+e49(g.student.current_level):''}</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <span class="badge purple">Individual</span>
      </div>
      ${g.instructions?`<p style="margin-top:10px">${e49(g.instructions)}</p>`:''}
      <div class="v49-private-links">
        ${(g.items||[]).map(r=>`
          <a class="v49-private-link" href="${e49(r.url||r.link||'#')}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
            <span class="mini">${icon49(r.type)}</span>
            <span class="copy"><b>${e49(r.title||'Abrir recurso')}</b><small>${e49(r.type||'link')}</small></span>
            <span style="color:var(--p);font-weight:900">↗</span>
          </a>`).join('')||'<small style="color:var(--muted)">Este material não possui links/arquivos.</small>'}
      </div>
      <div class="v49-private-footer">
        <small style="color:var(--muted);font-size:8px">${g.created_at?new Date(g.created_at).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR'):'—'}</small>
        <span class="badge green">Somente este aluno</span>
      </div>
    </article>`).join('');
}

window.renderPrivateMaterialsV49=async function(classId){
  const body=document.getElementById('ticV41ClassBody')||document.getElementById('classCenterBody');
  if(!body)return;
  body.innerHTML=`<div class="v49-private-wrap">
    <div class="v49-private-head">
      <div>
        <h3 style="margin:0;font:800 18px 'Plus Jakarta Sans'">👤 Materiais exclusivos por aluno</h3>
        <p style="margin:4px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:10px">Crie ou envie materiais com vários links/arquivos para <b>um aluno específico</b>. Não publica para a Class inteira.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="v49-private-actions">
        <button class="btn primary" onclick="openPrivateMaterialFormV49('${classId}')">＋ Novo material para aluno</button>
        <button class="btn secondary" onclick="openPrivateMaterialLibraryV49('${classId}')">📚 Inserir material existente</button>
        <button class="btn ghost" onclick="openClassStudentContent('${classId}',window.__ticClassCenterV41?.students?.[0]?.id||'')">👤 Atribuir conteúdo</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="v49-private-banner">💡 <b>Regra desta área:</b> o material é criado como conteúdo do tipo <b>Material</b> e vinculado ao aluno escolhido. Outros alunos não recebem. Você pode reutilizar o mesmo material da biblioteca para alunos diferentes.</div>
    <div id="v49PrivateKpis" class="v49-private-kpis"></div>
    <div id="v49PrivateGrid" class="v49-private-grid"><div class="loading">Carregando...</div></div>
  </div>`;

  const {data:members,error}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments')
    .select('id,assignment_id,student_id,status,tic_students(id,display_name,current_level),tic_assignments(id,title,instructions,assignment_type,class_id,resource_items,created_at,source_type,source_id)')
    .eq('status','pending');

  if(error){
    $('v49PrivateGrid').innerHTML=`<div class="v49-private-empty">${e49(error.message)}</div>`;
    return;
  }

  const rows=(members||[]).filter(x=>{
    const a=x.tic_assignments||{};
    return a.class_id===classId && String(a.assignment_type||'').toLowerCase()==='material';
  });

  const students=new Set(rows.map(x=>x.student_id));
  const resources=rows.reduce((n,x)=>n+(Array.isArray(x.tic_assignments?.resource_items)?x.tic_assignments.resource_items.length:0),0);
  $('v49PrivateKpis').innerHTML=`
    <div class="v49-private-kpi"><span>👤 Alunos com material</span><b>${students.size}</b></div>
    <div class="v49-private-kpi"><span>📂 Materiais individuais</span><b>${rows.length}</b></div>
    <div class="v49-private-kpi"><span>🔗 Links/arquivos</span><b>${resources}</b></div>`;
  $('v49PrivateGrid').innerHTML=renderPrivateCards49(rows);
};

window.openPrivateMaterialFormV49=async function(classId){
  const {data:students,error}=await getClassStudents49(classId);
  if(error)return toast(error.message,'error');
  if(!students?.length)return toast('Adicione pelo menos um aluno à Class antes de enviar material individual.','info');

  openModal('👤 Novo material exclusivo para aluno',`
    <form class="form" onsubmit="savePrivateMaterialV49(event,'${classId}')">
      <div class="notice"><b>Somente o aluno escolhido receberá este material.</b> Você pode adicionar vários links/arquivos no mesmo card.</div>
      <div class="field"><label>Aluno destinatário</label>
        <select id="v49PrivateStudent" required>
          ${students.map(s=>`<option value="${s.id}">${e49(s.display_name)} · ${e49(s.current_level||'')} ${s.email?'· '+e49(s.email):''}</option>`).join('')}
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="field"><label>Nome do material</label><input id="v49PrivateTitle" required placeholder="Ex.: Review — Personal Information"></div>
      <div class="field"><label>Mensagem / instrução</label><textarea id="v49PrivateNote" rows="2" placeholder="Ex.: Faça estes materiais antes da próxima aula."></textarea></div>
      <div class="resource-box">
        <div class="resource-head"><b>🔗 Links e arquivos</b><button type="button" class="btn secondary" onclick="addResourceRow('v49PrivateRows')">＋ Adicionar item</button></div>
        <div id="v49PrivateRows"></div>
        <div class="v49-private-banner" style="margin-top:9px">Você pode misturar PDF + vídeo + áudio + link + Drive + documento.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="modal-actions"><button type="button" class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary">📤 Enviar somente para este aluno</button></div>
    </form>`);
  renderResourceRows('v49PrivateRows',[]);
  addResourceRow('v49PrivateRows');
};

window.savePrivateMaterialV49=async function(ev,classId){
  ev.preventDefault();
  const studentId=$('v49PrivateStudent')?.value;
  const title=$('v49PrivateTitle')?.value.trim();
  const note=$('v49PrivateNote')?.value.trim()||'';
  const resources=typeof collectResources==='function'?collectResources('v49PrivateRows'):[];
  const items=resources.filter(r=>r?.url).map(r=>({type:r.type||'link',title:r.title||r.type||'Recurso',url:r.url,description:r.description||''}));
  if(!studentId)return toast('Selecione o aluno.','error');
  if(!title)return toast('Informe o nome do material.','error');
  if(!items.length)return toast('Adicione pelo menos um link/arquivo.','error');

  const payload={
    teacher_id:session.user.id,
    lesson_id:null,
    class_id:classId,
    title,
    instructions:note,
    assignment_type:'material',
    due_at:null,
    points:0,
    priority:'normal',
    resource_items:items,
    cover_image_url:null,
    source_type:'private_material',
    source_id:null
  };

  const {data:a,error:ae}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').insert(payload).select().single();
  if(ae)return toast('Não foi possível criar o material: '+ae.message,'error');

  const {error:te}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').insert({
    assignment_id:a.id,
    student_id:studentId,
    status:'pending'
  });

  if(te){
    await sb.from('tic_assignments').delete().eq('id',a.id);
    return toast('Não foi possível vincular o material ao aluno: '+te.message,'error');
  }

  closeModal();
  toast(`“${title}” enviado somente para o aluno.`, 'success');
  await renderPrivateMaterialsV49(classId);
};

window.openPrivateMaterialLibraryV49=async function(classId){
  const {data:students,error:se}=await getClassStudents49(classId);
  if(se)return toast(se.message,'error');
  if(!students?.length)return toast('Adicione alunos à Class antes de enviar materiais.','info');

  const {data:mats,error}=await sb.from('tic_materials')
    .select('id,title,level,material_type,resource_items,description,external_url,file_url')
    .eq('teacher_id',session.user.id)
    .order('created_at',{ascending:false});
  if(error)return toast(error.message,'error');

  openModal('📚 Enviar material da biblioteca para aluno',`
    <div class="form">
      <div class="notice">Selecione o <b>aluno</b> e um ou vários materiais. Cada material será entregue <b>somente</b> ao aluno escolhido.</div>
      <div class="field"><label>Aluno destinatário</label>
        <select id="v49LibStudent">${students.map(s=>`<option value="${s.id}">${e49(s.display_name)} · ${e49(s.current_level||'')}</option>`).join('')}</select>
      </div>
      <div class="field"><label>Materiais da biblioteca</label>
        <select id="v49LibMaterials" multiple size="10" style="min-height:230px">
          ${(mats||[]).map(m=>`<option value="${m.id}">${e49(m.title)} · ${e49(m.level||'')} · ${e49(m.material_type||'material')}</option>`).join('')||'<option value="">Nenhum material cadastrado</option>'}
        </select>
        <div class="v45-multi-help">Use Ctrl/Cmd para selecionar vários.</div>
      </div>
      <div class="field"><label>Mensagem opcional</label><textarea id="v49LibNote" rows="2" placeholder="Ex.: Material complementar para esta semana."></textarea></div>
      <div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Cancelar</button><button class="btn primary" onclick="sendLibraryMaterialsV49('${classId}')">📤 Enviar para este aluno</button></div>
    </div>`);
};

window.sendLibraryMaterialsV49=async function(classId){
  const studentId=$('v49LibStudent')?.value;
  const ids=[...($('v49LibMaterials')?.selectedOptions||[])].map(o=>o.value).filter(Boolean);
  const note=$('v49LibNote')?.value.trim()||'';
  if(!studentId)return toast('Selecione o aluno.','error');
  if(!ids.length)return toast('Selecione pelo menos um material.','error');

  const {data:mats,error}=await sb.from('tic_materials')
    .select('id,title,material_type,resource_items,description,external_url,file_url')
    .in('id',ids)
    .eq('teacher_id',session.user.id);
  if(error)return toast(error.message,'error');

  let sent=0;
  for(const m of (mats||[])){
    let items=Array.isArray(m.resource_items)?m.resource_items.filter(r=>r?.url):[];
    if(!items.length && (m.external_url||m.file_url)){
      items=[{type:m.material_type||'link',title:m.title,url:m.external_url||m.file_url}];
    }
    if(!items.length)continue;

    const {data:a,error:ae}=await sb.from('tic_assignments').insert({
      teacher_id:session.user.id,lesson_id:null,class_id:classId,
      title:m.title,instructions:note||m.description||'',
      assignment_type:'material',due_at:null,points:0,priority:'normal',
      resource_items:items,cover_image_url:null,
      source_type:'private_material',source_id:m.id
    }).select().single();

    if(ae)continue;

    const {error:te}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').insert({
      assignment_id:a.id,student_id:studentId,status:'pending'
    });

    if(te){
      await sb.from('tic_assignments').delete().eq('id',a.id);
      continue;
    }
    sent++;
  }

  if(!sent)return toast('Nenhum dos materiais selecionados possui links/arquivos válidos para enviar.','error');
  closeModal();
  toast(`${sent} material(is) enviado(s) somente para o aluno.`,'success');
  await renderPrivateMaterialsV49(classId);
};

/* The real Class Center uses classCenterTabV41, not classCenterTab.
   This override is deliberately limited to the Materials tab. */
const oldClassCenterTabV49=window.classCenterTabV41;
if(typeof oldClassCenterTabV49==='function'){
  window.classCenterTabV41=async function(classId,tab){
    if(tab==='materials'){
      await renderPrivateMaterialsV49(classId);
      return;
    }
    return oldClassCenterTabV49.apply(this,arguments);
  };
}

/* Extra click delegation protects against cached/previous tab handlers.
   Only the Materials button is intercepted. */
document.addEventListener('click',function(ev){
  const b=ev.target.closest?.('.v41-tabs button[data-tab="materials"]');
  if(!b)return;
  const shell=b.closest('.v41-class-shell');
  const classId=shell?.getAttribute('data-v41-class');
  if(!classId)return;
  ev.preventDefault();
  ev.stopImmediatePropagation();
  document.querySelectorAll('.v41-tabs button').forEach(x=>x.classList.toggle('active',x===b));
  renderPrivateMaterialsV49(classId);
},true);

})();
</script>

<script id="tic-v51-student-materials-js">
(function(){
'use strict';
const x51=v=>typeof x44==='function'?x44(v??''):String(v??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,m=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[m]));
const icon51=t=>{t=String(t||'link').toLowerCase();return t==='pdf'?'📄':t==='video'?'🎬':t==='audio'?'🎧':t==='file'?'📎':t==='worksheet'?'📝':t==='drive'?'📁':'🔗'};

window.openStudentMaterialV51=async function(taskAssignmentId){
 const s=await studentRecord();if(!s)return;
 const {data:x,error}=await sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,status,assigned_at,completed_at,student_id,assignment_id,tic_assignments(id,title,instructions,due_at,points,resource_items,cover_image_url,assignment_type,active,class_id,created_at)').eq('id',taskAssignmentId).eq('student_id',s.id).eq('active',true).maybeSingle();
 if(error||!x)return toast(error?.message||'Material não encontrado ou não está disponível para você.','error');
 const a=x.tic_assignments||{};
 if(String(a.assignment_type||'').toLowerCase()!=='material')return toast('Este conteúdo não é um Material.','error');
 const resources=Array.isArray(a.resource_items)?a.resource_items.filter(r=>r&&r.url):[];
 openModal('📂 '+x51(a.title||'Material'),`<div class="form">
   ${a.cover_image_url?`<img src="${x51(a.cover_image_url)}" style="width:100%;max-height:210px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:14px;margin-bottom:12px">`:''}
   <div class="notice success"><b>Material destinado a você.</b>${a.due_at?` Prazo informativo: ${fmtDate(a.due_at)}.`:''}</div>
   ${a.instructions?`<div class="card" style="padding:13px;margin:10px 0"><b>Instruções</b><p style="margin:6px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:11px;line-height:1.6">${x51(a.instructions)}</p></div>`:''}
   <div class="section-head" style="margin-top:12px"><div><h3>🔗 Recursos deste material</h3><span>${resources.length} item(ns)</span></div></div>
   <div class="v51-resource-grid">${resources.map(r=>`<div class="v51-resource-row"><span style="font-size:20px">${icon51(r.type)}</span><div><b>${x51(r.title||'Abrir recurso')}</b><small>${x51(r.type||'link')}${r.description?' · '+x51(r.description):''}</small></div><a class="btn sm primary" href="${x51(r.url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">Abrir ↗</a></div>`).join('')||'<div class="empty">Este material não possui recursos disponíveis.</div>'}</div>
   <div class="modal-actions"><button class="btn ghost" onclick="closeModal()">Fechar</button></div>
 </div>`);
};

window.studentClassPage=async function(){
 const s=await studentRecord();
 if(!s){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="card empty">Sua conta ainda não está vinculada a um cadastro de aluno pelo Teacher.</div>';return}
 const {data:members,error:me}=await sb.from('tic_class_students').select('class_id,status').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('status','active');
 if(me){$('content').innerHTML=`<div class="card attention">${x51(me.message)}</div>`;return}
 const ids=[...(members||[]).map(m=>m.class_id).filter(Boolean)];
 if(!ids.length){$('content').innerHTML='<div class="v44-empty">🏫 Você ainda não está em uma Class.</div>';return}
 const [{data:classes},{data:sessions},{data:links},{data:allAssignments},{data:tas},{data:boards}]=await Promise.all([
   sb.from('tic_classes').select('id,name,level,schedule_text,meeting_url,status').in('id',ids).eq('status','active').order('name'),
   sb.from('tic_class_sessions').select('id,class_id,session_date,duration_minutes,lesson_title,summary,status').in('class_id',ids).order('session_date',{ascending:false}).limit(100),
   sb.from('tic_class_material_links').select('id,class_id,title,url,material_type,note,position,created_at').in('class_id',ids).order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(100),
   sb.from('tic_assignments').select('id,title,instructions,assignment_type,due_at,points,priority,class_id,resource_items,cover_image_url,cefr_level,skill,created_at').in('class_id',ids).order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(200),
   sb.from('tic_task_assignments').select('id,assignment_id,status,due_at,active,assigned_at,completed_at').eq('student_id',s.id).eq('active',true).order('assigned_at',{ascending:false}).limit(200),
   sb.from('tic_class_board_items').select('id,class_id,title,description,item_type,status,position,created_at').in('class_id',ids).order('position').order('created_at',{ascending:false}).limit(100)
 ]);
 const cls=classes||[],map=new Map(cls.map(c=>[c.id,c])),taMap=new Map((tas||[]).map(t=>[t.assignment_id,t])),assignmentMap=new Map((allAssignments||[]).map(a=>[a.id,a]));
 let selected=cls[0]?.id||'';
 const go=name=>{document.querySelectorAll('[data-v44cp]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.v44cp===name));document.querySelectorAll('[data-v44pane]').forEach(p=>p.classList.toggle('active',p.dataset.v44pane===name));};
 const render=()=>{
  const c=map.get(selected)||cls[0];if(!c)return;selected=c.id;
  const cs=(sessions||[]).filter(x=>x.class_id===c.id),now=new Date(),past=cs.filter(x=>new Date(x.session_date)<now).sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.session_date)-new Date(a.session_date)),next=cs.filter(x=>new Date(x.session_date)>=now).sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.session_date)-new Date(b.session_date))[0];
  const rs=(links||[]).filter(x=>x.class_id===c.id);
  const as=(allAssignments||[]).filter(x=>x.class_id===c.id);
  const lessons=as.filter(x=>String(x.assignment_type||'').toLowerCase()==='lesson');
  /* CRITICAL: Materials are now ONLY materials assigned to this student. */
  const materials=as.filter(x=>String(x.assignment_type||'').toLowerCase()==='material' && taMap.has(x.id));
  const tasks=as.filter(x=>!['lesson','material'].includes(String(x.assignment_type||'').toLowerCase()));
  const myTasks=tasks.filter(x=>taMap.has(x.id));
  const bi=(boards||[]).filter(x=>x.class_id===c.id);
  setPage('My Class',`${c.name} · conteúdo separado por categoria`);
  $('content').innerHTML=`<div class="v44-class-page">
   <div class="v44-class-hero"><div><span class="eyebrow" style="color:#fff">MY CLASS</span><h2>🏫 ${x51(c.name)}</h2><p>${x51(c.level||'')} ${c.schedule_text?'· '+x51(c.schedule_text):''}</p></div><select id="v44ClassSelect" class="v44-class-select">${cls.map(z=>`<option value="${z.id}" ${z.id===c.id?'selected':''}>${x51(z.name)} · ${x51(z.level||'')}</option>`).join('')}</select></div>
   <div class="v44-kpis"><div class="v44-kpi"><span>📖 Aulas anteriores</span><b>${past.length}</b></div><div class="v44-kpi"><span>📚 Lessons da Class</span><b>${lessons.length}</b></div><div class="v44-kpi"><span>🔗 Resources</span><b>${rs.length}</b></div><div class="v44-kpi"><span>📂 Meus materiais</span><b>${materials.length}</b></div></div>
   <nav class="v44-class-nav"><button class="active" data-v44cp="home">🏠 Visão geral</button><button data-v44cp="lessons">📚 Lessons</button><button data-v44cp="materials">📂 Materials</button><button data-v44cp="resources">🔗 Resources</button><button data-v44cp="tasks">📝 Minhas tarefas</button><button data-v44cp="previous">📖 Aulas anteriores</button><button data-v44cp="board">📌 Board</button></nav>
   <section class="v44-class-pane active" data-v44pane="home"><div class="v44-class-grid"><div class="v44-card"><h3>📅 Próxima aula</h3><p class="desc">Somente a próxima aula registrada pelo Teacher.</p>${next?`<div class="v44-row"><div class="v44-row-icon">📅</div><div class="v44-row-main"><b>${x51(next.lesson_title||'Aula')}</b><small>${dt44(next.session_date)} · ${next.duration_minutes||'—'} min</small></div>${c.meeting_url?`<a class="btn sm primary" href="${x51(c.meeting_url)}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Entrar ↗</a>`:''}</div>`:'<div class="v44-empty">Nenhuma próxima aula registrada.</div>'}</div><div class="v44-card"><h3>🏫 Minha Class</h3><p class="desc">Informações da turma, sem misturar conteúdos.</p><div class="v44-row"><div class="v44-row-icon">🏫</div><div class="v44-row-main"><b>${x51(c.name)}</b><small>${x51(c.level||'')} · ${x51(c.schedule_text||'Horário não definido')}</small></div></div></div></div></section>
   <section class="v44-class-pane" data-v44pane="lessons"><div class="v44-card"><h3>📚 Lessons</h3><p class="desc">Somente conteúdos classificados como Lesson para esta Class.</p><div class="v44-list">${lessons.map(a=>`<div class="v44-row" style="cursor:pointer" onclick="viewStudentLessonAssignmentV51('${a.id}')"><div class="v44-row-icon">📚</div><div class="v44-row-main"><b>${x51(a.title)}</b><small>Lesson${a.cefr_level?' · '+x51(a.cefr_level):''}${a.skill?' · '+x51(a.skill):''}</small></div><span class="badge green">Abrir ↗</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="v44-empty">Nenhuma Lesson foi disponibilizada para esta Class.</div>'}</div></div></section>
   <section class="v44-class-pane" data-v44pane="materials"><div class="v44-card"><div class="section-head"><div><h3>📂 Materials</h3><p class="desc">Somente materiais atribuídos especificamente a você pelo Teacher.</p></div><span class="badge blue">${materials.length}</span></div><div class="v44-list">${materials.map(a=>{const ta=taMap.get(a.id),count=Array.isArray(a.resource_items)?a.resource_items.filter(r=>r&&r.url).length:0;return `<div class="v51-material-card" onclick="openStudentMaterialV51('${ta.id}')"><span class="v51-material-icon">📂</span><div class="v51-material-main"><b>${x51(a.title)}</b><small>${count} recurso(s) · ${a.created_at?dt44(a.created_at):'Material'}</small></div><span class="v51-material-private">Somente para você</span><span class="v51-material-open">Abrir ↗</span></div>`}).join('')||'<div class="v44-empty">Nenhum Material foi atribuído especificamente para você nesta Class.</div>'}</div></div></section>
   <section class="v44-class-pane" data-v44pane="resources"><div class="v44-card"><h3>🔗 Resources</h3><p class="desc">Somente links/arquivos publicados como Resource para a Class inteira.</p><div class="v44-list">${rs.map(r=>`<div class="v44-row"><div class="v44-row-icon">${String(r.material_type||'').toLowerCase()==='video'?'🎬':String(r.material_type||'').toLowerCase()==='audio'?'🎧':String(r.material_type||'').toLowerCase()==='pdf'?'📄':'🔗'}</div><div class="v44-row-main"><b>${x51(r.title)}</b><small>${x51(r.material_type||'link')}${r.note?' · '+x51(r.note):''}</small></div><a class="btn sm secondary" href="${x51(r.url||'#')}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Abrir ↗</a></div>`).join('')||'<div class="v44-empty">Nenhum Resource foi disponibilizado para esta Class.</div>'}</div></div></section>
   <section class="v44-class-pane" data-v44pane="tasks"><div class="v44-card"><h3>📝 Minhas tarefas</h3><p class="desc">Somente Assignments que foram atribuídos a você nesta Class.</p><div class="v44-list">${myTasks.map(a=>{const t=taMap.get(a.id);return `<div class="v44-row"><div class="v44-row-icon">📝</div><div class="v44-row-main"><b>${x51(a.title)}</b><small>${typ44(a.assignment_type)} · ${a.due_at?'Prazo '+dt44(a.due_at):'Sem prazo'}${a.skill?' · '+x51(a.skill):''}</small></div>${typeof badge==='function'?badge(t?.status||'pending'):'<span class="badge yellow">Pendente</span>'}</div>`}).join('')||'<div class="v44-empty">Nenhuma tarefa atribuída a você nesta Class.</div>'}</div></div></section>
   <section class="v44-class-pane" data-v44pane="previous"><div class="v44-card"><h3>📖 Aulas anteriores</h3><p class="desc">Somente aulas que o Teacher registrou em Class → Aulas.</p><div class="v44-list">${past.map(a=>`<div class="v44-session"><div class="v44-date"><b>${new Date(a.session_date).getDate()}</b><small>${new Date(a.session_date).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR',{month:'short'}).replace('.','')}</small></div><div><b>${x51(a.lesson_title||'Aula')}</b><small>${dt44(a.session_date)} · ${a.duration_minutes||'—'} min${a.summary?' · '+x51(a.summary):''}</small></div><span class="badge ${a.status==='completed'?'green':'blue'}">${x51(a.status||'Registrada')}</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="v44-empty">Nenhuma aula anterior foi registrada pelo Teacher.</div>'}</div></div></section>
   <section class="v44-class-pane" data-v44pane="board"><div class="v44-card"><h3>📌 Board</h3><p class="desc">Somente avisos e itens publicados no Board desta Class.</p><div class="v44-list">${bi.map(b=>`<div class="v44-row"><div class="v44-row-icon">📌</div><div class="v44-row-main"><b>${x51(b.title)}</b><small>${x51(b.description||'')}${b.item_type?' · '+x51(b.item_type):''}</small></div><span class="badge ${b.status==='completed'?'green':b.status==='in_progress'?'yellow':'blue'}">${x51(b.status||'Publicado')}</span></div>`).join('')||'<div class="v44-empty">Nenhum item no Board.</div>'}</div></div></section>
  </div>`;
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-v44cp]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>go(b.dataset.v44cp)));
  $('v44ClassSelect')?.addEventListener('change',ev=>{selected=ev.target.value;render()});
 };
 render();
};

 if(x.tic_assignments?.lesson_id&&typeof viewStudentLessonInteractive==='function')return viewStudentLessonInteractive(x.tic_assignments.lesson_id);
 if(typeof openStudentTask==='function')return openStudentTask(x.id);
};
})();
